schemes.title: Farmer ID (Kisan Pehchaan Patra) — AgriStack Farmer Registry
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (Digital Agriculture Mission), with state Revenue and Agriculture departments
schemes.brief: A free, lifelong 11-digit Farmer ID for every land-owning farmer, linked to Aadhaar and to the plots in the state's land records. Schemes such as PM-Kisan, crop insurance and Kisan Credit Card can then read your land details from the ID, so you stop carrying land papers for each one. New PM-Kisan applicants in the ten states that started first (UP, MP, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and Assam) have needed a Farmer ID since 1 January 2025, and over 10 crore farmers had one by August 2026. You register once, at a village camp, a CSC or yourself on your state's Farmer Registry website.
schemes.benefit: Free lifelong Farmer ID, needed for new PM-Kisan registration and used for crop insurance and KCC
eligibility: Any farmer who owns farm land recorded in the state's land records in his or her own name
Each owner of jointly held land registers separately. Land in several villages or states still gets one single Farmer ID
The name on Aadhaar must closely match the name in the land record. A big mismatch sends the claim for manual check or rejection
If the owner has died or the land was bought, the mutation (name transfer) must be done in the land record first
Tenant farmers and sharecroppers do not get the land in their name, but the owner can authorise them for a scheme
No fee is charged for registration or for the ID
documents: Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP (otherwise fingerprint or face check at a camp or CSC)
Copy of the land record (khatauni, 7/12, jamabandi, RTC, patta or pahani) showing district, tehsil, village and survey / khasra number
Khata or owner number, for land held jointly
Mutation order or heirship entry, if the land came to you by inheritance or purchase
schemes.submitAt: A Farmer Registry camp in your village (run by the Patwari / Lekhpal / Talathi, the agriculture assistant or a Krishi Sakhi), the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), or the tehsil or block agriculture office. Take your Aadhaar, the mobile phone linked to it and a copy of your land record with the survey numbers; there is no paper form to fill. You can also register yourself online on your state's Farmer Registry site, whose address is the state code followed by fr.agristack.gov.in, for example upfr.agristack.gov.in (Uttar Pradesh), mhfr.agristack.gov.in (Maharashtra), gjfr.agristack.gov.in (Gujarat), rjfr.agristack.gov.in (Rajasthan), mpfr.agristack.gov.in (Madhya Pradesh) and bhfr.agristack.gov.in (Bihar).

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. The OTP for e-KYC goes to the mobile linked with it.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The enrolment number and the Farmer ID come by SMS to this number.

demoFields.label: Name as per Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Filled in by itself after e-KYC. Check that it matches the name in your land record.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As written in the land record. The system matches both your name and this name.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-district / Village of the Land
demoFields.hint: Where the land is, not where you live.

demoFields.label: Survey / Khasra Number (and Sub-survey Number)
demoFields.hint: From your khatauni or 7/12. Enter one plot; your other plots in that village usually show up by themselves.

demoFields.label: Select Your Name from the Owners List
demoFields.value: Bhagwan Singh Yadav s/o Ram Prakash Yadav
demoFields.hint: Pick only your own name. For joint land, each owner registers with his or her own Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Verify Ownership
demoFields.hint: Press Verify. The site checks the plot against the state's land record.

demoFields.label: Consent and e-Sign
demoFields.hint: Your consent lets schemes use your land details. Nothing is shared without it.

demoFields.label: Enrolment ID
demoFields.hint: Write it down. Use it to track your claim until the Farmer ID is issued.

demoSteps: Go to a Farmer Registry camp or a CSC, or open your state's Farmer Registry site (state code + fr.agristack.gov.in), choose Farmer and create an account with your Aadhaar OTP.
Finish Aadhaar e-KYC. Your name and details come from Aadhaar; add your mobile number and address.
Plots already matched to your Aadhaar appear by themselves. For a missing plot, enter the district, sub-district, village and survey number, pick your name from the owners list and press Verify.
Give consent with an Aadhaar e-sign and submit. An enrolment number arrives by SMS.
The Patwari or revenue officer checks the claim against the land record. Once it is approved, the Farmer ID is made against your Aadhaar, usually within a day; check the status on the same site.
Quote the Farmer ID for PM-Kisan, crop insurance and KCC. If the claim is rejected for a name mismatch or a pending mutation, get the land record or Aadhaar corrected and claim again.
schemes.helpline: Tehsil or district agriculture office Farmer Registry help desk; 155261 / 1800-115-526 (PM-Kisan helpline, for linking the Farmer ID to PM-Kisan)

schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, with RBI, NABARD and banks
schemes.brief: A cheap farm loan account with a RuPay card, given by banks to farmers for seeds, fertiliser, labour and other farming costs, and also for dairy, poultry, goat rearing and fish farming. Interest is 7% a year, and if you repay on time the government cuts it to 4% on loans up to Rs.3 lakh. No security is needed up to Rs.2 lakh. PM-Kisan farmers can apply with a one-page form at the bank where their PM-Kisan money comes.
schemes.benefit: Farm loan at 4% a year if repaid on time (up to Rs.3 lakh); no security up to Rs.2 lakh
eligibility: Farmers who cultivate land: owners, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers, and farmer groups (SHG / JLG)
Farmers rearing dairy animals, sheep, goats, pigs or poultry, and fish farmers (inland or sea)
Banks usually lend from age 18 up to 75; above 60 a younger family member joins as co-borrower
The loan limit is fixed by the crop, the land area and the bank's scale of finance
You should not already hold a KCC at another bank
documents: Filled KCC application form with a signature or thumb impression
Aadhaar card
Land record (khatauni, 7/12, jamabandi or patta), or a lease or tenancy paper for tenant farmers
Two passport-size photographs
Bank passbook of the account where PM-Kisan money comes
Details of crops to be grown, or of animals and fish ponds for dairy or fisheries KCC
Details of any existing loan; some banks ask for a no-dues paper from other banks in the area
schemes.submitAt: At the branch of the bank where your PM-Kisan money is credited (or any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank or cooperative bank branch near your village). Hand the filled form to the field officer or branch manager with your Aadhaar, land record, two photos and passbook, and get the acknowledgement slip at the bottom of the form signed and dated.

demoFields.label: Name of Bank / Branch
demoFields.hint: The bank where your PM-Kisan money comes. Write it at the top of the form.

demoFields.label: Type of KCC
demoFields.hint: Tick fresh KCC for a new card, or enhancement or activation if you already have an old KCC.

demoFields.label: Amount of loan required
demoFields.hint: What you need for one year of farming. The bank will fix the final limit from your land and crops.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: Your name as on Aadhaar and the land record.

demoFields.label: Account No (PM Kisan Beneficiary)
demoFields.hint: The account where your PM-Kisan instalments come. The bank takes your KYC from this account.

demoFields.label: Consent for PMSBY / PMJJBY auto debit
demoFields.hint: Insurance of Rs.2 lakh each for Rs.20 and Rs.436 a year, cut from your account. Tick No if you do not want it.

demoFields.label: Details of existing loans
demoFields.hint: Write any loan you have from a bank, cooperative society or other source, with the amount still due.

demoFields.label: Land holding: Village / Survey-Khasra No. / Title / Area
demoFields.hint: Copy from your land record. Tick Leased or Share Cropper if the land is not yours.

demoFields.label: Name of crop to be grown
demoFields.hint: The crops you will sow this year in each season.

demoFields.label: KCC for animal husbandry / fisheries
demoFields.hint: Fill only if you also want a loan for animals or fish farming.

demoSteps: Download the KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in (Download KCC Form) or collect it free at the bank, and fill it.
Take it to your bank branch with Aadhaar, land record, two photos and passbook. Get the acknowledgement at the bottom of the form signed.
The bank officer checks your land record and crops, and may visit the field. The limit is fixed from your crop, land area and needs.
Banks are told to decide within 14 days of a complete application. Sign the loan papers. There is no processing fee for loans up to Rs.3 lakh.
Your KCC account opens and you get a RuPay card. Take out money as you need it, from the branch or an ATM.
Repay within one year, or after harvest, to get the 3% discount, so you pay only 4% interest. The card stays valid for five years with a yearly review.
If the bank refuses or delays without reason, complain to the branch manager in writing, then to RBI on 14448 or cms.rbi.org.in.
schemes.helpline: 155261 / 1800-115-526 (PM-Kisan and KCC helpline); 14448 (RBI complaints)

schemes.title: VB-G RAM G Rural Work Guarantee (Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card)
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development — Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025
schemes.brief: From 1 July 2026 the VB-G RAM G Act replaced MGNREGA, and the old job card is becoming the Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card. Every rural household can now ask for up to 125 days of unskilled manual work a year, up from 100, paid at the notified wage into the worker's bank or post office account. An old MGNREGA job card with e-KYC done stays valid until the new card is issued; a household with no card registers free at the Gram Panchayat. Work must be given within 15 days of asking, or an unemployment allowance is due.
schemes.benefit: 125 days of guaranteed wage work per household each year (up from 100 under MGNREGA), paid at the notified wage into the worker's bank or post office account
eligibility: Household living in a rural area of the Gram Panchayat where it applies
Adult members aged 18 or above who are willing to do unskilled manual work
No income, caste or land condition — the right belongs to every rural household
One card per household, listing all the adult members who want work; an old MGNREGA job card with e-KYC done stays valid until the new card comes
Single women, persons with disability, people over 60, freed bonded labourers, PVTG members and transgender persons get a Special card of a different colour
States can pause works for up to 60 days a year in peak sowing and harvest time; the 125 days are given in the rest of the year
documents: Aadhaar cards of all the adult members to be listed — used for e-KYC and face-based attendance at the worksite
Passport-size photographs of those adult members, which go on the card
Proof of residence in the Gram Panchayat — ration card, voter ID or a Panchayat certificate
Bank or post-office passbook copy, since wages are paid only into an account
The old MGNREGA job card, if the household has one
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office — the Panchayat Secretary or the Gram Rozgar Sevak; the Programme Officer at the Block office also accepts it

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: The household applies as one unit and the card is issued in this name, with every listed adult entitled to work under it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to tell apart households with similar names in the same village.

demoFields.label: Village / Gram Panchayat / Block / District
demoFields.value: Salaiya / Salaiya GP / Ghansor Block / Seoni, Madhya Pradesh
demoFields.hint: All four, because work is given within 5 km of the village named here as far as possible — if it is further away, inside the Block, you are owed an extra 10 per cent of the wage.

demoFields.label: Details of adult members willing to work (Sl. No., Name, Age, Sex, Relationship to head)
demoFields.value: 1. Budhram Singh Uikey, 41, M, Self; 2. Phoolwati Bai Uikey, 38, F, Wife; 3. Dinesh Uikey, 19, M, Son
demoFields.hint: List every adult who might want work, not only those working today. A name left off the card cannot demand work later without an amendment.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Numbers of the listed adult members
demoFields.hint: One against each name in the same order. Aadhaar is used for e-KYC and face-based attendance, and wages are paid through Aadhaar-based payment, so a missing number holds up that member's wages.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / General) and whether the household is a PMAY-G, land reform or small and marginal farmer beneficiary
demoFields.hint: Tick all that apply. These households get priority for individual-asset works such as a well, a cattle shed or land levelling on their own land.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number / BPL status
demoFields.hint: Asked for identification only. The scheme has no poverty condition — a household above the poverty line is equally entitled to a card.

demoFields.label: Bank / Post Office Account (bank, branch, account no., IFSC)
demoFields.value: Central Bank of India, Ghansor Branch, A/c 39876501234, IFSC CBIN0289876
demoFields.hint: Wages are paid only by bank or post-office transfer, never in cash. Give the account of the member who will work; a joint household account is also accepted.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Work allotment and wage credit messages come here. One number for the whole household is enough.

demoFields.label: Photographs of the adult members applying
demoFields.value: 3 photographs enclosed — one for each listed adult
demoFields.hint: The photographs go on the card itself, next to each listed member's name.

demoFields.label: Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. Write the date yourself, since the 15-day clock for issuing the card runs from it.

demoFields.label: Receipt of application (for office use — dated acknowledgement)
demoFields.value: Received on 22-09-2026, Regn. No. SAL/2026/0147 — Gram Rozgar Sevak, Salaiya GP (seal)
demoFields.hint: Ask for this dated receipt. It is the proof that fixes the 15-day deadline for issuing the card.

demoSteps: If your household already has an MGNREGA job card, ask the Gram Rozgar Sevak whether e-KYC is done for every adult on it. Such a card stays valid until the new Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card is issued, so you do not need to apply again.

A household with no card applies at the Gram Panchayat: any adult member gives the names, ages and address of the household — orally, on plain paper or on the printed form free at the Panchayat. List every adult who might ever want work.

Attach Aadhaar copies, the residence proof, the bank passbook copy and one photograph of each listed adult, and take a dated receipt with a registration number. The Panchayat must issue the card within 15 days, and it is valid for three years.

Getting the card is not the same as asking for work. Ask for at least six days of work — orally, in writing on Form 6, or through the digital system — at the Gram Panchayat or to the Programme Officer, and take a dated receipt.

Work must start within 15 days, as far as possible within 5 km of your village. If it does not, the State owes you an unemployment allowance of at least a quarter of the wage for the first 30 days and half after that.

Attendance at the worksite is taken by face authentication. Wages are paid weekly, or at the latest within 15 days of the muster roll closing, straight into your account; after that you are owed 0.05% of the unpaid wage for each day of delay.

Check your days and payments on the card, on the Janata Board at the worksite and on vbgramg.dord.gov.in. Never let the Sarpanch, the Rozgar Sevak or anyone else keep your card. For a complaint, go to the Programme Officer at the Block, then the District Programme Coordinator (the Collector).
schemes.helpline: No national toll-free number. Complain to the Programme Officer at the Block office, then the District Programme Coordinator (Collector), or call your state's rural employment helpline; online complaints at pgportal.gov.in

schemes.title: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (Rs.1,000 a month for TB patients)
schemes.department: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare — Central TB Division, National TB Elimination Programme
schemes.brief: Every person being treated for tuberculosis (TB) gets Rs.1,000 a month for food for the whole length of treatment, usually Rs.6,000 for a six-month course, paid straight into a bank account. It covers treatment at a government hospital or by a private doctor, as long as the TB case is notified on the government's Ni-kshay system. Underweight patients also get extra nutrition supplements for the first two months, and families can get food baskets from Ni-kshay Mitra volunteers.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month for the whole TB treatment, by bank transfer
eligibility: Anyone diagnosed with TB, of any type and any age, whose case is notified on Ni-kshay
Treatment at a government facility or by a private doctor or hospital: both are covered
No income limit and no BPL card needed
Paid for every month of treatment until the treatment ends
A child, or a patient without a bank account, can be paid into a parent's or guardian's account
Patients with a BMI below 18.5 also get energy-dense nutrition supplements for the first two months
documents: TB treatment card or the Ni-kshay ID given at the centre
Bank passbook or cancelled cheque of a savings account in your name (a parent's or guardian's for a child)
Aadhaar card, or the Aadhaar enrolment slip with another photo ID until it comes
Mobile number, for the payment SMS
For private patients: the doctor's prescription or TB notification slip
schemes.submitAt: Give your bank details to the TB staff at the government health centre or TB Unit where you were diagnosed (the health worker or Senior Treatment Supervisor). If you are treated privately, give them to your doctor or the programme's private-sector staff. Take your bank passbook, Aadhaar and treatment card. The staff enter everything on Ni-kshay, so there is no form for you to fill. Do it in the first two weeks of treatment.

demoFields.label: Ni-kshay ID
demoFields.hint: Written on your TB treatment card, or ask the health worker.

demoFields.label: Patient Name
demoFields.hint: As registered at the TB centre.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages and treatment reminders come to this number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The patient's Aadhaar, or the enrolment slip number if it has not come yet.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary Relationship to Patient
demoFields.hint: Self if the account is yours; Father, Mother or Guardian for a child.

demoFields.label: Account Holder Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed in the passbook. A mismatch stops the payment.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: A savings account that is in use. One account can be linked to only one patient.

demoFields.label: IFSC Code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the passbook or cheque.

demoFields.label: Treatment Start Date
demoFields.hint: Payments are counted from this date, Rs.1,000 for each month of treatment.

demoFields.label: Health Facility / TB Unit
demoFields.hint: Where your treatment is recorded.

demoSteps: Get tested free at a government health centre. Once TB is confirmed, the case is notified on Ni-kshay and you get a Ni-kshay ID; private doctors must notify too.
Give your bank passbook and Aadhaar to the TB health worker, who enters the account on Ni-kshay.
The account is checked by the government payment system. If it fails, the staff call you to correct the details.
The first payment comes after the account is approved, and then Rs.1,000 for each month of treatment. An SMS tells you of each credit.
Take the medicines every day until the doctor ends treatment; the payments run for the whole course. Ask for the nutrition supplement if you are underweight.
If the money has not come, call Ni-kshay Sampark on 1800-11-6666 with your Ni-kshay ID.
schemes.helpline: 1800-11-6666 (Ni-kshay Sampark, national TB helpline, free)

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A one-year life insurance cover, renewed every year, that pays the nominee on the death of the member from any cause. The premium is taken straight from the savings bank account by auto-debit once a year. The cover year runs from 1 June to 31 May, whichever month you join in.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh life cover for a premium of Rs.436 a year
eligibility: Age 18 to 50 years at the time of joining; the cover may be continued up to age 55
Holds a savings bank account, single or joint
Gives standing consent for the annual auto-debit of the premium
In good health, as declared on the form; a fresh member's claim other than by accident is not paid in the first 30 days
documents: Savings bank account number and the bank's own passbook or card
Aadhaar card, seeded with that bank account
Age proof, if the bank record does not carry the date of birth
Nominee's name, age and relationship; guardian's name if the nominee is a minor
schemes.submitAt: Your own bank branch — the branch that holds the savings account from which the premium is to be debited

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.hint: The branch holding the account the premium will come out of. The cover is tied to that one account.

demoFields.label: Savings Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it digit by digit from the passbook. A wrong digit means the auto-debit fails and the cover never starts.

demoFields.label: Name of the Account Holder (in block letters)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as the bank holds it. The claim is settled against the bank's record, not against what you write here.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 50 to join. Members already enrolled stay covered to 55.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits, the same Aadhaar that is seeded with this account.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number / Email
demoFields.hint: The annual renewal SMS and the auto-debit alert come here. Keep it current, or you will miss the warning when a renewal fails.

demoFields.label: Name of Nominee
demoFields.hint: The one person who will receive the Rs.2 lakh. Spell the name as it is on their own Aadhaar — the claim is paid into their account.

demoFields.label: Nominee's Age and Relationship with the Member
demoFields.hint: Both are needed. If the nominee is under 18 you must also name a guardian in the next box.

demoFields.label: Name of the Guardian (if the nominee is a minor)
demoFields.value: Not applicable — nominee is an adult
demoFields.hint: Fill only when the nominee is under 18, with the guardian's relationship to that child.

demoFields.label: Consent for auto-debit of premium
demoFields.value: I hereby give my consent to debit Rs.436 from my above savings bank account every year towards the premium under PMJJBY until I give written notice to stop.
demoFields.hint: This is the heart of the form. Without this consent the bank cannot collect the premium and there is no cover.

demoFields.label: Declaration of good health
demoFields.value: I declare that I am in good health and am not suffering from any of the conditions listed in the declaration.
demoFields.hint: Read the listed conditions before you sign. A false health declaration is the ground on which a claim is later repudiated.

demoFields.label: Place, Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Member
demoFields.hint: Sign the way you sign for the bank. A thumb impression needs the branch official's attestation beside it.

demoFields.label: Acknowledgement slip (tear-off portion at the bottom)
demoFields.value: To be filled and stamped by the branch: name of member, account number, date of receipt, branch seal
demoFields.hint: Do not leave the counter without this portion filled, stamped and handed back to you. It is your only proof that the bank received the consent.

demoSteps: Ask for the PMJJBY 'Consent-cum-Declaration Form' at the counter of the branch that holds your savings account. Every bank keeps it; it is a single page, free, and printable from the Jan Suraksha site in English, Hindi and the regional languages.

Check first that you are between 18 and 50 and that the account has Rs.436 sitting in it on the day of submission. The bank debits the premium as soon as it registers the enrolment, and an enrolment that fails for want of balance is simply dropped.
Fill the form in ink, copying the account number from the passbook digit by digit and writing the name exactly as the bank holds it.
Complete the nominee block with name, age and relationship, and add a guardian if the nominee is a minor. This single block decides who receives the Rs.2 lakh, so do not leave it for later.

Read the health declaration before signing it. If you already have one of the listed conditions, tell the branch officer — a claim can be repudiated years later on a declaration signed without reading.
Hand the form to the branch official yourself rather than to an agent, and sign the specimen where asked. No fee is payable beyond the Rs.436 premium; anyone asking for more is not entitled to it.
Demand the tear-off acknowledgement slip at the bottom of the form, filled in, stamped with the branch seal and signed. Keep it with the passbook — the family will need it to start a claim.

Watch the passbook for the Rs.436 debit within a few days, and for the SMS confirming enrolment. The certificate of insurance is then issued by the insurer through the bank, usually within two to four weeks; ask the branch for it if none arrives.

Remember the calendar: the cover runs from 1 June to 31 May and the premium is auto-debited each year in May. Keep the balance in the account through May, because one failed debit ends the cover, and rejoining later restarts the 30-day waiting period for non-accident death.

Tell the nominee where this paper is kept. On a death claim they take the death certificate, the acknowledgement slip and their own bank and Aadhaar details to the same branch; PMJJBY claims are normally settled within 30 days of a complete claim form.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A one-year accident insurance cover, renewed every year, that pays on accidental death or permanent disability. The premium is a rupee and a half a month, taken once a year by auto-debit from the savings bank account. The cover year runs from 1 June to 31 May.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, Rs.1 lakh for partial permanent disability, at Rs.20 a year
eligibility: Age 18 to 70 years
Holds a savings bank account, single or joint
Gives standing consent for the annual auto-debit of the premium
One cover per person even if several accounts are held; the extra premium on a duplicate enrolment is forfeited
documents: Savings bank account number and passbook
Aadhaar card, seeded with that bank account
Age proof, if the bank record does not carry the date of birth
Nominee's name, age and relationship; guardian's name if the nominee is a minor
schemes.submitAt: Your own bank branch — the branch that holds the savings account from which the premium is to be debited

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.value: Union Bank of India, Aliganj Branch, Lucknow
demoFields.hint: The branch holding the account the Rs.20 will be debited from.

demoFields.label: Savings Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it digit by digit from the passbook; a single wrong digit means the enrolment fails silently.

demoFields.label: Name of the Account Holder (in block letters)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as the bank holds the name. Claims are settled against the bank's record.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 70. Unlike the life cover, there is no health declaration and no upper entry bar below 70.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits, the Aadhaar seeded with this account.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number / Email
demoFields.hint: The enrolment confirmation and each year's auto-debit alert come to this number.

demoFields.label: Name of Nominee
demoFields.hint: Spell it as on the nominee's own Aadhaar — the claim money is paid into their account.

demoFields.label: Nominee's Age and Relationship with the Member
demoFields.hint: Both are required. A nominee under 18 needs a guardian named in the next box.

demoFields.label: Name of the Guardian (if the nominee is a minor)
demoFields.value: Not applicable — nominee is an adult
demoFields.hint: Fill only for a minor nominee, with the guardian's relationship to the child.

demoFields.label: Consent for auto-debit of premium
demoFields.value: I hereby give my consent to debit Rs.20 from my above savings bank account every year towards the premium under PMSBY until I give written notice to stop.
demoFields.hint: The cover exists only because of this standing consent. Do not strike it out or alter the wording.

demoFields.label: Whether already covered under PMSBY through another account
demoFields.hint: Declare honestly. Two enrolments do not double the payout — only one cover operates and the second premium is lost.

demoFields.label: Place, Date and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Member
demoFields.hint: Sign as you sign for the bank. A thumb impression must be attested by the branch official beside it.

demoFields.label: Acknowledgement slip (tear-off portion at the bottom)
demoFields.value: To be filled and stamped by the branch: name of member, account number, date of receipt, branch seal
demoFields.hint: Insist on getting this portion back, filled and stamped. It is the family's proof of cover when a claim has to be filed in a hurry.

demoSteps: Ask at the counter of your own bank branch for the PMSBY 'Consent-cum-Declaration Form'. It is one page, free, kept by every bank, and printable from the Jan Suraksha site in English, Hindi and the regional languages.

Make sure the account has at least Rs.20 in it on the day you submit. The premium is debited as soon as the enrolment is registered, and an enrolment that fails for want of balance is dropped without any notice to you.
Fill the form in ink, copying the account number straight from the passbook and writing the name exactly as the bank holds it.
Complete the nominee block — name, age, relationship, and a guardian if the nominee is a minor. This is the only place the insurer learns who to pay.
If you already hold PMSBY through another bank account, say so on the form. Only one cover ever pays, and the premium on the second enrolment is simply forfeited.
Hand the form to the branch official across the counter. There is nothing to pay beyond the Rs.20 premium, and no medical examination and no health declaration are involved in this scheme.
Demand the tear-off acknowledgement at the foot of the form, filled in, stamped with the branch seal and signed, and keep it with the passbook.

Check the passbook for the Rs.20 debit and the confirmation SMS within a few days. The certificate of insurance comes from the insurer through the bank, usually inside two to four weeks — ask the branch if it does not.

Note the calendar: cover runs 1 June to 31 May with the auto-debit each May, so keep the balance in the account through that month. A failed debit ends the cover, and it restarts only from the date of a fresh enrolment.

Tell the family where the acknowledgement is kept. An accident claim has to be intimated to the bank within 30 days of the accident, with the FIR or post-mortem report for a death claim, or the doctor's disability certificate for a disability claim; settlement normally follows within 30 days of a complete claim.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G Rural House)
schemes.department: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.brief: Money to build a pucca house for a village family that has no house or lives in a kutcha one: Rs.1.20 lakh in the plains and Rs.1.30 lakh in hill states, the North-East and difficult areas, paid into the bank account in instalments as the house goes up. On top of that the family gets 90 days of paid labour (95 in hilly areas) on its own house under the rural job scheme, and Rs.12,000 for a toilet. Families are picked from the SECC 2011 list and the new Awaas+ 2024 survey and checked by the Gram Sabha; homeless and destitute families, manual scavengers, primitive tribal groups and freed bonded labourers come first. The scheme runs till March 2029 for 2 crore more houses.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1.20 lakh (Rs.1.30 lakh in hill and NE areas), plus 90–95 days' wages and Rs.12,000 for a toilet
eligibility: Village family with no house, or living in a kutcha house (kutcha walls and roof, up to 2 rooms)
Name on the SECC 2011 Permanent Wait List, or found eligible in the Awaas+ 2024 survey and passed by the Gram Sabha
Ruled out if any member owns a pucca house, a motorised 3- or 4-wheeler or mechanised farm machinery, or has a KCC limit of Rs.50,000 or more
Ruled out if any member is a government employee, earns over Rs.15,000 a month, pays income or professional tax, or runs a government-registered business
Ruled out if the family owns 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land with irrigation equipment, or 5 acres or more of unirrigated land
Owning a two-wheeler, fridge, landline or motorised fishing boat no longer rules a family out (changed in 2024)
documents: Aadhaar card of the head of family and members (face e-KYC is done during the survey)
Bank or post office account seeded with Aadhaar
Job card under the rural employment scheme
Mobile number
Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) number, if the family already has one
Paper for the plot where the house will be built (patta or possession proof); landless families are given land by the state
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office: tell the Panchayat Secretary or the Gram Rozgar Sahayak that you want to be surveyed under Awaas+ 2024, and take your Aadhaar, job card, bank passbook and mobile phone. The Block Development Office (BDO) registers the approved names; complaints go to the BDO or the District Rural Development Agency.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of head of household
demoFields.hint: Checked by a face scan through the AadhaarFaceRD app; no fingerprint or OTP is needed.

demoFields.label: Name of head of household
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. A woman head of family is welcome; the house is usually sanctioned in the woman's name or jointly.

demoFields.label: Family members
demoFields.hint: Add every member living and cooking together, each with Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Social category
demoFields.hint: SC, ST, minority or other. This decides which priority list your family goes into.

demoFields.label: Type of present house
demoFields.value: Kutcha walls and kutcha roof, 1 room
demoFields.hint: Describe the house as it is today. More than 2 rooms with a pucca roof makes the family ineligible.

demoFields.label: Monthly income of highest earner
demoFields.hint: The member who earns the most. Above Rs.15,000 a month rules the family out.

demoFields.label: Land owned
demoFields.hint: Write irrigated and unirrigated land separately, as in the land record.

demoFields.label: Photo of present house
demoFields.value: Geo-tagged photo taken in the app
demoFields.hint: Taken standing at the house, so the location is recorded with the photo.

demoFields.label: Job card number
demoFields.hint: From your rural employment job card. The 90 days of paid work on your house are booked against it.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the beneficiary's own name, seeded with Aadhaar. All instalments come here.

demoSteps: Ask at the Gram Panchayat whether your name is already on the Permanent Wait List, or look up the Panchayat-wise list on the PMAY-G website.
If it is not, get surveyed under Awaas+ 2024: the Panchayat surveyor fills the form on the AwaasPlus app, or you survey yourself on the app with a face scan where your state's survey is open.
The Gram Sabha reads out and checks the list, objections are heard at the block and district, and approved families are ranked by priority.
When your turn comes, the Block office registers you on AwaasSoft, geo-tags your old house and plot, and issues the sanction order. The first instalment comes into your Aadhaar-seeded account.
Build the house, at least 25 sq m with a kitchen. At each stage (plinth, lintel, roof) the official takes a geo-tagged photo and the next instalment is released.
Work on your own house under the rural job scheme for 90 (or 95) days' wages, and claim Rs.12,000 for the toilet through the Panchayat.
Finish within 12 months. Track payments with Search Beneficiary or FTO Tracking on the PMAY-G site, and go to the BDO if an instalment is stuck.
schemes.helpline: 1800-11-6446 (PMAY-G helpline) / support-pmayg@gov.in; Block Development Office for local complaints

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Bank Account
schemes.department: Ministry of Finance — Department of Financial Services
schemes.brief: A basic savings account that any resident can open with no minimum balance and no charge. It comes with a RuPay debit card carrying free accident insurance, and after six months of satisfactory operation the branch may allow a small overdraft. It is also the account through which most government benefit transfers arrive.
schemes.benefit: Zero-balance account, free RuPay card with Rs.2 lakh accident cover, overdraft up to Rs.10,000
eligibility: Any resident individual aged 10 years or above
A minor aged 10 or above may operate the account with a guardian
One PMJDY account per person; an existing ordinary savings account can be converted instead
No income, caste or area condition of any kind
documents: Aadhaar card — by itself enough for full KYC at the branch
If no Aadhaar: voter ID, driving licence, PAN, passport or MGNREGA job card
If none of those either: a self-attested photograph plus the officer's signature opens a Small Account
One passport-size photograph
Mobile number for SMS alerts
schemes.submitAt: Any bank branch, or the Bank Mitra / Business Correspondent kiosk that serves your village or ward

demoFields.label: Name of the Bank and Branch
demoFields.value: State Bank of India, Dhanora Branch
demoFields.hint: Written by you at the top of the form. A Bank Mitra will tell you which branch the kiosk reports to.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on the Aadhaar card. A mismatch here blocks every future benefit transfer into the account.

demoFields.label: Father's / Spouse's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Tick which one you are giving. It is used to tell apart account holders with the same name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. An applicant aged 10 to 18 opens a minor account with a guardian.

demoFields.label: Gender / Marital Status
demoFields.hint: Tick the boxes. Women's accounts are counted separately for the overdraft priority.

demoFields.label: Address (as on Aadhaar) and Present Address if different
demoFields.value: Ward 3, Dhanora, Tehsil Chhindwara, Dist. Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh – 480001
demoFields.hint: If you actually live elsewhere, fill the present address too — the passbook and card are posted there.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All twelve digits. Aadhaar alone completes the KYC at the counter; nothing else is required.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Give a number in your own possession. This is the number that will receive OTPs and every credit alert.

demoFields.label: Occupation and Annual Income
demoFields.hint: An honest rough figure. There is no minimum income to open the account.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / Minority / General)
demoFields.hint: Tick one. It is collected for reporting only and changes nothing about the account.

demoFields.label: Do you already hold a bank account? If yes, give details
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. An existing savings account can simply be converted into a PMJDY account with the RuPay card, which is faster than opening a second one.

demoFields.label: Nominee: Name, Relationship, Date of Birth, Address
demoFields.value: Ramesh Shankar Chauhan — Husband — 22-07-1989 — same address
demoFields.hint: Never skip the nomination. Without it the family needs a succession certificate to claim the balance. Name a guardian if the nominee is a minor.

demoFields.label: RuPay Debit Card required (Yes / No)
demoFields.hint: Always tick Yes. The free accident cover of Rs.2 lakh rides on the RuPay card, and the card must be used at least once in the qualifying period for the cover to stay live.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression of the Applicant, with date
demoFields.hint: The signature you put here becomes your specimen signature at the bank — sign the same way every time afterwards.

demoFields.label: Introducer's details (only for a Small Account without documents)
demoFields.hint: Needed only when you have no officially valid document. An existing account holder of the same branch, known to the bank, introduces you.

demoSteps: Collect the PMJDY account opening form free at any bank branch counter, or from the Bank Mitra kiosk in the village. The bilingual form is also downloadable from the PMJDY site in English and Hindi and can be printed at home.

Fill it in ink, in block letters, copying the name, date of birth and address exactly from the Aadhaar card. Paste one passport photograph in the box and sign across its corner if the form has a line running over it.

Fill the nominee block in full — name, relationship, date of birth and address. Bank staff often let this slide; insist on completing it, because without a nominee the family must produce a succession certificate to draw the balance.
Tick 'Yes' for the RuPay debit card. The Rs.2 lakh accident insurance is attached to that card, not to the account, and it lapses if the card is never used.

Carry the original Aadhaar and one photocopy to the branch. If you have no Aadhaar or any other valid document, say you want a 'Small Account' — the bank must open one on a self-attested photograph and the officer's signature, with limits on balance and withdrawals for twelve months.

Hand the form across the counter, sign the specimen signature card the officer gives you, and have the Aadhaar photocopy self-attested. Nobody may charge you anything — the account, the passbook and the RuPay card are all free.

Demand the account number in writing before you leave, along with the passbook, which the branch is required to hand over the same day. Ask for the customer ID too, and check that the mobile number printed on the acknowledgement is yours.

The account is usually live the same day, and the RuPay card either comes across the counter or reaches you by post within two to three weeks; the PIN comes separately. Activate the card at an ATM and make one small transaction so the accident cover stays in force.

If a branch refuses to open the account or asks for a deposit, quote the PMJDY zero-balance rule and ask for it in writing, then complain to the branch manager, and after that to the bank's Nodal Officer or the RBI Banking Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in.

schemes.title: Ration Card under the National Food Security Act
schemes.department: Department of Food & Public Distribution — state Food & Civil Supplies Department
schemes.brief: The ration card that entitles a household to subsidised foodgrain at the fair price shop under the National Food Security Act. It is issued by the state food and civil supplies department in two categories — Antyodaya (AAY) for the poorest households and Priority Household (PHH) for the rest of the covered population.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month (35 kg per family for AAY households) from the fair price shop
eligibility: Household ordinarily resident in the state, not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
Household falls inside the state's NFSA coverage list — priority households, or Antyodaya for the poorest
Excluded if the household meets a state exclusion criterion, such as income tax payment, a four-wheeler or a government job
One card per household, with an adult woman of 18 or above as the head of the family
documents: Aadhaar cards of every family member
Proof of residence — electricity or water bill, rent agreement, or Panchayat or ward certificate
Surrender certificate or deletion certificate from the previous district or state, if the family has moved
Income certificate or self-declaration of annual income
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family
LPG consumer number and bank passbook copy, where the state form asks for them
schemes.submitAt: Taluka or tehsil supply office, or the District Food & Civil Supplies Office; in a city, the zonal or ward food office

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: Under NFSA the head of the family must be a woman of 18 or above. Write her name as it stands on her Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: The husband's name for a married woman; the father's name otherwise.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head of the Family

demoFields.label: Category applied for (AAY / Priority Household)
demoFields.hint: Tick Antyodaya only if the household is on the AAY list — landless labourers, destitute or similar. When unsure, tick Priority Household; the office reclassifies if needed.

demoFields.label: Full Residential Address with PIN
demoFields.value: House No. 112, Ganesh Nagar, Sinnar, Dist. Nashik, Maharashtra – 422103
demoFields.hint: The address where the family actually lives — the ration shop is allotted from it, and a field inspector will visit.

demoFields.label: Details of all family members (Sl. No., Name, Relationship with head, Age, Sex, Aadhaar No.)
demoFields.value: 1. Meenakshi K. Sonawane, Self, 39, F, 6543 2109 8765; 2. Kailash B. Sonawane, Husband, 44, M, 1098 7654 3210; 3. Aarti K. Sonawane, Daughter, 16, F, 2109 8765 4321; 4. Sanjay B. Sonawane, Father-in-law, 71, M, 8765 4321 0987
demoFields.hint: Every member who eats from the same kitchen, one per row, starting with the head. The monthly grain is counted per name here, so a missing name means missing grain.

demoFields.label: Annual Income of the Family
demoFields.hint: The household's total yearly income from all sources. Keep it consistent with the income certificate or self-declaration you attach.

demoFields.label: Occupation of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: Plain words are fine — labourer, farmer, domestic worker, small shopkeeper.

demoFields.label: Previous Ration Card No. and Surrender / Deletion Certificate

demoFields.hint: If the family held a card elsewhere, write its number and attach the surrender certificate. Holding two cards is an offence and both get cancelled.

demoFields.hint: Asked in most states to weed out duplicate households. Write 'No connection' if the family has none.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Details (bank, branch, account no., IFSC)
demoFields.value: Bank of India, Sinnar Branch, A/c 20481176543, IFSC BKID0009991
demoFields.hint: Needed in states that pay the food subsidy in cash instead of grain; optional elsewhere but harmless to fill.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The card number and each month's transaction alert come to this number.

demoFields.label: Declaration and Signature / Thumb Impression of the Head of the Family
demoFields.value: I declare that the particulars above are true and that no member of this family holds a ration card elsewhere. — Meenakshi K. Sonawane, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: Read it before signing. This declaration is the legal basis on which the card is cancelled and a penalty imposed if a second card turns up.

demoFields.label: Verification by the Field Officer / Ward Member (for office use)
demoFields.value: Household verified at the address on 29-09-2026. — Inspector, Sinnar Taluka Supply Office (seal)
demoFields.hint: Leave it blank. The supply inspector or the ward member fills it after the home visit.

demoSteps: Pick up the blank 'Application for New Ration Card' at the taluka or tehsil supply office, the district food and civil supplies office, or the city zonal food office. It is free, and it is also stocked at Common Service Centres and many fair price shops. The NFSA site links to each state's own form.
Fill it in ink, in block letters. Name a woman of 18 or above as the head of the family — that is a requirement of the Act, not a preference of the clerk.

List every member who eats from the same kitchen on the family table, with the exact Aadhaar number for each. The monthly entitlement is calculated per listed person, so one omitted name costs the household 5 kg every month.

Attach Aadhaar photocopies of all members, a residence proof, the income certificate or self-declaration, and one photograph of the head of the family. Self-attest every photocopy — sign across the face of each page.

If the family has moved from another district or state, get the surrender or deletion certificate from the old office and attach it. Without it the new card will be held back, since the system checks for duplicates nationwide.
Where the state form carries a verification block, get it signed and stamped by the ward member, the Sarpanch or the local revenue talathi or patwari before you submit.

Hand the file in at the taluka supply office counter and demand the acknowledgement slip with its application number and date. In most states you can also drop it at the Common Service Centre, which prints the same slip — keep it, since every follow-up runs on that number.

Expect a field verification visit within two to four weeks. Keep the original documents at home so the inspector can compare them; a household that is not found at home twice is marked 'not traceable' and the file closes.

The card is normally issued within 30 days of application — many states commit to that timeline under their Right to Public Services Act. Collect it at the supply office or the fair price shop, and check every member's name and age on it before leaving the counter.

If the 30 days pass with no card and no rejection, complain in writing to the District Supply Officer, and then to the state Food Commission or the district grievance redressal officer, both of which NFSA obliges each state to maintain.
schemes.helpline: 1967 (national food and PDS helpline) or 1800-11-0841

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Divyangjan Pension Yojana (formerly IGNDPS)
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development — Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (formerly NSAP)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for persons with severe disability who belong to a below-poverty-line household. It was called the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) until the Union Cabinet renamed it on 14 October 2026, as part of the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (formerly NSAP). The Cabinet also approved Rs.375 a month (Rs.625 from age 80), a 40 per cent disability limit instead of 80, and no minimum age; these start once the new guidelines are issued, due by mid-January 2027. Until then the old rules apply — age 18 or more and a certificate showing 80 per cent or more — and the state adds its own top-up.
schemes.benefit: Rs.300/month (Rs.500 after age 80) from the Centre, plus the state top-up; rising to Rs.375 (Rs.625 after age 80) once the new guidelines are issued
eligibility: Age 18 years or more on the date of application (no minimum age once the new guidelines are issued)
Severe or multiple disability of 80 per cent or more, certified by the competent medical authority (40 per cent or more once the new guidelines are issued)
Household is on the state's below-poverty-line (BPL) list
Not drawing another disability or social-security pension
documents: Disability certificate showing 80 per cent or more (40 per cent once the new guidelines are issued), issued by the Chief Medical Officer or a district medical board
UDID card, if one has been issued
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school leaving certificate
BPL ration card, or the family's serial number on the BPL list
Aadhaar card photocopy
First page of the bank or post-office passbook
Two passport-size photographs
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office, or the Block Development Office (BDO); in a town, the municipal ward office

demoFields.hint: Whichever the form asks for first; use the same name that appears on the disability certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age (completed years)
demoFields.hint: Under the current rules you must be 18 or above. Once the new guidelines are issued, there is no minimum age.

demoFields.label: Sex
demoFields.hint: Tick one box: Male / Female / Transgender.

demoFields.label: Nature of Disability
demoFields.hint: Copy the wording of the disability certificate exactly; do not summarise it in your own words.

demoFields.label: Percentage of Disability
demoFields.hint: Under the current rules it must read 80 per cent or more, or the Block office refuses it. Once the new guidelines are issued (due by mid-January 2027), 40 per cent or more qualifies.

demoFields.label: Disability Certificate No., Date and Issuing Authority

demoFields.hint: Printed on the certificate. If it carries an expiry date, renew it before applying — an expired certificate stalls the file.

demoFields.value: Bank of Baroda, Bansur Branch, A/c 30112233445, IFSC BARB0BANSUR
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name. Where the disability prevents operating an account, open it with a legal guardian under a guardianship certificate.

demoFields.label: Name of Guardian and Relationship (if applicable)
demoFields.hint: Fill this only for an applicant with intellectual disability or one who cannot operate the account, and attach the guardianship certificate.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression of Applicant or Guardian, with place and date
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is valid, attested by the Sarpanch or a Gazetted Officer. A guardian signing must write 'Guardian' under the signature.

demoFields.label: Verification / Recommendation by Gram Panchayat (for office use)
demoFields.value: Certified that the applicant resides in this Gram Panchayat, belongs to a BPL family and is a person with severe disability. — Sarpanch, Rampura Gram Panchayat (round seal)
demoFields.hint: Leave it blank for the Sarpanch or Ward Member to complete, sign and stamp.

demoSteps: Get the disability certificate in hand before anything else. The Chief Medical Officer's board at the district hospital assesses free of charge on fixed weekly days — ask the hospital's disability desk for the day. The certificate must show 80 per cent or more under the current rules, and 40 per cent or more once the new guidelines are issued.

Collect the blank NSAP disability pension form free from the Gram Panchayat clerk, the Block Development Office, the municipal ward office or a Common Service Centre; it can also be printed from the NSAP site.
Fill it in ink, in block letters, copying the nature of the disability, the percentage, the certificate number and its date word for word from the certificate.
Attach the disability certificate, the UDID card if issued, age proof, BPL ration card, Aadhaar photocopy, passbook first page and two photographs; paste one photograph on the form.
If the applicant cannot operate a bank account, get a guardianship certificate from the Local Level Committee under the National Trust first, and open the account with the guardian named on it.
Have the Sarpanch or Ward Member sign and stamp the verification block at the foot of the form, and check that the words 'person with severe disability' appear in it.
Submit the form at the Gram Panchayat office and ask for it to be listed in the next Gram Sabha, which approves the beneficiary list before the Block office sanctions.
Demand a dated acknowledgement with an inward number, or get your own acknowledgement line stamped on a photocopy of the form.

Sanction by the Block Development Officer normally takes 30 to 60 days, and the first credit commonly carries arrears from the sanction month. If nothing arrives in three months, send a written reminder quoting the inward number and then file an RTI application (Rs.10) with the BDO for the status of the file.
schemes.helpline: Block Development Office; District Disability Rehabilitation Centre for certificate and UDID queries

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY, farmer pension)
schemes.department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (run with LIC and CSC)
schemes.brief: A pension of Rs.3,000 a month from age 60 for small and marginal farmers who join between 18 and 40. You pay Rs.55 to Rs.200 a month, depending on your age when you join, and the government adds the same amount. The monthly amount can be cut automatically from your PM-Kisan money. You join at a Common Service Centre (CSC) with your Aadhaar and bank passbook.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month pension from age 60; Rs.1,500 family pension to the spouse
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with up to 2 hectares (about 5 acres) of cultivable land in their own name in the land records
Age 18 to 40 years when joining; you pay every month until you turn 60
Not for people already in NPS, ESIC or EPFO, or who joined PM Shram Yogi Maandhan or PM Vyapari Maandhan
Not for income-tax payers, government or PSU employees (Class IV / Group D staff can join), doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs and architects in practice, or holders of constitutional posts
You need an Aadhaar card and a savings bank account
documents: Aadhaar card
Savings bank passbook or cheque with IFSC (the PM-Kisan account if you want the amount cut from PM-Kisan)
Land record showing land up to 2 hectares in your name
Mobile number
Name and date of birth of your spouse and of the nominee
First month's contribution in cash (Rs.55 to Rs.200)

Take your Aadhaar card, bank passbook or cheque, land record and spouse and nominee details, and pay the first month's contribution in cash to the operator (VLE). Joining is free; the enrolment-cum-auto-debit form is printed there for you to sign.

demoSteps: Go to the nearest Common Service Centre with your Aadhaar, bank passbook, land record and spouse and nominee details.
The operator checks your Aadhaar with your fingerprint and fills in your bank, mobile, land, spouse and nominee details. The system shows your monthly amount.
Pay the first month's contribution in cash to the operator.
Sign the enrolment-cum-auto-debit form that is printed. The operator scans and uploads it.
You get your Kisan Pension Account Number (KPAN) and a printed Kisan card on the spot. Keep it safe.
From then on, the amount is cut automatically from your bank account or PM-Kisan money. If you leave within 10 years, you get back your own share with savings bank interest.
At age 60, LIC starts paying Rs.3,000 a month into your bank account. After your death, your spouse gets Rs.1,500 a month.
schemes.helpline: 1800-3000-3468 (PM-KMY / CSC) / 14434 (Maandhan helpline)

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Parivar Labh Yojana (National Family Benefit Scheme, NFBS)
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development — National Social Assistance Programme (Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana)
schemes.brief: A one-time payment of Rs.20,000 to a poor (BPL) family when its main earning member dies between the ages of 18 and 59, from illness, accident or any other cause. A woman who runs the home counts as a breadwinner too. The money goes to the family member who, after a local inquiry, becomes the new head of the household. This is the old National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS), renamed Pradhan Mantri Parivar Labh Yojana by the Cabinet on 14 October 2026 with the benefit unchanged, so local offices may still use the old name.
schemes.benefit: Rs.20,000 one-time payment to the family, into the bank account
eligibility: The family is below the poverty line (BPL) on the state's list. An eligible poor family missing from the list should still be considered
The person who died was the main earner of the household. A woman who looked after the home also counts
The death happened when that person was more than 18 and less than 60 years old
Any cause of death counts: illness, accident or anything else
Paid once for each such death, to the surviving member found to be the new head of the household (spouse, minor children, unmarried daughters and dependent parents make up the household)
documents: Death certificate of the breadwinner from the Registrar of Births and Deaths
Age proof of the person who died (birth or school certificate, Aadhaar or voter ID) showing an age between 18 and 59
BPL ration card, or the family's BPL list number
Aadhaar card of the applicant
First page of the bank or post-office passbook in the applicant's own name
FIR and post-mortem report, if the death was an accident
Residence proof and two passport-size photographs
Income certificate or legal heir / family certificate, where the state asks for it
schemes.submitAt: The office your state has named for this scheme: usually the Tehsil or SDM office, the Block Development Office, or the District / Tehsil Social Welfare Officer. In a village the Gram Panchayat secretary can take it and forward it; in a town, the municipal office. Most offices give their own form free; the government's model form is Annexe III (page 47) of the NSAP guidelines PDF. Take the filled form with the death certificate, the age proof of the person who died, the BPL ration card, your Aadhaar, your passbook and two photos, plus the FIR and post-mortem report for an accidental death. Some states also take this application online through their e-District or social welfare portal, or at a CSC.

demoFields.label: Name of the Deceased (Primary Breadwinner)
demoFields.hint: Copy it letter by letter from the death certificate. The two are compared.

demoFields.label: Gender and Age at the Time of Death
demoFields.hint: The age must be more than 18 and less than 60. Take it from the age proof you attach, not from memory.

demoFields.label: Date and Cause of Death
demoFields.hint: Date as on the death certificate. For an accident, attach the FIR and post-mortem report.

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: The family member who is now head of the household, usually the widow or widower.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name of the Applicant
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Relationship of the Applicant with the Deceased
demoFields.hint: Wife, husband, son, daughter, father or mother.

demoFields.label: Address (Village, Gram Panchayat / Ward, Block, District, PIN)
demoFields.value: Village Bhagwanpur, GP Bhagwanpur, Block Mahnar, Dist. Vaishali, Bihar – 844506
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: BPL Details (Survey Year, Family ID, Member ID) / Ration Card No.
demoFields.value: BPL 2002, Family ID 9999-0417, Member ID 02 / RC BR-99-999887
demoFields.hint: Copy from the BPL ration card or the BPL list kept at the Panchayat.

demoFields.value: Pooja (15, daughter), Aman (11, son), Kalavati Devi (68, mother-in-law)
demoFields.hint: Everyone in the household who depended on the person who died.

demoSteps: Get the death registered and collect the death certificate from the Panchayat or municipal Registrar. Nothing can be sanctioned without it.
Collect the free form at the Tehsil, Block or Social Welfare office (or the Gram Panchayat), fill it and attach the documents.
Get the verification part signed by the Sarpanch or ward member, submit the form at the named office, and take a dated receipt with an inward number.

A verification officer checks the facts, normally within two weeks. The case is then placed before the Gram Sabha or ward sabha and sent to the sanctioning officer (BDO, Tehsildar / SDM or District Social Welfare Officer).
The guidelines say the decision should come within 60 days of applying. You get a sanction order and Rs.20,000 is sent to your bank account.
If it is rejected, the reason must be given to you in writing. Appeal to the appellate officer your state names, usually the SDM or a district officer.
schemes.helpline: No national toll-free line: Block Development Office, Tehsil / SDM office or District Social Welfare Officer. Unresolved complaints: NSAP Division, Ministry of Rural Development 011-24663519, or CPGRAMS (pgportal.gov.in)

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Vidhawa Pension Yojana (formerly IGNWPS)
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development — Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (formerly NSAP)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension for widows aged 40 and above in below-poverty-line households. It was called the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) until the Union Cabinet renamed it on 14 October 2026, as part of the Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (formerly NSAP); the amount and rules stay the same. The Centre pays a fixed share and the state adds its own top-up. The pension stops if the widow remarries, and converts to the old-age pension once she turns 60 in states that run both.
schemes.benefit: Rs.300/month (Rs.500 after age 80) from the Centre, plus the state top-up
eligibility: Widow, aged 40 years or more on the date of application
Household is on the state's below-poverty-line (BPL) list
Has not remarried
Not drawing a family pension or another social-security pension
documents: Husband's death certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths
Age proof of the applicant — Aadhaar, voter ID or school certificate
BPL ration card, or the family's serial number on the BPL list
Aadhaar card photocopy
First page of the bank or post-office passbook in the widow's own name
Two passport-size photographs
Residence proof — voter ID, ration card or Panchayat certificate
schemes.submitAt: Gram Panchayat office, or the Block Development Office (BDO); in a town, the municipal ward office

demoFields.label: Name of the Applicant (Widow)
demoFields.hint: As spelled on the Aadhaar card. If the Aadhaar still carries the maiden surname, use that and mention the change in the declaration.

demoFields.label: Name of the Deceased Husband
demoFields.hint: Exactly as it is written on the death certificate — the two papers are compared.

demoFields.label: Date of Death of Husband

demoFields.label: Death Registration Number and Issuing Authority
