Choose the category, fill the mobile number and address, add the spouse if also 70+, and submit.
Approval usually comes the same day or within a day or two. Log in again and download the Vay Vandana card.
At an empanelled hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk and show the card. Treatment is cashless, so never pay for a covered treatment. You can also get the card made free at that desk.
schemes.helpline: 14555 / 1800-111-565 (Ayushman Bharat helpline)

schemes.title: PM Awas Yojana Urban 2.0
schemes.department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
schemes.brief: Help for a town or city family that has no pucca house of its own. There are four routes: build on your own plot, buy a flat built with government help, rent a government-built room, or take a home loan with an interest subsidy. You apply once on the portal and the urban local body decides which route fits you.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.2.50 lakh assistance, or Rs.1.80 lakh interest subsidy on a home loan
eligibility: The family, meaning husband, wife and unmarried children, must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS: yearly family income up to Rs.3 lakh. LIG: Rs.3 lakh to Rs.6 lakh. MIG: Rs.6 lakh to Rs.9 lakh
The house must be in a town or city notified under the scheme
For the Beneficiary-Led Construction route the family must already own the plot, with clear papers
The house should be in the name of a woman of the family, or jointly, except in the rental route
The family must not have taken help under any earlier central housing scheme
documents: Aadhaar of all family members
Income certificate or proof of yearly family income
Bank passbook with account number and IFSC
Proof that you own the plot, for the build-your-own route: sale deed, patta or allotment letter
Affidavit that the family owns no pucca house in India
Caste certificate, if claiming under SC, ST or OBC
Latest municipal tax or electricity bill as address proof

demoFields.label: Yearly family income
demoFields.hint: Add up what everyone in the family earns in a year. This decides whether you fall in EWS, LIG or MIG.

demoFields.label: Does the family own a pucca house?
demoFields.hint: Answer for the whole family and for the whole country, not just this city. A wrong answer here cancels the application later.

demoFields.label: Which vertical you are applying under
demoFields.hint: BLC if you own a plot and will build, AHP to buy a flat, ARH to rent, ISS for an interest subsidy on a home loan.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of the head of family
demoFields.hint: e-KYC is done on this Aadhaar. Prefer the woman of the house, since the house has to be in her name.

demoFields.label: Name and relation of each family member
demoFields.value: Anita Bhosale (self), Devidas Bhosale (husband), Sagar Bhosale (son, 12)
demoFields.hint: List husband, wife and unmarried children with their Aadhaar numbers. Married children make their own separate family.

demoFields.label: State / District / Town or city
demoFields.hint: Choose the urban local body where the house will stand. Your file will go to this office for checking.

demoFields.label: Address of the plot or present house
demoFields.hint: The full address with PIN code. For the build-your-own route, this must be the plot shown in your ownership paper.

demoFields.label: Plot ownership document number
demoFields.hint: The registration number on your sale deed, patta or allotment letter. Needed only for the build-your-own route.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The instalments are released into this account as the building work reaches each stage.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every message about survey, approval and instalments comes to this number. Give the number you use daily.

demoSteps: Open pmay-urban.gov.in and click Apply for PMAY-U 2.0.
Answer the eligibility questions: yearly family income, whether the family owns a pucca house, and your state.
Read the four verticals shown and pick the one that fits you, then enter your Aadhaar and complete e-KYC with the OTP.
Fill in the family details, the address of the plot or of your present house, and the bank account.
Upload the income proof, the ownership papers and the affidavit that you own no pucca house.
Submit and save the application number that appears. Print the acknowledgement.
The urban local body verifies the papers and a surveyor visits the plot.
Track the file on the same site under Search Beneficiary. Money is released in instalments as the work goes up, so send the photographs asked for at each stage.

schemes.title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Toilet Incentive (IHHL, Rs.12,000)
schemes.department: Ministry of Jal Shakti — Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
schemes.brief: Rs.12,000 to a village family with no toilet of its own, to build one at home with a water store for hand-washing and cleaning. In the current phase (running to March 2027) the money goes only to newly formed or left-out households that qualify, and the state may pay it in one go or in parts as the work progresses. You can apply online with just a mobile number or through the Gram Panchayat, and the incentive reaches your bank account after the finished toilet is photographed and checked.
schemes.benefit: Rs.12,000 per household for one toilet, paid into the bank account
eligibility: A rural household with no toilet of its own
Every below-poverty-line (BPL) household
Above-poverty-line households only if SC/ST, a small or marginal farmer, a landless labourer with a homestead, a household with a person with disability, or a woman-headed household
Only new or left-out households: a family that already got a toilet incentive earlier cannot get it again
Families in towns and cities apply under Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban) instead
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Mobile number for the OTP login
Bank passbook in the applicant's name, with account number and IFSC
BPL ration card, or for APL families proof of the category: caste certificate, disability certificate, or land record for small and marginal farmers
Proof that you live in the village: ration card, voter ID or Panchayat family register entry

demoFields.label: Mobile No. (as Login Id)
demoFields.hint: Register with this number first. Every login is by OTP, and only 5 OTP tries are allowed a day.

demoFields.label: Name of Applicant
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar and the bank passbook.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Pick the applicant's gender.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own 12-digit number.

demoFields.label: State / District / Block / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the house that needs the toilet stands.

demoFields.label: Household Category
demoFields.hint: Choose BPL if you are on the BPL list; otherwise the APL group that fits you.

demoFields.label: Social Category
demoFields.hint: SC, ST, OBC or General.

demoFields.label: Bank Name, Branch and IFSC
demoFields.hint: IFSC is printed on the passbook's first page.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Must be in the applicant's own name. The Rs.12,000 is paid here.

demoSteps: Open the SBM-G citizen page, tap Citizen Registration, enter your mobile number and the OTP.
Log in with mobile and OTP, open the toilet (IHHL) application, fill in applicant, address, category and bank details, submit, and note the application number.
The Gram Panchayat and block check that your household has no toilet and qualifies; new households are approved through the Gram Sabha and the district.
After approval, build the toilet with a safe pit (twin pit, or septic tank with soak pit), a superstructure and a water store for hand-washing.
Block or cluster staff take a geo-tagged photo of the finished toilet on the government mobile app.
After the check, the Rs.12,000 is paid into your bank account (some states pay part during construction). Log in again to see the status.
If nothing moves, go to the Gram Panchayat secretary or the block SBM coordinator, then file a complaint on CPGRAMS.
schemes.helpline: No national toll-free line for the incentive: Gram Panchayat secretary or Block Development Office (SBM-G block coordinator); complaints on CPGRAMS (pgportal.gov.in)

schemes.title: Aadhaar Enrolment & Update
schemes.department: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
schemes.brief: Aadhaar is the 12-digit identity number every resident of India can get, free of cost. First-time enrolment has to be done in person at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra because fingerprints, iris and photo are captured there. Name, address, date of birth and mobile can be corrected later from home on myAadhaar.
schemes.benefit: 12-digit Aadhaar number
eligibility: Any resident of India, including newborns and senior citizens — there is no minimum or maximum age.
You must have lived in India for 182 days or more in the 12 months before you apply.
NRIs holding a valid Indian passport can enrol on the strength of the passport.
Children under 5 get a Baal Aadhaar with no fingerprints; biometrics must be updated free of cost at age 5 and again at 15.
One person may hold only one Aadhaar number — enrol a second time only to correct an existing record.
documents: Proof of Identity — passport, PAN card, voter ID, ration card or driving licence
Proof of Address — electricity, water or telephone bill of the last 3 months, bank passbook or registered rent agreement
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet or passport
Proof of Relationship for a child — a parent's Aadhaar along with the child's birth certificate
Your own mobile number, which will receive the OTP for every future update

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number (only when updating)
demoFields.hint: Leave this blank if you have never enrolled. To change something in an existing record, type the 12 digits printed on your Aadhaar letter.

demoFields.label: Full Name
demoFields.hint: Write your name exactly as it should be printed — the same spelling as on your school certificate or passport. Do not use short forms.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY, as written on your birth certificate or Class 10 marksheet. You will have to upload that document as proof.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Choose Male, Female or Transgender.

demoFields.label: Guardian / Parent's Name
demoFields.hint: Compulsory for a child under 5. Adults may leave it blank unless they are using a parent's document as proof of address.

demoFields.label: Full Address
demoFields.value: H. No. 42, Gali No. 3, Nehru Nagar, Bhilwara, Rajasthan – 311001
demoFields.hint: House number, street, locality, village or town, district, state and PIN code — exactly as it appears on the bill or passbook you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Give a number you use yourself and will keep. Every Aadhaar update, bank KYC and DBT payment sends its OTP here.

demoFields.label: Email Address
demoFields.hint: Optional, but the e-Aadhaar PDF and update receipts come here. Leave blank if you do not use email.

demoFields.label: Proof of Identity Document
demoFields.hint: Pick the document type from the list, then upload a clear scan or photo of the original. The name on it must match what you typed above.

demoFields.label: Proof of Address Document
demoFields.hint: Must be in your own name and not older than 3 months for a bill. If the bill is in a parent's or spouse's name, use the relationship-proof route instead.

demoSteps: For a first Aadhaar, go straight to step 5 — a new enrolment cannot be completed online.
To correct an existing Aadhaar, open myAadhaar and sign in with your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your registered mobile.
Choose 'Update Aadhaar Online'. Name, date of birth, gender and address can be corrected from home; upload a scan of the supporting document.
Pay the fee online (around Rs.50 for an online document or address update) and save the URN — the Update Request Number that tracks your request.
For a first-time enrolment, or to change your photo, fingerprints or iris, book a slot at an Aadhaar Seva Kendra. This visit is unavoidable: biometrics can only be captured in person.
Carry the original documents to the centre. The operator takes your photograph, all ten fingerprints and both iris scans, and hands you an acknowledgement slip with a 14-digit EID.
Track the EID or URN on myAadhaar. The Aadhaar letter is posted to your address, and the e-Aadhaar PDF can be downloaded as soon as the number is generated.
A child's biometrics must be updated free of charge at age 5 and at 15, otherwise the Aadhaar can be deactivated.
schemes.helpline: 1947 — UIDAI toll-free helpline, available in 12 languages · help@uidai.gov.in

schemes.title: Birth Certificate (Civil Registration System)
schemes.department: Registrar General of India / State Registrar of Births & Deaths
schemes.brief: Every birth in India must be registered within 21 days, and it costs nothing in that window. The birth certificate is the first document a child owns and the one every school, passport office and employer later asks for. Since the 2023 amendment the whole system is digital and the certificate can be downloaded.
schemes.benefit: Legal birth certificate
eligibility: Every birth that takes place in India must be registered, whatever the parents' nationality or religion.
Free if reported within 21 days of the birth.
Between 22 and 30 days it is registered on payment of a late fee.
Between 30 days and one year it needs the written permission of the District Magistrate or the prescribed authority, plus an affidavit.
After one year it can only be registered on the order of a Judicial Magistrate First Class.
For a hospital birth the hospital is the informant; for a birth at home it is the head of the household.
documents: Discharge summary or the birth letter issued by the hospital or nursing home
Aadhaar of both parents
Parents' marriage certificate, where the state asks for it
Proof of the parents' address — electricity bill, ration card or Aadhaar
A declaration by the head of the household, for a birth at home
Affidavit and the competent authority's permission, for a late registration

demoFields.label: Child's Name
demoFields.hint: May be left blank if the name is not decided yet — it can be added later, free, within the period your state allows.

demoFields.label: Date and Time of Birth
demoFields.hint: Copy both exactly from the hospital discharge summary. A mismatch here is the commonest reason a certificate has to be corrected later.

demoFields.label: Sex
demoFields.hint: Male, Female or Transgender.

demoFields.label: Place of Birth
demoFields.hint: Choose Hospital, Home or Other. For a hospital birth give its registered name; for a home birth give the full house address.

demoFields.label: Mother's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Full name as on her Aadhaar. The spelling is carried onto the child's certificate and is hard to change afterwards.

demoFields.label: Father's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Full name as on his Aadhaar, matching the hospital record.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address of the Parents
demoFields.value: Plot 7, Ganesh Colony, Panchavati, Nashik, Maharashtra – 422003
demoFields.hint: The family's own address, which may differ from the hospital's. The certificate is issued by the registrar covering the place of birth, not this address.

demoFields.label: Mother's Age, Education and Occupation
demoFields.value: Age at marriage 24, age at this birth 27; Graduate; Homemaker
demoFields.hint: Statistical questions that the form requires. Answer honestly — they do not affect whether the certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Informant's Name and Relationship
demoFields.hint: The person reporting the birth. For a hospital birth this is usually the hospital's records clerk; for a home birth, the head of the household.

demoFields.label: Registration Unit
demoFields.hint: The local body covering the place of birth — municipal corporation, nagar palika or gram panchayat. The portal lists the units once you pick the district.

demoSteps: If the baby was born in a hospital, the hospital reports the birth itself. Ask the records desk for the reporting or acknowledgement number before you are discharged.
For a birth at home, the head of the household registers on the CRS portal as 'General Public' and verifies the mobile number by OTP.
Fill Form 1, the Birth Report, within 21 days of the birth — registration is free inside that window.
Attach the hospital discharge summary, or a declaration for a home birth, along with both parents' Aadhaar and an address proof.
The local Registrar of Births & Deaths checks the entry and registers it. There is no biometric visit and no interview, but the registrar may call you to clarify a detail.
A late report needs more: a fee after 21 days, the prescribed authority's written permission after 30 days, and a Judicial Magistrate's order after a year.
Download the digitally signed certificate from the portal once it is issued, or collect a copy from the registrar's office. It also appears in DigiLocker.
Check every spelling and the date on the certificate the day you receive it — correcting it later needs a separate application with supporting proof.
schemes.helpline: Your municipal corporation, nagar palika or gram panchayat Registrar of Births & Deaths — CRS applications are decided by the local registrar rather than a central number

schemes.title: Driving Licence
schemes.department: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways / State RTO
schemes.brief: A driving licence comes in two stages. First you get a learner's licence after a short test on road signs and rules, then you practise for at least a month and take a driving test at the RTO to get the permanent licence. Both stages start on Sarathi.
schemes.benefit: Permanent driving licence
eligibility: 18 years for a motorcycle with gears and for a light motor vehicle such as a car.
16 years for a gearless two-wheeler up to 50cc, with the written consent of a parent or guardian.
20 years for a transport vehicle licence, along with the schooling your state requires and a year's driving experience.
You must hold a learner's licence for at least 30 days before you can sit the driving test, and it stays valid for 6 months.
You must be medically fit — a self-declaration on Form 1, or a doctor's certificate on Form 1A if you are over 40 or applying for a transport licence.
documents: Proof of Age — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet, PAN or passport
Proof of Address — Aadhaar, electricity bill, ration card or voter ID
Form 1 self-declaration of physical fitness, or Form 1A from a registered doctor where required
Passport-size photographs and a scanned signature
The learner's licence, when you come back for the permanent licence
Consent of a parent or guardian, for a 16-year-old applying for a gearless two-wheeler

demoFields.label: State and RTO
demoFields.hint: Choose the RTO for the address where you live. Sarathi opens your state's own screens once you pick the state.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on your age proof. This is printed on the licence card and must match your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. The portal checks your age against the class of vehicle you are applying for and rejects the form if you are short.

demoFields.label: Father's or Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Full name, no initials. It is printed on the licence.

demoFields.label: Class of Vehicle
demoFields.hint: Tick every class you want. MCWOG is a scooter without gears, MCWG a geared motorcycle, LMV a car or jeep. Adding a class later means another test.

demoFields.label: Present Address
demoFields.value: C-118, Sector 12, Indira Nagar, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh – 226016
demoFields.hint: Must match your address proof, since the licence is posted there and the RTO is decided by it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Most states now allow Aadhaar e-KYC, which pulls in your name, photo and address and saves you a trip for document checking.

demoFields.label: Blood Group
demoFields.hint: Printed on the licence and used by hospitals after an accident. Get it right.

demoFields.label: Learner's Licence Number
demoFields.hint: Leave blank when applying for the learner's licence. Fill it when you come back for the permanent licence after 30 days.

demoFields.label: Test Slot
demoFields.hint: Book after paying the fee. Reach the RTO track on time with the vehicle of the class you are testing for.

demoSteps: Open Sarathi, choose your state and select 'Apply for Learner Licence'.
Fill Form 2, upload your age and address proof and the Form 1 self-declaration — or Form 1A from a doctor if you are over 40 or want a transport licence.
Pay the fee and book a slot. Unless your state completes Aadhaar e-KYC online, you go to the RTO for document verification, where your photograph and signature are captured.
Sit the learner's test: ten multiple-choice questions on road signs and traffic rules, taken at the RTO or from home in states that allow it. The learner's licence is issued the same day.
Practise for at least 30 days. The learner's licence is valid for 6 months.
Between the 31st day and the end of the sixth month, apply for the permanent licence on Form 4, pay the fee and book a driving test slot.
Take the driving test at the RTO track in a vehicle of the class you applied for — you have to arrange the vehicle yourself, and the inspector checks control, parking and reversing.
On passing, the licence is printed and posted to your address, and it can also be pulled into DigiLocker or mParivahan. It is valid for 20 years or until you turn 50, whichever comes first.
schemes.helpline: 0120-4925505 — Parivahan Sewa helpdesk · your own RTO for test slots and document checks

schemes.title: Indian Passport (Fresh or Re-issue)
schemes.department: Ministry of External Affairs — Passport Seva
schemes.brief: The passport is your proof of Indian citizenship and the document you travel abroad on. You apply online, then attend one appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra where your papers are checked and your photo and fingerprints are taken. A policeman usually visits your address afterwards.
schemes.benefit: Passport in about 30 days
eligibility: Any Indian citizen, of any age — there is no minimum age, and infants get a passport valid for 5 years.
A minor under 18 applies through both parents, who must sign Annexure D consenting to it.
You must apply at the Regional Passport Office covering your present address, whether or not it is your home town.
Tatkaal is open to most applicants but not to those with a pending court case, an earlier passport that was impounded, or a doubtful citizenship claim.
Anyone who has passed Class 10 gets ECNR status, which removes the emigration check requirement for working abroad.
documents: Proof of Present Address — Aadhaar, electricity or water bill, bank passbook with photo, or registered rent agreement
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 certificate, PAN or Aadhaar
Aadhaar card, which also serves as the standard proof of identity
Class 10 marksheet or certificate, if you want ECNR printed on the passport
Annexure D signed by both parents, plus their passports or IDs, when the applicant is a minor
The old passport in original, for a re-issue

demoFields.label: Type of Application
demoFields.hint: Fresh if you have never held one, Re-issue if you are renewing. Choose Tatkaal only if you genuinely need it in a week — it costs considerably more.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: Given name and surname in separate boxes, spelt exactly as on your Class 10 certificate. This spelling will follow you on every visa you ever apply for.

demoFields.label: Date and Place of Birth
demoFields.hint: Date as on your birth certificate, and the district and state where you were born — not where you live now.

demoFields.label: Father's and Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Both are compulsory and both are printed inside the passport. Use full names, not initials.

demoFields.label: Present Residential Address
demoFields.value: 8-2-341, Road No. 5, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500034
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, because this is the address the police will visit. It decides which Passport Office handles your file.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. A self-declaration that your Aadhaar details are correct is part of the form.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Be accurate — passing Class 10 or above is what gets you ECNR status, which matters if you plan to work in the Gulf.

demoFields.label: Employment Type
demoFields.hint: Government, Public Sector, Private, Self-employed, Student, Homemaker or Retired. Government employees must also attach an Identity Certificate or NOC.

demoFields.label: Emergency Contact
demoFields.hint: A relative or friend who is not travelling with you. Their name and phone number are printed in the back of the passport.

demoFields.label: Passport Office and Appointment Slot
demoFields.hint: The office is fixed by your address; you only choose the date and time. Slots open at a set hour each day and go quickly.

demoSteps: Register on the Passport Seva portal, confirm the link sent to your email, and log in.
Choose 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue', fill the form online or upload the XML, and save it.
Pay the fee online — this is what unlocks the appointment calendar — and book a slot at your Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office PSK.
Attend the appointment in person on the given date, carrying every original plus one self-attested photocopy of each. Nobody can attend on your behalf.
Inside the PSK you pass three counters: A, where your documents are scanned and your photograph and fingerprints are captured; B, the Verification Officer; and C, the Granting Officer.
Police verification follows. A constable from your local station comes to your address to confirm you live there — keep your originals ready and be reachable on the phone number you gave.
Track the file number on the portal or the mPassport Seva app. Once granted, the passport is printed and sent by Speed Post with a tracking number.
Normal applications take roughly 30 to 45 days including police verification. Tatkaal, where the verification happens after the passport is issued, takes about 3 to 7 working days.
schemes.helpline: 1800-258-1800 — Passport Seva National Call Centre, toll-free

schemes.title: PAN Card (Form 49A)
schemes.department: Income Tax Department, CBDT
schemes.brief: PAN is the 10-character permanent account number the Income Tax Department issues to you for life. You need it to file a return, open a bank or demat account, and for any large payment or property deal. With Aadhaar e-KYC the whole application is done online and nothing has to be posted.
schemes.benefit: 10-character PAN card
eligibility: Any Indian citizen of any age — a minor's PAN is applied for by a parent or guardian.
Compulsory once your income crosses the basic exemption limit, and for filing an income tax return.
Needed to open a bank or demat account, to buy or sell property or a vehicle, and for cash payments above the prescribed limit.
Foreign citizens and foreign entities apply on Form 49AA instead of Form 49A.
One person, one PAN — holding a second PAN attracts a penalty under section 272B of the Income Tax Act.
documents: Aadhaar number, and the mobile registered with it, for e-KYC
Proof of Identity — Aadhaar, voter ID, passport or driving licence
Proof of Address — Aadhaar, electricity bill, bank statement or passport
Proof of Date of Birth — birth certificate, Class 10 certificate or passport
A recent passport-size photograph and your signature scanned on plain white paper

demoFields.label: Application Type
demoFields.hint: Choose this for a first PAN. Pick 'Changes or Correction' only if you already hold a PAN and want to fix a detail or get a reprint.

demoFields.label: Title and Full Name
demoFields.hint: Shri, Smt or Kumari, then first, middle and last name in separate boxes. It must match your Aadhaar exactly, or the e-KYC will fail.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Compulsory even for married women. Fill your father's full name, not your husband's, unless you tick the option to print the mother's name instead.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY as on your birth certificate or Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. Quoting Aadhaar is mandatory, and the name and date of birth here must agree with your Aadhaar record.

demoFields.label: Address for Communication
demoFields.value: Flat 12-B, Sai Residency, Kothrud, Pune, Maharashtra – 411038
demoFields.hint: Where the printed card should be delivered. Give a full postal address with PIN code — the card is sent by ordinary post.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The OTP for e-Sign comes to this mobile and the e-PAN PDF comes to this email, so give a working pair.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.hint: Choose Salary, Business or profession, House property, Capital gains, Other, or 'No income' for a student or homemaker.

demoFields.label: AO Code (Area / AO Type / Range / AO Number)
demoFields.hint: Your assessing officer's code. Do not guess it — use the portal's 'AO Code Search' and pick the one for your city and income type.

demoFields.label: Name to be Printed on the Card
demoFields.hint: Usually the same as your full name. It is printed in capitals, so check the spelling carefully — a reprint costs money.

demoSteps: Open the Protean TIN-PAN portal and choose 'New PAN – Indian Citizen (Form 49A)'.
Pick the Aadhaar e-KYC and e-Sign route. Your photograph and details are pulled from Aadhaar, so no papers have to be posted anywhere.
Fill your name, father's name, address, source of income and the AO code — use the portal's AO Code Search rather than guessing.
Pay the fee online, roughly Rs.107 for a physical card delivered to an Indian address and less if you want only the e-PAN. Note the 15-digit acknowledgement number.
Authenticate with the Aadhaar OTP to e-Sign the form. There is no visit to any office on this route.
If you instead chose the physical mode, print the acknowledgement, paste two photographs, sign across them and post it to Protean's Pune office within 15 days — the application lapses otherwise.
The e-PAN PDF reaches your email in about 3 to 5 working days and the printed card follows by post in roughly two weeks.
If you need a PAN the same day and your mobile is linked to Aadhaar, the Income Tax portal's 'Instant e-PAN' issues one free in about ten minutes.
schemes.helpline: 020-27218080 — Protean TIN call centre · Income Tax helpline 1800-103-0025

schemes.title: Voter Registration (Form 6)
schemes.department: Election Commission of India
schemes.brief: Form 6 is how a first-time voter gets their name onto the electoral roll and receives an EPIC, the voter ID card. It is free. After you apply, the Booth Level Officer of your area comes to check that you really live at the address you gave.
schemes.benefit: Voter ID card (EPIC)
eligibility: You must be a citizen of India — this is the one document that is closed to non-citizens.
You must be 18 or older on the qualifying date. There are four qualifying dates a year: 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October.
A 17-year-old may apply in advance; the name is added once the next qualifying date passes.
You must be an ordinary resident of the constituency you are applying in, not a temporary visitor.
You must not already be enrolled somewhere else — to move your entry to a new address, use Form 8 instead of Form 6.
documents: Recent passport-size colour photograph with a plain white background
Proof of Age — birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet, PAN, passport or driving licence
Proof of Address — electricity, water or gas bill, bank passbook, rent agreement or Aadhaar
Aadhaar number, which is optional and collected on Form 6B
A declaration by a parent, along with their address proof, if the utility bill is not in your own name

demoFields.label: State, District and Assembly Constituency
demoFields.hint: Pick the constituency covering the address where you actually live. The portal shows the list once you choose the district.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on your school certificate. The portal also asks for the same name in the state's own script, which it can transliterate for you.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY. You must be 18 on the qualifying date, and the age proof you upload has to show this exact date.

demoFields.label: Relative's Name and Relationship
demoFields.hint: Father, mother, husband or legal guardian. This name is printed on the EPIC below yours.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Optional. Giving it helps the officer weed out duplicate entries, and you may tick 'I am not able to furnish Aadhaar' instead.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every status update and the e-EPIC download link are sent here. Use a number you check.

demoFields.label: Present Ordinary Residence Address
demoFields.hint: The address where you normally live and where the BLO will come looking for you. It must match the address proof you upload.

demoFields.label: Age or Date of Birth Proof
demoFields.hint: Upload a clear scan under the size limit the portal shows. A birth certificate or Class 10 marksheet is accepted everywhere.

demoFields.label: Address Proof
demoFields.value: Electricity bill in father's name, with his declaration
demoFields.hint: If the bill is not in your name, attach the declaration from the family member whose name is on it, along with their own proof.

demoFields.label: Photograph
demoFields.value: Colour photo, white background, JPG under 2 MB
demoFields.hint: Face straight to the camera, no cap and no dark glasses. This picture goes on your EPIC, so do not use a group photo cropped down.

demoSteps: Sign up on the Voter Services portal with your mobile number and set a password.
Choose 'New registration for general electors (Form 6)'.
Fill your constituency, name, date of birth, relative's name and address; upload the photograph, age proof and address proof.
Submit and save the reference ID — that is how you track the application from here on.
The Booth Level Officer of your polling area visits your address to verify that you live there. Keep your original documents at hand; if nobody is home the application can be held up.
The Electoral Registration Officer then decides the claim, and a public notice is put up before the name is added.
Once approved, download the e-EPIC free from the portal. The printed PVC card is posted separately to your address.
The whole process usually takes a few weeks, and is faster when a roll revision is under way.
schemes.helpline: 1950 — National Voter Helpline (dial your district's STD code before it)

schemes.title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
schemes.brief: A guaranteed pension of Rs.1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 a month from age 60, for anyone aged 18 to 40 who has a savings account and does not pay income tax. You choose the pension, and a fixed amount is auto-debited from your bank account until you turn 60; the younger you join, the less you pay. After you, your husband or wife gets the same pension, and after both of you the nominee gets the saved amount. The Cabinet extended the scheme up to 2030-31 in January 2026; you can join online on eAPY if your bank is listed there, through your bank's net banking, or at your bank or post office branch.
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension of Rs.1,000 to Rs.5,000 a month from age 60
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 to 40 years
Has a savings bank or post office savings account; only one APY account per person
Not an income tax payer now or in the past (rule from 1 October 2022); if found later, the account is closed and the money returned
Pays every month, quarter or half-year until age 60, so at least 20 years of payments
Monthly amount depends on joining age: Rs.42 to Rs.210 at age 18, Rs.291 to Rs.1,454 at age 40
documents: Savings bank account number and IFSC (passbook)
Aadhaar card
Mobile number registered with Aadhaar
Spouse's name, and the nominee's name, relation and date of birth
For eAPY: Aadhaar OTP, Virtual ID, or the Aadhaar offline e-KYC ZIP file with its share code

demoFields.label: Whether Income Tax Payer
demoFields.hint: Choose No. Anyone who has ever paid income tax cannot join APY.

demoFields.label: Select your Bank
demoFields.hint: The bank where your savings account is. If your bank is not in the list (for example SBI), join through its net banking or at the branch.

demoFields.label: NLCC/Branch Name
demoFields.hint: The branch where your account is, as printed on the passbook.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Type
demoFields.hint: APY works only with a savings account.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the passbook. The monthly amount is debited from this account until you turn 60.

demoFields.label: Bank IFS Code
demoFields.hint: The 11-character branch code printed on the passbook or cheque.

demoFields.label: Please Select option (KYC)
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar or Virtual ID sends an OTP. Offline KYC needs the ZIP file downloaded from the UIDAI site and its share code.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Registered Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The number linked to your Aadhaar; the OTP comes here.

demoFields.label: Pension Amount
demoFields.hint: The pension you want at 60. A bigger pension means a bigger monthly payment; the exact amount for your age is shown before you submit.

demoFields.label: Periodicity of Contribution
demoFields.hint: Monthly, quarterly or half-yearly. Monthly is easiest to keep up with on a small income.

demoSteps: Open the eAPY page and choose New Registration. Answer No to income tax, and pick your bank, branch, account type, account number and IFSC.
Choose Aadhaar, Virtual ID or offline KYC, enter your Aadhaar-registered mobile number and verify with the OTP; your details are taken from Aadhaar.
Pick the pension amount and how often you will pay, tick the consent for auto-debit, and fill the captcha.
On the next pages add your spouse and nominee, then confirm with OTP or eSign. Save the acknowledgement number that comes by SMS or email.
Once the bank verifies your account, you get a PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) and the first amount is debited, so keep enough balance.
Keep money in the account on the debit date every time. A late payment draws a small penalty.
From age 60 the chosen pension comes to your account every month. After you, your spouse gets the same pension; after both, the nominee gets Rs.1.7 lakh to Rs.8.5 lakh.
schemes.helpline: 1800-889-1030 (APY toll-free, Protean CRA); your bank branch for debit problems

schemes.title: Jeevan Pramaan — Digital Life Certificate
schemes.department: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY)
schemes.brief: Every pensioner has to prove once a year that they are alive, or the pension stops. Jeevan Pramaan replaces the trip to the bank with a biometric or face scan that can be done at home on a phone. The certificate reaches your bank electronically, so there is no paper to hand in.
schemes.benefit: Digital Life Certificate (Pramaan ID)
eligibility: Any pensioner of the Central Government, a State Government or another government body whose pension disbursing agency has joined Jeevan Pramaan.
Your Aadhaar must already be recorded with the bank or agency that pays your pension — without that the certificate cannot be matched to your file.
The mobile number linked to your Aadhaar must be working, since the OTP goes there.
The certificate is submitted every year in November, and pensioners aged 80 and above may submit from 1 October.
Family pensioners can submit in the same way, using their own Aadhaar and the PPO number of the family pension.
documents: Aadhaar number, with the mobile linked to it in working order
PPO number, from the Pension Payment Order book
Bank account number and the branch where the pension is credited
The name of the pension sanctioning authority and the disbursing agency
A smartphone with the Jeevan Pramaan or Face Authentication app, or a UIDAI-certified fingerprint or iris device

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The same Aadhaar that your pension office holds on record. If the bank has a different number on file, get that corrected first or the certificate will not attach.

demoFields.label: Pensioner's Name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as it appears in your Aadhaar record, not as it appears in the PPO, if the two differ.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Must be the number linked to your Aadhaar — the authentication OTP is sent there and nowhere else.

demoFields.label: Type of Pension
demoFields.hint: Service, family, disability or another category, as written in your PPO.

demoFields.label: Pension Sanctioning Authority
demoFields.hint: The office that sanctioned the pension — an Accountant General, a ministry, the CGDA for defence pensioners, or a state department. Pick it from the list.

demoFields.label: Disbursing Agency and Branch
demoFields.value: State Bank of India, Aliganj Branch, Lucknow
demoFields.hint: The bank or post office that actually credits your pension each month. The certificate is delivered to this agency.

demoFields.label: PPO Number
demoFields.hint: The Pension Payment Order number from the first page of your PPO book. Copy every digit — a wrong PPO number is the usual reason a certificate does not reach the bank.

demoFields.label: Pension Account Number
demoFields.hint: The account the pension is credited to, with its IFSC. Check it against your passbook.

demoFields.label: Re-employment and Re-marriage Declaration
demoFields.hint: A legal declaration that affects your entitlement. Family pensioners must answer the re-marriage question honestly; a false declaration can mean recovery of the pension.

demoFields.label: Biometric Authentication
demoFields.value: Right thumb fingerprint captured on the device
demoFields.hint: Fingerprint or iris on a certified device, or a face scan through the Face Authentication app. Elderly fingerprints often fail — use the face scan instead of trying repeatedly.

demoSteps: Install the Jeevan Pramaan app and the Aadhaar Face RD app on a smartphone, or go to a bank branch, post office, CSC or your pension office where an operator has the equipment.
Register with your Aadhaar number, mobile and email, and confirm the OTP that arrives.
Enter the PPO number, the sanctioning authority, the disbursing agency and your pension account number.

Authenticate biometrically — a fingerprint or iris scan on a UIDAI-certified device, or a face scan through the app, which needs no device at all. This step has to be done by the pensioner in person, but it can be done at home.
The Pramaan ID and the life certificate are generated on the spot and an SMS confirms it.
The certificate travels electronically to your pension disbursing agency. Nothing has to be printed, signed or carried to the bank.
Download the certificate from the Jeevan Pramaan site using your Pramaan ID if you want a copy for your records.
Repeat it every November. Pensioners of 80 and above may submit from 1 October, and the certificate stays valid for a year from the date it is generated.
schemes.helpline: 1800-111-555 — CSC and Jeevan Pramaan support · jeevanpramaan@gov.in

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM Pension)
schemes.department: Ministry of Labour & Employment (enrolment through Common Service Centres, pension paid by LIC)
schemes.brief: A pension of Rs.3,000 a month from age 60 for workers who have no employer pension: labourers, street vendors, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, farm hands, home-based workers and the like. You pay a small fixed amount every month from your bank account, from Rs.55 to Rs.200 depending on the age at which you join, and the Centre puts in the same amount again. You can join yourself on the Maandhan portal with a mobile OTP, or at any CSC with your Aadhaar and bank passbook.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month pension from age 60; the Centre matches every payment you make
eligibility: Unorganised worker aged 18 to 40 years on the day of joining
Monthly income of Rs.15,000 or less
Not a member of EPF, ESIC or the government-funded NPS, and not an income tax payer
Must have a savings bank or Jan Dhan account with IFSC, and a mobile phone
Husband and wife can each join separately, and each gets a pension of their own
documents: Aadhaar card
Savings bank or Jan Dhan passbook showing the account number and IFSC
Mobile number (the OTP and payment messages come here)
Name and date of birth of your spouse and of your nominee
Cash for the first month's contribution if you join at a CSC (later months are auto-debited)

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Self Enrollment. CSC VLE is only for the CSC operator, and Admin Login is for officials.

demoFields.label: Mobile
demoFields.hint: A number you always carry. The login OTP and every debit message come to this phone.

demoFields.label: Scheme
demoFields.hint: Pick PM-SYM. The other choice on the same portal, NPS-Traders, is for shopkeepers and small traders.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. After the Aadhaar OTP, your name, date of birth and gender fill in by themselves, so check them.

demoFields.label: Occupation
demoFields.hint: The work you actually do every day, for example construction labourer, street vendor, rickshaw puller or farm labourer.

demoFields.label: Monthly income
demoFields.hint: What you earn in a normal month. It must be Rs.15,000 or less.

demoFields.label: Bank IFSC and account number
demoFields.hint: Your own savings or Jan Dhan account. The monthly amount is auto-debited from here, so keep enough balance.

demoFields.label: Spouse name
demoFields.hint: Husband's or wife's name. If you die before 60, your spouse can carry on paying or take the money out.

demoFields.label: Nominee name and relation
demoFields.hint: The person who gets the savings if both you and your spouse die.

demoFields.label: Self-declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm you are not in EPF, ESIC or NPS and do not pay income tax. A false declaration gets the account closed.

demoSteps: Open the Maandhan login page, choose Self Enrollment and log in with your mobile number and OTP. Or go to a CSC with your Aadhaar and passbook, and the operator enrols you with your fingerprint.
Choose PM-SYM, enter your Aadhaar number and verify it with the Aadhaar OTP.
Fill in your occupation, monthly income, bank account with IFSC, spouse and nominee, and tick the self-declaration.
The portal shows your monthly amount for your age: Rs.55 at 18, Rs.100 at 29, Rs.200 at 40. Pay the first month and approve the auto-debit from your bank account.
Your Shram Yogi card with its Shram Yogi Pension Account Number (SPAN) is created. Download and keep it; an SMS confirms the enrolment.
Every month the same amount is auto-debited and the Centre adds an equal amount. Keep money in the account; missed months have to be paid later with a penalty.
From age 60, Rs.3,000 comes into your bank account every month. If you die after that, your spouse gets Rs.1,500 a month for life.
schemes.helpline: 1800-267-6888 (PM-SYM toll-free) / 14434 (Labour Ministry helpline)

schemes.title: UDID — Unique Disability ID Card
schemes.department: Dept. of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
schemes.brief: The UDID card is a single national identity card for a person with a disability, and it carries the disability certificate on it. One card replaces the separate certificates that different states and departments used to ask for, and it is what gets you reservation in jobs and education, travel concessions, scholarships and the disability pension.
schemes.benefit: UDID card and disability certificate
eligibility: Any person with one of the 21 disabilities listed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
Disability is assessed by a Medical Board, and most benefits require a certified disability of 40 per cent or more.
There is no age limit, and there is no income condition for the card itself.
Someone who already holds a state disability certificate can have it converted to a UDID without being examined again, if the certificate is valid.
The card is free, and the application, the medical assessment and the card all cost nothing.
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Recent passport-size colour photograph and a scanned signature or thumb impression
Any existing disability certificate, if one has already been issued
Medical reports or hospital records supporting the disability claim
Proof of address — Aadhaar, ration card, electricity bill or voter ID
Income certificate and BPL card, if you want to claim income-linked benefits

demoFields.label: Applicant's Full Name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The card is printed from this entry, so check the spelling before submitting.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: DD/MM/YYYY as on your birth certificate or Aadhaar. For a child, the parent or guardian fills the form.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: All 12 digits. Aadhaar is how the card is kept unique across states, so the same person cannot hold two.

demoFields.label: Type of Disability
demoFields.hint: Choose from the 21 conditions listed in the Act — locomotor, visual, hearing, speech, intellectual, multiple and others. The Medical Board confirms it later.

demoFields.label: Existing Disability Certificate
demoFields.hint: If a state certificate was issued to you earlier, enter its number and upload it; you may then be spared a fresh examination.

demoFields.label: Present and Permanent Address
demoFields.value: Village Barwadih, Post Chatra, District Latehar, Jharkhand – 829202
demoFields.hint: This decides which district's CMO office handles your file and which hospital you are called to, so give the address where you actually live.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The assessment appointment and every status change are sent here. Give a number someone in the house answers.

demoFields.label: Employment and Education Status
demoFields.hint: Used for scholarship and job-reservation schemes linked to the card. It does not affect whether the certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Photograph and Signature
demoFields.value: Colour passport photo, JPG under 1 MB, and a scanned signature
demoFields.hint: A plain background, face clearly visible. A thumb impression is accepted in place of a signature.

demoFields.label: Hospital for Assessment
demoFields.hint: Pick from the hospitals the portal lists for your district, or leave it to the CMO office to assign one.

demoSteps: Register on the UDID portal, or the UDID mobile app, and choose 'Apply for Disability Certificate and UDID Card'.
Fill your personal, disability, employment and identity details and upload your photograph, signature, Aadhaar and any existing disability certificate.
Submit the form and note the enrolment number. The CMO office of your district verifies what you have entered.
You are given a medical assessment appointment at a government hospital. Attend it in person — a specialist or a Medical Board examines you and records the type of disability and the percentage.
The board's finding is uploaded, the CMO signs off, and a UDID number is generated.
Download the e-Disability Certificate and the e-UDID card from the portal as soon as they appear — they are valid on their own and you need not wait for the plastic card.
The PVC card is printed centrally and delivered by post. Track it on the portal with your enrolment number.
A certificate given to a child, or one issued for a condition that can change, carries an expiry date and has to be renewed by a fresh assessment.
schemes.helpline: Your district Social Welfare Office or the Chief Medical Officer's office, which processes UDID applications and fixes the medical assessment

schemes.title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy
schemes.brief: Put solar panels on your own roof and the government pays a large part of the cost straight into your bank account. A household system of about 3 kW can cover the electricity a normal family uses, up to 300 units a month, and whatever you do not use is sold back to the power company.
schemes.benefit: Subsidy up to Rs.78,000 and up to 300 free units a month
eligibility: An Indian household that owns the roof where the panels will go, with the owner's consent if it is shared
A valid electricity connection in the applicant's own name, with the consumer number on the bill
The roof must be strong enough and get direct sun, with about 100 square feet needed for each kilowatt
The household must not already have taken a central subsidy for a rooftop solar plant
Subsidy is Rs.30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and Rs.18,000 for the third kW, with Rs.78,000 as the highest amount
documents: Latest electricity bill, showing the consumer number and the sanctioned load
Aadhaar card of the consumer
Proof that you own the roof: sale deed, property tax receipt or allotment letter
Bank passbook and a cancelled cheque, for the subsidy transfer
Recent photograph of the roof, uploaded during the application
Net-meter and inspection papers, which come later from the power company

demoFields.label: State and electricity company (DISCOM)
demoFields.hint: The company named at the top of your electricity bill. Choose it exactly, or your application will not reach anyone.

demoFields.label: Electricity consumer number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your electricity bill, usually at the top. Type it without spaces or dashes.

demoFields.label: Mobile number and email
demoFields.hint: Used for the login OTP and for every message about approval and subsidy. Email is optional but useful.

demoFields.label: Consumer name and address
demoFields.value: Lata Solanki, 12 Sunrise Society, Anand, Gujarat - 388001
demoFields.hint: Must match the name and address on the electricity bill. If the bill is in your late father's name, get it transferred first.

demoFields.label: Sanctioned load (kW)
demoFields.hint: Written on your electricity bill. The solar plant you ask for should not be larger than this, else you must apply to raise the load.

demoFields.label: Solar capacity you want (kW)
demoFields.hint: About 3 kW suits a family using 250 to 300 units a month. Subsidy is capped at 3 kW, so more than that gets no extra money.

demoFields.label: Roof area available (square feet)
demoFields.hint: Measure the clear, shade-free part of the roof. Roughly 100 square feet is needed for each kilowatt.

demoFields.label: Registered vendor chosen
demoFields.hint: Pick only from the vendor list on the portal. Work done by an outside fitter gets no subsidy.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Filled in after the plant is installed. The subsidy is credited here, usually within 30 days of commissioning.

demoFields.label: Cancelled cheque
demoFields.value: Photo of cheque with the account name printed
demoFields.hint: Upload a clear photo. The name on the cheque must match the name on the electricity bill.

demoSteps: Open pmsuryaghar.gov.in and click Apply for Rooftop Solar, then register with your state, power company, consumer number and mobile.
Log in with the consumer number and the OTP, and fill the application: sanctioned load, the capacity you want, and the roof area.
Submit and wait for the power company to approve feasibility. This usually takes a few days and comes as an SMS.
After approval, choose a vendor from the registered list on the portal and get the plant installed. Agree the price in writing first.
Once it is fitted, submit the plant details on the portal and apply for the net meter.
The power company installs the net meter and an inspector checks the work.
The commissioning certificate is issued on the portal. Only now add your bank account number and a cancelled cheque.
The subsidy reaches your account in about 30 days. After that, your bill shows only the units you draw over what your roof produces.

schemes.title: PM Ujjwala Yojana LPG Connection
schemes.department: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
schemes.brief: A free cooking gas connection for a woman of a poor household, so that the kitchen is free of smoke from wood and dung. The government pays the deposit for the cylinder and regulator, and gives the first refill and the stove free. Every refill after that gets a subsidy paid into the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Free connection, first refill and stove, plus Rs.300 subsidy on each refill
eligibility: The applicant must be a woman, aged 18 years or above
No other LPG connection may exist in the household, in anyone's name

The household must belong to one of the listed poor groups: SC or ST, PMAY beneficiary, Antyodaya card holder, most backward class, tea garden worker, forest dweller, island or river-island resident, or any poor family covered by the 14-point declaration
Aadhaar of the applicant, and of all adults in the family, must be given
A woman who has moved and cannot get a ration card in the new place may use a self-declaration of family instead
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman applying, used as identity and address proof
Aadhaar of all adult members of the family
Ration card or state-issued family certificate, or the KYC self-declaration form if you have moved
Bank passbook with account number and IFSC, in the applicant's own name
Recent passport-size photograph
Filled and signed KYC form of the gas company

demoFields.label: Gas company
demoFields.hint: Indane, Bharatgas or HP Gas. Choose the one whose delivery agency is closest to your village or ward.

demoFields.label: Type of connection
demoFields.hint: Choose the Ujjwala option, not the ordinary new connection, otherwise you will have to pay the deposit yourself.

demoFields.label: State, district and distributor
demoFields.value: Uttar Pradesh / Barabanki / Maa Sharda Indane Gramin Vitrak
demoFields.hint: The list shows the agencies near you. Pick one you can actually reach, since the cylinder comes from there.

demoFields.label: Name of the woman applying
demoFields.hint: The connection is given only in a woman's name. Spell it exactly as on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of the applicant
demoFields.hint: Her own 12-digit number, used both as identity and as address proof.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of other adults in the family
demoFields.hint: Give the Aadhaar of every adult living in the house. This is how the system checks there is no other gas connection.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If you have shifted and have no card here, fill the self-declaration of family instead.

demoFields.label: Which poor household category
demoFields.hint: Tick the group your family belongs to: SC, ST, Antyodaya, PMAY, most backward class, tea garden, forest dweller, or the 14-point declaration.

demoFields.label: Full address with PIN code
demoFields.value: Village Rampur Kalan, Post Dariyabad, Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh - 225414
demoFields.hint: Where the cylinder is to be delivered. Add a landmark so the delivery man finds the house.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name. The refill subsidy comes into this account, so it must be Aadhaar-seeded and active.

demoSteps: Open pmuy.gov.in and click Apply for New Ujjwala 2.0 Connection.
Choose your gas company: Indane, Bharatgas or HP Gas. The site takes you to that company's own page.
Select Ujjwala new connection, then your state and district, and pick a distributor near your home.
Fill in the woman applicant's name, Aadhaar, address, ration card and the poor household category you belong to.
Add the Aadhaar of every adult in the family, and the bank account in the applicant's own name.
Upload the photograph and the documents, then submit and note the reference number.
Print the form, sign it, and take it with the original Aadhaar and ration card to the distributor's showroom.
The distributor checks the papers and delivers the cylinder, regulator, pipe and stove. Do not pay anything beyond the printed charges, and take a receipt.
schemes.helpline: 1800-266-6696 / LPG emergency 1906

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti)
schemes.brief: Cash help for a pregnant woman or new mother, so she can rest before and after the birth instead of losing wages. For the first child you get Rs.5,000 in two parts, and for a second child you get Rs.6,000 in one go if the baby is a girl. The money goes straight into your Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account. You can apply yourself on the PMMVY portal, or your Anganwadi worker or ASHA can fill the form for you.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5,000 for the first child (Rs.3,000 + Rs.2,000); Rs.6,000 if the second child is a girl
eligibility: Pregnant women and new mothers aged between 18 years 7 months and 55 years when the baby is born

You must fit at least one of these: SC or ST; BPL or NFSA ration card; Ayushman card; e-Shram card; MGNREGA job card; woman farmer getting PM-Kisan; 40% or more disability; family income below Rs.8 lakh a year; pregnant or breastfeeding Anganwadi worker, helper or ASHA
Money is given for the first living child, and for the second child only if it is a girl
You can apply any time from the start of pregnancy up to 270 days after the birth
Not for women in regular government or PSU jobs who get paid maternity leave

Not run in Telangana, which has its own maternity scheme. In Odisha it runs jointly with the state's MAMATA scheme as MAMATA-PMMVY (since April 2025), paying Rs.10,000 for a boy and Rs.12,000 for a girl for up to two births; register at your Anganwadi centre
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman (the husband's Aadhaar is not needed)
Bank or post office account linked to Aadhaar for direct payment (DBT)
Mother and Child Protection (MCP) card with the last period (LMP) date and check-up dates
One eligibility proof: e-Shram card, ration card, job card, Ayushman card, caste certificate, disability certificate or income certificate
Mobile number for OTP and payment messages
For the second part or a second girl child: the baby's birth certificate and vaccination record (14 weeks)

demoSteps: Register your pregnancy at the Anganwadi centre or government health centre, get the MCP card and do the check-up (ANC).
Open pmmvy.wcd.gov.in, press Login, choose Citizen, verify your mobile with OTP and create your profile. If you cannot do it, ask your Anganwadi worker or ASHA to fill the form for you on her app.
Choose Beneficiary Registration, verify Aadhaar with OTP, fill the eligibility proof, LMP and check-up dates and the Anganwadi centre, then submit and note the registration number.
The Anganwadi worker checks your details and the block officer approves. Rs.3,000 is then sent to your Aadhaar-linked account.
After the birth, register the baby's birth and get the 14-week vaccines. Then log in again, or ask the Anganwadi worker, to fill the child's details. Rs.2,000 is sent next.
If your second child is a girl, apply after her birth and 14-week vaccines. Rs.6,000 is sent in one payment.
Check progress under Track Application Status on the portal. For a delay, use Lodge Grievance on the same site or call 1515.

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar Old Age Pension (Social Security Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Andaman & Nicobar Administration
schemes.brief: Old people in the islands get Rs.2,500 a month from 60, and Rs.3,000 a month from 80, paid into their bank account. It is for people who have lived in the islands for at least 10 years and whose household earns less than Rs.48,000 a year. One common form covers the old age, widow, destitute and disability pensions. You hand it in at the CDPO office of your area. More than 15,600 people get this pension.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.3,000 a month from age 80)
eligibility: Age 60 years or above
Living in the islands continuously for at least 10 years (local certificate or resident identity card)
Household income less than Rs.48,000 a year (Rs.4,000 a month)
Not getting any other pension, allowance or grant from the government
From age 80 the pension rises to Rs.3,000 a month
documents: Local certificate or domicile certificate
Aadhaar card
Bank account number (passbook copy)
Income and residence certificate from the Tehsildar (printed on the form)
Age certificate from a Medical Officer (printed on the form)
Certificate from your Pradhan or Councillor (printed on the form)
Signed declaration that you get no other government assistance
schemes.portalName: Directorate of Social Welfare, A&N Administration
schemes.submitAt: The office of the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) of your area: Urban (Sri Vijaya Puram), Ferrargunj, Rangat, Diglipur or Car Nicobar. Forms are also free at the Directorate of Social Welfare, Goalghar, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair). Before you submit, get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate filled in on the form. Attach the local certificate and an Aadhaar copy.

demoFields.label: Name of assistance applied for

demoFields.label: Sex
demoFields.hint: Male or Female.

demoFields.label: Married / Unmarried / Widow
demoFields.hint: Your present status.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must show you are 60 or more. The Medical Officer certifies your age on the form.

demoFields.label: Present address
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: Category (APL / BPL)
demoFields.hint: As on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Details of assistance received from Govt./local bodies
demoFields.hint: Write Nil if you get no pension or grant. Anyone already getting one is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The pension is paid into this account every month.

demoSteps: Download the pension form or collect it free at the CDPO office or the Directorate of Social Welfare.
Get the Tehsildar's income and residence certificate, the Medical Officer's age certificate and the Pradhan's or Councillor's certificate on the form.
Sign the declaration and hand in the form with your local certificate and Aadhaar copy at your CDPO office.
The CDPO checks that you get no other assistance and sends the case to the Directorate of Social Welfare for sanction.
Once sanctioned, Rs.2,500 (Rs.3,000 from age 80) is paid into your bank account every month.
Give a life certificate every year in the prescribed format to your Anganwadi worker or Mukhya Sevika, or the pension is suspended.
schemes.helpline: 03192-233356 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair); your CDPO office

schemes.title: Andaman & Nicobar e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' single window for the certificates a resident needs — income, local certificate, SC and ST certificates, birth and death registration and residence proof. Applying online saves a boat trip, which matters when your tehsil office is on another island.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed income, local, tribe and residence certificates without travelling to the tehsil
eligibility: Resident of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, applying in the tehsil where you live
A local certificate needs proof that the family has lived in the islands for the qualifying period
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued only for the notified tribes of the islands
An income certificate is valid for one year; a tribe certificate does not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Residence proof — electricity bill, rent agreement or a Panchayat certificate
Birth certificate or school certificate for date of birth
Salary certificate or an affidavit of income, for an income certificate
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, local, SC, ST, residence, birth or death. Each opens its own form and asks for different proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the tehsil records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years the family has lived in the islands
demoFields.hint: For a local certificate, say from when. The ration card, school records or an old electricity bill are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)

Choose the certificate you need and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload Aadhaar, the ration card, the residence proof and the income or tribe proof, then submit and note the application number.
The Patwari or the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave, since an island visit may be replaced by a phone check.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate digitally and it is downloaded from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number to the tehsil office or the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Port Blair

schemes.department: Administration of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
schemes.brief: The islands' online counter for the things residents pay and apply for regularly — electricity and water bills, licences, permits and departmental fees — without a trip to the office. Useful anywhere, essential when the office is a ferry ride away.
schemes.benefit: Electricity, water and departmental payments and applications made from home
eligibility: Resident or consumer in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands
A consumer number for the service you are paying for, as printed on the bill
A mobile number for the OTP and the payment receipt
Any card, net banking or UPI account for the payment
documents: Latest bill showing the consumer number
Aadhaar card, for an application rather than a payment
Address proof for the premises
Mobile number to receive the receipt

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Electricity, water, licence fee, permit or a departmental payment. Pick the department first, then the service.

demoFields.label: Consumer Name

demoFields.hint: The portal fills this from the department's record. If it differs from your paper bill, pay what the portal shows and take the paper bill to the office.

demoFields.label: Address of the premises

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The payment receipt and the transaction reference come here by SMS. Keep it until the next bill shows the payment.
