Apply on e-Samaj Kalyan, which can be switched to Gujarati from the top of the page, or fill the Gujarati form and hand it in at the taluka Mamlatdar's office or the Jan Seva Kendra - the counter route is what most applicants use, and the clerk checks the papers on the spot.
The Talati verifies in the village and the Mamlatdar's office processes the case.
Keep the acknowledgement slip. Ask for the sanction order number once it is passed.
The pension is credited every month by direct transfer.
Every year, give the continuation certificate - that she is alive and has not remarried - at the Mamlatdar's office. Miss it and the pension stops until you go and restart it.
Tell the Mamlatdar's office at once if the bank account or the address changes.
schemes.helpline: Taluka Mamlatdar's office, or the District Women & Child Development Officer

schemes.title: Kunvarbai nu Mameru Yojana - Marriage Assistance
schemes.department: Developing Castes Welfare and Scheduled Caste Welfare Directorates, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.12,000 paid to a bride from an SC, socially and educationally backward, or EBC family at the time of her marriage - the government's mameru. The money goes to the bride's own bank account, not to the groom or the family. The marriage must be registered first, and the claim has to be made within two years of the wedding. Applications are on e-Samaj Kalyan, which works in Gujarati.
schemes.benefit: Rs.12,000 to the bride, by direct bank transfer
eligibility: Bride from a Scheduled Caste, socially and educationally backward class, or EBC family of Gujarat
Bride 18 or above and groom 21 or above on the date of marriage
Help is given for at most two daughters in one family
Family income within the ceiling shown on the portal
The application must be made within two years of the marriage date
documents: Marriage registration certificate
Caste certificate of the bride's family
Income certificate
Bride's Aadhaar card and bank passbook
Age proof of the bride and the groom - school leaving certificate or birth certificate
Groom's Aadhaar card
Wedding invitation card (kankotri) and a joint photograph

demoFields.label: Bride's name
demoFields.hint: Her maiden name as on the school leaving certificate and the caste certificate, even if she has changed it after marriage.

demoFields.label: Groom's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar and on the marriage registration certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of marriage
demoFields.hint: From the marriage registration certificate. Count two years from this date - that is your last day to apply.

demoFields.label: Marriage registration number
demoFields.hint: Register the marriage at the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika first. Without this certificate the form cannot be submitted.

demoFields.label: Bride's date of birth
demoFields.hint: She must have been 18 or more on the wedding day, and the groom 21 or more.

demoFields.label: Caste and certificate number
demoFields.hint: The bride's own family's certificate. Apply under the department that issued it.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: From the Mamlatdar's income certificate. Check the year's ceiling on the portal.

demoFields.label: Bride's bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: It must be the bride's own single account, Aadhaar-seeded. A joint account with the husband or an account in the father's name is rejected.

demoFields.label: Village / Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: The bride's parental address, which is where the caste and income certificates were issued.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Keep the same number until the money arrives; the sanction message comes here.

demoSteps: Register the marriage at the Gram Panchayat or the Nagarpalika and collect the certificate. Nothing else can start before this.
Open a savings account in the bride's own name if she does not have one, and get her Aadhaar seeded to it.
Log in to e-Samaj Kalyan as a citizen, or register with your mobile number. The site can be switched to Gujarati.
Choose the department matching the bride's caste certificate, then Kunvarbai nu Mameru Yojana.
Fill the form and upload the marriage certificate, caste and income certificates, both Aadhaar cards, age proofs, the invitation card and the photograph.
Submit within two years of the wedding date and print the acknowledgement.
Hand the printout with the originals at the district office of the concerned welfare department, or through the Jan Seva Kendra if they tell you to.
The district officer verifies and sanctions.
Rs.12,000 is credited to the bride's own account by DBT.
If the payment fails, the fault is nearly always the bank account - check the seeding before you file anything again.
schemes.helpline: District Deputy Director of the concerned welfare department, or your nearest Jan Seva Kendra

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana (Free Monthly Nutrition Kit)
schemes.department: Women & Child Development Department (ICDS), Gujarat
schemes.brief: A free nutrition kit every month for a woman in her first pregnancy and until her first child turns two - the first 1000 days. Each month's kit has 2 kg chana, 1 kg tuver dal and 1 litre of groundnut oil, given at the Anganwadi against an OTP on your phone. The health worker first registers the pregnancy in the health department's TeCHO system; you then register yourself on the Matrushakti portal, or the Anganwadi worker does it for you. A ration card is no longer needed - Aadhaar is enough.
schemes.benefit: Every month: 2 kg chana, 1 kg tuver dal and 1 litre groundnut oil, free
eligibility: Woman pregnant with her first child - from registration of the pregnancy until delivery
Mother of a first child - from the birth until the child is 2 years old
Has an Aadhaar card
The pregnancy or child is registered by the ASHA or ANM in the health department's TeCHO system (the eMamta / unique number)
Registered with the local Anganwadi; there is no income or caste condition
documents: Woman's Aadhaar card
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar, for the OTP
eMamta / TeCHO unique number from the Mamta card given by the health worker
Name of your Anganwadi and the Anganwadi worker
Ration card member ID (optional - it helps fill the details)

demoFields.label: Aadhaar card number (beneficiary)
demoFields.hint: The pregnant woman's or mother's own Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary name (in English, as per Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed on Aadhaar, or the Aadhaar check fails.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / year of birth
demoFields.hint: Choose full date or only the year, whichever is on your Aadhaar. Then tick the consent box and press Validate Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card member ID
demoFields.hint: Comes up by itself if your name is on an NFSA ration card. It is fine if it stays empty.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so the right Anganwadi list appears.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi name
demoFields.hint: If your Anganwadi is not in the list, use Search to find it.

demoFields.label: Worker / helper name
demoFields.hint: The Anganwadi worker's name appears once you pick the Anganwadi.

demoFields.label: Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Press Send OTP and type the 4-digit OTP. Each month's kit is also given against an OTP on this number.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary ID (eMamta / unique number)
demoFields.hint: Step 2 of the form. It is on your Mamta card. After Search, the health centre and due date fill in by themselves.

demoSteps: Register your pregnancy with the ASHA or ANM at the health centre and get the Mamta card with your eMamta / unique number.
Open 1000d.gujarat.gov.in, choose Self Registration, enter your Aadhaar, name and birth date, tick the consent and press Validate Aadhaar.
Pick your district, taluka, village and Anganwadi, enter the Aadhaar-linked mobile, press Send OTP, type the OTP and press Save & Next.
In step 2 enter the eMamta / unique number and press Search; the health centre and due date fill in. Press Confirm and Submit and print the receipt.
Check Beneficiary Registration Status until it shows Approved. The Anganwadi worker can also do all of this for you.
Every month, collect the kit at your Anganwadi and give the OTP that comes to your phone.
The kit continues after delivery until the child is 2. If your mobile number changes, update it on the portal so the OTP keeps reaching you.
schemes.helpline: Women & Child Development Department 079-23257942; your Anganwadi worker or the taluka ICDS (CDPO) office

schemes.title: Namo Laxmi Yojana
schemes.department: Education Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.50,000 to a girl over her four years of secondary and higher secondary schooling - Rs.10,000 in each of classes 9 and 10, and Rs.15,000 in each of classes 11 and 12. Part comes month by month and part on passing the board exam. Parents do not apply on their own: the school enters the girl on the portal, so the documents go to the class teacher or the school clerk. The portal is available in Gujarati.
schemes.benefit: Rs.50,000 in all, across classes 9 to 12
eligibility: Girl studying in class 9 to 12 in a government, grant-in-aid or approved private school in Gujarat
Family income up to Rs.6 lakh a year
Regular attendance - the instalment for a term depends on it
The board exam instalment is paid on passing Class 10 and Class 12
A girl who drops out stops receiving the money from that term
documents: Girl's Aadhaar card
Mother's or father's Aadhaar card
Income certificate, or the self-declaration the school gives out
Bank account in the girl's name, or a joint account with the mother
School admission number (GR number)
Ration card

demoFields.label: Girl's name
demoFields.hint: As written in the school register. The school types it from the GR, so tell them if the spelling on the Aadhaar is different.

demoFields.label: School and GR number
demoFields.value: Shri Sarvajanik High School, Vanthali, Junagadh - GR 4482
demoFields.hint: The GR number is on the girl's school ID or the fee book. The clerk can read it out.

demoFields.label: Class and division
demoFields.hint: The class she is in now. The amount changes when she reaches class 11.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Same as the school record and the Aadhaar. A mismatch holds up the payment.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: The mother's name as on her Aadhaar, since the account is usually joint with her.

demoFields.label: Girl's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The girl's own Aadhaar. If she does not have one yet, get it made first - the payment cannot be released without it.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: Both parents together. Up to Rs.6 lakh qualifies. Give the income certificate or the school's declaration form.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the girl's name or joint with the mother. It must be active and Aadhaar-seeded - a dormant account is the main reason money bounces back.

demoFields.label: Parent's mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every instalment message comes here. Give the number the family actually uses.

demoSteps: Get a bank account opened in the girl's name, or joint with her mother, and have the Aadhaar seeded to it. Do this first - everything else waits on it.
If the school asks for an income certificate rather than its own declaration form, get it from the Mamlatdar's office or a Jan Seva Kendra.
Give the class teacher or the school clerk copies of the girl's Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar, the passbook and the income proof.
The school enrols the girl on the portal from its own login. There is no separate parent login for this scheme.
Check with the clerk that the bank account and Aadhaar were entered correctly, and that the account is shown as verified.
Attendance is reported by the school each term; the term instalment follows it.
The monthly part is credited through the year and the board-exam part after she passes Class 10, and again after Class 12.
If the money does not arrive, ask the school to check the account status on the portal before going anywhere else - almost every failure is a bank seeding problem.
Nothing has to be filled again when she moves from class 9 to 10 or 11 to 12; the school carries the record forward.
schemes.helpline: Your school's principal or clerk; Digital Gujarat helpdesk 1800-233-5500

schemes.title: Vahali Dikri Yojana
schemes.department: Women & Child Development Department, Gujarat
schemes.brief: Rs.1.10 lakh for a daughter of a family with small means, given in three parts - Rs.4,000 when she joins Class 1, Rs.6,000 when she joins Class 9, and Rs.1,00,000 when she turns 18, for her higher education or marriage. Only the first and second daughters count. The form has to be given within one year of the daughter's birth, and most families hand it in through their Anganwadi worker or the VCE at the Gram Panchayat rather than online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,10,000 in three instalments - Rs.4,000, Rs.6,000 and Rs.1,00,000
eligibility: First and second daughter of the family; a third daughter is not covered
Family income up to Rs.2 lakh a year
The parents' marriage must be registered
The application has to be made within one year of the daughter's birth
The family must be resident in Gujarat
documents: Daughter's birth certificate
Aadhaar cards of both parents
Income certificate from the Mamlatdar or the Jan Seva Kendra
Marriage registration certificate of the parents
Bank passbook of the parent in whose account the money goes
Self-declaration on stamp paper about the number of daughters, on the form the department provides
Ration card and residence proof

demoFields.label: Daughter's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on the birth certificate. If the child has not been named yet on the certificate, get it updated first.

demoFields.label: Birth registration number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the birth certificate given by the Gram Panchayat or the Nagarpalika.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar card. It should match the marriage registration certificate.

demoFields.label: Which daughter is she
demoFields.hint: First or second only. Declare all living children honestly - the Talati verifies this in the village record.

demoFields.label: Family annual income
demoFields.hint: Must be Rs.2 lakh or less. The figure has to come from the Mamlatdar's income certificate, not your own estimate.

demoFields.label: Parents' marriage registration number
demoFields.hint: From the marriage registration certificate. If the marriage was never registered, get it registered at the Gram Panchayat first.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account of the parent, active and Aadhaar-seeded. The Rs.1 lakh at 18 later goes to the daughter's own account.

demoFields.label: Village / Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Talati of this village does the verification.

demoSteps: Register the daughter's birth and collect the birth certificate from the Gram Panchayat or Nagarpalika.
Get the income certificate from the Mamlatdar or a Jan Seva Kendra, and the parents' marriage registration certificate if you do not already have one.
Take the form from your Anganwadi worker, the Gram Panchayat VCE, or download it from the department's site. It is in Gujarati.
Fill it and attach the birth certificate, both parents' Aadhaar, income certificate, marriage certificate, passbook copy and the declaration about the number of daughters.

Hand the set in at the Anganwadi centre, or at the taluka ICDS (CDPO) office or the Mamlatdar's office. The Anganwadi route is what most families use, and the worker checks the papers before they go up.
Do this within one year of the birth. An application made later is not accepted, whatever the reason.
Keep the acknowledgement slip safely - you will need it at each of the three instalments.
The District Women & Child Development Officer sanctions the case.
The first instalment comes when the girl is admitted to Class 1, the second at Class 9, and Rs.1 lakh when she turns 18 and is unmarried at that date.
At each stage produce the school certificate; the money does not come on its own.
schemes.helpline: Your Anganwadi worker, or the District Women & Child Development Officer / taluka CDPO office

schemes.title: Jamabandi Haryana — Land Records and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Haryana
schemes.brief: Jamabandi is where a Haryana landholder sees the record of rights, the mutation register and the cadastral map, checks the collector rate before a sale, and tracks a mutation after a purchase or a death. Most of it needs no login.
schemes.benefit: Jamabandi nakal, mutation status, cadastral map and collector rates online
eligibility: Land situated in Haryana and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view a jamabandi or a mutation; only the holder or an heir can apply to change one
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
A certified copy for a bank or a court is issued by the tehsil, not printed from the site
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khewat, khasra or murabba number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for a mutation application
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and legal heir details, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: What you want to see
demoFields.hint: Jamabandi nakal, mutation status, registered deed, cadastral map, collector rate, or the check on land ownership before buying.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khewat, khasra or murabba number, or the owner's name. Khewat is the account and gives the cleanest result.

demoFields.label: Khewat Number
demoFields.hint: From an older jamabandi or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khasra / Murabba and Killa Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly. In Haryana the murabba and killa are how a plot is actually identified on the ground.

demoFields.label: Owner's name as on the record
demoFields.value: Ranbir Singh, son of Dalbir Singh
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Jamabandi year
demoFields.hint: The jamabandi is revised every five years. Take the latest unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoFields.label: Mutation number, to check status
demoFields.hint: Given when the mutation is entered. Track the stage against it rather than going to the tehsil.

demoSteps: Open jamabandi.nic.in, pick district, tehsil and village, and search by khewat, khasra or owner's name. The view is free and needs no login.
Check the share, the area and the owner's name against what you know. Before buying land, use the same site to see the registered deeds and the collector rate for that village.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy. The print from the site is for your own reference.
After a purchase or a death, the mutation is entered at the tehsil with the registered deed or the death certificate and heirship papers.
Track the mutation on the site by its number. The stages — entry, notice, order — are all shown.
Once the order is passed, pull a fresh jamabandi and check that your name and share are right. An error is far easier to fix now than years later.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil revenue office, or the patwari of your village circle

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat Chirayu Haryana (Chirayu Card)
schemes.department: Ayushman Bharat Haryana Health Protection Authority, Health Department, Haryana
schemes.brief: Haryana's extension of Ayushman Bharat: Rs 5 lakh a year of cashless hospital treatment for the whole family. Families whose income in the Family ID (PPP) is up to Rs 1.80 lakh are covered free. Families above that can join by paying a yearly fee online: Rs 1,500 for income up to Rs 3 lakh, Rs 4,000 up to Rs 6 lakh and Rs 5,000 above Rs 6 lakh. For the cover year 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027, the fee portal is open until 30 November 2026.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless; free up to Rs 1.80 lakh income
eligibility: Families living in Haryana with a Family ID (PPP). Eligibility and the fee go by the verified income in the PPP
Verified income up to Rs 1.80 lakh a year: covered free
Above Rs 1.80 lakh up to Rs 3 lakh: Rs 1,500 a year per family
Above Rs 3 lakh up to Rs 6 lakh: Rs 4,000 a year. Above Rs 6 lakh: Rs 5,000 a year
No limit on family size or age. Every member on the Family ID is covered
documents: Family ID (PPP) number, with income verified
Mobile number registered in the Family ID, for the OTP
Aadhaar card of each member, for the card e-KYC
UPI, debit card or net banking to pay the fee, or cash at a CSC
Payment receipt or reference number, as proof that you paid

demoFields.label: Your PPP ID / Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Choose whether to search by Family ID or Aadhaar. If you have forgotten the Family ID, use I forgot my PPP ID and search with Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: PPP ID
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit Family ID of your family.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Sent to the mobile number registered in the Family ID, not any other number.

demoFields.label: Terms and conditions
demoFields.hint: Read the fee table and the dates, tick the box and continue.

demoFields.label: Linked Member Info
demoFields.hint: Check that every member is listed. A missing member must first be added in the Family ID.

demoFields.label: Family Head Name
demoFields.hint: Shown after Check Eligibility, with your verified income band.

demoFields.label: Amount to be paid
demoFields.hint: Set by the verified income: Rs 1,500, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000 a year.

demoFields.label: Payment partner
demoFields.hint: Choose Canara Bank to pay yourself, or CSC (Digital Seva Connect) if a CSC operator is paying for you.

demoFields.label: Payment mode
demoFields.hint: UPI and RuPay debit cards have no extra charge. Other cards may add a small bank fee.

demoFields.label: Reference number
demoFields.hint: Save it. Use Check Payment Status on the home page to see the payment and download the receipt.

demoSteps: If your Family ID income is up to Rs 1.80 lakh you pay nothing: get the Ayushman (Chirayu) card made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or empanelled hospital, or yourself on beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar e-KYC.
If your income is above Rs 1.80 lakh, open chirayuayushmanharyana.in before 30 November 2026 and tap the apply button.
Accept the terms, enter the Family ID (or Aadhaar) and the OTP sent to the registered mobile, then check the members and the eligibility shown.
Pay the fee shown (Rs 1,500, Rs 4,000 or Rs 5,000) through Canara Bank by UPI, card or net banking, or at a CSC, and download the receipt.
Your cover runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027. Get each member's card made with Aadhaar e-KYC on beneficiary.nha.gov.in, the Ayushman app or at a CSC.
At an empanelled hospital, go to the Ayushman Mitra desk with the card. Treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year is cashless, so do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-2036 (Ayushman Bharat Haryana toll-free) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)

schemes.title: Antyodaya SARAL Haryana — Schemes and Certificates
schemes.department: Citizen Resources Information Department, Government of Haryana
schemes.brief: SARAL is the single window through which Haryana delivers its schemes and certificates — income, caste, residence and domicile certificates, pensions, scholarships and departmental services. Most of it is tied to the Parivar Pehchan Patra, the family ID, which the portal reads your details from.
schemes.benefit: Certificates, pensions and scheme applications in one place, with a fixed delivery time
eligibility: Resident of Haryana, with the family registered under the Parivar Pehchan Patra
A domicile certificate needs proof the family has lived in Haryana for the qualifying period
A caste certificate needs the caste to be on the Haryana SC, BC-A or BC-B list
Each service has its own delivery time under the state's Right to Service Act
documents: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID) number
Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or voter card as residence proof
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a land record for a farming family
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, residence or domicile certificate, an old-age pension, a scholarship, or a departmental service. Each has its own form and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)
demoFields.hint: Eight digits. Most services read your name, family and income from it, so get the Family ID made and verified first.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar and the Family ID. A mismatch between the two stops the application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate. Note that the income already recorded in the Family ID is what most schemes actually use, so get that corrected if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Caste and category
demoFields.hint: Pick from the Haryana list. BC-A and BC-B are separate lists with separate benefits.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The ticket number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check your Parivar Pehchan Patra first on the Family ID portal, and get the income and member details corrected there if they are wrong. SARAL and most Haryana schemes take the figures from it, not from what you type.
Register on saralharyana.gov.in with your mobile, or go to a Saral Kendra or Atal Seva Kendra, which files it across the counter.
Choose the service, fill the form — most of it fills itself from the Family ID — and upload the documents.
Pay the fee and note the ticket number from the acknowledgement.
The patwari or the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The signed certificate is issued within the time the Right to Service Act sets for that service, and is downloaded from the same login.
If the deadline passes, the same Act gives you an appeal, and the ticket number is what you quote. The status of any SARAL application can be tracked without logging in.
schemes.helpline: 1800 2000 023 — SARAL Haryana helpline

schemes.title: Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID / PPP)
schemes.department: Haryana Parivar Pehchan Authority, Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID), Haryana
schemes.brief: An 8-digit Family ID for every family living in Haryana, holding each member's details, income and bank account in one record. Almost every Haryana scheme uses it, from pensions and ration cards to Chirayu health cover and Lado Lakshmi, so once it is verified you need not prove the same things again. Making or updating it is free. You can create it yourself online, or get it made at a CSC, Saral Kendra or PPP operator.
schemes.benefit: Free Family ID that opens Haryana schemes and selects you for benefits automatically
eligibility: Every family living in Haryana should enrol. It gets a permanent 8-digit Family ID
A family living outside Haryana that needs a Haryana service gets a 9-digit temporary ID starting with T
Creating, updating and downloading the Family ID are free, even at an operator. Never pay a fee
Income, caste and other details are verified by the department. Verified details cannot be edited later
Births, deaths and marriages are linked to it, so the record updates itself
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member
Mobile number of the head of family, for OTP
Bank passbook of the head of family and earning members
Income details of every earning member (salary, farming, business)
Caste certificate, if you belong to SC, BC or another category
Disability certificate, if any member is Divyang

demoFields.label: Do you Know Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID)?
demoFields.hint: Choose NO to make a new Family ID. Choose YES if your family already has one and you want to see or update it.

demoFields.label: Search With Aadhar No.
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of family. The system first checks whether you are already in some Family ID.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Sent to the mobile number linked with that Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Head of family: name, date of birth, gender
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: This number gets every OTP for the Family ID later, so give one you will keep.

demoFields.label: Address (district, block or town, village or ward, house no.)
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Caste category
demoFields.hint: Choose General, SC, BC-A or BC-B. It is checked against your caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual income of each member
demoFields.hint: Give true income. Schemes like Chirayu and Lado Lakshmi use the verified family income.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (head of family)
demoFields.hint: Pensions and other scheme money are sent to the account recorded here.

demoFields.label: Family members (name, relation, Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Add everyone who lives and eats together. Married daughters go to their husband's Family ID.

demoSteps: Open meraparivar.haryana.gov.in and choose I want to create my PPP, or open the PPP citizen login page and answer NO.
Search with the head of family's Aadhaar and verify the OTP. Then fill in the head's details, address, caste, income and bank account, and add each member with Aadhaar.
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. If the portal asks, download the filled PPP form, have the head of family sign it and upload it. After this, only one change is allowed.
The department verifies income and other details through records and field checks. Checked details are marked Verified.
The 8-digit Family ID comes by SMS. Download it any time on meraparivar.haryana.gov.in with the Family ID and an OTP.
If you cannot do it yourself, a CSC, Antyodaya Saral Kendra or PPP operator does it free. For wrong income or caste, use the correction module or Report Grievance on the PPP site.
schemes.helpline: 0172-4880500 (Family ID helpline, 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday) / 98886 33322 (PPP helpline)

schemes.title: Deen Dayal Lado Lakshmi Yojana (Lado Lakshmi)
schemes.department: SEWA Department (Social Justice, Empowerment, Welfare of SCs & BCs and Antyodaya), Haryana
schemes.brief: Rs 2,100 a month for women aged 23 and above from the poorest families of Haryana. From the second month, Rs 1,100 comes to your savings account and Rs 1,000 is saved for you in a government recurring deposit, paid back with interest when it matures (within five years). You apply only on the official Lado Lakshmi mobile app using your Family ID (PPP). There is no paper form, and any other link or form is fake.
schemes.benefit: Rs 2,100 a month (Rs 1,100 in hand + Rs 1,000 saved in a government RD)
eligibility: Woman aged 23 or above. Any number of eligible women in one family can apply
Family income verified in the Family ID (PPP) not more than Rs 1 lakh a year, and the family endorsed as poorest of the poor by the Gram Sabha or Ward Committee

Or family income up to Rs 1.80 lakh if a child in a government school scored over 80% in Class 10 or 12, reached the NIPUN grade level in Classes 1 to 4, or was brought out of malnutrition (SAM/MAM). Mothers of more than three children cannot use this route
She, or her husband if she married into Haryana from another state, has lived in Haryana for at least 15 years
Not for women already getting the old age, widow, Divyang or Ladli allowance or any other government pension, government employees whose family income is above the limit, or income tax payers
documents: Family ID (Parivar Pehchan Patra) with verified income
Aadhaar card of the applicant, and Aadhaar details of family members
Haryana residence certificate (15 years)
Savings bank account in the woman's own name
Electricity connection (consumer account) number
Vehicle ownership details and HKRN ID, if any
A smartphone, with the mobile number for OTP and the monthly face check

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Type your number in the app and enter the OTP. The eligibility and payment SMS come here.

demoFields.label: Family ID (PPP)
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit Family ID. Your income and family details are taken from it.

demoFields.label: Select applicant
demoFields.hint: The app shows the members on the Family ID. Pick the woman who is applying. She must be 23 or older.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Residence in Haryana
demoFields.hint: If you married into Haryana from another state, your husband's 15 years of residence counts.

demoFields.label: Electricity consumer account number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your electricity bill.

demoFields.label: Vehicle owned
demoFields.hint: Give any car or other vehicle owned by the family. It is checked against transport records.

demoFields.label: HKRN ID
demoFields.hint: Only if you or a family member work through Haryana Kaushal Rozgar Nigam.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Must be in the woman's own name. PFMS checks it before the first payment.

demoFields.label: Monthly amount you choose
demoFields.hint: Asked by SMS after verification. If you choose Rs 1,500 or less, Rs 500 is paid and Rs 1,000 still goes into the RD.

demoSteps: Install the Lado Lakshmi app (made by HARTRON for the Haryana government) from Google Play or the App Store. Do not use any other app, link or form.
Register with your mobile number and OTP, choose Apply for the Scheme, enter the Family ID and pick the woman who is applying.
Fill in the Aadhaar, residence, electricity, vehicle and bank details and submit. Note the Registration ID shown on screen.
CRID checks your details against Family ID records within 15 days. If you are eligible, an SMS asks you to choose the monthly amount: confirm it and give consent in the app with your Registration ID.

The District Social Welfare Officer creates your DDLLY ID and PFMS checks the bank account. Payment starts the next month: Rs 2,100 in full the first month, then Rs 1,100 to the account and Rs 1,000 to the RD.
After the first payment, do the face check (Blink to Click) in the app every month, or the money stops. Raise any complaint in the app's grievance window: the DSWO must act within 7 days.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-2231 (toll-free Lado Lakshmi helpline) / 0172-4880500 (Family ID and verification helpline)

schemes.title: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana (Rs 1,500 for Women)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice & Empowerment (Directorate of Empowerment of SCs, OBCs, Minorities & Specially Abled), Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Rs 1,500 a month for women of Himachal Pradesh from families with an income below Rs 2 lakh a year and no government job or pension. It began in 2023 in Lahaul-Spiti as the Indira Gandhi Mahila Samman Nidhi. In 2026 the rules were tightened: the income limit came in April, so earlier applications had to be made again, and from June the age is 21 to 59. Only one woman per family is paid and BPL families come first. You apply on a free form at the Tehsil Welfare Officer's office, and payments are being started area by area after verification.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 a month (Rs 18,000 a year), by DBT
eligibility: A woman who is a permanent (bonafide) resident of Himachal Pradesh, aged 21 to 59
Family income below Rs 2 lakh a year; BPL families get priority
Only one woman in a family can get the money

Not eligible if anyone in the family is a regular, contract, outsourced or daily-wage government employee or a pensioner, a serving or retired soldier or a soldier's widow, or works for a panchayat, urban body, board or corporation
Not eligible if anyone in the family is an Anganwadi worker or helper, ASHA, mid-day meal or multi-task worker, gets a social security pension, pays income tax or is registered for GST
Buddhist nuns (chomo) living permanently in a monastery in Himachal are also eligible
documents: Bonafide Himachali (permanent residence) certificate
Proof of age (birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar)
Family income certificate showing income below Rs 2 lakh
Aadhaar card of the woman
Copy of the bank passbook with IFSC
Ration card (towns) or copy of the Parivar Register (villages)
Buddhist nuns: a certificate from the chief chomo of the monastery
schemes.submitAt: Collect the application form free of cost from the Tehsil Welfare Officer's office in your tehsil (or the District Welfare Officer's office), fill it, attach the documents and hand it in at the same office. Take your income and bonafide certificates along; they can be made at a Lok Mitra Kendra on HimSeva first. Incomplete forms are returned within 15 days for correction. Since June 2026 the forms go to the Tehsil Welfare Officer, not to the panchayat.

demoFields.label: Husband's / father's name
demoFields.hint: As written in the Parivar Register or ration card.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: You must be at least 21 and not over 59. Attach the age proof.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.value: Village Dhalli, Panchayat Bhatta, Tehsil Theog, District Shimla
demoFields.hint: Village, panchayat, tehsil and district where you live permanently.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Income of the whole family from all sources, as in the income certificate. It must be below Rs 2 lakh.

demoFields.label: BPL family
demoFields.hint: Tick Yes only if the family is on the BPL list; BPL women are taken first.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name; the Rs 1,500 is paid here every month.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register / ration card number
demoFields.hint: Villages give the Parivar Register copy, towns give the ration card.

demoFields.hint: You declare that no one in the family is a government employee, pensioner, ASHA or Anganwadi worker or in the other excluded groups, and that no other woman of the family gets this money.

demoSteps: Get your bonafide Himachali certificate and an income certificate (below Rs 2 lakh) from a Lok Mitra Kendra or the tehsil.
Collect the free form at the Tehsil Welfare Officer's office.
Fill it, attach the documents, and hand it in at the same office. Ask for a receipt.
The Tehsil Welfare Officer checks the form and documents and sends the list of eligible women for approval.
Once approved, Rs 1,500 is paid into your bank account every month. Payments are being started area by area, so ask the welfare office when your area's turn comes.
For status, contact the Tehsil Welfare Officer. Complaints can be made on the CM Seva Sankalp helpline 1100.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — CM Seva Sankalp helpline. For the form and status, the Tehsil Welfare Officer or District Welfare Officer of your area

schemes.title: Indira Gandhi Sukh Shiksha Yojana (Rs 1,000 a Month for Children)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women & Child Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Education help for the children of widows, divorced, destitute or abandoned women, and of parents with 70% or more disability, when the family earns up to Rs 1 lakh a year. It was announced in 2024 as the Mukhya Mantri Sukh Shiksha Yojana. Children up to 18 get Rs 1,000 a month. From 18 to 27 the state pays the fees for a degree, diploma or professional course in a government institution in Himachal, and the government hostel and mess charges, or Rs 3,000 a month for rent where there is no hostel. You apply on the HimSeva portal or at a Lok Mitra Kendra.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,000 a month per child up to 18; fees, hostel and mess (or Rs 3,000 a month rent) from 18 to 27
eligibility: Children of a widow, a divorced woman, a destitute or abandoned woman, a woman whose husband has been missing for 7 years or more, or of a parent with 70% or more permanent disability
Family income from all sources not more than Rs 1 lakh a year
The family must be bonafide (permanent) residents of Himachal Pradesh
Up to 18 years: Rs 1,000 a month per child for school, health and food
18 to 27 years: the course must be in a government college, university or institution in Himachal (degree, PG, diploma, PhD, JBT, NTT, nursing or a professional course)
documents: Bonafide Himachali certificate
Income certificate
Proof of the child's date of birth (birth certificate or 10th certificate)
Death certificate of the father or spouse; or the FIR and report that he has been missing for 7 years; or proof of divorce; or the BDO or municipal report declaring the woman destitute or abandoned
Medical certificate of 70% or more permanent disability, for a disabled parent
Copy of the Parivar Register
Bank account details
For 18 to 27 years: detailed proof of fees and hostel expenses, verified by the head of the institution

demoFields.label: Applicant category

demoFields.label: Child's date of birth

demoFields.hint: For 18 to 27, give the government college and course, and upload the fee and hostel proof signed by the principal.

Open himseva.hp.gov.in, click Indira Gandhi Sukh Siksha Yojana and log in with Him Access.
Fill in the mother's and child's details, upload the documents and submit. Note the application number.

schemes.title: Mukhya Mantri Himachal Health Care Scheme (HIMCARE Card)
schemes.department: Himachal Pradesh Swasthya Bima Yojna Society, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Free hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year for Himachal families who are not covered by Ayushman Bharat and have no government-employee medical cover. You pay a small yearly premium (nothing at all for BPL, MGNREGA and some other families) and get a HIMCARE e-card for up to five members. Treatment is cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals in Himachal, and at PGIMER and GMCH Sector 32 in Chandigarh. New cards are made only in March, June, September and December, and each card is valid for one year.
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless; premium Rs 0, Rs 365 or Rs 1,000 a year
eligibility: Families of Himachal Pradesh whose ration card is not covered under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
No family member may be a government employee or pensioner covered by government medical reimbursement; you sign an undertaking
Free (category I): BPL families, registered street vendors, MGNREGA workers with 50 days of work in the previous or current year, children in orphanages
Rs 365 a year (category II): ekal naari, people with 40% or more disability, mid-day meal workers, and daily-wage, part-time, contract and outsourced workers of state government bodies
Rs 1,000 a year (category III): all other eligible families
One card covers five members; a bigger family is enrolled as a second unit
documents: Ration card, scanned front and back
Aadhaar card of every member being enrolled
Mobile number for the OTP and approval message

Category proof: BPL certificate attested by the panchayat secretary within the last month, MGNREGA job card with the 50-day report, street-vendor certificate, ekal naari certificate from the CDPO, disability certificate, or a certificate from your department
Undertaking that no family member is covered by a government employees' or pensioners' medical scheme
Online payment of the premium, if your category has one

demoFields.label: Login
demoFields.hint: Log in with your Himachal Him Access account, using Aadhaar or mobile OTP. At a Lok Mitra Kendra or CSC the operator does this for Rs 50.

demoFields.label: Application type
demoFields.hint: Choose fresh enrollment for a new card. Use Renewal of Card on hpsbys.in if you already have one.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Pick the category you really belong to. A premium paid under the wrong category is not refunded.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Type the number without the letters HP. It must match the scanned card exactly.

demoFields.label: Head of family
demoFields.hint: Name as on the ration card and Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of family. Each member's Aadhaar is added below.

demoFields.label: Family members
demoFields.value: Kamla Devi (self), Prem Chand (husband), Neha (daughter), Rohit (son)
demoFields.hint: Up to five members on one card, each with name, relation and Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: District and block
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives; it is printed on the card.

demoFields.label: Documents upload
demoFields.value: Ration card front and back, category proof
demoFields.hint: Upload clear scans of the original documents. Blurred or mismatched documents get the application rejected.

demoFields.label: Undertaking and premium
demoFields.hint: Tick the undertaking and pay within 30 days of confirming, or the application lapses.

demoSteps: In March, June, September or December, open hpsbys.in and click SSO Login, or go to a Lok Mitra Kendra or CSC.
Log in with Him Access, choose fresh HIMCARE enrollment and your category, enter the ration card number without HP and add the family members.
Upload the ration card and category proof, accept the undertaking, confirm, and pay the premium online within 30 days. Note the reference number.
The society approves the application within about 3 days and sends an SMS. Check progress on HIMCARE Enrollment Status with the reference or ration card number.
Open Get My HIMCARE Card on hpsbys.in, search by HIMCARE number, ration card or Aadhaar, and download or print the card.
At an empanelled hospital, show the card; your identity is checked by Aadhaar face authentication on the hospital's app. Renew the card online before it expires each year.
schemes.helpline: 1800-202-1311 (PMJAY/HIMCARE toll-free) / 70186-06884, 70086-05212 (card approvals) / 80917-73886 (technical support, working days)

schemes.title: HimSeva — Himachal Pradesh e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Revenue, Government of Himachal Pradesh

schemes.benefit: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste and agriculturist certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Himachal Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A bonafide Himachali certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
An agriculturist certificate needs land recorded in the family's name in Himachal Pradesh
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Land record (jamabandi) copy, for an agriculturist certificate
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Bonafide Himachali, income, caste, agriculturist, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the parivar register and the revenue records.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register number
demoFields.hint: The panchayat's family register entry. Most Himachal certificates are checked against it, so get a fresh copy before applying.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Himachal Pradesh
demoFields.hint: For the bonafide Himachali certificate. The parivar register and old land records are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including farming and horticulture.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get a current copy of the parivar register from your panchayat first. Most Himachal certificates are verified against it and the file stops without it.
Register on himseva.hp.gov.in with your mobile, or use a Lok Mitra Kendra, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar, ration card and parivar register.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the panchayat secretary verify the family, then the Tehsildar signs.
Download the signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If it is delayed beyond the time the service promises, quote the application number at the tehsil and then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Himachal Pradesh CM Seva Sankalp helpline

schemes.title: Himachal Pradesh Ration Card — ePDS
schemes.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs, Himachal Pradesh
schemes.brief: Himachal Pradesh's ration card system, where you check the family's card, see what the depot issued in your name, add or remove a member, and apply for a new card. The state gives subsidised pulses and oil alongside the NFSA grain, so the card is worth keeping correct even for families above the poverty line.
schemes.benefit: Ration card with NFSA grain, and the state's subsidised pulses, oil and salt
eligibility: Family resident in Himachal Pradesh and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
NFSA category decided from the household's circumstances; other families get an APL card with the state subsidy
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded, or that member's share is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Parivar register (parivar nakal) copy from the panchayat
Address proof — electricity bill or house tax receipt
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Gas connection number
Passport photograph of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, correct a detail, or check the depot's issue against your name.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and the relation to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 07-04-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Karsog
demoFields.hint: A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card. A newborn needs only the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Panchayat or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The depot is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop (depot) code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the depot's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and each month's issue message come here.

demoSteps: Open epds.hp.gov.in and search your card first. The same site shows what the depot recorded as issued in your name each month.
Choose the service you need, or take the papers to the Inspector, Food and Civil Supplies of your circle, who files it across the counter.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The grain and the subsidised pulses are counted per name.
Attach the parivar register copy, the address proof, and for a member moving in the deletion certificate from the old card.
The inspector verifies the household and the card is issued or updated. Download it and check every name and Aadhaar.
Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the depot's ePoS machine. Until then the family's quantity does not increase.
If the record shows grain issued in a month you did not collect any, that is the evidence. Take a printout to the Inspector and complain on 1967.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 180 8026 — HP Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: JKSSB Recruitment — Jammu & Kashmir Group C and D Posts
schemes.department: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board
schemes.brief: The Services Selection Board recruits for most non-gazetted posts in Jammu and Kashmir — junior assistant, patwari, teacher, technician and the police and health cadres. Every advertisement is applied for through the Board's own online system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every JKSSB advertisement, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Domicile of Jammu and Kashmir, proved by the domicile certificate
Age as the advertisement states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for reserved categories and disability
The qualification the post requires, complete on the closing date of that advertisement
Reservation claims under RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC, EWS or disability need the certificate on the J&K format
documents: Domicile certificate of Jammu and Kashmir
Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree, diploma or technical qualification certificates and marksheets
Category certificate — RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC or EWS — on the J&K format
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Advt 04 of 2026 — Junior Assistant, Revenue Department
demoFields.hint: One application per post. Read the qualification and the age limit in that advertisement before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Domicile Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: No JKSSB post can be applied for without a J&K domicile certificate. Get it from e-UNNAT well before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Open merit, RBA, ALC, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, disability or ex-serviceman. Claim only what you hold a J&K-format certificate for.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Many posts also need a computer certificate.

demoFields.label: Examination district preference
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The Board allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a friend's number.

demoSteps: Get the domicile certificate from e-UNNAT first if you do not have it. Nothing at JKSSB can be applied for without one.
Watch jkssb.nic.in for the advertisement and read the qualification and age limits before anything else.
Register with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated.
Fill the application, claim only the categories you hold J&K-format certificates for, choose your centres and pay the fee online.
Use the correction window if the Board opens one; it is the only chance to fix a wrong entry.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and take it with a photo ID.
Results and the answer key come out on the same site. Document verification is last, where the originals of the domicile and category certificates must be produced.
schemes.helpline: JKSSB office, Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar; helpdesk details on jkssb.nic.in

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY SEHAT (Golden Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency, Health & Medical Education Department, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: Free health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year for every family living in Jammu & Kashmir, whatever its income, including government employees and pensioners. Treatment is cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals in J&K, and at PM-JAY hospitals across India. The card, called the Golden Card or Ayushman card, is made on the family's ration card, and you can make it yourself on the phone.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, no premium
eligibility: Every family living in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, with no income limit
The family must hold a J&K ration card; every member named on it is covered
Government employees, pensioners and their families are covered too
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the same Rs.5 lakh card under that list
Everyone aged 70 or above can also get the Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one, with 3 days of costs before admission and 15 days after
documents: Aadhaar card of each family member
J&K ration card (inner and outer pages), which links the whole family
Mobile number for OTP
Domicile certificate, if the CSC or hospital desk asks for proof of residence
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family, not Operator.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP comes here, and so does the message when the card is approved.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: SEHAT runs through PM-JAY, so choose PMJAY and then Jammu and Kashmir.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card number finds everyone in the family at once. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in (or the Ayushman app) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and the state Jammu and Kashmir, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation, district and PIN code and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves it within a day or two.
Log in again, open Download Card and save the Golden Card. If your family is not found, go to a CSC or the Ayushman Mitra desk of a SEHAT hospital with your ration card and Aadhaar.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment. If an empanelled hospital refuses, call 104.
schemes.helpline: 104 — J&K health helpline, also for complaints when treatment is refused / 14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: e-UNNAT Jammu & Kashmir — Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology, Jammu and Kashmir
schemes.brief: e-UNNAT brings the services of nearly every Jammu and Kashmir department into one place — domicile, income, category and other certificates, revenue services, scheme applications and departmental permissions, each with a delivery time set under the Public Services Guarantee Act.
schemes.benefit: Domicile, income and category certificates and departmental services in one place
eligibility: Resident of Jammu and Kashmir, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A domicile certificate has its own conditions on years of residence, study or service in the union territory
A category certificate is issued for the categories notified for Jammu and Kashmir
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Permanent Resident Certificate of a parent, or other proof of residence, for a domicile certificate
School leaving certificate or Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Electricity bill or rent agreement for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Domicile, income, category, character or a revenue service. Each has its own form, fee and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a domicile certificate this matters most, since the claim usually runs through a parent's residence.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Basis of the domicile claim
demoFields.value: Father holds a Permanent Resident Certificate of J&K
demoFields.hint: Residence for the qualifying period, a parent's PRC, study in the union territory, or government service. Say which one and attach its proof.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on eunnat.jk.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or go to a Common Service Centre, which files it for the notified fee.
Choose the service and fill the form. For a domicile certificate, state clearly which ground you are claiming under and attach the proof for that ground.
Upload the documents, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the family. Be reachable on the mobile you gave.
The Tehsildar signs the certificate and it is downloaded from the same login.
Each service has a delivery time under the Public Services Guarantee Act. If it passes, the Act gives you an appeal, and the application number is what you quote.
schemes.helpline: 0194-2506062 — e-UNNAT helpdesk, Jammu and Kashmir

schemes.title: Ladli Beti Scheme, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: For a girl born on or after 1 April 2015 into a low-income family in Jammu & Kashmir, the government puts Rs.1,000 a month into an account in her name until she turns 14. The money then stays in a term deposit, and at 21 she receives about Rs.6.5 lakh for her studies or marriage. Parents apply online on JanSugam (also reached through e-UNNAT); the CDPO checks the application and the Deputy Commissioner sanctions it.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month till she is 14; about Rs.6.5 lakh paid to her at 21
eligibility: The girl was born on or after 1 April 2015
The parents' total income from all sources is below Rs.75,000 a year
The girl and her parents are residents of Jammu & Kashmir
The money is held in the girl's own account and paid to her only at age 21
documents: Birth certificate of the girl
Income certificate of the parents, showing less than Rs.75,000 a year
Aadhaar card of the girl and of the parents
Domicile certificate of the parents
Ration card or other address proof
J&K Bank account details in the girl's name, once the sanction letter asks for them

demoFields.label: Name of the girl child
demoFields.hint: Exactly as written on her birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must be on or after 01/04/2015. Apply soon after the birth certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: Place of birth
demoFields.hint: The hospital or place named on the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: As on his Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mother's name
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of parent
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the mother's or father's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Annual family income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Total from all sources, the same figure as on the income certificate. It must be below Rs.75,000.

demoFields.label: District and ICDS project
demoFields.hint: The block ICDS project where you live. Its CDPO checks your form.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Application updates and the sanction message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jansugam.jk.gov.in (or open it from e-UNNAT) with your mobile number, then log in.
Under Social Welfare, choose Application for obtaining Financial Assistance under Ladli Beti Scheme and fill in the girl's and parents' details.
Upload the birth, income and domicile certificates and the Aadhaar cards, submit, and note the application number from the SMS.
The CDPO checks the form within 15 days, then the District Programme Officer and the Deputy Commissioner take it up; the whole process is meant to finish within 45 days.
After sanction, open the girl's account at J&K Bank if the sanction letter asks, and add the account number on the portal.
Rs.1,000 is credited every month until she turns 14. At 21 the matured amount, about Rs.6.5 lakh, is paid to her.
schemes.helpline: 0194-2479645 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Kashmir / your District Social Welfare Officer or CDPO (ICDS) office

schemes.title: Abua Awas Yojana (Abua Awas)
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Jharkhand's own rural housing scheme: Rs.2 lakh to build a pucca house with three rooms and a kitchen, for families who have no house or live in a kutcha house and did not get one under PM Awas Yojana-Gramin. The state received about 30 lakh applications at the 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camps, found about 20 lakh genuine, and is building houses for them in phases. The money comes in instalments into the beneficiary's bank account as each stage of the house is geo-tagged, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages for the family's own labour.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh in instalments for a 3-room pucca house with kitchen, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages
eligibility: Rural families in Jharkhand with no house, or living in a kutcha or broken house
The family has never got a house under PMAY-G, Indira Awas, Birsa Awas or Baba Saheb Ambedkar Awas
Priority for PVTG families, families hit by natural disasters, and freed bonded labourers
Not for families with a serving or retired government employee, an income-tax or professional-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler or fishing boat
The family must be on the verified list made from the camp applications; each panchayat's list is shown at the Panchayat Bhawan
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's name
MGNREGA job card, for the 95 days of wages
Land paper for the plot where the house will be built (khatiyan or rent receipt)
Caste certificate, if SC, ST or PVTG
Mobile number
schemes.portalName: Abua Awas Yojana portal, Rural Development Department
schemes.submitAt: The 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp in your panchayat when one is held, or the Panchayat Sachiv or the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office. Take Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, MGNREGA job card and land papers. If you already applied at a camp, check your name in the list at the Panchayat Bhawan, because houses are sanctioned from that list in order. There is no fee, so never pay a middleman who promises a house.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The sanction and payments are in this name.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: Husband's name if married, otherwise father's name.

demoFields.label: Village, panchayat, block, district
demoFields.value: Hesal, Hesal panchayat, Torpa block, Khunti district
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives and where the new house will be built.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's 12-digit Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: The family's ration card number.

demoFields.label: Social category
demoFields.hint: Write SC, ST, OBC or General, and say if the family belongs to a PVTG group.

demoFields.label: Present house
demoFields.value: Kutcha, mud walls with tiled roof
demoFields.hint: Describe the house you live in now, or write 'no house'.

demoFields.label: House received earlier under PMAY-G, Indira Awas or Birsa Awas?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. Families who already got a government house are left out.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's own name. Every instalment comes here.

demoFields.label: MGNREGA job card number
demoFields.hint: Needed for the 95 days of wages for building your own house.

demoSteps: If you applied at a camp, look for your name on the Abua Awas list at the Panchayat Bhawan. If you never applied, apply at the next 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp or at the block office.
Panchayat and block staff visit to check that your house is kutcha and that the family never got a government house.
Selected families get a sanction letter, and the first instalment comes to the bank account.
Build the house in stages. At each stage the staff geo-tag a photo of it on the Abua Awas app, and the next instalment is released after that.
Work on your own house as MGNREGA labour and get up to 95 days of wages in your account; ask the Rozgar Sevak to open the work on your job card.
Finish the house with three rooms and a kitchen. The final geo-tag closes the case. For delays or demands for money, go to the Panchayat Sachiv or the BDO.
schemes.helpline: No dedicated helpline. Contact your Panchayat Sachiv or Rozgar Sevak, then the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office

schemes.title: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana (Maiyan Samman)
schemes.department: Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Rs.2,500 a month for women aged 18 to 50 in Jharkhand, paid into their own Aadhaar-linked bank account by the 15th of every month. It started in August 2024 at Rs.1,000 and was raised to Rs.2,500 from December 2024. Applications are taken at camps held across the state; there is no online form to fill yourself. Women already getting the money must finish the physical verification (satyapan) and Aadhaar e-KYC, or the next instalments are held back.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.30,000 a year) into the woman's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Jharkhand, aged 18 or above and below 50 on the day of applying
Her family holds a yellow Antyodaya, pink Priority Household, white K-Oil or green state ration card
She has her own Aadhaar and a single bank account linked to Aadhaar

Not for a woman who, or whose husband (father, if she is unmarried), works for the central or state government, a PSU, local body or government-aided institution as regular, contract or honorarium staff, or draws a government pension
Not if a family member is a present or former MP or MLA, if the family pays income tax, or if she is an EPF member
Not if she already gets another social security pension from the department
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card of the family (yellow, pink, white or green)
Passbook of the Aadhaar-linked bank account in her own name
Voter ID card
PAN card, if she has one (optional)
One colour passport-size photo
Mobile number
Signed self-declaration, which is part of the form
schemes.submitAt: The Maiya Samman camp held in your panchayat or urban ward. The department takes applications through camps across Jharkhand, announced by the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv and block office; between camps, ask at your Anganwadi centre or the block (Prakhand) or circle (Anchal) office. The form is free (the printed summary on the 2024 form still says Rs.1,000; the amount is now Rs.2,500). Go yourself, because your Aadhaar and photo are checked on the spot. Take the original Aadhaar, ration card, Aadhaar-linked bank passbook and voter ID, a colour photo and self-attested copies, and keep the acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का नाम (Applicant's name)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The money goes only to this woman.

demoFields.label: पिता/पति का नाम (Father's / husband's name)
demoFields.hint: Husband's name if married, otherwise father's name.

demoFields.label: पता (Village/mohalla, police station, panchayat/ward, block/circle, district)
demoFields.value: Tetartoli, PS Kanke, Panchayat Sarwa, Block Kanke, District Ranchi
demoFields.hint: Your present address in Jharkhand, as on the ration card.

demoFields.label: आधार संख्या (Aadhaar number)
demoFields.hint: Her own 12-digit Aadhaar number, one digit per box.

demoFields.label: खाता संख्या (Bank account number)
demoFields.hint: Her own single account. A joint account or someone else's account will be rejected.

demoFields.label: खाता आधार लिंक्ड है (Is the account linked to Aadhaar?)
demoFields.hint: Payment is made only to an Aadhaar-linked account. Get it linked at the bank before the camp.

demoFields.label: बैंक का नाम (शाखा सहित) / IFSC Code
demoFields.value: Bank of India, Kanke branch / BKID0099999
demoFields.hint: Copy the bank name, branch and IFSC from the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: राशन कार्ड संख्या (Ration card number)
demoFields.hint: Her name should be on this yellow, pink, white or green card.

demoFields.label: आयु / जन्म तिथि (Age / date of birth)
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or above and below 50. Use the date on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का मोबाइल नंबर (Mobile number)
demoFields.hint: Payment and verification messages come to this number.

demoSteps: Find out the date of the Maiya Samman camp in your panchayat or ward from the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv or block office, and get the free form there (or print the official form).
Fill the form, tick that the account is Aadhaar-linked, paste the photo, sign the declaration and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook and voter ID.
Go to the camp yourself. The operator enters the form on the portal and checks your Aadhaar and photo. Keep the acknowledgement.
Block and district officials verify the application. Once approved, Rs.2,500 arrives in your Aadhaar-linked account by the 15th of every month.
When the Anganwadi worker or block office calls you for satyapan or e-KYC, complete it. Names that are not verified do not get the next instalment.
If the money stops, check at the bank that the account is still linked to Aadhaar, then call 1800-890-0215 or complain at the block office.
schemes.helpline: 1800-890-0215 — toll-free, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Jharkhand

schemes.title: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana (SPKSY)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Money for girls in Jharkhand to stay in school and not be married off early: Rs.2,500 in Class 8, Rs.2,500 in Class 9, Rs.5,000 each in Classes 10, 11 and 12, and a one-time Rs.20,000 at age 18 to 19, Rs.40,000 in all. It goes to the first two daughters of a mother who study in government or government-aided schools. For school girls the school applies, by sending the girl's details from e-Vidya Vahini to the scheme portal. Others apply with the official form at the CDPO office.
eligibility: Girls living in Jharkhand, enrolled in Class 8 to 12 in a government, government-aided, welfare-department or NCLP school
Only the first two daughters of a mother; the mother gives a self-declaration
Parents must not be permanent or retired central or state government or PSU employees, or draw a government pension or family pension
Parents must not pay income tax
For the Rs.20,000 grant she must be 18 or 19 years old when applying, and a voter ID is needed
documents: Aadhaar card of the girl
Aadhaar card of the mother (of the father, if the mother has died)
Birth certificate
Bank or post office passbook in the girl's name
Ration card
Voter ID card (for the 18–19 grant)
Mother's self-declaration on birth order, and the parents' self-declaration that they are not taxpayers or government employees
Principal's certificate that she studies in the school; for orphans, the parents' death certificate and a Child Welfare Committee certificate
schemes.portalName: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana portal
schemes.submitAt: Girls in Class 8 to 12: ask the headmaster or class teacher. The school sends the girl's details from e-Vidya Vahini to the Savitribai portal, adds her Aadhaar, bank account and declarations, and forwards it to the CDPO. Girls of 18 to 19 who have left school, and anyone the school has not covered: fill the official form and hand it in at the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office of your block, yourself or through your Anganwadi worker. Attach self-attested copies of the ration card, Aadhaar, voter ID and bank passbook, the self-declarations and the principal's certificate. Girls still in school at 18 to 19 can apply through the school.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का नाम (Name of the girl)
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar and school register.
