demoFields.label: माता/पिता/अभिभावक का नाम (Mother's / father's / guardian's name)
demoFields.hint: The mother's name comes first. A guardian is written only for an orphan.

demoFields.label: ग्राम, पंचायत, प्रखंड, जिला (Village, panchayat, block, district)
demoFields.value: Barwadih, Barwadih panchayat, Chas block, Bokaro district
demoFields.hint: In a town, write the nagar nigam, nagar panchayat or nagar parishad instead of the block.

demoFields.label: आंगनवाड़ी केन्द्र का नाम एवं कोड (Anganwadi centre name and code)
demoFields.hint: Only if you know it. The Anganwadi worker can tell you.

demoFields.label: जन्म तिथि / जन्म प्रमाण पत्र संख्या (Date of birth / birth certificate number)
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of the birth certificate. For the 18–19 grant, also give the voter ID number.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का जन्म क्रम (Birth order)
demoFields.hint: Only the first or second daughter can apply. The mother signs a declaration on this.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का आधार संख्या (Girl's Aadhaar number)
demoFields.hint: The girl's own 12-digit Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: बैंक/पोस्ट ऑफिस खाता संख्या, शाखा, IFSC (Bank or post office account, branch, IFSC)
demoFields.hint: An account in the girl's own name. The money is sent here by DBT.

demoFields.label: विद्यालय का नाम, कक्षा, रोल नम्बर (School, class, roll number)
demoFields.value: Govt. High School Barwadih, Class 9, Roll 27
demoFields.hint: The principal signs a certificate that she studies in this class.

demoFields.label: लाभ प्राप्ति का वर्ग (Benefit category)
demoFields.hint: Tick the one class she is in now, or 18–19 years for the Rs.20,000 grant.

demoSteps: At the start of the school year, tell the class teacher that she wants the Savitribai benefit, and give copies of her Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar, the birth certificate, the bank passbook and the ration card.
The school sends her details from e-Vidya Vahini to the Savitribai portal, adds the Aadhaar, bank account and declarations, and forwards the application to the CDPO.

For the Rs.20,000 grant at 18 or 19 after leaving school, fill the official form, attach the self-declarations and voter ID, and submit it at the CDPO office or through the Anganwadi worker. Keep the receipt.
The CDPO checks the application and the District Social Welfare Officer approves it. Wrong details are sent back to the school for correction.
The money for that class comes by DBT into the girl's account. Check the status on savitribaipksy.jharkhand.gov.in under Track Beneficiary Status.
Repeat every year from Class 8 to Class 12, then apply for the Rs.20,000 grant at age 18 or 19.
schemes.helpline: 0651-2400757 / 0651-2223544 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Ranchi (technical help, savitribaihelpdesk@gmail.com) / 1800-890-0215 — department toll-free

schemes.title: e-Kalyan Jharkhand — Scholarships for SC, ST, OBC and Minority Students
schemes.department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: e-Kalyan is the Jharkhand welfare department's own scholarship portal — it is separate from the National Scholarship Portal. SC, ST, OBC and minority students apply here for pre-matric scholarships (Classes 1 to 10) and post-matric scholarships (college and above), renew them each year and check the payment. The portal reports 6 schemes and Rs 1,339.35 crore disbursed in 2024-25. The address is ekalyan.cgg.gov.in and not a jharkhand.gov.in name because the system is hosted by the Centre for Good Governance.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's own bank account
eligibility: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Backward Class or notified minority community of Jharkhand
Student is domiciled in Jharkhand — the scholarship follows the home state, not the state where the college is
Studying in a recognised school or institution that is registered on the portal; if your college is not registered, it cannot verify your form
Family income must be within the limit notified for that scholarship for the year, so read the notice on the portal before filling the form
The bank account must be in the student's own name and seeded with the student's Aadhaar; a parent's or joint account is rejected
Renewal is applied for every year and is not automatic
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate issued in Jharkhand, or the minority declaration
Income certificate of the parent or guardian
Residence (domicile) certificate of Jharkhand
Last passed marksheet
Fee receipt or admission receipt from the institution for the current year
Bank passbook in the student's own name showing account number and IFSC
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Scholarship applied for
demoFields.hint: Pre-matric is for Classes 1 to 10, post-matric for college and above. Choose fresh for the first year and renewal after that.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar and on the marksheet. A mismatch stops the payment at the bank stage.

demoFields.label: Father's / Guardian's Name
demoFields.hint: The same name as on the income certificate you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the caste certificate. The scheme and the rate depend on this.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The same Aadhaar must be seeded to the bank account, or the DBT transfer fails.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Your home district and block. The district welfare officer of this district sanctions the scholarship.

demoFields.label: Institution, Course and Year
demoFields.value: P.K. Roy Memorial College, Dhanbad — B.A. (Hons) History — 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, ask the college to get itself registered first.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Copy the figure from the income certificate you are uploading. The two must be the same number.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The student's own account. Copy both from the first page of the passbook, digit by digit.

demoSteps: Watch ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for the year's notice. Pre-matric and post-matric open on different dates and the last date is hard — a late form is not accepted.
Before anything else, open a bank account in the student's own name and get the student's Aadhaar seeded to it at the branch. Payment is by DBT and a parent's or joint account is rejected.
Register as a student with your mobile and Aadhaar, then fill the form: category, institution, course, year, fees paid and bank details.
Upload the caste certificate, income certificate, residence certificate, last marksheet and the fee receipt. Submit and note the application number.
Your institution must verify the application on its own login. Go to the college office and confirm that it has been forwarded — more applications stall at this step than anywhere else.
The district welfare office sanctions it and the money is credited to the seeded account. Check the payment status on the portal with the same login.
Apply again for renewal in the next academic year. A renewal that misses the last date lapses and cannot be claimed later.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the District Welfare Officer of your district, or the welfare section of your college, which holds the institution login.

schemes.title: JharSewa — Jharkhand e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology & e-Governance, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: JharSewa is Jharkhand's e-District system. Caste, income and residence (domicile) certificates, birth and death certificates, land record services and social security pension applications are filed here instead of at the block office, and the signed certificate is downloaded from the same login. A Pragya Kendra (Common Service Centre) will file it for you for the notified fee if you cannot do it yourself.
schemes.benefit: Caste, income, residence, birth and death certificates applied for and downloaded online
eligibility: Resident of Jharkhand, applying in the block and circle where the family actually lives
A residence (domicile) certificate needs proof that the family lives in Jharkhand — the ration card and the land or rent record for that address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Jharkhand's own list, and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate states the household income for one financial year, so departments ask for a recent one
The mobile number linked to your Aadhaar must be working, because the whole process runs on OTP and SMS
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, holding tax receipt or rent agreement
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a self-declaration where there is no salary
School leaving certificate or Class 10 marksheet for date of birth
Land record (khatiyan or rent receipt), where the claim rests on land in the family's name
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Caste, income, residence, birth, death, land record or pension. Each service has its own form and its own list of proofs.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints exactly from this box.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: The family is traced through this name in the revenue and caste records, so use the spelling on his own papers.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate or the birth certificate, not as remembered.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Circle Officer of this circle signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Write the caste exactly as it appears on your father's caste certificate. The office checks it against the state's notified list.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the year — wages, farming, shop, rent and pension together, not only your own.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded on the file. It does not limit where you can use the certificate afterwards.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the 'certificate ready' message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in with your name, mobile and email and confirm the OTP — or take the papers to a Pragya Kendra or your block office, which files it across the counter for the notified fee.
Pick the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card. Do not mix up the block and the panchayat; the file is routed on them.
Upload the scans, submit, and write down the application number. Everything after this is tracked on that number alone.
The Circle Officer's staff verify the claim. For a caste certificate the check runs through your father's record, so keep his certificate at hand.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy does not need any further attestation.
Jharkhand's service guarantee law fixes a time limit for each of these certificates. If it passes, quote the application number to the Circle Officer, then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for JharSewa. Ask at your block office (prakhand karyalaya) or the nearest Pragya Kendra, and at the District Informatics Office for a technical problem with the portal.

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK Health Card)
schemes.department: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Karnataka — Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST)
schemes.brief: Karnataka's health cover, run together with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Families with a BPL (Priority Household or Antyodaya) ration card get free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh a year for the whole family; other families get 30% of the treatment cost paid, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. Treatment starts at a government hospital, which refers you to a listed private hospital if it cannot treat you; listed emergencies can go straight to a listed hospital. The card is made at a government hospital counter for Rs.10 with your Aadhaar and ration card.
schemes.benefit: BPL families: up to Rs.5 lakh a year free; other families: 30% of the cost, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year
eligibility: Every resident of Karnataka with an Aadhaar card can enrol
Eligible category (free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh per family per year): families with a Priority Household (BPL) or Antyodaya ration card under the Food Security Act
General category (APL card or no ration card): the government pays 30% of the package rate, up to Rs.1.5 lakh per family per year, and the family pays the rest
Simpler treatments are given only in government hospitals. A private hospital needs a referral from a government hospital, except for the listed emergencies
Aadhaar authentication is compulsory before a referral to a private hospital
documents: Aadhaar card of the patient (each member of the family enrols separately)
Ration card, which decides whether you are in the eligible or the general category
Mobile number, for the SMS with your ArK ID
Rs.10 for the card (Rs.20 for a reprint if it is lost)
Referral letter from the government hospital, when going to a private hospital
Earlier prescriptions, test reports and discharge papers, if any
schemes.submitAt: At the registration (Arogya Mitra) counter of any government hospital: Primary Health Centre, Community Health Centre, taluk or district hospital, or medical college hospital. Take every member's Aadhaar card and the ration card, and Rs.10 per card. Grama One, Karnataka One and Bangalore One centres also issue the card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The patient's own Aadhaar. Each family member is enrolled one by one.

demoFields.label: Authentication
demoFields.hint: Fingerprint on the biometric device. If it fails, the staff can use an OTP to the Aadhaar mobile or the QR code on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Ration card (PDS) number
demoFields.hint: From the ration card. It links you to your family in the food department's records.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Filled automatically: Priority Household or Antyodaya card = Eligible; APL card or no card = General.

demoFields.label: Name, gender and age
demoFields.hint: Taken from the Aadhaar e-KYC. Check the spelling before the card is printed.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Your ArK ID is sent here by SMS.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk
demoFields.hint: Where you live.

demoFields.label: Consent and self-declaration
demoFields.value: Signed — no other health insurance scheme
demoFields.hint: A printed form: you allow your Aadhaar to be used for enrolment and state that you are not covered by another scheme.

demoFields.label: ArK ID (generated)
demoFields.hint: Your ration card number, a dash and your member number. It is printed on the card.

demoFields.label: Card fee
demoFields.hint: Paid once. A reprint of a lost card costs Rs.20.

demoSteps: Go to the registration counter of a government hospital (PHC, CHC, taluk or district hospital) with your Aadhaar and ration card.
The staff check your Aadhaar by fingerprint (or OTP or QR code), and your ration card decides your category: Eligible (BPL) or General.
Sign the consent and self-declaration, pay Rs.10, and collect the printed card with your ArK ID. Repeat this for each family member.
When you fall ill, go first to a government hospital. If it cannot give the treatment, ask the doctor for a referral to a private hospital empanelled under AB-ArK.
At the private hospital, go to the Arogya Mitra desk with the card, your Aadhaar and the referral letter. The hospital takes approval from SAST; for eligible families the treatment is cashless.
In an emergency covered by the listed emergency procedures, go straight to the nearest empanelled hospital. No referral is needed.
If a hospital asks a BPL card holder to pay for a covered treatment, call 104 or 1800 425 8330 before paying.
schemes.helpline: 104 — Arogya Sahayavani (toll free); 1800 425 8330 — Arogya Karnataka helpline

schemes.title: Karnataka Social Security Pensions (Old Age, Sandhya Suraksha, Widow and Disability Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays a monthly pension to poor elderly people, widows and people with disabilities, straight into a bank or post office account. The old age pension is Rs.600 a month from 60 to 64 and Rs.1,200 from 65; Sandhya Suraksha gives Rs.1,200 to farmers, labourers, weavers and fishermen aged 65 and above; widows get Rs.800; people with disabilities get Rs.800 to Rs.2,000. One common form covers all of them, and you hand it in at the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri) for your area.
schemes.benefit: Rs.600 to Rs.2,000 a month depending on the pension; Rs.1,200 for most people aged 65 and above
eligibility: Resident of Karnataka, with a family income below Rs.32,000 a year
Old age pension (IGNOAPS): BPL, aged 60 or above. Rs.600 a month at 60 to 64, Rs.1,200 at 65 and above

Sandhya Suraksha: aged 65 or above; small or marginal farmer, farm labourer, weaver, fisherman or unorganised worker (not construction-board workers); husband and wife's deposits together not above Rs.10,000. Rs.1,200 a month
Widow pension: destitute widow aged 18 to 64. Rs.800 a month, until remarriage or a job that takes income above the limit
Disability pension: 40% disability or more, certified by a medical board, Rs.800; 75% or more, Rs.1,400; 75% or more mental disability, Rs.2,000
Not already drawing another pension. Having sons does not disqualify you if they do not support you
documents: The filled application form
Aadhaar card
Age proof: birth certificate, voter ID with date of birth, or a doctor's age certificate
Residence certificate
Income certificate (below Rs.32,000 a year)
Bank or post office passbook, first page
Ration card
As needed: husband's death certificate (widow), medical board disability certificate (disability), occupation certificate from the Tahsildar (Sandhya Suraksha)
schemes.submitAt: The Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri counter) at your hobli or taluk office. Take the filled form, signed or with your thumb impression, with copies of Aadhaar, age proof, residence and income certificates, the bank or post office passbook and the ration card, plus the death, disability or occupation certificate your pension needs. The counter charges a small service fee; ask for the printed acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Written at the top of the form. It decides which village officer verifies your application.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Male or female
demoFields.hint: Tick or write one.

demoFields.label: Father's or husband's name
demoFields.hint: Husband's name for a married woman or a widow, father's name otherwise.

demoFields.label: Full postal address (present and permanent)
demoFields.value: Door no. 7, Hosahalli, Sira taluk, Tumakuru 572137
demoFields.hint: Write both if you live away from your permanent home.

demoFields.label: Age on the date of application
demoFields.hint: Write which age proof you are attaching.

demoFields.label: Pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Tick one box: old age, widow, disability, Sandhya Suraksha, Manaswini, Maithri, acid attack victim, farmer's widow or endosulfan victim.

demoFields.label: Family's annual income
demoFields.hint: Must be below Rs.32,000. Attach the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Combined deposits of husband and wife
demoFields.value: Rs.4,500, savings account, Sira branch of a co-operative bank
demoFields.hint: Amount, type of deposit and the bank. For Sandhya Suraksha it must not be above Rs.10,000.

demoFields.label: Any other pension, and occupation
demoFields.value: No other pension; farm labourer (Tahsildar's certificate attached)
demoFields.hint: Another pension makes you ineligible. The occupation certificate is needed for Sandhya Suraksha.

demoSteps: Download the common pension form from dssp.karnataka.gov.in, or ask for it at the Nadakacheri counter.
Fill it in, tick the pension you want, sign or put your left thumb impression, and attach the documents.
Hand it in at the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra for your hobli or taluk, and keep the acknowledgement number.
The village administrative officer and the revenue inspector check your age, income and residence, often with a home visit. The Tahsildar then sanctions the pension.
The pension order gives you a beneficiary ID. The pension is then paid every month into your bank or post office account.

Check the status, or a stopped payment, on the Beneficiary Status page of dssp.karnataka.gov.in with your beneficiary ID. If payments stop, first make sure your account is seeded with Aadhaar, then go to the taluk office.
schemes.helpline: 080-22232040 / 080-22232012 — Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Bengaluru; 1902 — Karnataka government citizen helpline

schemes.title: Shakti Yojana (Free Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka — KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC
schemes.brief: Women and girls who live in Karnataka, and transgender persons, travel free in ordinary government buses anywhere inside the state. There is no form, card or registration: show a government photo ID with a Karnataka address to the conductor and you get a zero-fare Shakti ticket. Air-conditioned and luxury buses, sleeper buses and buses that cross into another state are not free.
schemes.benefit: Free travel in ordinary and express non-AC government buses within Karnataka
eligibility: Women and girls of any age who live in Karnataka, including school and college students
Transgender persons who live in Karnataka
No income, caste or age limit, and nothing to apply for
Covers ordinary and express non-AC buses of KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC, including non-AC electric buses
Not covered: Rajahamsa, AC buses such as Airavat, Vajra, Vayu Vajra, Ambaari and Flybus, sleeper buses, and interstate routes, even for the Karnataka part of the trip
documents: Aadhaar card, or
Voter ID, driving licence, passport, or MGNREGA job card with photo and address
Photo ID with address issued by a Government of India or Karnataka department or a public sector company
ID card from the Department for the Empowerment of Differently Abled and Senior Citizens, or a transgender ID card
School or college ID card, for girl students
The original, a photocopy, or the DigiLocker copy (printed or on the phone) is accepted
schemes.submitAt: There is no form and nowhere to apply. Board an ordinary or express non-AC bus of KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC or NWKRTC on a route inside Karnataka, show the conductor an ID with your photo and Karnataka address (original, photocopy or DigiLocker copy), and ask for the Shakti ticket.

demoFields.label: Corporation
demoFields.hint: Printed at the top of the ticket. KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC buses are all covered.

demoFields.label: Type of bus
demoFields.hint: Ordinary, express and non-AC electric buses are free. Rajahamsa, AC, sleeper and Flybus services are not.

demoFields.label: Boarding point
demoFields.hint: Tell the conductor where you got on.

demoFields.label: Destination
demoFields.hint: Must be inside Karnataka. On a bus going to another state you pay the full fare.

demoFields.label: ID shown
demoFields.hint: Any government photo ID that shows a Karnataka address.

demoFields.label: Passengers
demoFields.hint: Each woman and girl gets her own zero ticket. Men travelling with you buy normal tickets.

demoFields.label: Ticket type
demoFields.hint: Keep it until you get down. Checking staff can ask for it.

demoFields.label: Fare value printed
demoFields.hint: The ticket shows what the trip would have cost. The state pays this amount to the bus company.

demoSteps: Carry one ID with your photo and Karnataka address. Aadhaar is the easiest; a photocopy or the DigiLocker copy on your phone is also accepted.
Board an ordinary or express non-AC government bus. Check the name on the front: Rajahamsa, Airavat, Vajra, Vayu Vajra, Ambaari, Flybus and sleeper buses are not free.
Tell the conductor your destination, show the ID and ask for the Shakti ticket.
Take the zero-fare ticket and keep it until you get down. A passenger without a ticket can be fined even on a free trip.
On KSRTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC buses half the seats are kept for men; BMTC city buses have no such split.
If a conductor refuses the free ticket on a covered bus, note the bus number, route and time, and complain to that corporation's helpline.
schemes.helpline: KSRTC call centre (24x7): 080-26252625; BMTC helpline: 080-22483777; 1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline

schemes.title: Bhoomi — Karnataka RTC (Pahani) and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Bhoomi holds the land record of every agricultural holding in Karnataka. The RTC, also called the pahani, shows who holds the land, how much, and what was sown. The i-RTC is a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept, and mutation status after a sale or a death is tracked on the same site.
schemes.benefit: RTC and digitally signed i-RTC online, with mutation status and survey sketches
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Karnataka and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view an RTC; only the holder or a legal heir can apply for a mutation
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
An i-RTC needs a mobile number, since it is delivered against an OTP
documents: Survey number and hissa number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for an i-RTC or a mutation
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and family tree, for a mutation on inheritance
Existing RTC or pahani copy

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: A free RTC view for your own reference, an i-RTC for a bank or an office, mutation status, or a Mojini survey sketch.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all four from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: From the old RTC or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Surnoc / Hissa Number
demoFields.hint: The sub-division of the survey number. Copy it exactly — a wrong hissa pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first and get a correction later if needed.

demoFields.label: Year / Period
demoFields.hint: The RTC is kept year by year. Take the current year unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar and Mobile (for an i-RTC)
demoFields.hint: Needed for a digitally signed copy. The download link comes to this mobile against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Mutation (MR) number, to check status
demoFields.hint: Given when the mutation is filed. Track the stage against it rather than going to the office.

demoSteps: Open landrecords.karnataka.gov.in and view the RTC for your survey and hissa number. Check the extent, the owner's name and the crop entry against what you know. This view is free.
For a bank, a court or a subsidy claim, buy the i-RTC — the digitally signed copy. The free print is not accepted for those.
After a purchase or a death, file the mutation at the taluk office or through Nadakacheri with the registered deed, or the death certificate and family tree.
Keep the MR number and track the mutation stage on Bhoomi rather than waiting at the office.
The Revenue Inspector gives notice and hears any objection before the Tahsildar passes the order.
Once the order is passed, pull a fresh RTC and check that the name and extent are right. An error here is much easier to fix now than years later.
Keep a current RTC with your papers. Crop loans, PM-Kisan and state farm schemes all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk office, or the nearest Nadakacheri centre

schemes.title: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal — SC, ST, OBC and Minority
schemes.department: Social Welfare, Backward Classes and Minority Welfare Departments, Karnataka
schemes.brief: One portal for every Karnataka state scholarship — pre-matric for school children and post-matric for SC, ST, OBC, Category-1 and minority students in college. Applications are made fresh each year and the money is paid by DBT into the student's own account.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's account
eligibility: Student domiciled in Karnataka and studying in a recognised institution in the state
SC, ST, OBC, Category-1 or a notified minority, on a Karnataka caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, on a current income certificate
Passed the previous year; a student repeating a failed year is not eligible
Not drawing another scholarship for the same course
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Karnataka caste and income certificate (Sindhutva Pramana Patra) numbers
Previous year's marks card
Bonafide or admission certificate from the institution
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Fee receipt paid to the institution
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: Pre-matric for Classes 1 to 10, post-matric from Class 11 upwards. Fresh for the first year of a course, renewal after.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The institution record and the bank record must agree or the DBT fails.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The student's own. The portal does an Aadhaar e-KYC, so the name and date of birth must match.

demoFields.label: Caste and Income Certificate Number (Sindhutva Pramana Patra)
demoFields.hint: The RD number of the Karnataka caste-cum-income certificate. The portal validates it, so an expired or wrongly typed number stops the application.

demoFields.label: Institution and Course
demoFields.value: Karnatak Arts College, Dharwad — B.A., 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, it has not registered on SSP and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Previous year marks
demoFields.hint: From the marks card you upload. A student repeating a failed year is not eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is the usual reason the money bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the payment message come here.

demoSteps: Get the Sindhutva Pramana Patra — the Karnataka caste-cum-income certificate — from Seva Sindhu first. SSP validates its RD number and will not proceed without a current one.
Register on ssp.karnataka.gov.in with your Aadhaar, complete the e-KYC and choose pre-matric or post-matric, fresh or renewal.
Fill in the institution and course from the portal's list, upload the marks card, the bonafide certificate and the fee receipt, and give an Aadhaar-seeded account in your own name.
Submit and note the application number, then follow it up with the institution — it has to verify and forward the application before anything moves.
The welfare department sanctions it and the money is credited by DBT. The portal shows the sanction and the payment against your application number.
Apply again every year with a current certificate. Renewal is not automatic and missing the window costs that year's money.
schemes.helpline: 8050770004 — SSP Karnataka helpdesk

schemes.title: KPSC Recruitment — KAS, FDA and SDA
schemes.department: Karnataka Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Karnataka Public Service Commission recruits for the Karnataka Administrative Service and for Group A, B and C posts including First and Second Division Assistant and the engineering services. Notifications appear on the Commission's site and applications are filed on its online portal.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every KPSC recruitment, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Karnataka domicile for the reserved quotas and for posts with a local requirement
Age as the notification states, usually 21 to 35 for KAS, with relaxation for SC, ST, Category-1, OBC and disability
A degree from a recognised university, held on the closing date, for KAS and most Group A and B posts
Kannada language knowledge as the notification requires for several posts
Each notification sets its own conditions; read that one before you pay
documents: Aadhaar card
SSLC (Class 10) marks card for date of birth
Degree certificate and marks cards
Karnataka caste and income certificate, for a reserved category
Rural, Kannada medium or Hyderabad-Karnataka certificate, where claiming those quotas
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post or examination applied for
demoFields.value: Gazetted Probationers (KAS) Group A and B
demoFields.hint: One application per notification. Check the qualification and the age limit in that notification before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on SSLC marks card)
demoFields.hint: The SSLC marks card governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Category and special quotas claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Karnataka certificate for. The rural and Kannada-medium quotas need separate certificates from your school and the taluk office.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Kannada language knowledge
demoFields.value: Studied Kannada as first language up to SSLC
demoFields.hint: Several posts require it and test it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's.

demoSteps: Watch kpsc.kar.nic.in for the notification and read the age, qualification and language conditions before anything else.
Register on kpsconline.karnataka.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSLC marks card, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Fill the application, claim only the quotas you hold certificates for, choose your centres and pay the fee online.
Use the correction window if the Commission opens one. It is the only chance to fix a wrong entry and it closes quickly.
Download the admit card about a week before each stage and take it with a photo ID.
KAS runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview. Results for each are published on the Commission's site.
Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed — a rural or Kannada-medium certificate you cannot produce there costs you the post.
schemes.helpline: 080-30574957 — KPSC online application helpdesk

schemes.title: Karnataka Construction Workers Labour Card (KBOCWWB e-Card)
schemes.department: Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Construction workers in Karnataka who register with the Welfare Board get a labour card, now a digital e-card, which opens the board's help: Rs.50,000 for each of a woman worker's first two deliveries, Rs.60,000 for a marriage, up to Rs.2 lakh for a major illness, education help for children, accident cover and a pension at 60. You register on the board's Karmika Seva Kendra (KSK) portal with your Aadhaar mobile number and a 90-day work certificate. Workers who already hold an old Seva Sindhu or e-Karmika card move it to the new portal with their registration and reference numbers.
schemes.benefit: Labour e-card for board help: Rs.50,000 per delivery, Rs.60,000 for marriage, up to Rs.2 lakh medical aid, pension up to Rs.3,000 a month at 60
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60
Worked at least 90 days as a building or construction worker in the last 12 months: mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, bar bender, tile layer and similar work
Working in Karnataka
The e-card is valid for one year. Renew it on the portal with a fresh work certificate, or the benefits stop
For the pension, you must have been registered for at least 3 years before turning 60
documents: Aadhaar card, and the mobile number linked to it
90-day work certificate in the board's format, signed by your employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, or the labour inspector
Ration card number and a copy of the card
Bank passbook of the worker and of the nominee (account number and IFSC)
Nominee's details, and the nominee's own application number if the nominee is also a construction worker
Educational certificate, only if you studied beyond SSLC
Ayushman Bharat card number, if you have one
Your old Seva Sindhu or e-Karmika card, if you already have one

demoFields.label: Registration type
demoFields.value: Register as a New Construction Worker
demoFields.hint: If you already have an old card, choose 'Already Existing Seva Sindhu/E-Karmika Construction Worker' instead and type its registration and reference numbers exactly as printed.

demoFields.label: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here. The Aadhaar e-KYC then fills in your name, date of birth and photo.

demoFields.label: Caste, religion and education
demoFields.hint: An education certificate is needed only if you studied beyond SSLC.

demoFields.label: Present address
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, if it is different from the address on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Family and nominee
demoFields.value: Wife Renuka (31), son Kiran (9), daughter Pooja (6)
demoFields.hint: The nominee receives the death and funeral help. Add your children too; education and marriage help is given for them.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (worker and nominee)
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar-seeded accounts. Upload the passbook page for each.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Upload a copy of the card as well.

demoFields.label: Employer / owner details
demoFields.hint: Name of the employer, the company, and the mobile number of the person in charge of the site.

demoFields.label: Work site address and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you did the 90 days of work.

demoFields.label: Nature of work and certificate issuer
demoFields.value: Mason — certificate by a registered construction workers' union
demoFields.hint: Upload the 90-day certificate and the self-declaration. The labour inspector checks them, sometimes at the site.

demoSteps: Get the 90-day work certificate in the board's format (the KSK portal has the template), signed by your employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, or the labour inspector.

Open kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in, choose Apply for Registration, select 'Register as a New Construction Worker' and verify your Aadhaar-linked mobile with the OTP. Without a smartphone, go to the Karmika Seva Kendra or labour inspector's office in your taluk.
Fill in your personal, family, nominee, bank and work details as in this sample, and upload the documents (JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB each).
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. The labour inspector checks your documents and may visit the work site.
Once approved, download your e-card (digital labour ID) from your KSK dashboard.
Apply for help (delivery, marriage, medical, pension) from the same dashboard. For your children's education help, apply on the State Scholarship Portal, ssp.karnataka.gov.in.
Renew before the e-card expires: log in, and enter your current employer, work site and a new work certificate. The portal reminds you 15 days before expiry.
schemes.helpline: 155214 — Construction Workers Welfare Board helpline (toll free)

schemes.title: Yuva Nidhi (Unemployment Allowance for Graduates and Diploma Holders)
schemes.department: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department (Department of Employment and Training), Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays a monthly allowance to young people who finished a degree or diploma and still have no job six months after the result: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates and postgraduates, Rs.1,500 for diploma holders. It is paid for up to two years, or until you get a job or start further studies, whichever comes first. You apply on Seva Sindhu (now Seva One), and you must confirm on the portal every three months that you are still unemployed, or the payment stops.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates, Rs.1,500 a month for diploma holders, for up to 2 years
eligibility: Passed a degree, postgraduate degree or diploma from the 2022-23 academic year onward
No job (government or private) and not self-employed for 180 days after the result
Karnataka domicile: studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years, counting SSLC, PUC and the degree or diploma
Not studying further, not drawing an apprenticeship stipend, and not getting any other unemployment allowance
A bank account in your own name, seeded with Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Degree, postgraduate or diploma marks cards and the provisional or final certificate
SSLC and PUC marks cards, as proof of study in Karnataka
Bank passbook of an account in your own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Mobile number and email ID
Self-declaration that you are not employed or studying (made on the portal)

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. Your name, date of birth and photo are taken from it after the OTP.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages and the three-monthly declaration reminders come here.

demoFields.label: Qualification
demoFields.hint: Graduates and postgraduates get Rs.3,000; diploma holders get Rs.1,500. Choose what you actually passed.

demoFields.label: University / Board
demoFields.hint: The body that awarded the degree or diploma.

demoFields.label: Register number / USN
demoFields.hint: As printed on your final marks card.

demoFields.label: Year and date of result
demoFields.hint: The 180 days without a job are counted from this date. Apply only after they are over.

demoFields.label: SSLC and PUC register numbers and years
demoFields.hint: These prove that you studied in Karnataka.

demoFields.label: Are you employed, self-employed or studying?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. Money paid on a false answer is recovered.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Your own account, NPCI-seeded with Aadhaar, or the transfer fails.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The district employment officer handles your file.

demoSteps: Wait until 180 days have passed since your result date, with no job and no further studies.

Open the Yuva Nidhi service on Seva One (sevaone.karnataka.gov.in), log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete the Aadhaar e-KYC. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre can do this for you.
Fill in your qualification, register number, year of passing and SSLC and PUC details, upload the marks cards, and give your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Submit and note the application number. The district employment officer checks your certificates; follow it with 'Yuvanidhi Application Status Check' on the portal.
Once approved, the allowance is paid into your account every month by DBT. The department may also ask you to register on the Kaushalkar skills portal for training.
Every three months, submit the 'Unemployment Self Declaration' on the portal. If you miss it, the payment stops until you submit it.
When you get a job or join a course, stop declaring. The allowance ends after two years in any case.
schemes.helpline: 1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline; 080-22279954 / 87926 62814 / 87926 62816 — Seva Sindhu application and technical help

schemes.title: Kaveri Online Services — Registration, EC and Marriage
schemes.department: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Kaveri is where property is registered in Karnataka. You do the data entry and pay the stamp duty online, then keep one appointment at the Sub-Registrar's office. The encumbrance certificate, a certified copy of a deed and marriage registration are on the same portal.
schemes.benefit: Online property registration with a booked slot, plus EC, certified copies and marriage registration
eligibility: Property situated in Karnataka, for registration, an EC or a certified copy
Both parties present at the Sub-Registrar's office on the appointment date, with two witnesses
For marriage registration, both parties of legal age with proof of the marriage having taken place
A mobile number and email, since the slot and every notice go there
documents: Aadhaar cards of both parties and of the two witnesses
PAN cards of both parties, for a property transaction
Draft of the deed to be registered
Latest khata certificate, tax paid receipt and the earlier title deed
Encumbrance certificate for the past thirteen years
Marriage invitation, photographs and a priest's or registrar's certificate, for marriage registration
Passport-size photographs of both parties

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Property registration, EC, certified copy of a deed, or marriage registration. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the property lies. The EC is searched against the Sub-Registrar's office for that area.

demoFields.label: Property identification
demoFields.hint: Survey and hissa number for agricultural land, or the site and khata number for a site. Copy it from the title deed.

demoFields.label: Period for which the EC is wanted
demoFields.hint: Banks usually ask for thirteen years. Ask for a longer period if the title has changed hands often.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Owner's name as on the records
demoFields.hint: The EC is searched against the name in the registered documents, which may not match Aadhaar exactly.

demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number and the download link come here.

demoSteps: Register on kaveri.karnataka.gov.in with your mobile and email, and choose the service you need.
For an EC, enter the district, the Sub-Registrar's office, the property details and the period, pay the fee online and download the certificate when it is ready.
For a property registration, do the data entry on the portal, work out the stamp duty and registration fee with the calculator, and pay online.
Book the Sub-Registrar appointment slot on the portal. This is what saves the day of waiting — the slot is a fixed time, not a queue token.
Attend on the date with both parties, two witnesses and the originals of every document. Photographs and thumb impressions are taken there.
The registered deed is scanned and returned, and the certified copy can be downloaded from the portal afterwards.
Pull a fresh EC a few weeks later and check that the registration shows on it. That is the proof the record has actually been updated.
schemes.helpline: 080-22220192 — Department of Stamps and Registration, Karnataka

schemes.title: Seva Sindhu citizen services
schemes.department: Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka's single window for several hundred services across departments: caste, income and residence certificates from the revenue department, transport, labour welfare, social security and scheme registrations. Kannada and English. You can apply yourself with a mobile OTP, or walk into a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One counter, or the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra at the taluk office, and have it filed for you. The Sakala Act puts a deadline on most of these services, and your acknowledgement carries a Sakala number you can complain against.
schemes.benefit: Several hundred state services, with a deadline fixed under the Sakala Act
eligibility: Resident of Karnataka
Aadhaar with a mobile number linked to it, for the OTP and e-KYC
Whatever the particular service itself requires; the portal lists this before you begin
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card
Proof of residence: electricity bill, property tax receipt or voter ID
Income proof: salary certificate, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage families
For a caste certificate: a parent's or close relative's caste certificate with its RD number
Passport photograph
Bank passbook, for any service that pays money into your account

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed with this spelling in both Kannada and English.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: e-KYC is done against this, so the mobile linked to your Aadhaar must be with you.

demoFields.label: Service applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the department first. Income, caste and residence certificates are three separate applications.

demoFields.label: Parent's caste certificate RD number
demoFields.hint: Needed only for a caste certificate. It is the reference number on your father's or mother's existing certificate, and it saves a fresh field enquiry.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village
demoFields.hint: This decides which revenue inspector and tahsildar handle the file, so it must be where you live.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From the top of your ration card. It is used to confirm the members of the household.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The household's total earnings for the last financial year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the Sakala acknowledgement number and the download link all come here.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Only for services that pay you money. Put your own account, Aadhaar-seeded.

demoSteps: Check which service you need and what it asks for. Seva Sindhu lists the documents for each service on the service's own page before you start.
Register on Seva Sindhu with your Aadhaar and mobile number, and complete the e-KYC with the OTP.
Choose the department and the service, and fill the form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents and pay the fee where one applies. Many certificates cost only a small statutory amount.
Submit and save the acknowledgement. It carries a Sakala number and the date by which the office must answer you.

If you would rather not do this on a phone, take the same documents to a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One counter, or the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra at the taluk office, and the operator files it under your name.
The revenue inspector verifies and the tahsildar signs digitally. Track it on the portal with your acknowledgement number.
Download the signed certificate from your login. If the Sakala deadline passes, use the Sakala number to complain; the Act provides compensation for delay.
schemes.helpline: 1902 (Sakala citizen helpline)

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
schemes.department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka, through the electricity supply companies (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM)
schemes.brief: Karnataka gives every household free electricity up to its usual monthly use, as long as that stays within 200 units. Your free limit is your average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. Use within that limit and the bill is zero; use more and you pay only for the extra units; cross 200 units in a month and you pay the full bill for that month. You register once, free, by linking the house's electricity account to your Aadhaar. Owners and tenants can both apply.
schemes.benefit: Zero bill up to your free limit (average 2022-23 use + 10 units), up to 200 units a month
eligibility: A domestic (house) electricity connection in Karnataka. Shops and other commercial use are not covered
Owner, tenant or family member living in the house. One connection per Aadhaar, and one connection per house
Monthly use must stay at or below 200 units. Above 200, the full bill is charged for that month
Free limit = average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. A new house or new connection with no 2022-23 record gets a fixed limit based on the state average of 53 units
Old unpaid electricity dues must be cleared. Homes on Bhagya Jyothi, Kutira Jyothi and Amrut Jyothi are included in Gruha Jyothi
documents: Aadhaar card of the person applying
Latest electricity bill, for the ESCOM name and the Account ID (connection ID)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
The bill need not be in your name: tenants and family members choose their type in the form
Tenants: a rent agreement or other proof of living at that address, if the office asks for it

demoFields.hint: Filled in automatically. Check that it is the house you actually live in.

demoFields.hint: Owner, Tenant, or Family member (for example, when the bill is in your father's name).

demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. One Aadhaar can be linked to only one connection in the whole state.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your Aadhaar. The OTP check matches it.

demoFields.label: Phone number for communication
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement and later messages about the scheme come here.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm the connection is used only for the house. Commercial use cancels the benefit, and the free amount is recovered with interest.

demoSteps: Keep your latest electricity bill ready and find the ESCOM name and the Account ID on it.

Open sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in, choose Gruha Jyothi and click to register. The form opens without any login. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre, or your ESCOM office, will also register you free.
Select your ESCOM, type the Account ID and check the name and address that appear. Choose Owner, Tenant or Family member, then enter your Aadhaar and verify it with the OTP.
Tick the declaration, submit, and note the acknowledgement number. You can check the status later on the Seva Sindhu 'Track Status' page.
From the next bill, your bill shows your free limit (eligible units). Within it the bill is zero; above it you pay only for the extra units; above 200 units you pay the whole bill.
Tenants moving house: use the Gruha Jyothi De-link option on the same portal to free your Aadhaar from the old connection, then register again at the new house.
If the bill is not zero, first check the eligible-units line on it, then call 1912 or visit the ESCOM sub-division office with your acknowledgement number.
schemes.helpline: 1912 — ESCOM electricity helpline (24x7); 1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline; 080-22279954 / 87926 62814 — guarantee scheme application help

schemes.title: Karnataka Ration Card — Ahara
schemes.department: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Ahara is Karnataka's ration card system. A Priority Household or Antyodaya card brings free rice under Anna Bhagya from the fair price shop, and the card is also the household record that Gruha Lakshmi, Gruha Jyothi and other state schemes are paid against, so it is worth keeping correct.
schemes.benefit: Priority Household or Antyodaya card, with free rice under Anna Bhagya
eligibility: Family resident in Karnataka and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household within the state's limits on income, land, vehicle ownership and government service, for a Priority Household card
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded and the biometric e-KYC done, or that member's rice is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or rent agreement
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member has moved in
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride being added
Gas connection number
Bank passbook of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, correct a detail, or change the head of the family. Pick the right one or the file is returned.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. Gruha Lakshmi is paid to whoever is named here, so get it right.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and how they are related to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.hint: A newborn needs the birth certificate and an Aadhaar. A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides whether the card is Priority Household or APL.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement number and the status messages come here.

demoSteps: Open ahara.karnataka.gov.in and choose the service you need, or go to a Grama One or Karnataka One centre, which files it for the notified fee.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The rice is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.
Attach the address proof and, for a member moving in, the deletion certificate from the old card. Without it the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Submit and keep the acknowledgement number; the portal shows the status against it.
The food inspector verifies the household at the address, and for a new card the category — Antyodaya, Priority Household or APL — is decided at this stage.
Once approved, download the card and check every name and Aadhaar on it.
Take the new member to the fair price shop for the biometric e-KYC on the ePoS machine. Until that is done the family's rice does not increase.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 425 9339 — Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: Gruha Lakshmi — Karnataka Monthly Assistance to the Woman of the House
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays Rs.2,000 a month to the woman recorded as head of the family on the ration card. One woman per household, and the money goes into her own bank account. It is applied for on Seva Sindhu, free, and at a Bangalore One, Karnataka One or Grama One centre if you would rather have help.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month into the woman head of household's own account
eligibility: Woman recorded as head of the family on an Antyodaya, BPL or APL ration card of Karnataka
One woman per household — if the card names another head, that is the person who qualifies
Neither she nor her husband pays income tax or files GST returns
Not a government employee, and not drawing another state monthly assistance of this kind
documents: Aadhaar card of the woman applying
Ration card showing her as head of the family
Aadhaar card of the husband, where she is married
Bank passbook in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded with NPCI
Mobile number linked to her Aadhaar

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The whole application is built from this. The portal pulls the family up and shows who is recorded as head.

demoFields.label: Name of the woman head of the family
demoFields.hint: It must be the name the ration card shows as head. If the card names someone else, get the card corrected first.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Her own twelve digits. The OTP for the application goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Husband's Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Asked so the income-tax and GST check can be run on him too. Leave it blank if she is unmarried or widowed.

demoFields.label: Do you or your husband pay income tax or file GST?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is matched against the tax database, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: As on the ration card. It decides which office handles the file.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In her own name, and NPCI-seeded with Aadhaar — not merely linked. This is the single commonest reason the money does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and every monthly credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check first that the ration card records you as head of the family. If it does not, get the card corrected through Ahara before applying — the scheme goes by the card, not by who actually runs the house.
Open the Seva Sindhu services portal, choose Gruha Lakshmi, and enter your ration card number. The portal fills the family details itself.
Confirm your Aadhaar with the OTP, add your husband's Aadhaar where you are married, and give a bank account in your own name.
Submit and note the application number. There is no fee; a Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre will file it for you free too.
Check the NPCI seeding of your account on the portal or at your bank. An account that is linked to Aadhaar but not NPCI-seeded will still fail when the money is sent.
Once approved, Rs.2,000 is credited each month. Track the sanction and each payment on the portal against your application number.
If a month is missed, check the seeding first, then take the application number to your Grama One centre or the taluk office.
schemes.helpline: 1902 — Seva Sindhu helpline

schemes.title: Kerala Construction Workers Welfare Board Membership (Nirmana Thozhilali Kshemanidhi)
schemes.department: Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour and Skills Department, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Membership for masons, carpenters, helpers, painters, electricians, plumbers and other building workers aged 18 to 59. Members pay Rs.50 a month and get a pension after 60, and help at childbirth and marriage, for children's education, medical treatment, disability and death. You join at the Board's district office with proof of age and of 90 days' construction work. The Board has about 20 lakh members but is short of money: in June 2026 the Labour Minister told the Assembly that pensions have been pending since June 2025.
schemes.benefit: Pension Rs.1,600 a month after 60, plus maternity, marriage, education, treatment and death aid
eligibility: Aged 18 to 59 and working in building or other construction work in Kerala
Worked at least 90 days in construction work in the last 12 months
Pay the Rs.50 monthly subscription to keep the membership active; a break can stop your benefits
Pension: 60 or older with at least 5 years of active membership
Maternity aid: women members with at least 1 year of membership, for up to two deliveries
After a member's or pensioner's death, the nominee or spouse can claim the death benefit or family pension
documents: Membership application form from the Board's district office
Age proof: birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar
Certificate of at least 90 days' construction work in the last 12 months, from your employer or contractor
Aadhaar card copy
Copy of a bank passbook in the worker's own name
Passport-size photos and your nominee's details
For each benefit later: the Board's claim form for it (Form 34 for pension, Form 38 for disability pension, Form 36 for death benefit) with the Welfare Fund ID card and passbook
schemes.submitAt: The district office of the Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (District Executive Officer) in your district. Collect the membership form there, attach the copies, pay the first subscription and take a receipt. Head office: Nirman Bhavan, Mettukada, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram.

demoFields.label: Name of worker
demoFields.hint: As on your Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must match your age proof. You must be between 18 and 59 to join.

demoFields.label: Address and local body
demoFields.value: Thekkethil House, Ward 9, Pallickal Grama Panchayat, Kollam
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. The district office of this district handles your file.

demoFields.label: Type of work
demoFields.hint: Your main construction trade, such as mason, carpenter, helper, painter, plumber or electrician.

demoFields.label: 90 days' work certified by
demoFields.hint: The employer or contractor who signs that you worked at least 90 days in the last 12 months.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of your Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. All benefits are paid into it.

demoFields.label: Nominee and relation
demoFields.hint: The person who gets the death benefit and the refund if something happens to you.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you, for messages from the Board.

demoFields.label: Monthly subscription
demoFields.hint: Pay it every month and see that it is entered in your Welfare Fund passbook.

demoSteps: Collect the membership form at the Board's district office in your district.
Fill it and attach the age proof, the 90-day work certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook copy and photos.
Submit it at the district office with the first subscription and keep the receipt. If the District Executive Officer rejects it, you can appeal to the Board Secretary within 30 days.
You get a Welfare Fund ID card and passbook. Pay Rs.50 every month so the membership stays active.

For a benefit such as maternity, marriage or treatment aid, apply at the same office on the Board's form for it, with the ID card and passbook, soon after the event; after 90 days you must explain the delay.

At 60, with 5 years of active membership, apply for the pension on Form 34 with the ID card, passbook, bank passbook copy and Aadhaar. It is paid into your bank, but payments are running many months late now.
schemes.helpline: 0471-2337941 — Board head office, Thiruvananthapuram; or the Board's district office in your district

schemes.title: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency Kerala, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Kerala's free health cover, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. About 42 lakh poorer families get treatment worth up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at about 180 government and 365 private empanelled hospitals. The KASP card is made at the KASP help desk of an empanelled hospital or at an Akshaya centre after an Aadhaar check. The new government plans to merge KASP into a bigger Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme, but until that is notified KASP cards keep working as before.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families that had an RSBY or CHIS health card in 2018-19, and families on the PM-JAY list (SECC 2011), including those who got the letter from the Prime Minister
About 42 lakh families, the poorest 40% of Kerala. Every member is covered, whatever the age or the size of the family
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one. Costs for 3 days before admission and 15 days after discharge are included
Other families cannot join now. New names are added only when the government announces it

A seriously ill patient from a poor family that is not in KASP can ask the same hospital desk about the Karunya Benevolent Fund: Rs.2 lakh for illnesses such as cancer and heart disease, Rs.3 lakh for kidney disease
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member who needs a card
Ration card
Mobile number for the OTP
Old RSBY or CHIS card, or the letter from the Prime Minister, if you have one
At admission: the KASP card (or its number) and the patient's Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The KASP (PM-JAY) help desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, such as a medical college, district or taluk hospital, or any Akshaya e-Kendra. Take the Aadhaar card of every member who needs a card, the ration card and a mobile phone. There is no paper form: the staff search your family on the computer and check each member's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Search family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card finds the whole family at once. If nothing comes up, the staff try with your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: The 10-digit number printed on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Family found in
demoFields.hint: Shows whether your family is on the PM-JAY list or the state KASP list. Both get the same Rs.5 lakh cover.

demoFields.label: Member selected
demoFields.hint: Each member is done one by one. Check the name and age before the card is printed.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The Aadhaar of the member whose card is being made now.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Fingerprint on the machine. If it fails, an OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile or a face scan is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. Messages about the card and hospital approvals come here.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Face the camera straight, without cap or dark glasses.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: Where you live now.

demoFields.label: Card status
demoFields.hint: Keep the card or a photo of it on your phone. It is valid at every empanelled hospital in the country.

demoSteps: Check if your family is covered: ask at an Akshaya centre or a hospital KASP desk, or call DISHA on 1056.
Go to the KASP desk of an empanelled hospital or an Akshaya centre with each member's Aadhaar, the ration card and your phone.
The staff find your family, check each member's Aadhaar by fingerprint or OTP, take a photo and print the KASP card.
When treatment is needed, go to an empanelled hospital and show the KASP card and Aadhaar at the KASP counter before admission.
The hospital takes approval from the State Health Agency. Medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, room and food in the package are free; do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
If the hospital refuses or asks you to pay, call DISHA 1056 or the State Health Agency before paying.
Not on the list but seriously ill and poor? Ask the same desk how to apply to the Karunya Benevolent Fund.
schemes.helpline: 1056 — DISHA health helpline (24x7); 0471-2960221 / 0471-4063121 — State Health Agency Kerala; 14555 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: Social Security Pension (Kshema Pension / Sevana Pension)
schemes.department: Local Self Government Department and Finance Department, Government of Kerala, through grama panchayats, municipalities and corporations
schemes.brief: Kerala's monthly welfare pension, Rs.2,000 since November 2025, for poor elderly people, widows, persons with disabilities, unmarried women over 50 and old agricultural labourers. About 52 lakh people get it. Your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation takes the paper form, checks your case and must decide within 45 days. The money comes every month to your bank account, or a co-operative bank agent hands it over at your home. The new government has promised to raise it to Rs.3,000, but no date has been fixed yet.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month
eligibility: Family income not above Rs.1 lakh a year, and not an income tax payer
Old age pension: 60 or above. Agricultural labourer pension: 60 or above, at least 10 years as a farm labourer and a member of the Agricultural Workers' Welfare Fund
Widow pension: widows who have not remarried, and women of 50 or more whose husband has been missing or has left them for over 7 years. Unmarried women's pension: unmarried women aged 50 or more
Disability pension: persons with 40% or more disability certified by a medical board

Not eligible: land over 2 acres (except ST families), a car over 1000 cc that is not a taxi, a concrete house over 2,000 sq ft with modern flooring, or a government or PSU service or family pension (ex-gratia or NPS pension up to Rs.4,000 is allowed)
Only one social security pension per person (except persons with disability), applied for in the local body where you live permanently
documents: Age proof: school certificate, birth certificate, church or mosque record, voter ID or Aadhaar
Income certificate from the Village Office
Certificate of permanent residence
Aadhaar card and voter ID card (copy of both sides)
Ration card (copy of the first page and the page with your name)
Bank passbook copy, if you want the pension in a bank
Widows: husband's death certificate. Disability pension: medical board disability certificate
EPF passbook, only if you get an EPF pension below Rs.4,000
schemes.submitAt: The front office of your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation, addressed to the Secretary. The linked form is for the old age pension; the forms for widow, disability, unmarried women and agricultural labourer pensions are on welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in under Application Forms. Fill the form, paste a passport photo taken within the last 6 months, sign it, attach self-attested copies of the documents and take a receipt.

demoFields.label: Gender and category
demoFields.hint: Tick woman, man or transgender, and General, SC or ST.

demoFields.label: Name (in English and in Malayalam)
demoFields.hint: Write the name exactly as on Aadhaar, once in English and once in Malayalam.

demoFields.label: Ward number, ward name and house number
demoFields.hint: From your house tax receipt. The ward member of this ward is asked to confirm your details.

demoFields.label: Address, PIN code and post office
demoFields.hint: The home where you live permanently.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. Pension is paid only to an Aadhaar-verified person.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of the first page and the page with your name.

demoFields.label: Annual income
demoFields.hint: The family income shown on your Village Office income certificate. Also write its number and date at the end of the form.

demoFields.label: How you want the pension
demoFields.hint: Choose bank account, money order (EMO) or direct to home, where a co-operative bank agent brings the cash.

demoFields.label: Service pension, income tax, EPF pension?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. A wrong answer later means the pension is stopped and the money recovered.

demoFields.label: Land owned by you or your family
demoFields.hint: All land in your or your family's name. More than 2 acres makes you ineligible, except for ST families.

demoSteps: Get an income certificate from the Village Office, online on e-District or through an Akshaya centre.
Download and fill the form for your pension type, paste a recent passport photo, sign it and attach the copies.
Hand it in at the front office of your panchayat, municipality or corporation and keep the receipt.
Local body staff check the details and may visit your house. The Secretary must decide within 45 days; if it is refused, you can appeal to the District Collector within 30 days.
Once approved and digitally signed, the pension is due from that month and is paid by DBT to your bank or at your home.
Every year, do the mustering (life check) by fingerprint at an Akshaya centre. Widows and unmarried women under 60 must also give a certificate that they have not married or remarried.
Check your status and payments on welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in under Quick Search or Pension Search.
schemes.helpline: 0471-2327526 — DBT cell for social security pensions; for applications, your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation office

schemes.title: Priyadarshini Scheme (Free KSRTC Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.department: Transport Department, Government of Kerala — Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC)
schemes.brief: Since 15 June 2026, women and transgender persons travel free on KSRTC ordinary buses in Kerala, with no limit on distance. There is no form, card or registration, and no ID is needed: tell the conductor where you are going and take the zero-fare Priyadarshini ticket. Fast Passenger, City Fast and higher-class buses, festival and weekend specials and chartered trips are not free.
schemes.benefit: Free travel on KSRTC ordinary buses, any distance
eligibility: All women and girls, of any age, and transgender persons
No income, residence or caste condition, and nothing to apply for
Covers KSRTC ordinary services; these buses carry 'Priyadarshini Scheme' on both sides and on the front
Not covered: Fast Passenger, City Fast and other higher-class services, BTC services, festival specials, weekend extra services and chartered trips
Private buses are not part of the scheme
documents: Nothing to show: no ID, card or registration is needed
Ask for the zero-fare (Priyadarshini) ticket and keep it until you get down
Normal fare for any men travelling with you
Luggage charge if you carry more than the free limit
schemes.submitAt: There is no form and nowhere to apply. Board a KSRTC ordinary bus marked 'Priyadarshini Scheme', tell the conductor your destination and ask for the zero-fare ticket.

demoFields.label: Bus type
demoFields.hint: Only ordinary services are free. Fast Passenger, City Fast and higher-class buses charge the normal fare.

demoFields.label: Board on the bus
demoFields.hint: Written on both sides and the front of every bus in the scheme.

demoFields.label: Boarding point
demoFields.hint: Tell the conductor where you got on.

demoFields.label: Destination
demoFields.hint: Any distance on the bus's route.

demoFields.label: Ticket type
