Mobile number for the OTP

demoFields.label: Case type (प्रकरण का प्रकार)
demoFields.hint: Choose Normal for a girl under one year old. Choose Special only for a delay of more than a year, an orphan or adopted girl, or a girl whose mother or father has died.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A phone you keep with you. The OTP comes here now, and the messages about approval and payments come here later.

demoFields.label: OTP
demoFields.hint: Type the code within a few minutes. If it expires, ask for a new OTP.

demoFields.label: Girl's Samagra member ID
demoFields.hint: The baby's own 9-digit number. If she has not been added to the family Samagra yet, get that done at the gram panchayat or ward office first.

demoFields.label: Family Samagra ID
demoFields.hint: The 8-digit family number printed on the Samagra slip or card.

demoFields.label: Girl's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: These come from Samagra. If anything is wrong, have Samagra corrected first, because the form takes the details from there.

demoFields.label: Anganwadi centre
demoFields.hint: The centre where the girl is registered. The anganwadi worker there checks your application.

demoFields.label: Number of children
demoFields.hint: Count all living children. If this is the second child, family planning details are needed.

demoFields.label: Family planning adopted
demoFields.hint: Needed for the second girl. Upload the certificate from the hospital where the operation was done.

demoFields.label: Photo of girl with parent
demoFields.hint: A clear photo of the baby with her mother or father. Only JPG, JPEG, PNG or GIF, between 40 KB and 200 KB.

demoSteps: Get the baby added to your family Samagra ID with e-KYC, at the gram panchayat or ward office or on samagra.gov.in, and register her at the anganwadi.
Open ladlilaxmi.mp.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें). Read the eligibility, then tick the self-declarations. The anganwadi worker, a Lok Seva Kendra or an MPOnline kiosk can also do this for you.
Choose Normal case, enter your mobile number and the OTP, and tap Proceed. Fill in the Samagra IDs, check the details, upload the photo and submit. Note the application number.
The anganwadi supervisor checks the case and the Project Officer (CDPO) of Women and Child Development approves it.
Download the Rs 1,43,000 assurance certificate from the Certificate (प्रमाण पत्र) link on the home page. Keep it safely with her birth certificate.
When she joins classes 6, 9, 11 and 12, the scholarship of Rs 2,000, Rs 4,000, Rs 6,000 and Rs 6,000 is paid after the school records her admission. Keep her Samagra and bank details up to date.

After class 12, when she joins a college or professional course of at least two years, apply under the graduation incentive link (प्रोत्साहन राशि) with her Ladli registration number for Rs 25,000, paid in two halves in the first and last year. At 21 she gets Rs 1 lakh.
schemes.helpline: 0755-2700800 (portal helpdesk), CM Helpline 181

schemes.title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY / Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: Public Health Department, Government of Maharashtra (State Health Assurance Society)
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment for every family in Maharashtra, up to Rs.5 lakh a family each year, at government and private hospitals that have joined the scheme. Since 1 July 2024 it runs together with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, so one Ayushman card works for both, and families with a white ration card, or with no ration card but a Maharashtra domicile certificate, are covered as well. It was earlier called Rajiv Gandhi Jeevandayee Arogya Yojana. There is nothing to apply for in advance: at the hospital, the Arogyamitra desk registers the patient with the ration card and Aadhaar.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at network hospitals
eligibility: Every family living in Maharashtra, whatever its income (universal cover since 1 July 2024)
Families with a yellow, Antyodaya (AAY), Annapurna, orange or white ration card
A family with no ration card is covered if it holds a Maharashtra domicile certificate
The Rs.5 lakh is shared by the whole family in a year (family floater), and illnesses you already have are covered from the first day
Covers listed surgeries and hospital treatments in 34 specialities at network hospitals in Maharashtra; in 2025 the state approved widening the list from 1,356 to 2,399 procedures
documents: Ration card of any colour (yellow, orange, white, AAY or Annapurna)
Aadhaar card of the patient
Maharashtra domicile certificate, if the family has no ration card
Mobile number for the OTP during Aadhaar e-KYC
Ayushman card, if already made (it is not needed to start treatment)
schemes.submitAt: The Arogyamitra desk at any MJPJAY network (empanelled) hospital in Maharashtra, government or private; it is usually near the main reception. Take the original ration card (or the domicile certificate) and the patient's Aadhaar card. The list of network hospitals is on jeevandayee.gov.in and is also given on the toll-free number 155388. The Ayushman card itself can be made beforehand at a CSC (Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra), through the ASHA worker, or at the same hospital desk.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: The 12-digit number printed on the ration card. The Arogyamitra uses it to find your whole family in the scheme list.

demoFields.label: Ration card colour
demoFields.hint: Yellow, orange, white, AAY or Annapurna are all accepted. If you have no ration card, show the Maharashtra domicile certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Patient's name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as printed on the patient's Aadhaar card, so that the e-KYC matches.

demoFields.label: Patient's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The patient's own Aadhaar, not the head of family's. An OTP, fingerprint or face scan confirms it.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How the patient is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number someone in the family keeps with them; messages about approval and discharge come here.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Treatment needed
demoFields.hint: The doctor writes this after examining the patient. The hospital then asks the scheme for approval of that package.

demoFields.label: Admission type
demoFields.hint: In an emergency the hospital starts treatment at once and informs the scheme by phone or email; the papers can follow.

demoSteps: When a doctor says the patient needs an operation or admission, ask whether the hospital is an MJPJAY / Ayushman network hospital. If you are not sure, call 155388 or look up the hospital list on jeevandayee.gov.in.
Go to the Arogyamitra desk with the ration card and the patient's Aadhaar. The Arogyamitra registers the patient on the scheme portal and does the Aadhaar e-KYC by OTP, fingerprint or face scan.

The doctor examines the patient, and the hospital sends a pre-authorisation request online to the State Health Assurance Society with the reports. Approval usually comes within hours; in an emergency, treatment starts first.
Once approved, the listed treatment, operation, medicines, tests, bed and food are free. Do not pay cash or sign any paper promising to pay for a listed treatment.
At discharge you receive the discharge summary. The hospital's bill goes to the government, not to you.
If a hospital asks for money for a covered treatment, call 155388 or 1800-233-2200 before paying and tell them the hospital's name.
To make the next visit quicker, get the Ayushman card made for every family member at a CSC, through the ASHA worker or at the Arogyamitra desk.
schemes.helpline: 155388 / 1800-233-2200 (MJPJAY toll-free call centre); 14555 (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY)

schemes.title: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Niradhar Pension)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (through the Tehsildar)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension of Rs.1,500 for people under 65 who have no one to support them: persons with 40% or more disability, people with serious illnesses such as cancer, TB, HIV or leprosy, widows, divorced or abandoned women, orphan children and transgender persons, among others. Disabled beneficiaries get Rs.2,500 a month from October 2025. The money comes every month by DBT into an Aadhaar-linked bank account. You apply through the talathi or the tehsil office; the state has also opened online applications on the MahaDBT portal.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month (Rs.2,500 for disabled beneficiaries)
eligibility: Living in Maharashtra for at least 15 years; aged 18 to below 65 (orphan or disabled children under 18 get it through a guardian)
Family income up to Rs.21,000 a year, or up to Rs.50,000 a year if the applicant is disabled; or the family is on the BPL list

Belongs to a destitute group: disabled (40% or more, UDID card needed), serious illness, widow, divorced or abandoned woman, woman whose divorce is pending, unmarried woman of 35 or more with no support, orphan child, transgender person, or the family of a farmer who died by suicide
Not drawing a regular monthly benefit from any government, semi-government or local body
At 65 the beneficiary moves to the Shravanbal or the central old-age pension
documents: Aadhaar card, and MGNREGA job card if you have one
Residence certificate from the gram panchayat or talathi, and the ration card
Age proof: birth certificate or school leaving certificate
Income certificate from the tehsildar, or BPL certificate
Proof of your category: UDID card, husband's death certificate, court divorce papers, orphan certificate, medical certificate of the illness, or transgender certificate
First page of an Aadhaar-linked bank passbook in your own name
Signed self-declaration with a passport-size photograph
schemes.submitAt: The talathi (gram mahsul adhikari) of your village, or the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of the tehsil office; in a city, the tehsil office of your area. The prescribed application is Form 3 of Annexure 1 (page 20) of the government resolution linked here, and the tehsil office and Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras also keep blank forms. Hand in two copies of the form and of each certificate, carry the originals for checking, and ask for a dated acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: To: Tehsildar, Taluka / District
demoFields.value: Tehsildar, Taluka Paithan / District Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
demoFields.hint: The tehsil where you live now.

demoFields.label: Applicant's full name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar, with husband's or father's name in the middle.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: Your present address, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: Date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: You must be at least 18 and below 65.

demoFields.label: Residence in Maharashtra
demoFields.hint: At least 15 years is required. The residence certificate is the proof.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy. The pension is paid only to an account linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Number of family members
demoFields.hint: Everyone living and eating together in the household.

demoFields.label: Total yearly family income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Add up all earnings, including support from grown sons. It must be Rs.21,000 or less (Rs.50,000 if you are disabled), as shown on the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Category of destitute
demoFields.hint: Tick one: disabled, illness, destitute woman, widow, divorced, abandoned, orphan child, transgender, family of a farmer who died by suicide.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar-linked bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. If it is not linked with Aadhaar the money does not arrive, so check at the bank first.

demoSteps: Collect the papers first: income certificate from the tehsildar (apply at a Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra), residence certificate, age proof and the proof of your category, such as the UDID card or husband's death certificate.
Get the form from the talathi, the tehsil office or a Setu kendra. Fill it in, sign or put your thumb impression in front of a witness, and attach the self-declaration with a photo.

Hand it to the talathi or at the tehsil's Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch and take the acknowledgement. The talathi visits your home to check the papers and family income and uploads a photo of the visit.

The tehsildar checks the file and places it before the Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana committee, which meets every month. The lists of approved and rejected names are put on the notice board and read in the gram sabha.
Once approved, the pension starts from the month after the online process is complete and comes by DBT into your Aadhaar-linked account every month.

Keep your Aadhaar and bank linking in order, because payments that fail for Aadhaar or bank reasons are the beneficiary's responsibility. Give the life certificate each year when the tehsil asks; if the pension stopped, giving it in the same financial year restarts it.
If nothing happens for two or three months, go to the tehsil office with your acknowledgement and ask for the committee's decision.
schemes.helpline: Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of your tehsil office; 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpline)

schemes.title: Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana (Shravanbal Pension)
schemes.department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra (through the Tehsildar)
schemes.brief: A monthly pension of Rs.1,500 for poor men and women aged 65 and above in Maharashtra. If the family is not on the BPL list but earns up to Rs.21,000 a year, the whole Rs.1,500 comes from the state (Group A). If the family is on the BPL list, the person gets the central Indira Gandhi old-age pension plus a Shravanbal top-up, again Rs.1,500 in all (Group B). Each eligible person is counted separately, so husband and wife can both get it, applying with one form each at the talathi or tehsil office; the money comes monthly by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 a month per person
eligibility: Aged 65 or above
Living in Maharashtra for at least 15 years
Group A: family not on the BPL list, with yearly family income up to Rs.21,000 (Rs.50,000 if the applicant is disabled)
Group B: family on the BPL list; gets the central old-age pension with the state top-up
Not drawing a regular monthly benefit or pension from any other government scheme
documents: Aadhaar card
Age proof: birth certificate, school leaving certificate, or an age certificate from a government medical officer
Income certificate from the tehsildar, or BPL certificate or BPL list extract
Residence certificate from the gram panchayat or talathi, and the ration card
First page of an Aadhaar-linked bank passbook in your own name
UDID card, if the applicant is disabled
Signed self-declaration with a passport-size photograph
schemes.submitAt: The talathi (gram mahsul adhikari) of your village, or the Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of the tehsil office, which also handles Shravanbal; in a city, the tehsil office of your area. The prescribed application is Form 3 of Annexure 1 (page 20) of the government resolution linked here, the same form as for the Niradhar pension, and the tehsil office and Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras keep blank forms. Hand in two copies of the form and of each certificate, carry the originals, and ask for a dated acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: To: Tehsildar, Taluka / District
demoFields.hint: The tehsil where you live now.

demoFields.label: Applicant's full name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: Your present address, with village or ward.

demoFields.label: Date of birth and age
demoFields.hint: You must have completed 65. If no paper shows your age, a government medical officer can give an age certificate.

demoFields.label: Residence in Maharashtra
demoFields.hint: At least 15 years is required.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy. The pension is paid only to an account linked with this Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Is the family below the poverty line?
demoFields.hint: Yes if the family is on the BPL list (Group B), No otherwise (Group A). The amount is the same either way.

demoFields.label: Total yearly family income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Needed for Group A. Count all earnings, including help from sons. It must be Rs.21,000 or less, as shown on the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Category of destitute
demoFields.hint: Tick elderly. Also mention a disability, if any, and attach the UDID card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar-linked bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name. Husband and wife should each give their own account.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate from the tehsildar through a Setu or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra, or a BPL certificate if the family is on the BPL list, and keep the age proof and residence certificate ready.
Get the form from the talathi, the tehsil office or a Setu kendra. Fill it in, sign or put your thumb impression in front of a witness, and attach the self-declaration with a photo.
Hand it to the talathi or at the tehsil's Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch and take the acknowledgement. The talathi visits your home to check the papers and family income.

The tehsildar places the file before the Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana committee, which also decides Shravanbal cases every month. Approved names are put on the notice board and read in the gram sabha.
The pension starts from the month after approval is complete online and comes by DBT into your Aadhaar-linked account every month.
Give the life certificate each year when the tehsil asks. If the pension stopped, giving it in the same financial year restarts it.
If nothing happens for two or three months, go to the tehsil office with your acknowledgement and ask for the committee's decision.
schemes.helpline: Sanjay Gandhi Yojana branch of your tehsil office; 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpline)

schemes.title: Lek Ladki Yojana
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra (ICDS Commissionerate)
schemes.brief: Rs.1,01,000 in five instalments for a girl born on or after 1 April 2023 in a family with a yellow or orange ration card, paid at stages from her birth until she turns 18. It replaced the older Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree scheme. The parents apply through the anganwadi sevika, who fills in the form with them, uploads it to the scheme portal and gives a receipt. The money goes by DBT into a joint bank account of the girl and her mother.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,01,000 in 5 parts: Rs.5,000 at birth, Rs.6,000 in Class 1, Rs.7,000 in Class 6, Rs.8,000 in Class 11, Rs.75,000 at 18
eligibility: Girl born on or after 1 April 2023 to a family living in Maharashtra
The family holds a yellow or orange ration card and its yearly income is not more than Rs.1 lakh
Covers one or two daughters; if the family has a son and a daughter, the daughter gets it; twin girls at the second delivery both get it
For the 3rd instalment of the first child, or the 2nd instalment of the second child, the mother or father must give a family planning operation certificate
The bank account must be in Maharashtra; for the last Rs.75,000 the girl must be 18, unmarried and on the voter list
documents: Girl's birth certificate (register the birth with the gram panchayat or municipality first)
Income certificate from the tehsildar showing yearly family income up to Rs.1 lakh
Attested copy of the yellow or orange ration card
Aadhaar of the parents, and of the girl (not needed for the first instalment)
First page of the passbook of the joint account of the girl and her mother
Proof of residence in Maharashtra
For later instalments: school bonafide certificate, family planning certificate, and at 18 her voter ID and a self-declaration that she is unmarried
schemes.submitAt: The anganwadi sevika of your area, at the anganwadi centre. The application form is printed at the end of the scheme GR linked here (pages 9 to 12), and blank forms are also kept at every Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office, the Zilla Parishad District Programme Officer's office and the District Women and Child Development Officer's office. Take the filled form with copies of the documents, carry the originals for checking, and ask the sevika for the signed receipt (pohoch pavti) at the bottom of the form. Apply the same way for each later instalment.

demoFields.label: Applying for (first child / second child / twins)
demoFields.hint: Tick the one that fits this girl. For twins born at the second delivery, tick twins.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary's name
demoFields.hint: The girl's name as written on her birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Beneficiary's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The girl's Aadhaar is not needed for the first instalment. Get it made before the Class 1 instalment.

demoFields.label: Parent's name (mother / father)
demoFields.hint: Usually the mother, because the money goes to the joint account of the girl and her mother.

demoFields.label: Parent's Aadhaar number and mobile
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of this Aadhaar. Messages about the payment come to the mobile.

demoFields.label: Present address
demoFields.value: House 14, Shivaji Chowk, Malegaon BK, Tal. Baramati, Dist. Pune 413115
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now: house number, village, post office, taluka, district and PIN code.

demoFields.label: Number of living children when applying
demoFields.hint: Count all living children, sons and daughters.

demoFields.label: Joint bank account number (girl and mother)
demoFields.hint: Open a joint account in the names of the girl and her mother. If the mother has died, open it with the father and attach her death certificate.

demoFields.label: IFSC code and branch
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the first page of the passbook, and say whether the account is linked to Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Instalment applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose first to fifth. Each later instalment needs a fresh form when the girl reaches that stage.

demoSteps: Register the girl's birth at the gram panchayat or municipal office and collect the birth certificate.

Keep ready the yellow or orange ration card (attested copy), an income certificate of up to Rs.1 lakh from the tehsildar, the parents' Aadhaar and the joint account passbook of the girl and her mother.
Go to your anganwadi centre. The sevika fills in the Lek Ladki form with you, ticks the document checklist, uploads it to the portal and gives you the signed receipt. Keep that receipt.

The anganwadi supervisor checks the papers and the CDPO sends the list to the District Programme Officer of the Zilla Parishad, who approves it. If anything is missing you are told in writing within 15 days and get one month (plus 10 days) to complete it; the whole process should finish within two months.
Once approved, Rs.5,000 is credited by DBT to the joint account of the girl and her mother.

Apply again through the anganwadi with the school bonafide certificate when she enters Class 1, Class 6 and Class 11, and at 18 for the Rs.75,000 with her voter ID and a declaration that she is unmarried.
If the family moves to another district, apply for the remaining instalments to the ICDS office of the new district.
schemes.helpline: Your anganwadi sevika or the taluka CDPO office; 181 (women's helpline)

schemes.title: Mahabhulekh — 7/12, 8A and Property Card
schemes.department: Revenue Department — Settlement Commissioner and Director of Land Records, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: Mahabhulekh carries the land record of every village in Maharashtra — all districts, 716 talukas and more than 89,000 villages. The 7/12, called the satbara, shows who holds a piece of agricultural land, how much, what is sown on it and any bank charge against it; the 8A lists every holding of one khatedar in the village; the property card does the same for surveyed urban land. Viewing is free, and a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept costs about Rs 15.
schemes.benefit: Free 7/12, 8A and property card view; digitally signed extract for about Rs 15
eligibility: Land situated in Maharashtra and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view a 7/12, an 8A or a property card — no login, no fee and no proof of ownership is needed
A digitally signed extract needs registration with a mobile number and payment of about Rs 15 per copy
7/12 and 8A cover agricultural land; a property card covers surveyed urban land holding a City Survey number
Only the khatedar or a legal heir can ask the Talathi to correct an entry or to record a mutation
documents: Survey number or gat number of the land, or the khatedar's name
The village, taluka, district and the revenue division they fall in
Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
Aadhaar card, if you are getting the extract at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC
Registered sale deed, for a mutation after a purchase
Death certificate and the heirship paper, for a mutation after a death
The existing 7/12 or 8A extract, where you are asking for a correction

demoFields.label: Revenue division (Vibhag)
demoFields.hint: The six divisions are Amravati, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Konkan, Nagpur, Nashik and Pune. Satara falls under Pune division.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: 7/12 for one piece of agricultural land, 8A to see every holding of one khatedar in the village, property card for urban land.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is kept village by village, so a wrong village shows nothing.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Search by survey or gat number if you know it, otherwise by the khatedar's surname. The number is the surer way.

demoFields.label: Survey Number / Gat Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the old extract or the purchase deed. A wrong sub-division number pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Khatedar's name — surname, first name, middle name
demoFields.hint: Only if you are searching by name. Use the spelling on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Verification code shown on the screen
demoFields.hint: Type the characters exactly as displayed. It refreshes if you get it wrong.

demoFields.label: Mobile number, for a digitally signed copy
demoFields.hint: Needed only for the paid signed extract. The download link comes to this number against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Payment for the digitally signed extract
demoFields.hint: Pay for each copy you need. Buy one for each bank or office that will keep a copy.

demoSteps: Open bhulekh.mahabhumi.gov.in, choose your division, then the district, taluka and village.
Search by the gat or survey number and open the 7/12. Check the area, the khatedar names, the crop entry and the 'other rights' column, which is where a bank charge or a loan is recorded.
Pull the 8A as well to see every piece of land held in that village under the same khata. That is what land revenue is charged on.

The free print is for your own reference. For a bank, a court, a subsidy claim or a sale, buy the digitally signed extract from digitalsatbara.mahabhumi.gov.in for about Rs 15 — offices do not accept the unsigned print.
Read the ferfar (mutation) entries. After a purchase or a death the change shows here only once the Talathi has recorded it and the Tahsildar has passed the order.
If a name, an area or a crop entry is wrong, apply to the village Talathi with the deed or the heirship paper. Fixing it now is far easier than at the time of a sale.
If you cannot use the site, the same extracts are issued at an Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or a CSC for a small fee.
schemes.helpline: Your village Talathi or the taluka Tahsildar's office; extracts are also issued at Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendras and CSCs

schemes.title: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Namo Shetkari)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (Commissionerate of Agriculture, Pune)
schemes.brief: Rs.6,000 a year from the Maharashtra government to every farmer family that receives PM-Kisan, paid in three instalments of Rs.2,000 straight into the bank account. Together with PM-Kisan's Rs.6,000 that makes Rs.12,000 a year. There is no separate Namo form: the state pays everyone who is eligible for the PM-Kisan instalment, so a farmer not yet on PM-Kisan registers on the PM-Kisan portal, and a farmer already on it who is not getting Namo money checks the status on nsmny.mahait.org and fixes the fault shown. An increase was announced in 2025, so check the portal for the rate in force.
schemes.benefit: Rs.6,000 a year (3 x Rs.2,000), on top of PM-Kisan's Rs.6,000
eligibility: Farmer family in Maharashtra that is registered and found eligible under PM-Kisan; whoever qualifies for a PM-Kisan instalment gets the Namo instalment too
Cultivable land in the farmer's own name on the 7/12 extract, with the land seeded on the PM-Kisan record
PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and an Aadhaar-seeded bank account switched on for DBT
Farmer ID (Agristack) is needed for a new PM-Kisan registration

Same exclusions as PM-Kisan: income-tax payers, serving or retired government employees (Class IV staff excepted), pensioners getting Rs.10,000 or more a month, practising doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs and architects, and holders of constitutional posts
documents: Aadhaar card
7/12 extract and 8A of the land in your name
Mutation entry (ferfar), if the land came to you by inheritance
Bank passbook of an account seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for DBT
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for OTP and e-KYC
Farmer ID (Agristack number), made free at a CSC or through the talathi or krushi sahayak

demoFields.label: Type of farmer
demoFields.hint: Choose Rural Farmer if your land is in a village; Urban Farmer only if it lies within municipal limits.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar. It is checked with UIDAI before the form opens.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Best if it is the number linked to your Aadhaar, because the OTP and later e-KYC use it.

demoFields.label: State
demoFields.hint: The state where your land is. The portal then checks whether your Farmer ID exists; if not, it offers the steps to make one.

demoFields.label: Farmer ID (Agristack)
demoFields.hint: Get it made first at a CSC or through the talathi with Aadhaar and 7/12. Without it the registration does not go through.

demoFields.label: Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. If the 7/12 spells it differently, get one of them corrected, or the land check fails.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: The village where the land is, as written on the 7/12.

demoFields.label: Gat / survey number and area (from 7/12)
demoFields.hint: Copy both from your 7/12 extract. Add every piece of land you hold in your own name.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name that is seeded with Aadhaar at the bank. Both PM-Kisan and Namo money come here.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: The 11 characters printed on the first page of the passbook.

demoSteps: If you already receive PM-Kisan, do not apply again. Open nsmny.mahait.org and use Beneficiary Status to see your Namo instalments; if one failed, the error-code table on the same page says what to do, such as re-seeding Aadhaar at the bank.
If you are not on PM-Kisan, first get your Farmer ID (Agristack) made at a CSC (Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra) or through the talathi or krushi sahayak, taking Aadhaar and the 7/12.
Open the PM-Kisan New Farmer Registration form, choose Rural Farmer, enter Aadhaar, mobile and the state Maharashtra, and verify with the OTP.
Fill in your name, address, land details from the 7/12 and bank details, upload the 7/12, submit, and note the registration number shown.
The talathi and the taluka agriculture office check the land record, and the state approves it. Finish e-KYC on the portal by OTP or by face authentication.
Once you are approved for PM-Kisan, the Namo instalments follow automatically: Rs.2,000 three times a year, usually soon after each PM-Kisan instalment.
If payments stop, check the status on both portals. The usual causes are pending e-KYC, Aadhaar not seeded with the bank, or land not seeded; the taluka agriculture office can fix the last one.
schemes.helpline: 020-25538755 (Namo Shetkari cell, Commissionerate of Agriculture, Pune); 155261 / 1800-115-526 (PM-Kisan helpline)

schemes.title: MahaDBT post-matric scholarship
schemes.department: Social Justice, Tribal Development, OBC and Higher Education Departments, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: One portal carrying about forty scholarships and freeships for students of Maharashtra from class 11 upward, covering SC, ST, OBC, VJNT, SBC, EBC and minority students. Tuition and exam fees go to the college and the maintenance allowance comes to the student's own account. Marathi and English. The college has to verify your application online after you submit it, so a form that is never followed up at the college office simply sits there. Renewal is needed every single year.
schemes.benefit: Tuition and exam fees paid in full, plus a maintenance allowance
eligibility: Domiciled in Maharashtra
Studying in class 11 or above in a recognised institution inside the state
Caste certificate and, for professional courses, caste validity for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT and SBC students
Family income within the ceiling of the particular scholarship; for most freeships and EBC schemes it is Rs.8 lakh a year
At least 75 percent attendance in the previous year, and not repeating the same year twice
documents: Aadhaar card, linked to a bank account that is switched on for DBT
Caste certificate, and caste validity certificate where the course demands it
Income certificate from the tehsildar, issued through Aaple Sarkar
Last year's mark sheet, and the class 10 certificate for date of birth
College admission receipt or bonafide certificate with the fee structure
Domicile certificate of Maharashtra
Gap certificate on affidavit, if there was a break in studies

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: Spelled exactly as on the class 10 certificate. The college verifies against that, not against your college ID.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: It must be seeded with your bank account and DBT-enabled. Ask the bank to confirm; an un-seeded account is the single biggest reason money does not arrive.

demoFields.label: Caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Copy the number from the certificate itself. Leave this out if you are applying for an open-category EBC freeship.

demoFields.label: Income certificate number
demoFields.hint: The number on the tehsildar's income certificate. It has to be current, usually issued within the last year.

demoFields.label: College and course
demoFields.value: Rajaram College, Kolhapur / B.Sc. Agriculture, 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the college from the drop-down list rather than typing it. If your college is not listed, tell the college office, because they must first be registered on MahaDBT.

demoFields.label: Year of admission
demoFields.hint: The year you joined this course, not the year you are in now.

demoFields.label: Previous year percentage
demoFields.hint: From your last mark sheet. Some scholarships have a minimum; the portal will tell you which ones you clear.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Must be the student's own account, not a parent's. The maintenance allowance can only be paid into the student's account.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: From the first page of the passbook. Check the zeros carefully, they are digits, not the letter O.

demoSteps: Get the papers in place before the portal opens for the year: caste certificate, caste validity if your course needs it, and a fresh income certificate from Aaple Sarkar. These take the longest, so start with them.
Go to the bank and confirm that your own account is Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled. Ask them for it in writing if they hesitate.
Register on MahaDBT with your Aadhaar and mobile number, complete the e-KYC, and log in.
Fill your personal, address, academic and bank details once. They are saved to your profile and reused for every scholarship you apply to.
The portal then shows the list of schemes you are eligible for. Apply to all of them that apply to you, not just one, because they are sanctioned by different departments.
Upload the documents and submit. Note the application ID.
Now go to your college office and ask them to verify your application on their MahaDBT login. This step is not automatic and nothing moves until they do it.
Track the status through your login. Tuition and exam fees are paid to the college and the maintenance allowance comes to your account. Remember to renew next year, in the same way.
schemes.helpline: 022-49150800 (MahaDBT helpdesk)

schemes.title: MPSC Recruitment — Rajyaseva, Group B and Group C
schemes.department: Maharashtra Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Maharashtra Public Service Commission recruits for the Maharashtra Civil Services (Rajyaseva) and for the Group B and Group C combined services, which include PSI, STI and Assistant Section Officer, as well as the engineering, agriculture, forest and judicial services. Notifications and syllabi are published on mpsc.gov.in; the application itself is filed on the separate online system. You build one candidate profile, lock it, and then apply to each advertisement from it.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every MPSC examination and direct recruitment, with hall tickets and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Maharashtra domicile certificate is needed for the reserved category posts and for most state services
Age as the advertisement states — generally 19 to 38 years for the open category, relaxed to 43 for backward class candidates, with further relaxation for ex-servicemen and disabled candidates
A degree from a recognised university, complete on the closing date the advertisement gives, for Rajyaseva and the Group B posts
Knowledge of Marathi is required, and it is tested in the examination
A Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC candidates
Each advertisement sets its own age, qualification and physical standards — read that one before you pay the fee
documents: Aadhaar card
SSC (Class 10) certificate, which governs the date of birth and the spelling of the name
Degree certificate and every marksheet
Maharashtra domicile certificate
Caste certificate and Caste Validity Certificate, for a reserved category
Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid on the closing date, for OBC, VJNT and SBC
Disability, ex-serviceman, sportsperson or project-affected certificate, where that reservation is claimed
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature in the sizes the portal states

demoFields.label: Examination or post applied for
demoFields.value: Maharashtra Group B (Combined) — PSI, STI and ASO
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Check the age limit and the qualification in that advertisement before you pay anything.

demoFields.label: Candidate's full name as on the SSC certificate
demoFields.hint: The SSC certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later check is made against it.

demoFields.label: Father's name and Mother's name
demoFields.value: Bhaskar Namdev Deshmukh / Shobha Bhaskar Deshmukh
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSC certificate. The age limit counts from this date and it cannot be changed once the profile is locked.

demoFields.label: Category, caste and caste certificate number
demoFields.hint: Claim only the category you hold a Maharashtra certificate for. The number is printed on the certificate itself.

demoFields.label: Non-Creamy Layer certificate number and validity
demoFields.hint: It must be valid on the closing date of the advertisement, not merely on the day you apply. An expired one loses you the reservation.

demoFields.label: Maharashtra domicile
demoFields.hint: Needed for the reserved seats and for most state posts. Get it from the tehsil or through Aaple Sarkar if you do not have it.

demoFields.label: Educational qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Enter the marks as printed on the final marksheet.

demoFields.label: Knowledge of Marathi
demoFields.value: Yes — studied Marathi up to SSC
demoFields.hint: MPSC requires it and tests it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate for verification.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give the choices the form allows. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can, but it is not guaranteed.

demoSteps: Watch mpsc.gov.in for the advertisement and read the age, qualification, physical standards and reservation conditions before doing anything else.
Create your candidate profile on mpsconline.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSC certificate, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Lock the profile. Check every entry twice first — the locked profile is what is carried into all your applications and it is not freely editable afterwards.
Run the eligibility check for that advertisement, submit the application and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
Download the hall ticket about a week before each stage and take it with a photo identity card.
Rajyaseva runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview; the combined Group B and Group C examinations run as a preliminary and a main. Each result is published on the Commission's site.

Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed, including the Caste Validity Certificate within the time the Commission allows — a claim you cannot prove there costs you the post.
schemes.helpline: Maharashtra Public Service Commission — contact details and every notice are published on mpsc.gov.in

schemes.title: Maharashtra Construction Worker Registration (Bandhkam Kamgar Card, MAHABOCW)
schemes.department: Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Industries, Energy, Labour and Mining Department
schemes.brief: Registration with the state construction workers' welfare board, which opens about 29 schemes for the worker and family: scholarships for two children, Rs.30,000 for the worker's first marriage, Rs.51,000 for a daughter's marriage, help to build or buy a house, Rs.5 lakh if the worker dies in a site accident and Rs.2 lakh on natural death. Since August 2025 registration and renewal cost nothing. You apply online on the board's portal, pick a date, and go once to your taluka construction workers' facilitation centre with the original papers for photo and fingerprint. The registration lasts one year and has to be renewed.
schemes.benefit: Free registration that opens 29 schemes, e.g. Rs.5 lakh on site-accident death, Rs.51,000 for a daughter's marriage, scholarships
eligibility: Construction worker aged 18 to 60
Worked 90 days or more on building or other construction work in the last 12 months
The 90-day certificate can come from a private builder or contractor, a government authority, or the naka worker booklet
Choose the taluka facilitation centre of the taluka where those 90 days were worked, or the papers will not be checked
Renew every year, from one month before expiry, with a fresh 90-day certificate, to keep getting benefits
documents: Aadhaar card
90-day work certificate for the last 12 months
Mobile number for OTP
Bank passbook of an account in your own name
Ration card
Age proof and residence proof
Passport-size photographs (a photo is also taken at the centre)
Aadhaar of wife or husband and children, to add them as family members
schemes.portalName: Maharashtra Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MAHABOCW)

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. Name, photo, date of birth and Aadhaar cannot be changed later, so check them carefully.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. The OTP, appointment date and later claim messages come here.

demoFields.label: Name of worker (first / middle / last)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar, with father's or husband's name in the middle.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. You must be between 18 and 60.

demoFields.label: Present address / District / Taluka
demoFields.value: Room 7, Laxmi Chawl, Hadapsar / Pune / Haveli
demoFields.hint: Where you live now in Maharashtra. If you came from another state, the native state and district are asked separately.

demoFields.label: Sector / nature of work
demoFields.hint: The construction work you do: mason, bar bender, painter, plumber, electrician, carpenter, helper and so on.

demoFields.label: Site address and employer
demoFields.value: Sai Residency site, Wagholi / Shree Constructions
demoFields.hint: The site where you did the 90 days, and the builder or contractor who signed the 90-day certificate, with the supervisor's name and phone.

demoFields.label: 90-day work certificate (upload)
demoFields.hint: It must cover the last 12 months. A naka worker booklet or a government authority's certificate is also accepted.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in your own name; every benefit is paid into it.

demoFields.label: Taluka facilitation centre and appointment date
demoFields.hint: Pick the centre of the taluka where the 90 days were worked, and a date you can surely attend. Missing it cancels the application.

demoSteps: Get the 90-day work certificate for the last 12 months from your builder or contractor, a government authority, or your naka worker booklet.
Open mahabocw.in and click 'Bandhkam Kamgar: Nondani' (registration). Enter your Aadhaar and mobile number and verify with the OTP.
Fill in your personal, family, bank and work-site details, and upload Aadhaar and the 90-day certificate. There is no fee, so do not pay any agent.
Choose the taluka facilitation centre and an appointment date, submit, and note the acknowledgement number.
On that date go to the centre with all original papers. They check the documents and take your photo and fingerprint.
The taluka registration officer approves the application and your identity card is printed. Collect it from the facilitation centre as told in the SMS.
After registering, apply for each benefit online with 'Online claim' on the same portal, and renew every year from one month before expiry.
schemes.helpline: 1800-8892-816 (MAHABOCW toll-free); 022-2657-2631 / 022-2657-2632 (board office, Mumbai)

schemes.title: Aaple Sarkar certificates, income and domicile
schemes.department: Directorate of Information Technology, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: One login for the certificates that every other scheme asks you for: income, domicile (adhivas), non-creamy layer, age and nationality, senior citizen, solvency and around five hundred more services. The Maharashtra Right to Public Service Act puts a deadline on each one, so the tehsildar cannot sit on it. The portal is in Marathi and English. You can file it yourself, or hand the papers over at a Maha e-Seva Kendra or the Setu centre in the tehsil office, which is how most people outside the cities do it.
schemes.benefit: Income, domicile and caste certificates within 15 working days
eligibility: Any resident of Maharashtra
A mobile number that can receive an OTP, used as your login
Papers for the particular certificate you are asking for; the portal lists them before you start
documents: Aadhaar card
Proof of where you live: ration card, electricity bill, water bill or voter ID
Proof of age: birth certificate, school leaving certificate or bonafide from the school
Proof of income for an income certificate: salary slip, Form 16, or the talathi's report for farming and daily-wage families
Self-declaration on the format the portal gives you, signed
Recent passport photograph

demoFields.label: Username you want
demoFields.hint: Pick something you will remember. This one login opens every service on the portal, so do not create a fresh one each time.

demoFields.label: Full name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed with this spelling and a mismatch later costs you another application.

demoFields.label: Service applied for
demoFields.hint: Choose the department first, then the service. Income certificates sit under Revenue, not under Social Justice.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: The tehsil office that gets your application is decided by what you put here, so it must be where you actually live.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Total earnings of the whole household for the last financial year. For farming families the talathi's report is what the office goes by.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the certificate
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for: scholarship, hostel admission, EWS quota, a scheme. This decides the format that is issued.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Used to pull your name and address in automatically, which saves typing mistakes.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Every status message and the download link for the signed certificate comes to this number.

demoSteps: Work out which certificate you actually need. An income certificate and a non-creamy-layer certificate are different papers, and applying for the wrong one wastes two weeks.
Register once on Aaple Sarkar with your mobile number and an OTP. Keep the username and password written down somewhere safe, because the same login is used for every future service.
Choose the department and then the service. The screen lists the exact documents that service needs before you commit to anything.
Fill the form as this sample shows and upload scanned or photographed documents. Each file has a size limit, so photograph on a plain surface in daylight rather than scanning badly.
Pay the small statutory fee online if that service has one. Many certificates are free.
Submit, and save the application ID. The portal shows the deadline by which the office must answer you under the Right to Public Service Act.
If you would rather not do this yourself, take the same documents to a Maha e-Seva Kendra or the Setu centre at the tehsil office and the operator will file it under your name for the notified fee.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from your login. It is valid as it is; you do not need a stamp or an attestation on top of it.
schemes.helpline: 1800-120-8040 (Aaple Sarkar helpdesk)

schemes.title: Mahavitaran — New Electricity Connection and Consumer Services
schemes.department: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran)
schemes.brief: Mahavitaran, the state electricity distribution company, supplies the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs. A new domestic, commercial or agricultural connection is applied for on its Web Self Service portal, which also handles bill payment, self meter readings, a name or address change on the account, a load change, reconnection after disconnection, security deposit refund and complaints. The information site is mahadiscom.in; the applications and account transactions happen on the self-service portal.
schemes.benefit: New connection normally released within one month of a complete application, plus online billing, meter readings and complaints
eligibility: Premises anywhere in the MSEDCL supply area — the whole of Maharashtra except most of Mumbai city and its suburbs
You own the premises or lawfully occupy them, and can produce proof of that
No unpaid electricity dues standing against the premises or against you at another connection
The internal wiring is finished and tested, with a test report signed by a licensed electrical contractor
Under the Electricity Act, supply must be given within one month of a complete application wherever the line and the network already reach the premises
documents: Proof of ownership or occupancy — 7/12 extract, property tax receipt, sale deed, Index II or a registered rent agreement
Photo identity proof and Aadhaar card
Recent passport-size photograph
Test report of the internal wiring from a licensed electrical contractor
Consumer number and the latest paid bill of a neighbouring or existing connection, to identify the feeder
No Objection Certificate from the owner, if you are a tenant
Municipal or Gram Panchayat building permission, where the sub-division asks for it

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: New connection, bill payment, name or address change, load change, reconnection, security deposit refund or a complaint. A new connection can be started without registering.

demoFields.label: Tariff category and phase
demoFields.hint: Residential for a home, commercial for a shop, agricultural for a pump. The wrong category means the wrong rate on every bill afterwards.

demoFields.label: Connected load applied for
demoFields.hint: Add up the wattage of the lights, fans, pump and appliances you will run. Asking for too little means paying again later for a load change.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name as it should appear on the bill
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on Aadhaar and matching the ownership or rent paper. Changing it later is a separate name-change application.

demoFields.label: Full address of the premises where supply is wanted
demoFields.value: Plot 27, Shivneri Nagar, Hudkeshwar Road, Nagpur — 440034
demoFields.hint: The address of the building itself, not a correspondence address. The section engineer comes to this spot.

demoFields.label: Nearest existing consumer number
demoFields.hint: The 12-digit number from a neighbour's or the landlord's bill. It tells the office which pole and feeder you will be connected to.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number and mobile number
demoFields.hint: The request number, the site inspection message and the demand note all come to this mobile.

demoFields.label: Proof of ownership or occupancy uploaded
demoFields.value: Property tax receipt, Nagpur Municipal Corporation, 2026-27
demoFields.hint: Any one of the accepted papers. A tenant uploads the registered rent agreement and the owner's NOC.

demoFields.label: Licensed contractor's test report
demoFields.hint: Get the wiring tested before you apply. No supply is released without this report.

demoFields.label: Payment of processing fee and security deposit
demoFields.value: Paid online against demand note DN-NGP-2026-55214
demoFields.hint: The exact amount is in the demand note the office raises after inspection. Pay it online and keep the receipt.

demoSteps: Open wss.mahadiscom.in, choose the new connection request and fill the premises details, the tariff category and the load. You can start this without registering.
Upload the ownership or rent proof, the identity proof, the photograph and the contractor's test report, then submit and note the request number.
The section engineer inspects the site and the office raises a demand note — the firm quotation for the service line, the processing fee and the security deposit.

Pay the demand note online through the portal. The meter is installed and supply is released after payment; where the line already reaches the premises this should happen within one month of the complete application.
Register on the self-service portal with your new 12-digit consumer number so you can see and pay bills, send self meter readings and switch to Go Green paperless billing.

If the connection or a repair is delayed beyond the time the rules allow, file a Standards of Performance compensation claim, and use the complaint and Swagat Cell pages on the same portal to track it.
Keep the consumer number written down somewhere safe. Every later service — name change, load change, reconnection, deposit refund — is asked for against that number.
schemes.helpline: Your MSEDCL sub-division office, or the Swagat Cell complaint pages on the Mahavitaran self-service portal

schemes.title: Ration Card — Mahafood RCMS
schemes.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: The ration card is applied for online on RCMS, the transactional site of the Food and Civil Supplies Department. The same login adds or removes a family member, transfers a card to a new taluka, corrects a name and downloads the e-ration card. The card also works as proof of address and of family composition for school admissions, pensions and many other applications.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg of free foodgrain per person per month under NFSA; 35 kg per card for Antyodaya families
eligibility: Ordinarily resident in Maharashtra and not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
One card for one family; the eldest woman of the household aged 18 or above is entered as head of the family
Priority Household (yellow or saffron) under NFSA: annual family income up to Rs 44,000 in a rural area and up to Rs 59,000 in an urban area
Antyodaya (yellow): the poorest families picked by the tehsil — landless labourers, widows, the aged and households with no assured income
A family above the NFSA income limit still gets a white card, which is valid as identity and address proof but carries no subsidised grain
Aadhaar of every member must be seeded and e-KYC done at the fair price shop before grain is released
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member
Proof of residence — electricity bill, property tax receipt, registered rent agreement or a Gram Panchayat letter
Passport-size photograph of the head of the family
Income certificate or salary slip, for the NFSA income test
Gas connection number and the name of the gas agency
Surrender or removal certificate from the earlier taluka, if the family has moved
Bank passbook first page, where the tehsil asks for it

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, delete a member, transfer the card to another taluka, or correct a detail. Pick one — each opens its own form.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives now. The card is issued by that tehsil and the grain comes from a shop in that area.

demoFields.label: Name of Head of Family
demoFields.hint: Spelt exactly as on her Aadhaar. The card is issued in this name and the shop machine checks her fingerprint against it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of Head of Family
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on her own Aadhaar card. A mistake here stops the card at verification.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The OTP for registration, the application number and the approval message all come here. Use a number in the family.

demoFields.label: Full residential address with pin code
demoFields.value: House 148, Gavthan Road, Shivade, Taluka Sinnar, District Nashik — 422103
demoFields.hint: Write it as it appears on the residence proof you are uploading, not a shortened version.

demoFields.label: Family members — name, relation, age, Aadhaar
demoFields.value: Prakash Ramchandra Gaikwad, husband, 41, 9999 4721 7745; Aarti Prakash Gaikwad, daughter, 14, 9999 4721 8836; Ramchandra Nivrutti Gaikwad, father-in-law, 68, 9999 4721 9927
demoFields.hint: Every person who eats in the house. Leave one out and that person gets no grain until a separate add-member application goes through.

demoFields.label: Annual income of the whole family
demoFields.hint: Add up what everyone earns in a year. This decides the colour of the card, so state it correctly and keep the proof.

demoFields.label: Gas connection number and agency
demoFields.hint: Maharashtra asks for this to stop one family holding two cards. Write 'none' if the family has no connection.

demoFields.label: Removal / surrender certificate of the earlier card
demoFields.value: Not applicable — no earlier card held
demoFields.hint: If the family moved from another taluka or state, get this from the old tehsil first. Without it the new card is rejected.

demoSteps: Open rcms.mahafood.gov.in, use 'New User' to register with your mobile number and an OTP, and set a username and password.
Choose 'Apply for New Ration Card', fill the family details and upload Aadhaar, the residence proof, the income proof and the photograph.
Submit and write down the application number. Every enquiry after this is against that number.
The tehsil verifies the papers and a Food Inspector or Talathi may visit the house to confirm the family lives there.
On approval the card is issued and the e-ration card can be downloaded and printed from the same login. Maharashtra is moving to the e-card and away from the printed book.
Take the head of the family to the fair price shop for Aadhaar e-KYC on the ePoS machine. Grain is not released until this is done.
Draw the monthly quota with a fingerprint at the shop. Under One Nation One Ration Card the same card also works at a shop in another district or state.
schemes.helpline: 1800-22-4950, or the PDS toll-free number 1967

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
schemes.department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
schemes.brief: A monthly payment to women of Maharashtra between 21 and 65, sent straight to her own bank account so that she does not have to ask anyone for it. The portal works in Marathi and English. You may fill it yourself on a phone, but most women applied through the anganwadi sevika, the gram sevak or a Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC), which costs nothing extra and gets the e-KYC done on the spot. The state revises the amount in its budget, so treat the figure below as the rate the scheme pays and check the portal for the rate in force today.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,500 per month
eligibility: Woman who lives in Maharashtra, aged 21 to 65 on the date of applying
Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute woman; one unmarried woman per family may also apply
Total family income Rs.2.5 lakh a year or less
No one in the family pays income tax or holds a regular government job
The family owns no four-wheeler (a tractor does not count)
She has a bank account in her own name, linked to her Aadhaar and switched on for DBT
documents: Aadhaar card
Bank passbook in her own name, first page, Aadhaar-seeded
Domicile certificate of Maharashtra, or a birth certificate or school leaving certificate in its place
Ration card (a yellow or orange card is accepted instead of an income certificate)
Income certificate from the tehsildar, if the ration card does not show income
Recent passport photograph
Signed self-declaration (hami patra) in the format printed on the portal

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as printed on your Aadhaar. If your name changed after marriage and Aadhaar still carries the old one, use the old one here and get Aadhaar corrected later, otherwise the bank match fails.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on your Aadhaar card. The state uses this to match your bank account, so check every digit twice.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: As written on Aadhaar. You must have completed 21 years and not yet crossed 65.

demoFields.label: Marital status
demoFields.hint: Married, widow, divorced, abandoned or unmarried. A widow or an abandoned woman is fully eligible, so do not leave this blank out of hesitation.

demoFields.label: District / Taluka / Village
demoFields.hint: The place where you actually live now, not your maternal village.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the top of your ration card. A yellow or orange card is itself the proof that your income is within the limit.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Everyone in the household added together for the whole year. It must be Rs.2,50,000 or less.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: It must be in your own name. A joint account with your husband, or his account, will be rejected.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: Eleven characters printed on the first page of your passbook, next to the branch name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you hold yourself if possible, because the OTP and every later message about the payment comes to it.

demoSteps: Decide where to apply from. You can do it on your own phone, or walk into an anganwadi centre, the gram panchayat office or a Maha e-Seva Kendra (CSC) and have the sevika or operator do it. The government route is free; a CSC may charge only the notified service fee.

Keep the papers ready before you start: Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook and a photo. Photograph each one clearly in daylight, because blurred uploads are the commonest reason an application comes back.
Open the Ladki Bahin portal, choose 'Applicant Login', and register with your mobile number. An OTP comes to that number; type it in and set a password you will remember.
Fill the application form: name, Aadhaar, date of birth, address, ration card, income and bank details, exactly as this sample shows.
Upload the documents and the signed self-declaration (hami patra). The declaration format can be downloaded from the same page, printed, signed and photographed.
Submit and note down the application number that appears on the screen. Take a photograph of that screen.
The anganwadi sevika and then the CDPO office check your form and the list of applicants is displayed publicly at the anganwadi. If something is objected to, you get a chance to correct it.
Once approved, the money starts arriving in your own account. Check the status any time on the portal with your application number, and pass a complaint to 181 if payment stops without reason.
schemes.helpline: 181 (Maharashtra state helpline), or your district Women and Child Development office

schemes.title: Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT Card)
schemes.department: State Nodal Cell (CMHT), Directorate of Health Services, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Manipur
schemes.brief: Manipur's free health cover for poor families: up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family for hospital treatment, cashless at empanelled hospitals in Manipur and at chosen hospitals in Guwahati and Kolkata. It covers AAY card holders, widows, persons with disability, ASHAs, Anganwadi workers and helpers, Ima Keithel women vendors, newspaper hawkers, local media persons, displaced persons, and other poor families approved by the Deputy Commissioner. The card is made at the CMHT enrolment kiosk of a district hospital, and the scheme also pays travel fare and a daily allowance for treatment outside the state. It was launched in 2018 with Rs.2 lakh cover, now raised to Rs.5 lakh.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, plus travel fare and Rs.1,000 a day for treatment outside Manipur
eligibility: Bona fide citizen of Manipur, with no family member in government service (a declaration is signed at the counter)
Families holding an AAY (Antyodaya) ration card, widows, and persons with disability
ASHAs, Anganwadi workers and helpers, Ima Keithel (Ima Market) women vendors, newspaper hawkers and local media persons
Internally displaced persons holding an IDP certificate from the Deputy Commissioner
Other poor families outside these groups can also apply. The Deputy Commissioner checks their economic status before the card is approved
Up to 5 names are printed on the card, and any extra members are noted as '2 more' and so on. There is no limit on family size
documents: Original Aadhaar card of the applicant and of every family member, with the Aadhaar consent form
Photo ID: voter ID, PAN, driving licence, ration card, passport or government ID card
AAY ration card (AAY families)
Disability certificate (persons with disability)
Husband's death certificate (widows)
Membership letter from NHM, the Social Welfare Department, Imphal Municipal Corporation or the authorised association (ASHAs, Anganwadi staff, Ima Keithel vendors, hawkers, media persons)
IDP certificate from the Deputy Commissioner (displaced persons)
schemes.submitAt: CMHT enrolment kiosk (Health Coordinator help desk) at the reception of your District Hospital, or at RIMS or JNIMS in Imphal; enrolment camps are also held at DC offices and in villages. Take all original documents and the Aadhaar cards of every family member. Fill in the declaration that nobody in the family is in government service at the counter. A card fee of Rs.50 per family may be charged; AAY card holders, persons with disability and widows pay nothing.

demoFields.label: Eligibility category
demoFields.hint: AAY, Widow, Disabled, ASHA, Anganwadi Worker/Helper, Ima Keithel Vendor, Hawker, Local Media, IDP, or Other Poor Family (DC verification).

demoFields.label: Name of head of family
demoFields.hint: As written on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The head's 12-digit Aadhaar. At least one member must give Aadhaar to enrol the family.

demoFields.label: Eligibility proof
demoFields.hint: AAY card, disability certificate, death certificate, membership letter or IDP certificate, as your category needs.

demoFields.label: ID proof
demoFields.hint: Any one government photo ID, shown in original.

demoFields.label: Family members and relation
demoFields.hint: Everyone who lives and eats with you. Carry each member's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: District and address
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The approval message for DC-verification cases comes here.

demoFields.label: Declaration: no family member in government service
demoFields.hint: Filled in at the kiosk before the card is made. Do not sign if anyone in the family is a government employee.

demoFields.label: Photo
demoFields.hint: The Health Coordinator takes the photo on the spot. No passport photo is needed.

demoSteps: Check which category you belong to. If you are poor but in no listed category, you can still apply. Your claim is sent to the Deputy Commissioner for checking.
Go to the CMHT kiosk at your District Hospital (or RIMS or JNIMS in Imphal, or a village enrolment camp) with the originals and every member's Aadhaar.
The Health Coordinator enters your details, takes the photo and the Aadhaar consent, and you sign the government-service declaration.

Listed categories get the CMHT-Manipur Health Card on the spot, with a unique family number. For 'other poor families', the details go to the DC for verification, and you are told the result before the card is issued.
At an empanelled hospital, show the card at the CMHT desk. The Health Coordinator guides you from admission to discharge, and treatment is cashless.

For the travel allowance, give your bank details when you are admitted. Inside Manipur it is Rs.300 a visit, up to Rs.3,000 a year. Outside Manipur it is the cheapest airfare for the patient and one attendant (up to Rs.30,000 a year) plus Rs.1,000 a day (up to Rs.10,000), all within the Rs.5 lakh.
schemes.helpline: 1800 103 2015 — CMHT toll-free helpline (24x7) / 14555 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: Manipur Ration Card
schemes.department: Department of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Manipur
schemes.brief: The NFSA ration card in Manipur, in two kinds — Antyodaya for the poorest households and Priority Household for the rest. New cards, additions and corrections are applied for on paper at the district's Food and Civil Supplies office or through the sub-divisional officer.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month; 35 kg per family for an Antyodaya card
eligibility: Family resident in Manipur and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household inside the state's NFSA list and not excluded by income, land or government service
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be given; a name without Aadhaar draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or a certificate from the village authority
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where the family or a member has moved
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Income certificate or a self-declaration of income
Passport photograph of the head of the family
schemes.submitAt: District Food and Civil Supplies office, or the Sub-Divisional Officer of your sub-division; the village authority or Pradhan forwards it in rural areas

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, or correct a detail. Each needs a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Members of the family (name, relation, age, Aadhaar)
demoFields.value: 1. Thoibi Devi Laishram, self, 29, 9999 2217 4408; 2. Ibomcha Singh, husband, 33, 9999 8041 3327; 3. Chaoba Singh, son, 4, 9999 5570 1128
demoFields.hint: Everyone who eats from the same kitchen, one per line. The grain is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.

demoFields.label: Category applied for
demoFields.hint: Antyodaya only if the household is on that list. When unsure, ask for Priority Household; the office reclassifies if needed.

demoFields.label: District / Sub-division / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides the category.

demoFields.label: Village authority or Pradhan recommendation
demoFields.value: Chairman, Langjing Village Authority — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: In rural Manipur the village authority's recommendation is what carries the application forward.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.hint: Sign or put your thumb impression, and write the date yourself.

demoSteps: Get the application form free at the district Food and Civil Supplies office or from your Sub-Divisional Officer.
Fill it in ink listing every member who eats from the same kitchen, with each one's exact Aadhaar number.
Attach Aadhaar copies, the address proof, the income declaration and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the old card.
In a rural area, get the village authority's or Pradhan's recommendation before you submit.
Hand the file in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number.
The supply inspector verifies the household at your address, and the category is decided at this stage.
Collect the card and check every name, age and Aadhaar on it before leaving the counter, then get each member's Aadhaar seeded at the fair price shop.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Food and Public Distribution toll free; your District Food and Civil Supplies office

schemes.title: Manipur Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.department: Manipur Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: The Manipur Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted posts of the state departments. Every advertisement is applied for through its online application system.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every Manipur PSC advertisement
eligibility: Indian citizen who is ordinarily a resident of Manipur for the posts that require it
Age as the advertisement states, usually 21 to 38, with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and disability
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Each advertisement sets its own conditions; read that one before paying
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Manipur caste or tribe certificate, for a reserved category
Permanent residence certificate of Manipur
Employment exchange registration, where the advertisement asks for it
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Manipur Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and the age limit there before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Manipur certificate for. A certificate from another state is not accepted for the reservation.

demoFields.label: Permanent residence certificate number
demoFields.hint: Required for most Manipur state posts. Get it from the district administration before the closing date.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Examination centre
demoFields.hint: Give a choice where the advertisement asks for one.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the permanent residence certificate and, for a reserved category, the Manipur caste or tribe certificate before the closing date.
Register on empsconline.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.
schemes.helpline: Manipur Public Service Commission, Imphal

schemes.title: Megha Health Insurance Scheme (MHIS Card)
schemes.department: State Nodal Agency, Megha Health Insurance Scheme, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
schemes.brief: Meghalaya's universal health insurance, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, now in its sixth phase (MHIS VI). Every resident family except state and central government employees gets Rs.5.3 lakh a year, shared by the family, cashless at almost every hospital in the state and at PM-JAY hospitals across India, plus some outpatient care such as maternity, child care and tests. Registration is free and open all year at District Kiosks and hospital registration centres. A family head whose name is missing from the list (newly married, orphan, or not in the data) can send the request online.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5.3 lakh a year per family, cashless; registration free
eligibility: Every resident of Meghalaya, with no income limit
