demoFields.hint: Copy the number from your NFSA or SFSS ration card exactly.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar, otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face with the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request sent back.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in (gjay.odisha.gov.in links to it under Know Your ABPMJAY GJAY Health Card Number) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and Odisha, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar. Members marked eKYC pending still need a card.
For each member, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo and fill in mobile, relation, district and PIN code, then submit.

The state health agency checks the request and an SMS comes when it is approved. Log in again and download the card. If you have no smartphone, a CSC or the Ayushman desk of an empanelled hospital makes the card free.
At an empanelled hospital, go to the Ayushman Bharat counter with the card, ration card and Aadhaar. Your fingerprint or iris is checked at admission and again at discharge.
The hospital bills the government directly. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme. In Odisha government hospitals all treatment is free even without the card.
schemes.helpline: 104 (GJAY and state health helpline, toll-free) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY helpline)

schemes.title: Odisha Income Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: The certificate from the Tahasildar that states your family's yearly income. Almost every scholarship, fee concession, hostel seat and welfare scheme asks for it. Apply on Odisha One, the state's single citizen portal, which has taken over the old e-District counter for this service. If you cannot fill it yourself, the operator at any Mo Seva Kendra or CSC will do it for you. The Revenue Inspector of your tahasil verifies the income before the Tahasildar signs.
schemes.benefit: Income certificate signed digitally by the Tahasildar, downloaded as a PDF
eligibility: You must live in Odisha and apply in the tahasil where you actually live
The certificate is issued for the whole family's yearly income from every source, not for one person's salary
The applicant must be 18 or above; for a student under 18 the parent or guardian applies
An Aadhaar number and a mobile number that can receive an OTP are needed to register on the portal
The income you write must match what the Revenue Inspector finds on enquiry, or the application is rejected
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Residence proof with the Odisha address - electricity bill, voter ID or ration card
Passport photograph of the applicant
Salary slip or the employer's certificate, if anyone in the family is in service
Land record (RoR) from Bhulekh, if the family income comes from farming
Ration card, where the family holds one

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as it is spelt on your Aadhaar card. The certificate is printed with this spelling and cannot be corrected later without a fresh application.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Your father's name, or your husband's name if you are married and want the certificate in your married name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on your Aadhaar or your matriculation certificate.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12 digits. An OTP goes to the mobile number linked to this Aadhaar, so carry that phone.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: A number you actually carry. The acknowledgement and the download link arrive here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Present Address - District / Tahasil / Block / Gram Panchayat / Village / PIN
demoFields.hint: Pick each one from the drop-downs. Choose the tahasil you really live in - the Revenue Inspector of that tahasil is the person who comes to enquire.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Add up what every earning member of the family makes in one year - wages, farming, shop, pension, rent. Do not write only your own income.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.hint: Say plainly where the money comes from. If it is farming, the land record you attach should match this.

demoFields.label: Purpose of the Certificate
demoFields.hint: Write why you need it. Some offices want the purpose printed on the certificate itself.

demoSteps: Open Odisha One, register with your mobile number and the OTP, then go to Revenue & Disaster Management and choose Income Certificate. A Mo Seva Kendra or CSC operator will do this for you if you cannot.
Fill the form and upload Aadhaar, residence proof and the photograph as clear scans within the file size the page shows, then pay the fee displayed before you submit.
Write down the acknowledgement number on the receipt. It is the only way to track the case or to raise a complaint about it.
The Revenue Inspector of your tahasil verifies the income, usually by asking at your village or ward and at the Gram Panchayat.
The Tahasildar signs the certificate digitally and the status on the portal changes to approved.
Log in with the acknowledgement number and download the signed PDF. The digital signature is valid on its own - no office needs to stamp it again.
If it is rejected, the reason appears on the same status page. Correct only that point and apply again; there is no appeal fee.
schemes.helpline: Mo Seva Kendra in your block or ward, or the Tahasildar's office of your tahasil

schemes.title: Bhulekh Odisha - Land Record (RoR / Khatian)
schemes.department: Revenue & Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: Bhulekh is the state's online land record. You can look up and print the Record of Rights - the khatian - for any plot in Odisha free of charge, with no login. Search by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name. Use it to check who the land stands in the name of and how much area is recorded before you buy, mortgage or divide land. The free printout is for information only; a bank or a court will ask for a certified copy from the Tahasil office.
schemes.benefit: Free view and printout of the Record of Rights for any plot in Odisha
eligibility: Anyone can search - there is no login, no registration and no fee
You need to know the district, the tahasil and the revenue village where the land lies
You can search by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name
The free printout carries no signature; a bank, a court or a registration office needs a certified copy from the Tahasildar
Mutation, partition and correction of a name are not done here - those go through the Tahasil office or Odisha One
documents: Nothing is needed to view the record - no Aadhaar, no login and no fee
The district, tahasil and revenue village (mouza) name of the land
The khata number, the plot number, or the tenant's name as it is written in the record
An older RoR, a rent receipt or the sale deed, to copy those numbers from
Aadhaar and the court fee stamp fixed by the Tahasil office, only if you go on to ask for a certified copy

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district where the land lies, not where you live, if the two are different.

demoFields.label: Tahasil
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-down. If you do not know the tahasil, the sale deed or an old rent receipt names it.

demoFields.label: Village (Mouza)
demoFields.hint: The revenue village name as it appears in the land record. It is often different from the post office or panchayat name.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Three choices: khata number, plot number, or tenant's name. Use the plot number if all you have is a sale deed.

demoFields.label: Khatian / Khata Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older RoR, a rent receipt or the deed. One khata can hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Plot Number
demoFields.hint: Fill this box instead if you are searching by plot. Write it exactly, including the part number after the slash.

demoFields.label: Tenant's Name
demoFields.hint: Only if you are searching by name. Spell it as it stands in the record, which may be an old spelling or a father's name form.

demoFields.label: Verification Code (captcha)
demoFields.hint: Type the characters shown in the picture. If you cannot read them, press refresh for a new code.

demoSteps: Open the RoR View page on Bhulekh Odisha and pick your district, tahasil and village from the three drop-downs.
Choose how you want to search - by khata number, by plot number, or by the tenant's name - and fill only that one box.
Type the verification code and press View RoR. The record opens as a PDF showing the khata, the plot numbers, the area and the recorded tenant.
Check the area and the name against your own papers. An ancestor's name still standing on the record means the mutation was never done.
Print or save the PDF. It is free and there is no limit on how many times you look.
For a copy a bank or a court will accept, apply for a certified copy at the Tahasil office or through Odisha One - the free printout carries no signature.
To correct a name or record an inheritance, file a mutation case at the Tahasildar's office. Bhulekh only shows the record; it does not change it.
schemes.helpline: Tahasildar's office of the tahasil where the land lies, or the Revenue Inspector of that circle

schemes.title: Odisha Ration Card - NFSA or State Food Security Scheme
schemes.department: Food, Supplies & Consumer Welfare Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: A new ration card for a family, applied for online on the PDS Odisha portal. There are two schemes: NFSA, the central food law, and SFSS, the State Food Security Scheme, which covers poor families left out of the NFSA list. The same portal is used later to add a newborn or a bride to the card, or to remove a name. The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above is the head of the household on the card - this is fixed by law and cannot be changed to the husband's name.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg of rice per person per month; 35 kg a month for an Antyodaya (AAY) family
eligibility: The family must live in Odisha and must not hold a ration card in any other state or district
A family with a government or PSU job, an income-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler in the house is excluded from NFSA
A poor family left out of the NFSA list applies under the State Food Security Scheme (SFSS) instead, on the same portal
The eldest woman of the family, aged 18 or above, must be shown as the head of the household
Every member's Aadhaar has to be given, and e-KYC done at the fair price shop before grain starts
documents: Aadhaar card of every member of the family
Residence proof - electricity bill, voter ID, or a certificate from the Sarpanch or ward officer
Passport photograph of the head of the family
First page of the bank passbook of the head of the family
A mobile number linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar, for the OTP
Deletion certificate from the old card, if the family has moved in from another district or state
Caste certificate, if the family is claiming the Antyodaya (AAY) category

demoFields.label: District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs. Choose the place where the family actually lives - the block staff verify at this address.

demoFields.label: Name of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: The eldest woman of the family aged 18 or above. The law fixes this; do not put the husband's name here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head of the Family
demoFields.hint: Her own 12 digits, spelt exactly as on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number (linked to Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here. If her Aadhaar has no mobile linked, get it linked at an Aadhaar centre first, or do the form at a Mo Seva Kendra.

demoFields.label: Family Members - Name, Relation, Aadhaar
demoFields.value: Gopal Behera - husband - 9999 7744 3344; Lipsa Behera - daughter - 9999 7744 5566; Sanatan Behera - son - 9999 7744 7788
demoFields.hint: Add every person who eats in the house. A name left out now needs a separate member-addition application later.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole family's income for one year. It decides whether you come under NFSA, under SFSS, or under neither.

demoFields.label: Scheme applied for
demoFields.hint: NFSA if the family is on the priority list, SFSS if it was left out of NFSA but is still poor. Ask at the Block office which list your family is on.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC of the Head
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the first page of her passbook. The account should be in her own name and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop to draw from
demoFields.value: Sakhigopal FPS, picked from the list for the Gram Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Choose the ration shop nearest your house from the drop-down. Changing it later means a fresh application at the Block office.

demoFields.label: Old Ration Card Number, if any
demoFields.value: Blank - the family has never held a card
demoFields.hint: Leave it blank for a brand new card. If the family held a card elsewhere, write that number and attach the deletion certificate.

demoSteps: Open the NFSA new-card form on the PDS Odisha portal, or the SFSS form if your family is outside the NFSA list. Mo Seva Kendra and CSC operators fill it for you.
Enter the head of the family's Aadhaar and verify with the OTP on her Aadhaar-linked mobile, then add every member of the family with their own Aadhaar.

Upload the residence proof and the photograph, submit, and write down the Form Number printed on the acknowledgement. Every later step - tracking, adding a member, removing a member - uses this Form Number.
The Block office or the ULB verifies the household, and the Sarpanch or ward officer may be asked about your family.
Once approved, the card is printed and handed over at the Block or ULB office or at your fair price shop. Check every name, relation and Aadhaar on it before you leave.
Get each member's Aadhaar e-KYC done on the machine at the fair price shop. The family's grain does not start until this is finished.
Track the application by the Form Number on the same portal, or ring the department's toll-free helpline if it has not moved in a month.
schemes.helpline: 1800-345-6724 or 155335 (Food, Supplies & Consumer Welfare Department, Odisha)

schemes.title: Subhadra Yojana - Rs 50,000 for Women
schemes.department: Women & Child Development and Mission Shakti Department, Government of Odisha
schemes.brief: A cash payment to women of Odisha aged 21 to 60: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, Rs 50,000 in all. It comes in two instalments of Rs 5,000 each year, near Rakhi Purnima and near International Women's Day on 8 March. The money is paid straight into the woman's own bank account by DBT, so the account must be Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled - an ordinary Aadhaar link is not enough. Apply on the Subhadra portal, or free of charge at any Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10,000 a year for five years, paid as two instalments of Rs 5,000 - Rs 50,000 in total
eligibility: A woman living in Odisha, aged 21 to 60 on the qualifying date the government fixes for that year
The family holds an NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card; a woman without either can apply if the family's yearly income is Rs 2,50,000 or less
She must not be getting Rs 1,500 a month or more, or Rs 18,000 a year or more, from any other government scheme
Not an income-tax payer, and not a serving or retired government or public sector employee
Not a sitting or former MP or MLA, and not an elected head of a local body
e-KYC must be completed, and the bank account must be in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
documents: Aadhaar card, with a mobile number linked to it for the OTP
NFSA or State Food Security Scheme ration card of the family
Income certificate from the Tahasildar, only if the family holds neither ration card
Bank passbook of an account in her own name, Aadhaar-seeded and DBT-enabled
Residence proof showing an Odisha address
A mobile number she can use to receive the OTP herself

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Her own 12 digits. The whole application is built on this number, so check it twice.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Copy it letter for letter from the Aadhaar card. If the bank passbook has a different spelling, get one of them corrected before applying.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. You must be 21 or above and not over 60 on the date fixed for that year's round.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: The e-KYC OTP comes here. If nothing is linked to your Aadhaar, go to a Mo Seva Kendra and do face e-KYC instead.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Type and Number
demoFields.hint: NFSA or SFSS, with the number from the front of the card. If the family has no card, attach the income certificate instead.

demoFields.label: District / Block or ULB / Gram Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick from the drop-downs, for the place where you live now.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC (account in her own name)
demoFields.hint: Copy both from your passbook. A joint account or your husband's account will not be paid - the money only goes to an account in your own name.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The family's income for one year. It must be Rs 2,50,000 or less if you are applying without a ration card.

demoFields.label: e-KYC
demoFields.value: Completed by OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile
demoFields.hint: The application is not counted until e-KYC is done. Face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra is the way round a missing mobile link.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.value: I am not an income-tax payer, not a government employee, and I do not receive Rs 1,500 a month or more from another scheme
demoFields.hint: Tick it only if it is true. A false declaration means the money is recovered later.

demoSteps: Open the Subhadra portal and press Apply Now, or take your Aadhaar and ration card to a Mo Seva Kendra, Anganwadi centre or CSC. They file it free - do not pay anyone for it.
Enter your Aadhaar and finish e-KYC with the OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile. If no mobile is linked, do face e-KYC at a Mo Seva Kendra.
Fill the form, give a bank account in your own name, submit, and note the application number on the acknowledgement.
Ask your bank branch to make the account DBT-enabled, not merely Aadhaar-linked. This one step is behind most of the payments that fail.
Check your name on the beneficiary list on the portal. If you are on the rejected list, the reason is shown next to your name and you can file a grievance on the same site.
Rs 5,000 reaches the account at each instalment, near Rakhi Purnima and near 8 March. Check your passbook or the bank's own message, not a forwarded one.
Ring 14678 between 6 AM and 10 PM for any problem with the application or a missing payment.

schemes.title: Puducherry Old Age Pension
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry pays a monthly pension to old people, widows, deserted wives, unmarried women above a certain age and people with disability. The application is made on paper at the Social Welfare office of your region and the money is credited to the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension credited to the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam for the qualifying period
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for the widow or disability pension
Family income within the limit the department sets, proved by an income certificate
Not drawing a government service pension or another social security pension
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by a government medical board, for the disability pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Age proof — birth certificate, school record or voter card
Income certificate from e-District
Nativity or residence certificate of Puducherry
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name and two photographs
schemes.submitAt: Department of Social Welfare office of your region — Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam; the Commune Panchayat or Municipality office also forwards the application

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, deserted wife, unmarried woman above the prescribed age, or disability. Each has its own condition and certificate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: You must be 60 or above for the old-age pension on the date of application. Write the date as on the age proof you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life certificate both run on this.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The household's card. Eligibility is judged against it.

demoFields.label: Region / Taluk / Commune or Municipality
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The Social Welfare office of this region processes the application.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: From the income certificate you attach. It must be within the department's limit.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.value: Left thumb impression of Lakshmi Ammal, 22-09-2026
demoFields.hint: A thumb impression is fully valid. The office staff attest it beside your mark.

demoSteps: Collect the income certificate and the nativity certificate from e-District first, and the death or disability certificate if the pension needs one.
Get the pension application form free at the Social Welfare office of your region, or at your Commune Panchayat or Municipality office.
Fill it and attach Aadhaar, the ration card, the age proof, the certificates, the passbook copy and two photographs.
Hand it in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number. Without it you cannot follow the case.
The department verifies the applicant and the household's income, and may call you in or visit.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited to the account each month. Check the first credit and tell the office at once if it does not arrive.
Give the life certificate each year when the department asks, or the payment stops.
schemes.helpline: Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry

schemes.title: Monthly Financial Assistance to Women Heads of BPL Families (Rs.2,500)
schemes.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry pays Rs.2,500 a month to the woman who heads a BPL (red) ration card family, aged 21 to 55. It was Rs.1,000 until a January 2026 notification raised it. There is no separate application now. The department picks eligible women every month from the Civil Supplies ration-card data, checks them against other schemes, and pays straight into the woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account. Being shown as head on a BPL card, with Aadhaar seeded, is what gets you in.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month, paid into the woman's own bank account
eligibility: Head of a BPL family ration card (AAY or PHH), aged 21 to 55
Living in the Union territory of Puducherry continuously for the past 5 years. A woman from another state qualifies 5 years after her name is added to a Puducherry BPL card
Only one woman per card is paid: the eldest woman aged between 21 and 55
Must not get any other monthly financial help funded by the Centre or the UT, such as an old age or widow pension
Must not live in a home or institution that gives free boarding and lodging
documents: BPL family ration card showing her as head of the family
Aadhaar card, seeded with the ration card
Bank passbook of an account in her own name, linked to Aadhaar
Age proof (birth certificate, school or college transfer certificate, or marriage registration certificate)
Mobile number
Signed undertaking that she gets no other government financial assistance
schemes.portalName: Department of Women and Child Development, Puducherry
schemes.submitAt: There is no application form now. The department reads the details from the Civil Supplies ration-card data. First make sure your BPL card shows you as head of the family, with Aadhaar linked, at the Civil Supplies office. If you are eligible but not being paid, go with your ration card, Aadhaar and bank passbook and sign the undertaking. In Puducherry region go to the Deputy Director (Social Defence), Old Age Pension Section, Department of Women and Child Development. In Karaikal go to the Child Development Project Officer. In Mahe or Yanam go to the Welfare Officer.

demoFields.label: Name of the applicant
demoFields.hint: There is no form to fill now. These are the details the department reads from your ration card, so check that they are correct on the card.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As printed on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: The address on your ration card.

demoFields.label: Family ration card number
demoFields.hint: Your BPL card number. You must be shown as head of the family.

demoFields.label: Type of card (AAY / PHH)
demoFields.hint: Only AAY and PHH (BPL) cards qualify. APL cards do not.

demoFields.label: Date of birth / age
demoFields.hint: Between 21 and 55. If two women on the card qualify, the elder one is paid.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: It must be seeded with the ration card and linked to your bank account.

demoFields.label: Getting any other government financial help?
demoFields.hint: Anyone already getting a pension or similar monthly help is not eligible. You sign an undertaking saying this.

demoFields.label: Living in Puducherry for the past 5 years?
demoFields.hint: Continuous residence of 5 years is required.

demoFields.label: Bank name and account number
demoFields.hint: The money is sent to the Aadhaar-linked account in your own name.

demoSteps: Check your ration card at the Civil Supplies office: it must be a BPL (AAY or PHH) card with you as head of the family and your Aadhaar seeded.
Link your Aadhaar to a bank account in your own name.
Every month Civil Supplies uploads card data to the Unified Data Hub, and the department prepares the list of eligible women after removing those in other schemes.
The list is put up on the website for social audit. Sign the undertaking at the department office if you are asked to.
Rs.2,500 is paid into your Aadhaar-linked account after the end of each month.

If the money does not come, go to the Deputy Director (Social Defence), the CDPO Karaikal or the Welfare Officer of Mahe or Yanam. You can appeal to the Secretary, Women and Child Development, within 30 days of a decision.
schemes.helpline: 0413-2244785 — Department of Women and Child Development, Puducherry

schemes.title: Puducherry e-District — Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Government of Puducherry
schemes.brief: Puducherry's e-District portal covers the certificates and services of the union territory's four regions — Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam. Income, community, nativity and residence certificates are applied for and downloaded here.
schemes.benefit: Income, community, nativity and residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam
A nativity certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
A community certificate needs the community to be on the Puducherry SC, ST, BC or MBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Father's community certificate, for a community certificate
School transfer certificate for date of birth and nativity
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, community, nativity, residence, birth or death. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Region
demoFields.hint: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam. The taluk office of that region handles the file.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a community certificate this decides the case — community is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Community claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the Puducherry list. SC, ST, BC and MBC are separate lists with separate benefits.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Taluk / Commune or Municipality / Street
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tahsildar of this taluk signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.py.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre in your region.
Choose the certificate, pick your region, and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a community certificate, the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Submit, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The Village Administrative Officer verifies the family, then the Tahsildar signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the community name and your father's name at once.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk Tahsildar's office, or the Collectorate of your region

schemes.title: Mukh Mantri Sehat Yojana (Sehat Card)
schemes.department: State Health Agency Punjab, Department of Health & Family Welfare
schemes.brief: A free health cover of Rs 10 lakh a year for every family living in Punjab, with no income limit. Treatment is cashless at government and listed private hospitals: you show the Sehat Card and the hospital bills the government. It replaced the older Ayushman Bharat Mukh Mantri Sehat Bima Yojana, which gave Rs 5 lakh only to listed families. You register the family once at a CSC with Aadhaar and Voter ID.
schemes.benefit: Rs 10 lakh a year per family, cashless, at 900+ hospitals
eligibility: Every family living in Punjab, rich or poor. There is no income limit
Government employees and pensioners are covered too
Each adult member needs an Aadhaar card and a Voter ID card with a Punjab address. Aadhaar e-KYC is compulsory
Covers more than 2,000 treatments, including costs before and after admission, at government and listed private hospitals
A person living alone can enrol as a one-member family with a declaration verified by the Sarpanch, Municipal Councillor or MLA
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member, for e-KYC
Voter ID card of every adult member
A mobile number, for the SMS that confirms registration
Family Declaration Form (for families new to the scheme), signed by the head, with a copy of the head's Voter ID pasted on it
Single Member Declaration Form with photo, if you live alone, verified by the Sarpanch, Municipal Councillor or MLA
schemes.submitAt: Your nearest CSC (Common Service Centre). Take every member's Aadhaar card, every adult's Voter ID, a mobile number and, if your family is new to the scheme, the filled Family Declaration Form (or the Single Member form if you live alone). Registration and the card are free. The Sehat Card is handed out at the same CSC in 2 to 3 weeks.

demoFields.label: I (name of declarant)
demoFields.hint: The head of the family, written exactly as on his or her Voter ID card.

demoFields.label: S/o, D/o or W/o
demoFields.hint: Father's name, or husband's name for a married woman.

demoFields.label: House No.
demoFields.hint: House number where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Village/Town
demoFields.hint: Your village or town in Punjab.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district of that village or town.

demoFields.label: Member 1: Name / Relation / Age
demoFields.hint: Start with yourself, then add every member who lives with you. The form has room for 8 members.

demoFields.label: Member 2: Name / Relation / Age
demoFields.hint: Relation is how this person is related to you, the declarant.

demoFields.label: Voter ID no. (last column)
demoFields.hint: Write each adult's Voter ID number. Children have none: leave it blank and carry their Aadhaar cards.

demoFields.label: Voter ID of Declarant (front and back)
demoFields.hint: Paste only your Voter ID copy here. The form says not to attach any other document.

demoFields.label: Dated / Place / Signature
demoFields.hint: Sign only after checking every name. A false entry can cancel the family's cover.

demoSteps: Check whether your family is already listed: open sha.punjab.gov.in, choose Check for Eligibility and search with your Aadhaar.
If the family is new, download the Family Declaration Form from the Resources menu on sha.punjab.gov.in, fill in every member and paste the head's Voter ID copy.
Go to the nearest CSC with all members' Aadhaar cards and the adults' Voter IDs. The operator does Aadhaar e-KYC for each member by fingerprint or OTP.
An SMS confirming the registration and your benefits comes at once. Keep this message.
The printed Sehat Card is given at the same CSC within 2 to 3 weeks. You can also download it from Download Health Card on sha.punjab.gov.in.
At any listed government or private hospital, show the Sehat Card at the help desk. The hospital checks your details digitally and treats you cashless up to Rs 10 lakh a year.
schemes.helpline: 104 (Sehat Card, hospital and grievance helpline, State Health Agency Punjab)

schemes.title: Ashirwad Scheme (Shagun for Daughter's Marriage)
schemes.department: Department of Social Justice, Empowerment & Minorities, Punjab
schemes.brief: Rs 51,000 from the Punjab government for the marriage of a daughter from a poor Scheduled Caste, Christian, Backward Class or economically weaker family, or the daughter of a widow of any caste. It was earlier called the Shagun scheme. Since 28 January 2026 applications are taken only at Sewa Kendras, before the wedding or within 60 days after it, and the money goes straight to the bank account.
schemes.benefit: Rs 51,000 per daughter, for up to two daughters
eligibility: Daughters of Scheduled Caste, Christian, Backward Class and economically weaker families, and daughters of widows of any caste. Scheduled Caste widows and divorced women also get it when they remarry
Family income from all sources must not be more than Rs 32,790 a year
The girl must be at least 18 years old on the wedding day
Her parents or guardian must be permanent residents of Punjab
Apply before the wedding date or within 60 days after it
At most two daughters of one family can get the money
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant (parent or guardian) and of the bride
Caste certificate (SC or BC) and proof of address in Punjab
Proof of the girl's age: birth certificate or school certificate
Self-declaration of family income
Bank passbook of the applicant, showing account number and IFSC
Wedding card, and the marriage certificate from the gurdwara, temple, church or other religious place
Family BPL or blue ration card, if you have one
Photos of the applicant, the bride and the groom
schemes.submitAt: Any Sewa Kendra in Punjab. Take a token at the counter, or book a slot first on connect.punjab.gov.in. Since 28 January 2026 Ashirwad applications are accepted only at Sewa Kendras, so do not pay anyone to apply elsewhere. Take the originals and copies of all documents and the photos. There is no fee.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The mother, father or guardian who is applying, as written on Aadhaar. For a widow's daughter, the mother applies.

demoFields.label: Relation with the bride
demoFields.hint: How the applicant is related to the girl getting married.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the applicant's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: SC, Christian, BC, economically weaker, or daughter of a widow. It decides which certificate is checked.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Everyone's earnings in the family for a full year. Above Rs 32,790 the file is rejected.

demoFields.label: Bride's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must match her birth or school certificate. She must be 18 or older on the wedding day.

demoFields.label: Date of marriage
demoFields.hint: Apply before this date or within 60 days after it. Later applications are not taken.

demoFields.label: Groom's name and address
demoFields.value: Jaspreet Singh, Village Bhaini Kalan, Ludhiana
demoFields.hint: As printed on the wedding card.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the applicant's own name, linked to Aadhaar. The Rs 51,000 is sent here.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Updates on the application and the payment SMS come to this number.

demoSteps: Collect all the documents and photos. Get the caste certificate and the income self-declaration ready before the wedding.
Go to the nearest Sewa Kendra, take a token and ask for the Ashirwad Scheme. The operator fills in the application and scans your documents.
Keep the receipt with the application number. Track it on connect.punjab.gov.in under Track, or by calling 1100.
The Tehsil and District Welfare Officers check the papers, and the district committee headed by the Deputy Commissioner approves it. The service time is about 47 days.
After sanction, Rs 51,000 is sent by DBT straight into the applicant's bank account, and an SMS comes when it is credited.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Punjab Sewa Kendra and Connect helpline) / District and Tehsil Welfare Officer (list under Contact Details on ashirwad.punjab.gov.in)

schemes.title: Jamabandi Punjab — Land Records, Fard and Mutation
schemes.department: Punjab Land Records Society, Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: Punjab's land records portal. Looking up the jamabandi by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra number is free and needs no account, and you can also see mutations, the roznamcha and registered deeds. A digital fard can be bought and delivered on WhatsApp. Requests for virasat (inheritance) mutation, mutation on a registered deed (vasika), fard badar correction, rapat entry and oral or family partition under the Chief Minister's 30-day taksim scheme are filed on the same site with a mobile OTP, and tracked on the application number.
schemes.benefit: Free jamabandi viewing, digital fard on WhatsApp, and mutation requests filed online
eligibility: The land must lie in Punjab and be entered in the jamabandi of that village
Viewing the jamabandi, mutations, roznamcha and registered deeds is free and open to anyone, with no login
For a virasat mutation you must be a legal heir of the owner recorded in the jamabandi
For a mutation on a deed, the vasika must already be registered at the sub-registrar's office before you file here
For the Chief Minister's 30-day partition scheme, every co-sharer of the khewat has to agree to the partition
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP; there is no standing citizen account, so the application number is your only handle on the file
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Copy of the current jamabandi (fard) showing the khewat, khatauni and khasra numbers
Death certificate of the recorded owner, for a virasat mutation
Family tree (kursinama) of the heirs, attested by the sarpanch or the patwari
Registered deed (vasika) with its registration number and date, for a deed mutation
Written consent of all co-sharers, for a family partition
Court order or decree, where the land is under one
Mobile number for the OTP, and for WhatsApp delivery of a digital fard

demoFields.label: Request type
demoFields.hint: Virasat mutation, mutation on a registered vasika, fard badar, rapat, or partition. Each has its own page on the site.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district where the land is, which is not always the district you live in.

demoFields.label: Tehsil
demoFields.hint: The revenue tehsil of the land. The Revenue Officer of this tehsil sanctions the mutation.

demoFields.label: Village / Hadbast
demoFields.hint: Pick the village from the dropdown. The dropdown takes a moment to load, so wait for the list.

demoFields.label: Jamabandi Year
demoFields.hint: Jamabandi is rewritten every five years. Choose the latest year shown for your village.

demoFields.label: Khewat / Khatauni Number
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the fard exactly. The whole request is filed against these numbers.

demoFields.label: Khasra (Killa) Numbers
demoFields.hint: Every khasra of the holding being mutated, with the slashes as printed in the record.

demoFields.label: Name of the recorded owner
demoFields.value: Bachan Singh son of Inder Singh
demoFields.hint: The name as it stands in the jamabandi, not as spoken. For a virasat mutation this is the deceased owner.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name and relation
demoFields.value: Manjit Singh — son of the deceased
demoFields.hint: Your name as on Aadhaar and how you are related to the recorded owner. List every heir; leaving one out means the mutation has to be redone.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number for OTP
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the hearing date come here. A digital fard is delivered to this number on WhatsApp.

demoSteps: Open jamabandi.punjab.gov.in and view the jamabandi free first — search by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra. Write down the spelling and the numbers exactly as the record shows them.
If you only need a copy, use the digital fard service; it can be sent to your mobile on WhatsApp for the notified fee. A paid subscription is offered for people who need fards often.
For inheritance, open the Virasat mutation request, fill the district, tehsil, village, jamabandi year and khewat, add every legal heir, and verify your mobile number by OTP. No account is needed.
Note the application number the site gives you and follow it on the online request status page.
The patwari enters the rapat in the roznamcha and the Revenue Officer — Naib Tehsildar or Tehsildar — sanctions the mutation after hearing the co-sharers. Attend the hearing when you are called.
Once it is sanctioned, look up the jamabandi again and check the new names, the shares and the khasra numbers. If anything is wrong, file a Fard Badar correction request on the same site.
There is a grievance form on the portal with its own tracking number. Use it if the request sits without movement, and keep the application number with you.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the Fard Kendra or the Tehsildar's office of the tehsil where the land lies, and the Punjab Land Records Society through the Deputy Commissioner's office if it is not resolved there.

schemes.title: e-Sewa Punjab — Sewa Kendra Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Governance Reforms and Public Grievances, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: e-Sewa Punjab is the Sewa Kendra counter put online. More than 400 services of over 30 departments run through it — birth, death and marriage certificates, caste, residence and income certificates, fard (a copy of the land record), arms licence, vehicle and driving licence services, labour registration and social security pensions. You can file it yourself with a mobile OTP, or hand the papers in at any Sewa Kendra and let the counter do it.
schemes.benefit: Over 400 services of more than 30 departments, filed online or at a Sewa Kendra
eligibility: Resident of Punjab, applying in the tehsil where the family actually lives
A residence certificate needs proof that the family has been living in Punjab — the ration card, an old electricity bill or a school record for the address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Punjab's notified list and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate covers one financial year, and departments normally want a recently issued one
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP, and it should be the one linked to your Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or blue card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, water bill or house tax receipt
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary slip, or a self-declaration and affidavit where there is no salary
Matriculation certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Copy of the jamabandi or rent agreement, where the address rests on land or a tenancy
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Department and Service
demoFields.hint: Pick the department first, then the service. Each one has its own form, its own fee and its own delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this box in Punjabi and English.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his own Aadhaar or the family's ration card, since the family is traced through it.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the matriculation certificate or the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The tehsil office named here processes and signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your father's caste certificate. Leave it blank if the service does not need it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year — wages, farming, shop and rent together, not just the applicant's earnings.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the OTP and the 'ready for collection' message all come here.

demoSteps: Register on esewa.punjab.gov.in with your mobile number and the OTP — or take the papers to any Sewa Kendra and let the counter file it for you.
Choose the department and the service, then fill the form. The name must match the Aadhaar letter for letter, or the file comes back for correction.
Upload the scans, pay the fee, and keep the receipt. It carries the application number and the date the service is promised by.
The patwari or the tehsil clerk verifies the address, the income or the caste claim. Stay reachable on the mobile you gave.

Track the application number on the portal. When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login or collect it at the Sewa Kendra — a digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If the promised date passes, Punjab's service delivery law gives you an appeal to the department's designated appellate officer. Quote the application number when you file it.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for e-Sewa. Ask at the Sewa Kendra counter in your tehsil, or at the District Governance Reforms office in the Deputy Commissioner's complex.

schemes.title: Old Age Pension Scheme (Budhapa Pension)
schemes.department: Department of Social Security and Women & Child Development, Punjab
schemes.brief: A pension of Rs 1,500 every month for women aged 58 and above and men aged 65 and above in Punjab whose income is low. The money is paid into the pensioner's bank account. You can apply online on Connect Punjab, at any Sewa Kendra, or by calling 1076 for an operator to come home. There is no fee and no paper form.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,500 a month, paid into your bank account
eligibility: Women aged 58 or above, men aged 65 or above
Total yearly income not more than Rs 60,000, counting business, rent and interest
Husband and wife together may own up to 2.5 acres of canal or well-irrigated (nehri/chahi) land, or up to 5 acres of barani or waterlogged land
You must be a resident of Punjab
The CDPO verifies the case within a month and the District Social Security Officer sanctions it
documents: Aadhaar card (proof of identity, address and age)
A second proof of age: voter card or voter list entry, birth certificate or matriculation certificate
First page of the bank passbook
Self-declaration
Village: land report from the Patwari. City: property verification from the Executive Officer of the Municipal Council
Mobile number, for OTP and SMS updates

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The elderly person who will get the pension, as written on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: As written on your Aadhaar or voter card.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Women can apply from 58, men from 65.

demoFields.label: Date of birth
demoFields.hint: Must match the Aadhaar and your second age proof, such as the voter list or matric certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar e-KYC is done for this service, so give the pensioner's own number.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: OTP and messages about the pension come here. A son's or daughter's number is fine.

demoFields.label: Address (village, tehsil, district)
demoFields.value: Village Rampura Kalan, Tehsil Malout, Sri Muktsar Sahib
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. The CDPO of this area verifies the case.

demoFields.label: Annual income from all sources
demoFields.hint: Include rent, business and bank interest. The limit is Rs 60,000 a year.

demoFields.label: Land owned (husband and wife)
demoFields.hint: Up to 2.5 acres nehri/chahi or 5 acres barani is allowed. The Patwari's report must say the same.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The pensioner's own account. Upload the first page of this passbook.

demoSteps: Open connect.punjab.gov.in, find Old Age Pension Scheme in the services list and tap Click to apply service. If you cannot go online, call 1076 and an operator will come home, or visit a Sewa Kendra.
Log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete Aadhaar e-KYC for the person applying.
Fill in the form, upload the age proof, passbook page, self-declaration and the land or property report, and submit. There is no fee.
Note the application number on the receipt and follow it under Track on Connect Punjab.
The CDPO verifies your details and the District Social Security Officer sanctions the pension. The service time is 32 days online and 34 days at a Sewa Kendra.
After sanction, Rs 1,500 a month is credited to your bank account. For problems, contact the District Social Security Officer.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Connect Punjab and Sewa Kendra helpline) / 1076 (doorstep service) / 0172-2608746 (Social Security head office) / 14567 (elderly helpline)

schemes.title: Lado Protsahan Yojana (Lado Sankalp Patra)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women Empowerment, Women & Child Development Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: A girl born in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital in Rajasthan is promised Rs 1.5 lakh, paid in seven instalments from birth until she graduates at 21. The scheme began on 1 August 2024, replaced the old Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana (Rajshri girls get their remaining instalments under Lado), and was raised from Rs 1 lakh to Rs 1.5 lakh in 2025. There is no form: the hospital, the school and the college record her details, and every instalment goes by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,50,000 in 7 instalments — Rs 2,500 at birth up to Rs 1 lakh at graduation
eligibility: The mother is a resident of Rajasthan and has an Aadhaar card and a Jan Aadhaar card
The girl is born in a government hospital or in a private hospital approved under Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
The guidelines set no income or caste condition, and no limit on the number of children for the 3rd instalment onwards
Instalments 3 to 6 need admission in a government school or a state-recognised private school
The last instalment needs graduation from a recognised institution and age 21 completed
A mother living in Rajasthan who delivered outside the state and got JSY can claim the first instalment at her local government hospital
documents: Mother's Aadhaar card
Jan Aadhaar card of the family; add the girl's name after birth
Bank passbook of the mother (father or guardian if the mother has died)
Pregnancy (ANC) registration done with the ANM or government hospital
Mamta card showing all vaccinations done by 9–12 months, for the 2nd instalment
School admission entry on Shala Darpan or the private school portal, for instalments 3 to 6
Graduation marksheet, for the 7th instalment
schemes.submitAt: No form and no fee. During pregnancy, register at the ANC check-up with the ANM, ASHA or government hospital and give the mother's Aadhaar, Jan Aadhaar and bank details for the PCTS entry. Deliver in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital. School instalments come through the school's Shala Darpan entry and the last one through the college. For a missing instalment, ask the ANM or the Block Chief Medical Officer for the first two, the school head for instalments 3 to 6, or the district Women Empowerment office.

demoFields.label: Mother's name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the Aadhaar and the bank account, or the payment can bounce.

demoFields.label: Mother's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The ANM enters this at the first pregnancy check-up.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The family's 10-digit Jan Aadhaar. If the family has none, get it made at e-Mitra before the delivery.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC (mother)
demoFields.hint: An account in the mother's own name. The first six instalments go to the parent; the last one goes to the girl.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages come here.

demoFields.label: ANC registration (place and date)
demoFields.hint: Register early in pregnancy with the ANM; this PCTS entry is what starts the scheme.

demoFields.label: Place of delivery
demoFields.hint: Only a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital counts. A home birth is not covered.

demoFields.label: Girl's PCTS / unique ID
demoFields.hint: Given at birth. Quote it for every instalment and at school admission.

demoFields.label: Full vaccination (Mamta card)
demoFields.hint: All vaccines due by 9–12 months. The second Rs 2,500 is paid once this shows on PCTS.

demoFields.label: School and class (later instalments)
demoFields.value: Govt. Senior Secondary School, Bilara — Class 1
demoFields.hint: The school enters her on Shala Darpan at Class 1, 6, 10 and 12, using her PCTS ID, Jan Aadhaar or APAAR ID.

demoSteps: Register the pregnancy at the first check-up with the ANM, ASHA or government hospital, and give the mother's Aadhaar, Jan Aadhaar, bank account and mobile number.
Deliver in a government hospital or a JSY-approved private hospital. The girl gets a PCTS ID and the family gets the Rs 1.5 lakh Sankalp Patra.
The first Rs 2,500 is credited to the mother's account after the hospital birth, without any application.
Complete all vaccinations by 9–12 months on the Mamta card. When PCTS is updated, the second Rs 2,500 is paid; no proof that the child is alive is asked.
Add the girl to the Jan Aadhaar. On admission to Class 1, 6, 10 and 12 the school records her, and the Education Department pays Rs 4,000, Rs 5,000, Rs 11,000 and Rs 25,000.
After she passes graduation and turns 21, Rs 1 lakh goes to her own account. Missing one stage does not stop the later instalments.
If a payment does not arrive, ask the ANM or the school to check the entry, or complain on 181.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark (state helpline for complaints about any scheme)

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Matritva Poshan Yojana (MMMPY)
schemes.department: Directorate of Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS), Women & Child Development Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Gives Rs 6,000 in three instalments to a woman pregnant with her second child, for better food and care. It was earlier called the Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana; only the name changed and the rules are the same. If the second baby is a boy, the third instalment is Rs 4,000; if it is a girl, she gets Rs 6,000 under the central PM Matru Vandana Yojana instead, making Rs 8,000 in all. There is no form: the Anganwadi worker or ANM records the pregnancy on PCTS and the money comes by DBT.
schemes.benefit: Rs 6,000 in 3 instalments for the second child (Rs 8,000 in all if it is a girl)
eligibility: Woman pregnant with her second child on or after 1 April 2022 (1 November 2020 in Pratapgarh, Dungarpur, Banswara, Udaipur and Baran)
Runs in all districts; pregnant or breastfeeding Anganwadi workers, helpers, ASHA sahyoginis and saathins are also eligible
Not for women regularly employed by the Centre, the state or a PSU, or getting the same kind of benefit under another law
Not eligible if the first pregnancy gave twins, or if after remarriage either partner already has more than one child
Cannot take MMMPY and PM Matru Vandana instalments for the same conditions
After a miscarriage or still birth, she stays eligible in a later pregnancy
documents: Jan Aadhaar card (it will be made at registration if the family has none)
Mamta card (mother and child protection card) — photocopy
Bank passbook copy of the account linked to the Jan Aadhaar
Mobile number
Aadhaar card of the woman
schemes.submitAt: No form and no fee. Register the pregnancy at the Anganwadi centre, or with the ANM at the sub-centre or government hospital, within 120 days of the last period. Give the Jan Aadhaar, Mamta card, bank passbook and mobile number for the PCTS entry; the instalments then come on their own as the check-ups and the hospital delivery are recorded. For a missing instalment, ask the Anganwadi worker or the CDPO (ICDS project office) of your block.

demoFields.label: Woman's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Jan Aadhaar and the bank account.

demoFields.label: Husband's name
demoFields.hint: As on the Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Must be given at registration. If the family has none, the Anganwadi worker will help get it made.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Payment messages come here.

demoFields.label: Last menstrual period (LMP) date
demoFields.hint: The first instalment needs registration within 120 days of this date.

demoFields.label: Pregnancy number and living children
demoFields.hint: MMMPY is for the second child only. The first child is covered under PM Matru Vandana Yojana.

demoFields.label: ANC registration date and place
demoFields.hint: Register as early as you can; this PCTS entry is your application.

demoFields.label: Mamta card number
demoFields.hint: Every check-up and vaccine is written on this card. Keep it safe.

demoFields.label: Bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Your own account linked to the Jan Aadhaar. The money is paid only by DBT.

demoFields.label: Place of delivery
demoFields.hint: The third instalment needs a hospital delivery.

demoSteps: As soon as you know you are pregnant, and within 120 days of the last period, go to the Anganwadi worker or ANM and register. Give your Jan Aadhaar and mobile number.
Get your Mamta card. Your details go on PCTS; there is no form to fill.
First instalment: Rs 1,000 is paid after registration within 120 days.
Second instalment: Rs 1,000 after at least two check-ups within the first six months of pregnancy.
Deliver in a hospital. For a boy (or transgender child) the third instalment is Rs 4,000; for a girl, Rs 6,000 comes in one go under PM Matru Vandana Yojana instead.
The money goes to the account linked to your Jan Aadhaar, with an SMS. If an instalment is missing, ask the Anganwadi worker to check the PCTS entry, or call 181.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark; your Anganwadi worker or the block CDPO office for PCTS entries

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (Rajasthan top-up to PM-Kisan)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Rajasthan adds its own money to PM-Kisan. Every Rajasthan farmer family that receives PM-Kisan also gets Rs 3,000 a year from the state, paid in instalments of Rs 1,000, so the total becomes Rs 9,000 a year with the Centre's Rs 6,000. There is no separate state form: a farmer registered and active in PM-Kisan gets the state money by DBT automatically.
schemes.benefit: Rs 3,000 a year from the state on top of PM-Kisan's Rs 6,000 (Rs 9,000 in all)
eligibility: Rajasthan farmer family that is an active PM-Kisan beneficiary
Farm land in own name as on 1 February 2019; land got later only by inheritance counts
One person per family — husband, wife and minor children count as one family
Farmer ID from the Rajasthan Farmer Registry, PM-Kisan e-KYC done, and an Aadhaar-linked bank account open for DBT
PM-Kisan exclusions apply: income-tax payers, government employees, pensioners drawing Rs 10,000 or more a month, doctors, lawyers and other registered professionals
documents: Aadhaar card, with a mobile number linked for OTP
Farmer ID (Rajasthan Farmer Registry), made free at e-Mitra, a CSC or a registry camp
Jamabandi (land record) copy showing the land in your name
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account open for DBT
Mobile number

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The farmer's own 12-digit Aadhaar. The name on the land record must match it.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP and every payment SMS come here.

demoFields.label: State
demoFields.hint: Choose Rajasthan; only then is the state's Rs 3,000 added.

demoFields.label: Farmer ID
demoFields.hint: From the Rajasthan Farmer Registry. Get it at e-Mitra, a CSC or a camp if you do not have one.

demoFields.label: District / tehsil / village
demoFields.hint: Where the farm land is, not where you live now.

demoFields.label: Farmer name and gender
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Category and farmer type
demoFields.hint: Small means 1 to 2 hectares and marginal means under 1 hectare. Every landholding size is eligible.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The account must be linked to Aadhaar for DBT, or the money fails.

demoFields.label: Land details (khata, khasra, area)
demoFields.hint: Copy them from your jamabandi. The patwari checks them against the land record.

demoFields.label: Self-declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm that you are not in an excluded group such as an income-tax payer or a government employee.

demoSteps: Already in PM-Kisan? Check Know Your Status on pmkisan.gov.in. If you are active and e-KYC is done, the state money will come on its own; do nothing more.
Not registered? First get a Farmer ID at e-Mitra, a CSC or a Farmer Registry camp, carrying Aadhaar and the jamabandi.

Open New Farmer Registration on pmkisan.gov.in, enter Aadhaar and mobile, choose Rajasthan, verify the OTP, fill in the land and bank details and submit. Note the registration number. e-Mitra or a CSC can do this for you.
The patwari and the tehsil verify the land, and the state approves the record.
Finish e-KYC with an Aadhaar OTP, face authentication or a fingerprint at a CSC, and make sure the bank account is linked to Aadhaar.
Once active, PM-Kisan pays Rs 2,000 three times a year and the state pays its Rs 1,000 instalments separately, all by DBT.
Check payments on pmkisan.gov.in under Know Your Status, or on the Jan Soochna portal.

schemes.title: Nirman Shramik Panjiyan — BOCW Welfare Board (Shramik Card)
schemes.department: Rajasthan Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Registers a construction worker with the state welfare board and gives a beneficiary identity card, the shramik card. With it the worker and family can claim the board's schemes: Rs 55,000 under Shubhshakti for a woman worker or an adult unmarried daughter, Rs 21,000 maternity help for a girl and Rs 20,000 for a boy, scholarships for children, up to Rs 1.5 lakh towards a house, and Rs 5 lakh if the worker dies in an accident. Registration is online through SSO and the Labour Department's LDMS, by the worker or at an e-Mitra kiosk.
schemes.benefit: Shramik card for the board's schemes — Rs 55,000 Shubhshakti, Rs 20,000–21,000 maternity help, Rs 5 lakh accident cover
eligibility: Construction worker aged 18 to 60
At least 90 days of building or construction work in the last 12 months
Work certificate from the employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, the Panchayat executive officer or the area labour inspector
Pays the Rs 25 registration fee and Rs 60 contribution when the labour office asks, and keeps the contribution paid
Scheme benefits need time on the register: 3 months for Shubhshakti, 6 months to a year for housing help, 3 years for the toolkit
documents: Jan Aadhaar card and Aadhaar card
Construction worker certificate for 90 days' work in the last 12 months, signed and sealed with a phone number
Age proof — school leaving certificate, birth certificate or a doctor's certificate
Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned)
Bank passbook first page, needed for scheme payments
Mobile number
Names and ages of family members, and the nominee's details
schemes.portalName: LDMS — Labour Department Management System (through SSO Rajasthan)

demoFields.label: Are you a permanent resident of Rajasthan?
demoFields.hint: Tick Yes if you live in Rajasthan; then your Jan Aadhaar is used to fill in your name.

demoFields.label: Name of applicant (from Jan Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Pick your own name from the family list.

demoFields.label: Father's / husband's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Gender and mobile number
demoFields.hint: Approval and payment messages come to this number.

demoFields.label: Present address — district, block, gram panchayat, village
demoFields.hint: Where you live now. Your labour office is chosen from this.

demoFields.label: Category, date of birth, marital status
demoFields.hint: You must be between 18 and 60. Age is worked out from the date of birth.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Your own 12-digit Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Construction worker certificate issued by
demoFields.value: Employer / contractor — Shree Ganesh Builders, Bhilwara
demoFields.hint: Choose who signed your 90-day certificate and fill in their name, address and Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Employers in the last 12 months (site, work, days)
demoFields.value: Housing site, Pur Road — mason — 140 days
demoFields.hint: List every site, the work you did and the days worked. The total must be at least 90.

demoFields.label: Nominee (name, relation, age, share)
demoFields.hint: Up to three nominees. They receive the money if something happens to you.

demoSteps: Get the 90-day construction worker certificate signed and sealed by your contractor, a registered union, the Panchayat executive officer or the labour inspector.
Log in at sso.rajasthan.gov.in (make a free SSO ID with Jan Aadhaar if needed) and open LDMS, or go to an e-Mitra kiosk.
In LDMS choose BOCW Welfare Board, then Beneficiary Registration, and fill in Form V: your details, address, employers of the last 12 months, family and nominee.
Upload the photo, age proof and worker certificate, choose your labour office, tick the declaration and submit. Save the application number.

The labour office checks the form. If it asks for a missing paper, upload it from the same login. When approved, it asks you to pay the Rs 25 registration fee and Rs 60 contribution online or at e-Mitra.
After payment, print your beneficiary identity card (shramik card) from Print Identity Card in LDMS.
Apply for schemes from Apply for Scheme in the same login, for example maternity help within 90 days of the delivery. Keep the contribution paid so claims are not refused.
schemes.helpline: 1800-1800-999 — Labour Department helpline; 0141-2222961 / 0141-2220334 — construction worker schemes; 0141-2450793 — LDMS help

schemes.title: RSMSSB Recruitment — Rajasthan Group C Posts and CET
schemes.department: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board
schemes.brief: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board recruits for most Group C posts in the state — Patwari, Village Development Officer, Junior Assistant, Forest Guard, Computer and Livestock Assistant. Many of them now go through a Common Eligibility Test first, and every application is filed through the SSO login.
schemes.benefit: One SSO login for every RSMSSB recruitment and the Common Eligibility Test
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Rajasthan domicile for the reserved-category quotas and the lower fee
Age as the notification states, usually 18 to 40, with relaxation for Rajasthan SC, ST, OBC, women and disability
The qualification the post requires, complete on the notification's closing date
A valid CET score where the post is one of those screened through it
Knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script and of Rajasthani culture, which most posts test
documents: SSO ID of Rajasthan
Aadhaar card and Jan Aadhaar
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Higher qualification certificates and marksheets
Rajasthan caste certificate, for a reserved category
Domicile (Mool Niwas) certificate of Rajasthan
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: SSO ID
demoFields.hint: Every Rajasthan government application runs through the Single Sign On. Create it once at sso.rajasthan.gov.in and use it for everything after.

demoFields.label: Post applied for
demoFields.hint: One application per notification. Read the qualification and age limit in that notification before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed afterwards.

demoFields.label: Category and domicile

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.value: B.A., Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University Ajmer, 2023, 59%
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected. Most Group C posts also require a computer certificate — check that notification.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's number.

demoSteps: Create an SSO ID at sso.rajasthan.gov.in if you do not have one. No Rajasthan recruitment can be applied to without it.
Watch rsmssb.rajasthan.gov.in for the notification, and check whether the post needs a valid CET score before anything else.
Log in through SSO, open the recruitment portal and fill the application with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee online. Rajasthan candidates in the reserved categories pay less.
Use the correction window if the Board opens one — it is the only chance to fix a wrong entry.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and take it with a photo ID and the printed application.

Results and the answer key appear on the same site. Document verification comes last, where the originals of everything claimed — including the Mool Niwas and caste certificate on the Rajasthan format — must be produced.
schemes.helpline: 0141-2722520 — Rajasthan Staff Selection Board, Jaipur

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana (MAA Card)
schemes.department: Medical, Health & Family Welfare Department — Rajasthan State Health Assurance Agency (RSHAA), Government of Rajasthan
schemes.brief: Rajasthan's own health cover, earlier called the Chiranjeevi Yojana and renamed MAA Yojana in 2024. A covered family gets cashless treatment of up to Rs 25 lakh a year when admitted to a government hospital or an empanelled private hospital, with no limit on family size or age. NFSA and SECC families, small and marginal farmers and government contract workers are covered free; any other family that is not a government employee or pensioner can join by paying Rs 850 a year.
schemes.benefit: Cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 25 lakh per family per year
eligibility: Family living in Rajasthan with a Jan Aadhaar card; every member listed on the Jan Aadhaar is covered
Free, no registration needed: families under the Food Security Act (NFSA) and SECC 2011 families
Free after registration: small and marginal farmers, contract workers of state departments, boards and corporations, and destitute families who got the Covid-19 ex-gratia
All other families can join by paying Rs 850 a year, half the premium; the state pays the other half
Not for government employees or pensioners who get medical benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules
No limit on family size or age; a baby up to one year old is treated even before its name is on the Jan Aadhaar
documents: Jan Aadhaar card, Jan Aadhaar number or Jan Aadhaar enrolment receipt number
Aadhaar number of the member who registers, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Land holding seeded in the Jan Aadhaar, for small and marginal farmers (done at e-Mitra)
Department verification by the nodal officer, for contract workers
Rs 850 premium, only for families in the paid category
At the hospital: Jan Aadhaar card or the MAA policy document, and the patient's Aadhaar card
schemes.portalName: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana portal (through SSO Rajasthan)

demoFields.label: SSO ID
demoFields.hint: Your Rajasthan SSO login. If you have none, make one free on the same page using your Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Registration type
demoFields.hint: Free is for small and marginal farmers, contract workers and Covid ex-gratia families. Every other family chooses Paid and pays Rs 850. NFSA ration-card families do not register at all.

demoFields.label: Free category
demoFields.hint: Farmers choose SMF, government contract staff choose Contractual, and destitute families who got the Covid aid choose Covid 19 ex Gratia.

demoFields.label: Jan Aadhaar number or enrolment receipt number
demoFields.hint: The 10-digit family number on the Jan Aadhaar card. If the card is still being made, the enrolment receipt number also works.

demoFields.label: Family member who e-signs
demoFields.hint: All members appear on screen. Pick any one adult whose Aadhaar has a working mobile number linked to it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number of that member
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the Aadhaar card of the member you picked.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar OTP (e-signature)
demoFields.hint: The OTP goes to the mobile linked with Aadhaar, which may differ from the number on the Jan Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. Messages about the policy come here.

demoFields.label: Land details (farmers only)
demoFields.value: Khasra 412, 1.6 hectare, village Kishanpura, tehsil Chomu
demoFields.hint: Must match the land seeded in your Jan Aadhaar. If it is not seeded yet, get it done at e-Mitra first.

demoFields.label: Premium (paid category only)
demoFields.hint: Paid families pay Rs 850 online or in cash at the e-Mitra. The kiosk may not charge anything extra for registering or printing.

demoSteps: Check first: if your family has an NFSA ration card or is in the SECC 2011 list, you are already covered. Just take your Jan Aadhaar or Aadhaar card to the hospital.
Everyone else logs in at sso.rajasthan.gov.in and opens the MAA Yojana registration, or goes to an e-Mitra kiosk with the Jan Aadhaar and Aadhaar.
Choose Free (farmer, contract worker, Covid ex-gratia family) or Paid, then enter the Jan Aadhaar number or its enrolment receipt number and search.
The family list appears. One adult member e-signs with the OTP sent to the mobile linked to their Aadhaar, then fills in the details for the chosen category.
Paid families pay Rs 850. Contract workers' forms are checked online by their department's nodal officer.
Print the policy document. It shows your family's cover; keep it with the Jan Aadhaar card.

At an empanelled hospital, go to the scheme counter, give the Jan Aadhaar or Aadhaar number and verify with your fingerprint. Listed treatment is free, including the tests and medicines from 5 days before admission to 15 days after discharge.
schemes.helpline: 181 — Rajasthan Sampark; 1800-180-6127 — MAA Yojana toll-free complaint line

schemes.title: Rajasthan Housing Board — Flats and Plots
schemes.department: Rajasthan Housing Board
schemes.brief: The Rajasthan Housing Board builds and sells flats and plots across the state's cities, including units set aside for the economically weaker and lower income groups. Registration, the lottery or first-come-first-served booking, instalments and the e-auction of leftover units are all handled on its applicant portal.
schemes.benefit: Board-built flat or plot, with units reserved for EWS and LIG families
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 or above
Income within the limit of the category applied under — EWS, LIG, MIG or HIG
For a reserved-category unit, a Rajasthan caste certificate
One unit per family under the subsidised categories
Allotment is by lottery where a scheme is oversubscribed, otherwise first come first served
