schemes.title: e-Sevai citizen services
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency, Information Technology Department
schemes.brief: Tamil Nadu's single window for community (jaathi), income, nativity, first graduate, residence and legal heir certificates, along with utility payments and department services. Tamil and English. Everything hangs off a CAN, the Citizen Access Number, which is made once and reused for life. Most people go to the nearest e-Sevai Maiyam, the common service centre found in taluk offices and many villages, and the operator files it for a small fixed fee. The VAO verifies and the Tahsildar signs the certificate digitally.
schemes.benefit: Community, income and nativity certificates, digitally signed
eligibility: Resident of Tamil Nadu, applying in the taluk where you live
A CAN number, which is created free at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal
The household known to the Village Administrative Officer, who does the verification
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card or smart card
Proof of residence: electricity bill, property tax receipt or house rent agreement
School transfer certificate, which is the usual proof of community and date of birth
Self-declaration on the format the centre provides, signed
Recent passport photograph
For income: salary certificate for the employed, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage households

demoFields.label: CAN number
demoFields.hint: The Citizen Access Number. If you do not have one, the first step is to create it, free, at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal. Keep it for life; you do not need a new one each time.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar and the school transfer certificate. The certificate prints in Tamil and English.

demoFields.label: Father's or husband's name
demoFields.hint: For a community certificate this is what the record is traced through, so it must match the school transfer certificate.

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Community, income, nativity and first graduate are separate applications. Apply for each one you actually need.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Village
demoFields.hint: This sends the file to the right VAO and Tahsildar. Choosing the wrong taluk means the application is returned.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: From your smart ration card. It is used to confirm the household members.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the last year. For an income certificate the VAO checks this before the Tahsildar signs.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: College admission under the community quota
demoFields.hint: Write what it is for. Admission and scholarship are the commonest reasons and the office is used to them.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the message that your certificate is ready all come here.

demoSteps: Create a CAN number first if you do not already have one. It is free, takes a few minutes at any e-Sevai centre or on the portal, and is used for every service afterwards.
Collect the documents, above all the school transfer certificate, which is what community and date of birth are established from in Tamil Nadu.
Log in to the e-Sevai portal with your CAN and mobile OTP, or take the papers to the nearest e-Sevai Maiyam at the taluk office or in your village.
Choose the department and the service, and fill the form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents, pay the small fixed fee and submit. Keep the acknowledgement receipt with the application number.
The Village Administrative Officer verifies the details, and the Revenue Inspector and Tahsildar act on it in turn.
When it is ready, an SMS comes to your mobile. Download the digitally signed certificate from the portal, or collect the printout from the e-Sevai centre.
Keep a soft copy. Colleges and offices in Tamil Nadu accept the digitally signed certificate as it is, and you can reprint it from your CAN any time.
schemes.helpline: 1100 (Tamil Nadu citizen helpline)

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Social Security Pension (Old Age, Widow and Disability Pension)
schemes.department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Social Security Scheme), Government of Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: A monthly pension from the Tamil Nadu government for poor elderly people, widows, deserted women, unmarried poor women over 50, landless farm workers over 60 and persons with disabilities. Most get Rs 1,200 a month, and persons with disabilities get Rs 1,500, paid into the bank account; the central old-age, widow and disability pensions are included in this amount. You apply online through e-Sevai, yourself or at an e-Sevai centre. The VAO and Revenue Inspector verify the application, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office sanctions it.
schemes.benefit: Rs 1,200 a month (Rs 1,500 for persons with disabilities)
eligibility: Old age pension: aged 60 or above, destitute and from a below-poverty-line family
Widow pension: a destitute widow aged 18 or above
Disability pension: 40% disability or more, aged 18 or above, and unemployed or earning under Rs 3 lakh a year
Also for deserted women aged 30 or above, unmarried poor women aged 50 or above, and landless farm workers aged 60 or above (Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu scheme)
Immovable property worth no more than Rs 1,00,000, not counting a house given free by the government
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration (smart family) card
Age proof, such as a birth certificate, school certificate or a doctor's age certificate
Bank passbook of an account in the applicant's own name
Recent passport-size photo
Husband's death certificate for a widow, or the disability certificate or UDID card for a person with disability

Choose the Revenue Department social security pension service, pick the right scheme, fill in the details and upload the documents.
Submit and keep the application number from the receipt or SMS.
The VAO and the Revenue Inspector visit or call to check your age, income and property, and the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office decides.
Once sanctioned, the pension is paid into your bank account every month. You can check the status on e-Sevai with the application number.
If it is rejected or delayed, meet the Special Tahsildar (Social Security Scheme) at the taluk office, or complain on the 1100 helpline.

schemes.title: New Electricity Service Connection — TNPDCL
schemes.department: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (TNPDCL), the former TANGEDCO distribution wing
schemes.brief: A new electricity connection for a house, a shop, a workshop or a farm pump is applied for online on the NSC Online portal, without going to the section office first. The application is filed, the fee paid and the reference number issued on the site; the section officer then inspects the premises and raises the demand. Distribution has been split out of TANGEDCO into TNPDCL, so the old tangedco.org site now only shows a migration notice.
schemes.benefit: New LT service connection, with online application, fee payment and status tracking
eligibility: Premises inside Tamil Nadu, in the area of a TNPDCL section office
Applicant must own the premises or have the owner's written consent
Connected load up to 150 kW is an LT connection; anything larger is an HT application
House wiring must be finished and tested by a licensed wiring contractor before the inspection
There must be no unpaid electricity dues standing against the same premises
documents: Proof of ownership — patta, registered sale deed or the latest property tax receipt
Owner's written consent and the rent agreement, if you are a tenant
Aadhaar card or another photo ID of the applicant
Wiring completion and test report from a licensed wiring contractor
Approved building plan, for a new building
Passport-size photograph of the applicant
The service connection number of a neighbouring service, which helps the section office locate the premises
schemes.portalName: NSC Online — TNPDCL new service connection portal

demoFields.label: District / Circle / Section Office
demoFields.hint: The section office that covers the street where the meter is to be fixed, not where you live now.

demoFields.hint: The full door number and street of the building needing supply. The inspecting officer comes to this address.

demoFields.value: Patta 1176, Survey 142/3B, Coimbatore Corporation property tax assessment 27-0045-2210
demoFields.hint: Give the document you are uploading — patta, sale deed or tax receipt — with its number.

demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The service connection can also be Aadhaar-seeded later from the TNPDCL online services page.

demoFields.hint: The Application Reference Number, the inspection visit and the demand notice all come here by SMS.

demoFields.label: Email Address
demoFields.hint: The copy of the application and the payment receipt are emailed here.

demoFields.hint: Write it down. It is also your username on the payment portal, with the registered mobile number as the password.

demoSteps: Get the wiring finished and the contractor's test report ready first — the connection is held up at inspection without it.
Open app1.tangedco.org/nsconline, register with your mobile number and email, and fill the application, choosing the correct district, circle and section.
Upload the ownership proof, the ID proof and the wiring test report, pay the registration fee online, and save the Application Reference Number.
The section officer inspects the premises, usually within a few days, and then raises the demand for the deposit and service charges.
Pay the demand on the consumer portal at www.tnebnet.org/awp/login, using the Application Reference Number as the username and the registered mobile number as the password.
The meter is fixed and supply given after the payment clears, and you receive the service connection number — keep it, every future bill and complaint runs on it.

schemes.title: Rythu Bharosa (Rs.12,000 per Acre for Farmers)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture & Cooperation, Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana gives farmers Rs.12,000 per acre a year for crop costs, paid as Rs.6,000 per acre before each season (Vanakalam and Yasangi) straight into the farmer's bank account. Rythu Bharosa replaced the old Rythu Bandhu scheme from 26 January 2025. Every pattadar whose farmland is recorded in Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) is included automatically, with no new application each season. A new farmer, or one whose money is not coming, gives bank and passbook details to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of the cluster.
schemes.benefit: Rs.12,000 per acre a year (Rs.6,000 per acre each season)
eligibility: Pattadar (land owner) whose farmland is recorded in the Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) land records
Tribal farmers holding forest-rights (ROFR) pattas are also eligible
Money is paid only for land fit for farming. House plots, layouts, real-estate ventures, mines, roads and land taken for projects are left out
A bank account in the farmer's own name, linked with Aadhaar
Tenant farmers are not covered. Landless farm labourers have a separate scheme (Indiramma Atmiya Bharosa)
documents: Pattadar passbook (PPB), copy
Aadhaar card
Bank passbook front page with account number and IFSC
Mobile number
Aadhaar consent form, signed (the AEO gives it)
Mutation / Bhu Bharati record if the land was bought or inherited recently
schemes.submitAt: Give the filled Rythu Bharosa Bank Details Collection Form to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of your cluster at the Rythu Vedika, or at the Mandal Agriculture Office. Attach copies of the pattadar passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook, and sign the Aadhaar consent form. The AEO checks the details, signs the form and uploads it on the Rythu Bharosa portal. AEO mobile numbers are under Contact Us on rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in.

demoFields.hint: The bank's SMS for each payment comes to this number.

demoFields.hint: The bank where you want the money.

demoFields.hint: As printed in the bank passbook.

demoSteps: Make sure your land is correctly recorded in Bhu Bharati and you have the pattadar passbook. Mutation of bought or inherited land must be finished first.
Get the Bank Details Collection Form from the AEO, or download it. Fill in your name, Aadhaar, passbook number, mobile number and bank details, and sign it.
Give it to the AEO at your Rythu Vedika with copies of the passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The AEO checks and uploads it on the portal.
Before each season the government releases the money, usually to small holdings first and then to larger ones. Rs.6,000 per acre is credited to your account by DBT.
Check the bank SMS or your passbook. If neighbours were paid and you were not, ask the AEO to check your status on the portal. The usual reasons are an Aadhaar-bank mismatch or a closed account.
If the problem stays, complain to the Mandal Agriculture Officer, then to the District Agriculture Officer or the Collector's grievance cell.

schemes.title: Telangana Construction Workers Registration (BOCW Labour Card)
schemes.department: Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department
schemes.brief: A construction worker registered with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board gets an identity card and the board's benefits: Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident, Rs.1 lakh on natural death, up to Rs.5 lakh for permanent disability, Rs.30,000 for the marriage of a woman worker or of up to two daughters, and Rs.30,000 for each of up to two deliveries. Masons, helpers, painters, carpenters, plumbers, electricians, brick-kiln and road workers and over 50 other trades can register. Fill Form XXVII and give it at the Assistant Labour Officer's office with a work certificate and the Rs.50 fee; membership then costs Rs.12 a year.
schemes.benefit: Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident; Rs.30,000 each for marriage and for delivery
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years

Keeps membership renewed (Rs.12 a year or Rs.60 for five years) to stay eligible for benefits

Hand in the filled Form XXVII with two photos and copies of your Aadhaar, ration card, voter ID, bank passbook, age proof and the 90-day work certificate. Pay Rs.50 registration plus Rs.12 for one year or Rs.60 for five years. To renew, pay by challan at any SBI branch and give the challan copy to the same ALO. demoSteps: Download Form XXVII from tbocwwb.telangana.gov.in (Downloads) or get it at the ALO office, and fill it in Telugu or English.
Get the 90-day work certificate. The ALO can check your work at the site, or your union or builder can certify it.
Hand in the form with photos and copies at the ALO office and pay Rs.50 + Rs.12 (or Rs.60 for five years). Keep the receipt.
After the ALO checks your details, you get a registration number and the construction worker's identity card. You can check it under Search Registered Workers on the board's site.
Renew every year, or every five years, by SBI challan and give the challan copy to the ALO. Benefits stop if your membership lapses.

To claim marriage, maternity, accident or death help, download the claim form from the board site and give it at the ALO office with your card and proof. Track it with Check Claim Status. The money is paid to your bank account.
schemes.helpline: TBOCWW Board customer care 080-69434343; Board office 040-23447738 / 040-23447739; your Assistant Labour Officer

schemes.title: Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Scheme (Aarogyasri Card)
schemes.department: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, Telangana
schemes.brief: Free treatment worth up to Rs.10 lakh a year per family for serious illnesses and operations, such as heart, cancer, kidney, brain and accident cases, covering about 1,835 listed treatments, at government hospitals and at private hospitals that have joined the scheme (network hospitals) in Telangana. Treatment is cashless: the Aarogyasri Trust pays the hospital, not you. There is no form to fill: your white ration card (Food Security Card) is your proof, and the Aarogyamitra at the hospital desk registers you on the spot.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.10 lakh a year per family, cashless, for listed treatments
eligibility: Families holding a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card), or an Aarogyasri health card already issued to the family
Every member named on the card is covered: head of family, spouse, children and dependent parents
Orphan children are being given their own Aarogyasri cards through the Women & Child Welfare Department
Only treatments on the Aarogyasri list are covered, at a government or network hospital. Ordinary OPD visits are not covered
Government employees and pensioners are not covered here. They use the separate Employees Health Scheme (EHS)
documents: Food Security Card (white ration card) or Aarogyasri health card, the original
Aadhaar card of the patient (the original, for fingerprint or face check)
Mobile number for updates
Old prescriptions, scan and test reports, if you have any
Referral letter from a PHC, government hospital or health camp, if you have one
schemes.submitAt: Go to the Aarogyamitra help desk (Aarogyasri counter) at any government hospital (Area, District or Teaching hospital) or at an Aarogyasri network private hospital. The Aarogyamitra at your PHC can tell you which hospitals are in the scheme. Take the original white ration card or Aarogyasri card, the patient's Aadhaar and any old reports. The Aarogyamitra checks the card online, takes the patient's photo and fingerprint, and registers the case. For a listed treatment, you pay nothing at any stage.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your white ration card. Once the Aarogyamitra types it in, everyone on the card comes up.

demoFields.label: Patient name (as on the card)
demoFields.hint: Must match the name on the ration card. If the spelling differs, show your Aadhaar as well.

demoFields.label: Relation to head of family
demoFields.hint: How the patient is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Patient Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The fingerprint or face check is done on this Aadhaar, so bring the original card.

demoFields.label: Age / gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Updates about approval and discharge come to this number.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Complaint / illness
demoFields.hint: Say it in your own words. The doctor writes down the illness after checking the patient.

demoFields.label: Hospital / department
demoFields.hint: Filled in by the Aarogyamitra according to the department you are sent to.

demoSteps: Keep the white ration card and the patient's Aadhaar ready. If you are not sure a hospital is in Aarogyasri, ask the Aarogyamitra at your PHC or call 104.
At the hospital, go to the Aarogyamitra desk first, not the cash counter. Show the card. The Aarogyamitra registers the patient online, with a photo and fingerprint.
The doctor examines the patient and orders tests. If the treatment is on the list, the hospital asks the Aarogyasri Trust online for approval (pre-authorisation).
Approval usually comes within hours, and at once in an emergency. The Aarogyamitra tells you when it is approved.
The operation, medicines and hospital stay are free. Do not pay any money. If anyone asks you to pay, refuse and call 104.
At discharge, sign the discharge papers and collect your medicines and the date of your follow-up visit. Follow-up check-ups for the same treatment are also free.
schemes.helpline: Aarogyasri call centre 104; Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Hyderabad 040-23547107

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
schemes.department: Energy Department, Telangana: TGSPDCL, TGNPDCL and CESS Sircilla
schemes.brief: Your home gets a zero electricity bill for every month it uses 200 units or less. It covers one home connection for each family with a white ration card linked to Aadhaar, and the bill stays in the house owner's name, so tenants get it too. If a month's use goes above 200 units, the whole month's bill must be paid, not only the extra units. Families who applied in Praja Palana were added automatically; others apply at the MPDO or municipal office.
schemes.benefit: Zero bill for every month the home uses 200 units or less
eligibility: Family holds a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card) linked with Aadhaar
One home (domestic) electricity connection per family. The house can be rented
The application is entered in the Praja Palana portal with the ration card and the connection's USC number
The connection is used only for the home. Using it for a shop or business is an offence
Monthly use is 200 units or less. Above 200 units the full bill is payable for that month
documents: Latest electricity bill showing the USC (unique service connection) number
Food Security Card (white ration card)
Aadhaar card of the head of the family
Mobile number
Praja Palana receipt number, if you applied earlier
schemes.submitAt: Give the Praja Palana (Gruha Jyothi) application at the Praja Palana counter in your MPDO office (villages) or the municipal office or GHMC circle office (towns). Attach copies of the white ration card, Aadhaar and the latest electricity bill showing the USC number. If you applied before but still get a bill, ask the same office to correct the ration card or USC number in Praja Palana. Take the receipt and show it at your electricity section office (AE office).

demoFields.label: Head of family name
demoFields.hint: As on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card number
demoFields.hint: From the white ration card. Without it the scheme cannot be linked.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you use.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: The address where this electricity connection is.

demoFields.label: Monthly power consumption (units)
demoFields.hint: See 'units consumed' on your bill. Only months of 200 units or less get a zero bill.

demoFields.label: Electricity service connection (USC) number
demoFields.hint: The USC number printed on the bill, not the meter number. One mistake here and the zero bill does not come.

demoFields.label: Name on the electricity bill
demoFields.hint: If you rent, this can be the owner's name. The name on the bill is not changed.

demoSteps: Find the USC number on your latest electricity bill, and keep the white ration card and Aadhaar ready.
Go to the Praja Palana counter at the MPDO or municipal office. Fill the form with the units you use and the USC number, attach copies and take the receipt.
The office enters it in the Praja Palana portal, and the power company links your ration card to your connection.
From the next billing month, the meter reader gives a zero bill whenever the month's use is 200 units or less.
Watch your use. If it crosses 200 units, that whole month's bill must be paid. The zero bill comes back the next month you stay within 200.
Still getting a bill? Take the receipt to your electricity section (AE) office, or call 1912, and ask them to link your connection.
schemes.helpline: Electricity complaints 1912; TGNPDCL toll free 1800-425-0028; your MPDO or municipal office for the application

schemes.title: Mahalakshmi (Free Bus Travel for Women and Rs.500 Gas Cylinder)
schemes.department: Government of Telangana: TGSRTC (free bus) and Civil Supplies Department (gas subsidy)
schemes.brief: Under Mahalakshmi, one of Telangana's six guarantees, since 9 December 2023 women, girls and transgender persons living in Telangana have travelled free in TGSRTC Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary and Metro Express buses: show an ID and take the zero ticket. Families with a white ration card who applied through Praja Palana get each LPG cylinder for Rs.500: you pay the full price on delivery and the rest comes back to your bank account. The promised Rs.2,500 a month for women heads of family has not started yet, and there is no application open for it (October 2026).
schemes.benefit: Free state bus travel for women; LPG cylinder for Rs.500
eligibility: Free bus: any woman, girl or transgender person living in Telangana, of any age or income, for travel within Telangana
Free bus is valid in Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary and Metro Express buses, not in Deluxe, Super Luxury or AC buses
Rs.500 gas: the family holds a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card)
Rs.500 gas: the family has an active domestic LPG connection and applied for this in Praja Palana or later at the MPDO / municipal office
Rs.500 gas: the number of cylinders is limited to what the family used on average in the last three years
documents: Bus: Aadhaar card or any government photo ID with a Telangana address (voter ID, driving licence)
Gas: Food Security Card (white ration card)
Gas: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Gas: gas consumer book or latest cylinder bill showing the consumer number and agency
Gas: bank passbook of the account linked to the gas connection
Gas: Praja Palana receipt number, if you applied earlier
schemes.submitAt: Free bus: there is nothing to apply for. Get into a Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary or Metro Express bus, show your Aadhaar or other Telangana ID to the conductor and take the zero-fare Mahalakshmi ticket. Rs.500 gas: if your family was left out, fill the Praja Palana application (tick Mahalakshmi, Rs.500 gas cylinder) at the Praja Palana counter in your MPDO office (villages) or municipal / GHMC circle office (towns). Attach copies of the white ration card, Aadhaar, gas consumer book and bank passbook, and keep the receipt with the application number.

demoFields.label: Applicant name (woman of the house)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The applicant's own 12-digit Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card (Food Security Card) number
demoFields.hint: From your white ration card. The gas benefit is given only with a white card.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you use. Messages about the application come here.

demoFields.label: Address (as per Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: House number, ward or village, mandal and district.

demoFields.label: Mahalakshmi: choose benefit
demoFields.hint: Tick the Rs.500 gas cylinder box. The Rs.2,500 box is on the form, but that payment has not started.

demoFields.label: Gas connection number
demoFields.hint: The consumer number printed in your gas book or on the cylinder bill.

demoFields.label: Gas company / agency name
demoFields.value: HP Gas, Sri Sai Gas Agency, Wyra
demoFields.hint: The company (HP, Bharat or Indane) and the agency that delivers to you.

demoFields.label: Cylinders used in a year
demoFields.hint: About how many cylinders your family uses in a year. The subsidy is limited to your average use.

demoSteps: Free bus: board a Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary or Metro Express bus, show your Aadhaar or other Telangana ID to the conductor and take the zero ticket. Girls of any age travel free too.
Rs.500 gas: check that your white ration card is linked with Aadhaar and that your gas connection is active.

If you did not apply in Praja Palana, fill the form at the MPDO or municipal office. Tick Rs.500 gas cylinder, write the gas consumer number, the company and how many cylinders you use a year, attach copies and take the receipt.
Officials check the ration card and gas connection. Your name is then added to the Mahalakshmi gas list that goes to the oil companies.
Book the cylinder as usual and pay the full price to the delivery person.
Within a few days, the amount above Rs.500 is credited to the bank account linked to your gas connection. If it does not come, ask at the gas agency and the MPDO office.
schemes.helpline: TGSRTC enquiry 040-69440000 / 040-23450033; Civil Supplies toll free 1967 (gas subsidy and ration card)

schemes.title: Bhu Bharati — Telangana Land Records and Mutation
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Bhu Bharati is where a Telangana farmer sees the Record of Rights and the Pahani for their land, and applies for a mutation when land is sold or inherited. It replaces the older Dharani system under the Record of Rights Act, 2025, and all agricultural land services now run through it.
schemes.benefit: Record of Rights and Pahani online, with mutation, correction and pattadar passbook services
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Telangana and recorded in the Record of Rights
The applicant must be the recorded pattadar, or a legal heir, to apply for a mutation
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile, since every application is confirmed by OTP
Anyone may view a Record of Rights; only the holder can change one
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Existing pattadar passbook
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on sale
Death certificate and legal heir certificate, for a mutation on succession
Survey number and khata number of the land
Passport photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: View Record of Rights, mutation on sale (Form V), mutation on succession (Form VI), correction, or pattadar passbook. Pick the one that fits what happened to the land.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it exactly from the pattadar passbook or an old Pahani, including any letter at the end.

demoFields.label: Khata / Pattadar Account Number
demoFields.hint: Covers all your survey numbers in that one village, so it is the quicker way in if you hold several plots.

demoFields.label: Pattadar Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may not match Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling first, then ask for a correction if it is wrong.

demoFields.label: Applicant's Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the person applying. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: Relation to the recorded holder
demoFields.hint: For a succession mutation, state the relationship and attach the legal heir certificate and death certificate.

demoFields.label: Extent claimed (acres / guntas)
demoFields.hint: As on the passbook. A figure that does not match the record is the usual reason a mutation is held up.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the hearing notice and the final order all come here.

demoSteps: Open bhubharati.telangana.gov.in and view the Record of Rights and Pahani for your survey number. Check the extent, the pattadar name and the classification before you apply for anything.
Choose the service you need — Form V for a mutation after a sale, Form VI after a death in the family — and log in with Aadhaar and OTP.
Fill in the survey number, the extent and the parties, and upload the registered sale deed, or the death certificate and legal heir certificate.
Pay the fee online and keep the application number. Where a registration is involved, book the Sub-Registrar slot from the same system.
The Tahsildar examines it, and both sides may be called for a hearing where there is an objection. Attend, with the originals.
Once the order is passed, the Record of Rights is updated and a new pattadar passbook is issued. Download the updated record and check the extent and spelling at once.
Keep the updated Record of Rights with your papers. Rythu Bharosa, crop loans and farm subsidy applications are all matched against it.
schemes.helpline: Your mandal Tahsildar's office

schemes.title: Telangana ePASS — Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement
schemes.department: Social, BC, Tribal and Minority Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana pays the college tuition fee of SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and disabled students straight to the institution, and a maintenance amount to the student. Both run through ePASS, applied for fresh in the first year and renewed every year after that.
schemes.benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement paid to the college, plus a monthly maintenance allowance
eligibility: Student of Telangana studying an approved course in a recognised institution
SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority or disabled category with a valid caste certificate
Family income within the limit for the category, on a current income certificate
Admitted through the notified counselling; a management-quota seat is usually outside the scheme
Attendance kept up through the year — the sanction is stopped for a student who has left
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate number issued in Telangana
Income certificate number, issued within the last year
Bonafide certificate from the college
Admission or allotment letter from counselling
Bank passbook in the student's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Class 10 and Class 12 marks memos

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Student
demoFields.hint: The student's own, not a parent's. The maintenance money goes into the Aadhaar-seeded account behind it.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The college record and the bank record must agree or the payment fails.

demoFields.label: Caste Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: The number on your Telangana caste certificate. The portal checks it against the revenue database, so type it, do not guess.

demoFields.label: Income Certificate Number
demoFields.hint: Must have been issued within the last year. An expired income certificate is the single commonest cause of rejection.

demoFields.label: Course, Year and College
demoFields.value: B.Pharmacy, 2nd year, Kakatiya Government College, Warangal
demoFields.hint: Pick the college from the portal's list. If it is not listed, the college has not registered on ePASS and must do so first.

demoFields.label: Admission / Allotment Number
demoFields.hint: From the counselling allotment letter.

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: Fresh for the first year of a course, renewal for every year after. Choosing the wrong one sends the file back.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the student's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. A parent's account is why maintenance money bounces.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Sanction and payment messages come here. Use a number the student keeps through the course.

demoSteps: Get a fresh income certificate and the caste certificate from MeeSeva first. ePASS validates both numbers, so an expired income certificate stops the application dead.
Register on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in with Aadhaar and mobile, confirm the OTP, and choose Fresh or Renewal for the current year.
Fill in the course, the college from the portal's list and your own Aadhaar-seeded bank account, then upload the bonafide certificate and marks memos.
Submit, note the application number, and take the printout to the college scholarship section — the college must verify and forward it before anything moves.
The welfare department sanctions it; the tuition fee goes to the college and the maintenance to your account by DBT. Track both on the portal.
Apply again every year of the course with a fresh income certificate. Renewal is not automatic, and missing the window costs that year's money.
schemes.helpline: Your college scholarship section, or the district welfare office

schemes.title: TGPSC Recruitment — One Time Registration
schemes.department: Telangana Public Service Commission
schemes.brief: Every Telangana state government post advertised by the Public Service Commission — Group 1, 2, 3 and 4, engineering, lecturer and forest posts — is applied for through one profile called OTR. You build it once, and each notification afterwards takes only minutes. The commission was renamed from TSPSC to TGPSC, and the old addresses now redirect here.
schemes.benefit: One registration for every TGPSC notification, with hall tickets and results in the same place
eligibility: Indian citizen meeting the age limits in the notification, usually 18 to 44 with relaxation for SC, ST, BC and disability
The qualification the notification requires, held on its closing date
Local status in Telangana where the post is reserved for local candidates
One OTR profile per person; a second profile gets both cancelled
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Degree or diploma certificates and marks memos
Caste certificate, for a reserved category
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Study certificates for Classes 4 to 10, to prove local status
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Every later certificate is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after the profile is made.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one profile.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a certificate for. Age relaxation and fee concession both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Local Status (district)
demoFields.hint: Decided by where you studied Classes 4 to 10. Many posts are reserved for locals of a zone.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: Course, university, year of passing and marks. It must be complete on the notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: OTR Number (after registration)
demoFields.hint: Generated once and used for every application afterwards. Write it down.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Every notification alert and the hall ticket link come here. Do not use a friend's number.

demoSteps: Open otr.tgpsc.gov.in and create the One Time Registration with your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate. This is the part that cannot be freely corrected later.
Fill in education, category, local status and identity, upload the photograph and signature, and confirm the mobile OTP. Note down the OTR number.
When a notification you qualify for is out, open it from tgpsc.gov.in, log in with the OTR number, and apply — the profile fills most of the form.
Pay the application and examination fees online. SC, ST, BC, disabled, ex-servicemen and unemployed candidates are exempt from the examination fee on producing the certificate.
Keep the filled application printout and the payment receipt, and download the hall ticket about a week before the exam from the same login.
Results, answer keys and the selection list appear on the TGPSC site. Certificate verification follows the written stage, where the originals of everything you claimed must be produced.
Keep the OTR profile up to date. A qualification or category that is out of date on the closing date is treated as a false claim and the candidature is cancelled.
schemes.helpline: 040-23542185 — TGPSC helpdesk

schemes.title: Indiramma Indlu — Telangana House Construction Assistance
schemes.department: Housing Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana pays a poor family to build its own pucca house on its own plot, released in instalments as the construction reaches each stage. Families without any house of their own are chosen at the village level, and the money goes straight into the beneficiary's bank account.
schemes.benefit: House construction assistance paid in stage-wise instalments into the beneficiary's account
eligibility: Family resident in Telangana holding a Food Security Card and owning no pucca house anywhere
The applicant must own the plot, or be allotted government land, in his or her own name
Household within the state's income limit and not a government employee or income-tax payer
One house per family; a family that has taken housing assistance before is not eligible again
Priority for houseless, SC, ST and women-headed families
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Proof of the plot — sale deed, pattadar passbook, or the government allotment order
Property tax receipt or Panchayat record for the plot
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Passport photograph and a photograph of the vacant plot

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The sanction and every instalment are issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The status of your application can be checked on the portal with this alone.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's card. The household's eligibility is judged on it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the plot is. The village-level list is drawn up here.

demoFields.label: Plot details — survey number and extent
demoFields.value: Survey 88/2, 120 square yards, patta in applicant's name
demoFields.hint: The plot must be in your own name. Assistance is not released for building on someone else's land.

demoFields.label: Do you own a pucca house anywhere?
demoFields.value: No — living in a thatched house
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. It is checked against property and municipal records, and a false answer cancels the sanction and recovers the money.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It must be within the state's limit for the scheme.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name and Aadhaar-seeded. Every instalment lands here.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Selection, sanction and each instalment are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Check first that the plot is in your own name and that no one in the family owns a pucca house. Both are verified later against records, and a wrong claim ends the case.
Apply on indirammaindlu.telangana.gov.in, or through your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office during the enrolment drive announced for your village.
Enter your Aadhaar, Food Security Card, plot details and bank account, and upload the plot proof and the photograph of the vacant site.
Keep the application number. Beneficiary status can be checked on the portal by Aadhaar, mobile, application number or Food Security Card number.
The Gram Sabha or ward meeting approves the village list, and the housing officials verify the plot and the family's circumstances.

Once sanctioned, build in stages. Each instalment is released after an officer photographs and certifies that the stage — foundation, walls, roof — is complete, so do not wait for the whole amount up front.
If something goes wrong, use the grievance option on the portal or the helpline, quoting the application number.
schemes.helpline: 1800 599 5991 — Indiramma Indlu helpline

schemes.title: Telangana Income Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: The Tahsildar's certificate stating a family's yearly income, needed for scholarships, fee reimbursement, welfare schemes and EWS claims in Telangana. It is applied for through MeeSeva, either at a MeeSeva centre or online, and it is valid for one year.
schemes.benefit: Income certificate signed digitally by the Tahsildar, valid one year
eligibility: Resident of Telangana, applying in the mandal where the family lives
Applied for by the head of the family, covering the whole household's income
Aadhaar linked to a working mobile number, since every step is confirmed by OTP
A fresh certificate is needed each year; an expired one is refused by every office
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, property tax receipt or rent agreement
Salary certificate or Form 16, for a salaried applicant
Pahani or ROR extract, where the income is from farming
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Your own twelve digits. The OTP goes to the mobile linked to it, so it must be a number in your hand.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate is printed from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to separate families with the same surname in one village.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. Your mandal Tahsildar signs the certificate, so this decides where the file goes.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's earnings for the year from every source. It is cross-checked against land, vehicle and electricity records, so an understated figure gets the file rejected.

demoFields.label: Source of Income
demoFields.value: Farming on two acres and a tailoring shop
demoFields.hint: Name the work of every earning member, not only the head's.

demoFields.label: Caste / Category
demoFields.hint: As on your caste certificate. It is printed on the income certificate and checked against welfare quotas later.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. The office pulls up the rest of the family's details from it.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: ePASS scholarship for my son's B.Tech
demoFields.hint: Say plainly what it is for. It is recorded but does not limit where the certificate can be used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready-to-download message arrive here by SMS.

demoSteps: Open the MeeSeva portal or walk into any MeeSeva centre and ask for the Income Certificate service. The centre charges only the notified fee, which is printed on the receipt.
Fill the form with names and the village exactly as on Aadhaar and the Food Security Card, and state the household income honestly.
Upload or hand over Aadhaar, the Food Security Card, the address proof and any salary or land proof.
Pay the fee and take the acknowledgement with its application number. The same number comes by SMS and is how you track the file.
The Village Revenue Officer or the mandal staff verify the family, usually within a week, and may call or visit.
The Tahsildar signs it digitally, normally within 7 to 15 days, and you download it from MeeSeva or collect it at the centre. A digitally signed copy needs no further attestation.
If the time passes with nothing happening, quote the application number to the Tahsildar's office, and use the grievance link on the MeeSeva portal.
schemes.helpline: 1100 — Telangana citizen call centre

schemes.title: Aasara Pension — Telangana Social Security Pension
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Aasara is Telangana's monthly pension for old people, widows, people with disability, beedi workers, single women, weavers, toddy tappers and several other groups. It is sanctioned by the district administration and paid by DBT into the pensioner's own account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension, with a higher rate for people with disability
eligibility: Resident of Telangana, in a household that meets the state's income and land limits
Age 57 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for widow, disability or single-woman pension
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by the district medical board, for the Divyangula pension
Death certificate of the husband, for the widow pension
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Food Security Card of the family
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school record
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a disability pension
Bank or post office passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Two passport-size photographs

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow, differently abled, beedi worker, single woman, weaver, toddy tapper, AIDS patient or filaria patient. Each has its own conditions and rate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for a widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: There is no minimum age for the widow pension. For the old-age pension you must be 57 or above on the date of application.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly life check both run on this.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the family's card. The household's eligibility is checked against it.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The MPDO or Municipal Commissioner of this mandal sanctions the pension.

demoFields.label: Supporting certificate number
demoFields.hint: The death certificate for a widow pension, or the disability certificate number and percentage for a disability pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Sanction and every month's credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Collect the papers the pension type needs — the death certificate for a widow pension, the medical board's disability certificate for a disability pension — before starting.
Apply on the Aasara portal, or through your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office, which files it for you free.
Fill in the details from Aadhaar and the Food Security Card and give a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-seeded.
Take the acknowledgement with its application number; every follow-up runs on it.
The Panchayat Secretary or ward staff verify the applicant at home, and the household is checked against the state's income and land limits.
The MPDO or Municipal Commissioner sanctions it, usually within 30 to 60 days, and the money reaches the account by DBT each month.
Do the yearly life certificate when asked, or the pension is stopped. If the application is refused, the reason is shown on the portal and can be corrected and filed again.
schemes.helpline: Your Gram Panchayat or municipal ward office; district Rural Development office for sanction status

schemes.title: Telangana Food Security Card
schemes.department: Civil Supplies Department, Government of Telangana
schemes.brief: Telangana's ration card is called the Food Security Card. It brings subsidised fine rice from the fair price shop and is the household record most state schemes check first. New cards are filed through MeeSeva; the EPDS portal is where you add or remove a member, do the Aadhaar e-KYC and check the status.
schemes.benefit: Subsidised fine rice at the fair price shop, and the household record used across state schemes
eligibility: Family resident in Telangana and not holding a ration card anywhere else in India
Household within the state's limits on land, income, vehicle ownership and government service
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded and the e-KYC completed, or that member draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or rent agreement
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where a member or the family has moved
Marriage certificate, for a bride being added
Birth certificate, for a newborn being added
Gas connection number and a bank passbook copy

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.value: Add a member to an existing card
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, split a card or correct a detail. A brand new card is filed at a MeeSeva centre; the rest can be done on EPDS.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's own Aadhaar, and how she or he is related to the head.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.value: Marriage on 03-03-2026; deletion certificate from parents' card at Siddipet

demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address and the inspector verifies here.

demoSteps: For a new card, go to a MeeSeva centre with every member's Aadhaar and the address proof; for adding or removing a name, open epds.telangana.gov.in and use the Food Security Card services.
List every member who eats from the same kitchen, each with the exact Aadhaar. The rice is counted per name, so a missing member costs the family every month.
Attach the address proof and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the previous card — without it the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Pay the notified fee at the centre and keep the acknowledgement with its application number.
The Village Revenue Officer or the civil supplies inspector verifies the household at your address.
Once approved, complete the new member's Aadhaar e-KYC on the ePoS machine at your fair price shop. The family's quantity does not increase until this is done.
Check the card and the month's issue on EPDS. If rice was drawn in your name but you did not get it, raise it with the Tahsildar and the Civil Supplies toll free number at once.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Civil Supplies toll free

schemes.title: Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam (Rs.1,00,116 Marriage Help)
schemes.department: SC Development, Tribal Welfare and BC Welfare Departments, Telangana
schemes.brief: The Telangana government gives a one-time Rs.1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family, or Rs.1,25,145 if the bride has a disability. The money is paid into the bride's mother's bank account. Apply after the wedding on the Telangana ePASS site, yourself or at a MeeSeva centre, then take the printout and documents to the Tahsildar's office for checking. Brides from minority communities apply under Shaadi Mubarak instead.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,00,116 one time (Rs.1,25,145 for a bride with a disability)
eligibility: The bride is from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family and lives in Telangana
Parents' total income: SC and ST up to Rs.2,00,000 a year; BC and EBC up to Rs.2,00,000 in towns and Rs.1,50,000 in villages
The bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21 on the wedding day
Only for the bride's first marriage
The bride's mother needs a bank account in her own name. A bride whose parents have died uses her own account
documents: Aadhaar of the bride, her mother and the groom
Caste-cum-nativity certificate and income certificate from MeeSeva (you enter their numbers in the form)
Bride's age proof: SSC hall ticket number, or a birth certificate
Marriage certificate (registration), one wedding photo, and the wedding card if available
First-marriage confirmation certificate and the VRO / Panchayat Secretary certificate
Bank passbooks of the bride's mother and the bride
Bride's photo; SADAREM disability certificate if the bride has a disability

demoFields.label: SSC or equivalent details available / Hall ticket no.

demoFields.hint: Number on the MeeSeva income certificate. The name, mandal and income then fill in by themselves.

demoFields.hint: An account in the mother's own name, with IFSC. The money is paid here.

demoFields.label: Name of the bride groom / Date of birth
demoFields.hint: He must have been 21 or older on the wedding day.

demoFields.label: Date and place of marriage / registration

demoFields.hint: From the marriage registration certificate.

demoSteps: Get the caste-cum-nativity and income certificates from MeeSeva and register the marriage. Scan every document from the original (JPG, 50 to 150 KB).
Open telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in, go to Kalyana Lakshmi and click Registration, or ask a MeeSeva centre to apply for you.

Fill in the bride's details, the mother's bank details, the groom's details and the marriage details, and enter the MeeSeva certificate numbers. Upload the files and submit, then note the application ID and print it.
Take the printout and copies of the documents to the Tahsildar (MRO) office. The Revenue Inspector checks them and the RDO approves.
Track the application with Print/Status on the same page. If there is an objection, correct it through Edit/Uploads.
After sanction, the money is released to the bride's mother's bank account. The local MLA often hands over the sanction at a programme.
schemes.helpline: ePASS technical help 040-23120311 / 040-23120312 (10:30 am to 5 pm, working days); your Tahsildar office or District SC / BC / Tribal Welfare Officer

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Konya Bibaha Yojana (MKBY, Girls' Marriage Help)
schemes.department: Social Welfare & Social Education Department, Government of Tripura
schemes.brief: Tripura gives Rs.50,000 once for the marriage of a girl from an Antyodaya (poorest) family, when the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21. Up to two girls in one family can get it. You apply at the CDPO office, which checks the papers and sends them to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate within 15 days. The SDM pays once the marriage is confirmed and registered. The scheme was notified in August 2025 and covers about 2,000 girls a year.
schemes.benefit: Rs.50,000 once, for each eligible girl (up to two girls per family)
eligibility: The bride must be 18 or older and the groom 21 or older on the date of marriage
The bride's family must be in the state's Antyodaya database (Antyodaya ration card)
The bride must be a permanent resident of Tripura (PRTC holder)
Neither bride nor groom may have a living spouse, unless the earlier marriage was legally dissolved by divorce
Help is given once per girl, for at most two girls in a family
The marriage is registered at the venue or right after it
documents: Aadhaar card and PRTC of the bride
Age proof of the bride (birth certificate or school leaving certificate)
Antyodaya ration card of the bride's family
Aadhaar card and address proof of the groom
Age proof of the groom
Passport-size photographs of bride and groom
Self-declaration on marital status, signed by both bride and groom (form attached)
Bride's bank account details
schemes.portalName: Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Tripura
schemes.submitAt: The Child Development Project Office (CDPO) of the ICDS project where the bride lives. Hand in the filled form with photocopies of every document and the self-declaration signed by both bride and groom, and keep the originals to show. The CDPO forwards it to the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) within 15 days. If you are refused, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector, who must decide within 10 days.

demoFields.hint: Capital letters, exactly as on her Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's / Guardian's name
demoFields.hint: The parent or guardian named on the ration card.

demoFields.hint: The money is paid into the bride's own account, so give her account number and IFSC.

demoFields.label: PRTC number
demoFields.hint: The bride's Permanent Resident of Tripura Certificate. Attach a copy.

demoFields.label: Age and date of birth of bride
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or more on the wedding day. Attach the birth or school leaving certificate.

demoFields.label: Name of the groom
demoFields.hint: As written on the groom's Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Age and date of birth of groom
demoFields.hint: He must be 21 or more on the wedding day.

demoFields.label: Date and venue of marriage (if already held)
demoFields.hint: Fill this only if the wedding has already taken place. The SDM confirms the marriage before paying.

demoSteps: Download the form or ask for it at your CDPO office, and get both bride and groom to sign the self-declaration.
Submit the form with all the photocopies at the CDPO office of the bride's area and take an acknowledgement.
The CDPO checks eligibility and sends the application to the SDM within 15 days.
The marriage is registered, either at a mass marriage event held by the SDM or on its own, and the SDM confirms it.
After confirmation, Rs.50,000 is sanctioned and paid into the bride's bank account.
If the application is rejected, appeal to the District Magistrate & Collector.

schemes.title: Chief Minister Jan Arogya Yojana (CM-JAY Card)

State government employees can join if they give up the yearly medical allowance
Families already in PM-JAY keep using their Ayushman card instead
Every member needs their own card, made through Aadhaar e-KYC

Ration card, to find and link the family
A mobile number for the OTP
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC
