schemes.title: Ujjwala Free LPG Refill on Holi and Diwali (Muft Gas Cylinder)
schemes.department: Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, with Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum and HP Gas
schemes.brief: Families in Uttar Pradesh with a PM Ujjwala gas connection get the money for two 14.2 kg refills a year back from the state government: one between October and December (Diwali) and one between January and March (Holi). You book and pay for the cylinder as usual, and the money comes back into your Aadhaar-linked bank account in about 3 to 4 days. There is no form. The only condition is that the connection holder's Aadhaar authentication is done at the gas agency. The UP cabinet approved the 2026–27 round on 9 October 2026.
schemes.benefit: Two 14.2 kg refills a year free, with the money credited back to your bank account
eligibility: A PM Ujjwala (PMUY) gas connection in Uttar Pradesh
Aadhaar authentication (e-KYC) of the connection holder done at the gas agency
A bank account linked to Aadhaar, because the money goes only to the Aadhaar-linked account
One free refill in October–December and one in January–March. A refill outside these months is not refunded
The state approves the scheme again every year. The 2026–27 round runs from October 2026 to March 2027
documents: Aadhaar card of the connection holder
Gas consumer number or the LPG passbook (blue book)
Bank passbook of the account linked to Aadhaar
Mobile number registered with the gas agency
Ration card, if the agency asks to check the family
schemes.portalName: Your LPG distributor (Indian Oil, Bharat Gas or HP Gas)
schemes.submitAt: Nothing to fill in. The Ujjwala connection holder goes to her own LPG distributor (gas agency) in person with her Aadhaar card, the gas passbook or consumer number and the bank passbook, and gets the Aadhaar fingerprint authentication (e-KYC) done for free. Where the oil company's app offers it (IndianOil ONE, Hello BPCL, HP Pay), the e-KYC can also be done at home with Aadhaar face authentication.

demoFields.label: LPG consumer number
demoFields.hint: Printed on the gas passbook and on every cash memo.

demoFields.label: Connection type
demoFields.hint: The refund is only for Ujjwala connections. Ask the agency if you are not sure which type you have.

demoFields.label: Name of connection holder
demoFields.hint: The woman in whose name the Ujjwala connection was given. She must go for the authentication herself.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The connection holder's own Aadhaar. Her fingerprint or face is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Registered mobile
demoFields.hint: The number linked to the gas connection. The booking and delivery messages come here.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar authentication
demoFields.hint: It is done only once and is free. If it is pending, you will not get the refund.

demoFields.label: Bank account linked to Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Ask your bank to confirm this account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. The money goes only here.

demoFields.label: Refill booked on
demoFields.hint: Book between October and December for the Diwali refill, and between January and March for the Holi refill.

demoSteps: Ask your gas agency whether your Aadhaar authentication is done. If not, the connection holder goes there with her Aadhaar card and gas passbook and gives her fingerprint. It is free.
Make sure your bank account is linked to Aadhaar for DBT. Ask at your bank branch if you are not sure.
Between October and December, book a refill as usual (IVRS call, missed call, WhatsApp or the app). Pay the normal price at delivery and keep the cash memo.
In about 3 to 4 days the money is credited to your Aadhaar-linked bank account. Check the bank SMS or the passbook.
Between January and March, book one more refill the same way for the Holi refund.
If the money does not come, call the Ujjwala helpline 14438 or the UP food department toll-free number, with your consumer number and delivery date ready.
schemes.helpline: 14438 (Ujjwala helpline) / 1906 (LPG emergency) / 1800-1800-150 (UP Food & Civil Supplies toll-free)

schemes.title: Krishi Yantra Anudan — Farm Machinery Subsidy (Yantra Token Booking)
schemes.department: Agriculture Department (Krishi Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The UP Agriculture Department pays 40–50% of the price of farm machines such as rotavators, seed drills, threshers, sprayers, super seeders, happy seeders and agricultural drones. Farmer groups setting up a farm machinery bank or custom hiring centre get up to 80%. Booking opens online on the Agri Darshan portal a few times a year: in 2026 it opened in February–March and again in July. Selected farmers get a token, buy the machine from a listed dealer, and upload the bill and a photo. After a check, the subsidy is paid into their bank account.
schemes.benefit: 40–50% of the machine price for farmers; up to 80% for farmer groups and machinery banks
eligibility: A farmer of Uttar Pradesh registered with the Agriculture Department, with the registration linked to Aadhaar, land record and bank account
Farm land in your own name, as shown in the Khatauni
Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher 50% share. Other farmers get 40%
A refundable security deposit is paid when booking: Rs.2,500 if the subsidy is Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, and Rs.5,000 if it is above Rs.1 lakh
One booking per mobile number in each window. Farmers are picked first-come-first-served, or by e-lottery when bookings exceed the district target
The machine must be bought within the days given on the token, or the token is cancelled
documents: Farmer registration number from the Agriculture Department
Aadhaar card
Khatauni (land record)
Bank passbook of the Aadhaar-linked account in the farmer's name
Mobile number for OTP
Caste certificate, for SC or ST farmers
After buying: the dealer's GST bill and a photo of the farmer with the machine, showing its serial number
schemes.portalName: Agri Darshan — UP Agriculture Department portal

demoFields.label: Registration No
demoFields.hint: Your farmer registration number with the Agriculture Department. If you do not have one, register first with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details.

demoFields.label: Mobile No
demoFields.hint: The OTP comes here. Only one booking is allowed per mobile number, but you may use the number of a parent, brother, sister, son or daughter.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Where your land is. Targets are fixed district by district.

demoFields.label: Scheme
demoFields.hint: Choose the crop residue scheme (CRM) for super seeders, happy seeders, mulchers and balers.

demoFields.label: Machine
demoFields.hint: Choose the exact machine and size. The subsidy amount for it is shown on the screen.

demoFields.label: Farmer category
demoFields.hint: Small and marginal, SC/ST and women farmers get the higher share. It must match your land record and certificates.

demoFields.label: Subsidy amount
demoFields.hint: The fixed subsidy for that machine. You pay the full price to the dealer and this amount comes back to you.

demoFields.label: Security amount
demoFields.hint: Rs.2,500 for a subsidy of Rs.10,001 to Rs.1 lakh, Rs.5,000 above that. It is refunded as the rules say.

demoFields.label: Dealer
demoFields.hint: Buy only from a dealer listed on the portal for that machine, or the subsidy is not paid.

demoSteps: If you are not yet registered, register as a farmer on agridarshan.up.gov.in with Aadhaar, Khatauni and bank details, and note your registration number.

When booking opens (watch the news or ask the block agriculture office), open the portal, go to Kisan Corner, choose Yantra Booking, log in with the registration number and OTP, pick the scheme and machine, and pay the security amount.
Your token is confirmed by SMS, either straight away (first-come-first-served) or after the district e-lottery.
Within the days given on the token, buy the machine from a listed dealer at full price and take a GST bill.
Upload the bill and a photo of yourself with the machine on the portal. The block or district team checks the machine in person.
After the check, the subsidy is paid into your Aadhaar-linked bank account by DBT, and the security amount is refunded as the scheme rules say.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-1551 (Kisan Call Centre) / 1076 (CM Helpline); Deputy Director Agriculture office in your district

schemes.title: UP Bhulekh — Khatauni and Khasra Land Records
schemes.department: Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: UP Bhulekh is where you see and print the khatauni, the record of rights for a piece of land in Uttar Pradesh, and the khasra showing the plot and the crop. It is free and needs no login. Farm schemes, crop loans and mutation applications all ask for the khatauni.
schemes.benefit: Free khatauni and khasra copies, searchable by plot, khata number or owner name
eligibility: Land situated in Uttar Pradesh and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view and print a record; no login and no fee
A certified copy for court or bank use is issued by the tehsil, not by this portal
Only the recorded holder or an heir can apply to change a record
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khasra or gata number, or the khata number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, if you go on to apply for a mutation at the tehsil
Registered sale deed or succession papers, for a mutation

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khasra number, khata number, or owner's name. Khasra number gives the cleanest result; searching by name returns every similar name in the village.

demoFields.label: Khasra / Gata Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older khatauni or from the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khata Number
demoFields.hint: The account number. It covers every plot you hold in that one village, so it is quicker if you own several.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.value: Ram Naresh Yadav, son of Sita Ram
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search by the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: Khatauni for the record of rights, khasra for the plot and crop details, real-time khatauni for the current position including pending mutations.

demoFields.label: Captcha
demoFields.hint: The site asks for it on every search. It is the only thing standing between you and the record.

demoSteps: Open upbhulekh.gov.in and choose the record you want — khatauni, khasra or the real-time khatauni.
Select district, tehsil and village, then search by khasra number, khata number or owner's name and enter the captcha.
Check the area, the owner's name and the share against what you know, and print the copy. There is no fee.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy — the portal's print is for your own reference and is not stamped.
If the record is wrong, or a sale or a death has not been entered, apply for a mutation at the tehsil with the registered deed or the succession papers. It cannot be corrected from this portal.
Keep a printed khatauni with your papers. PM-Kisan, crop loans and state farm subsidies all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil office, or the Lekhpal of your village

schemes.title: UP Scholarship and fee reimbursement
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Pre-matric scholarships for classes 9 and 10 and post-matric scholarships with fee reimbursement for students above class 10, for SC, ST, OBC, general and minority students of Uttar Pradesh. Hindi and English. The application has two parts: you first register and get a registration number, then fill the full form, then print it and hand a signed copy with the documents to your own institution. Students without a computer at home usually do the whole thing at a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) or a cyber cafe, which is fine, but the printed copy must still reach the college.
schemes.benefit: Tuition fees reimbursed plus a maintenance allowance
eligibility: Domiciled in Uttar Pradesh, studying in an institution recognised by the state
Family income within the ceiling for the year: commonly Rs.2.5 lakh for SC and ST students and Rs.2 lakh for general, OBC and minority students in post-matric, with a lower ceiling for pre-matric
Caste certificate for SC, ST and OBC applicants, issued through UP e-District
Not drawing another government scholarship for the same course at the same time
Passed the previous class; students repeating a year are not eligible
documents: Aadhaar card, seeded with the student's own bank account
Caste certificate and its application number, from UP e-District
Income certificate and its application number, from UP e-District
Last passed class mark sheet and certificate
High school certificate, which is the accepted proof of date of birth
Institution's fee receipt and its registration number on the scholarship portal
Bank passbook first page in the student's own name

demoFields.label: Registration number
demoFields.hint: Generated the moment you register for the year. Write it down at once; you cannot log in again without it, and it is not sent by post.

demoFields.label: Student's name
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the high school certificate. The board record is what the portal checks against.

demoFields.label: Father's name
demoFields.hint: Again as on the high school certificate, not as on Aadhaar, if the two differ.

demoFields.label: Caste certificate application number
demoFields.hint: The long application number on the e-District certificate, not the certificate serial. The portal verifies it live, so a wrong digit stops the form.

demoFields.label: Income certificate application number
demoFields.hint: Same idea, from the e-District income certificate. It must be issued in the current session.

demoFields.label: Institute name and code
demoFields.hint: Take the code from your college office. Choosing the wrong college with a similar name sends your form to a place that will never verify it.

demoFields.label: Course and year
demoFields.hint: The class or year you are studying in now, in this session.

demoFields.label: High school roll number and year
demoFields.hint: Used to confirm your date of birth and your last passed class automatically.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Must be the student's own account with the Aadhaar seeded into it. A parent's or a joint account will not receive the money.

demoFields.label: IFSC code
demoFields.hint: From the first page of the passbook. Copy it letter by letter.

demoSteps: Before the window opens, get a fresh caste certificate and income certificate from UP e-District, because the scholarship form asks for their application numbers and checks them live.
Make sure the student's own bank account exists and is Aadhaar-seeded. Ask the bank branch to confirm the seeding.
Register on the UP Scholarship portal for the current session, choosing the right category (pre-matric or post-matric, and fresh or renewal). Note the registration number that appears.
Log in with that registration number and date of birth, and fill the full form as this sample shows.
Upload the documents, submit the form and take a printout of the final application.
Sign the printout, attach photocopies of the documents, and hand it in at your own school or college office. This physical step is compulsory and the form is rejected without it.
Ask the institution to forward and verify your application on their own login, and keep the receipt they give you.
Track the status on the portal with your registration number. If it shows a defect, correct it within the correction window, which is short and does not reopen.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2209270 (Social Welfare Department scholarship helpdesk)

schemes.title: UP BOCW Shramik Panjikaran (Construction Worker Labour Card)
schemes.department: Uttar Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UPBOCW), Labour Department
schemes.brief: Registering with the UP construction workers' board gives a construction worker a labour card. The card opens the family's main benefits: Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, money at childbirth, school and college help for two children, a Rs.1,000 monthly pension after 60, and up to Rs.5 lakh if the worker dies in an accident. Masons, helpers, carpenters, bar benders, plumbers, electricians, painters, tile workers and road and building labourers can all register. You register online with Aadhaar e-KYC (or at a CSC) and renew the card to keep the benefits.
schemes.benefit: Rs.65,000 for a daughter's marriage, Rs.20,000–25,000 at childbirth, Rs.1,000 monthly pension, Rs.5 lakh on accidental death
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years
Has done at least 90 days of building or other construction work in the last 12 months
Works in Uttar Pradesh and is not registered with the construction board of another state
Pays a Rs.20 registration fee once, plus Rs.20 for each year of membership chosen (1, 2 or 3 years). One year costs Rs.40 in all
Most benefits (marriage, maternity, serious illness) start after 1 year of membership. The pension needs 10 years of membership and age 60
Benefits go to at most two children, and you must apply within 1 year of the event
documents: Aadhaar card, with OTP on the Aadhaar-linked mobile for e-KYC
Certificate of 90 days of work from the contractor or employer, or the board's self-declaration form
Family ID or ration card, to add family members
Bank passbook of an account in the worker's own name
Recent colour photo
Mobile number

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: The worker's own Aadhaar. Your name, date of birth and address are filled in from Aadhaar after the OTP.

demoFields.label: Enter 6-digit OTP
demoFields.hint: The OTP goes to the mobile linked with Aadhaar. If that number is lost, get it updated at an Aadhaar centre first.

demoFields.label: Mobile
demoFields.hint: Your Aadhaar-linked number or any other number you keep. The approval SMS and login messages come here.

demoFields.label: Family ID / Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: Pick Family ID or Ration Card, enter the number, and the family members appear. Tick each member who should be linked to your card.

demoFields.label: Present Address
demoFields.hint: Where you live and work now, if it is different from the address on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Nature of Work
demoFields.hint: The construction work you actually do, for example helper, carpenter, plumber, painter or bar bender.

demoFields.label: Worked Days (last 12 months)
demoFields.hint: It must be 90 days or more. The work certificate you upload has to show the same number.

demoFields.label: Contractor Name / Contractor Mobile No.
demoFields.hint: The contractor or employer who gave you the 90-day certificate. The office may call this number.

demoFields.label: IFSC / Account Number
demoFields.hint: Your own account. Benefit money is paid only by DBT into this account.

demoFields.label: Registration period
demoFields.hint: Choose 1, 2 or 3 years. Each year costs Rs.20 more. The Rs.20 registration fee is paid only once.

demoSteps: Open labour.upbocw.in and tap Register. Enter your Aadhaar number, tick the consent and verify with the OTP. Your details come from Aadhaar. Then enter a mobile number and set a password.
Log in and complete each part of the profile: personal details, family ID or ration card members, present address, work details and bank details.
Upload your photo and the 90-day work certificate, then tick the self-declaration.
Choose 1, 2 or 3 years and pay the fee online. Save the application number and the payment receipt.
The Labour Enforcement Officer at the district labour office checks the application. You get an SMS when it is approved.
Log in and download your labour card. Renew it up to one month before it expires, because benefits stop on an expired card.
After one year of membership, apply for benefits (daughter's marriage, maternity, children's education) from the same login or at a CSC, within 1 year of the event.
schemes.helpline: 1800-180-5412 (UPBOCW toll-free); district Labour Office (Shram Karyalaya)

schemes.title: UPSSSC PET and Group C Recruitment
schemes.department: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
schemes.brief: Almost every Group C job in Uttar Pradesh — Lekhpal, Village Development Officer, Junior Assistant, Forest Guard, Junior Engineer — now runs through one screening exam, the Preliminary Eligibility Test. You must hold a valid PET score before you can apply to any of those posts, so the PET is the door and the post comes after.
schemes.benefit: One PET score that qualifies you for every UPSSSC Group C recruitment for a year
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh for the reserved quotas; open to others on the unreserved seats
Age 18 to 40 for most posts, with relaxation for SC, ST, OBC and disability
Class 10 passed for the PET itself; each later post sets its own qualification
A PET score is valid for one year, and a fresh PET must be taken after that
documents: Aadhaar card
Class 10 certificate for date of birth
Class 12 and degree certificates, for the posts that need them
Caste certificate on the UP format, for a reserved category
Domicile certificate of Uttar Pradesh
Disability certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on Class 10 certificate)
demoFields.hint: The Class 10 certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is matched against it.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, used to keep one candidate to one registration.

demoFields.label: Category and sub-category
demoFields.value: OBC; no disability; not an ex-serviceman
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a UP-format certificate for. Age relaxation and the fee both follow from this.

demoFields.label: Domicile
demoFields.hint: Reserved-category benefits are for UP domiciles only. A candidate from another state competes on the unreserved seats.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: For the PET itself Class 10 is enough. The post you later apply for sets its own requirement, and it must be complete on that notification's closing date.

demoFields.label: PET Registration / Roll Number
demoFields.hint: Generated when you register. Your PET score is tied to it and every later application asks for it.

demoFields.label: Preferred examination district
demoFields.hint: Give two or three choices. The commission allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: Admit card and every notification come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's number.

demoSteps: Register on upsssc.gov.in for the Preliminary Eligibility Test when the notification opens, entering your name and date of birth exactly as on the Class 10 certificate.
Fill category, domicile and qualification, upload the photograph and signature, pay the fee online and keep the registration number.
Download the admit card about a week before the exam and sit the PET. The score decides which posts you can go on to apply for.
When the score is published, note it with your registration number. It stays valid for one year.
Apply to individual posts — Lekhpal, VDO, Junior Assistant and the rest — as those notifications open, using the same login and your PET score.
Those posts have a main exam and, for some, a typing or physical test. Certificate verification comes last, where the originals of everything you claimed must be produced.
Take the PET again before your score expires, or you drop out of every Group C recruitment until you do.
schemes.helpline: UPSSSC candidate helpdesk, contact details on upsssc.gov.in

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan (MMJAA Ayushman Card)
schemes.department: State Agency for Comprehensive Health and Integrated Services (SACHIS), Medical Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Uttar Pradesh's own health cover for poor families who were left out of Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. It gives the same Rs.5 lakh a year of free, cashless hospital treatment for the whole family at empanelled government and private hospitals, fully paid by the state. Covered families get the same Ayushman card, made free on the Ayushman portal or app, at a CSC, or at the Ayushman Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital. It has run since 1 March 2019 and is managed by SACHIS.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, same as the Ayushman card
eligibility: Poor families who should have been covered by PM-JAY but were missed in the SECC 2011 list, and were later found in the state's own surveys
All Antyodaya (AAY) ration card families of Uttar Pradesh, added in July 2021
Construction workers registered with the UP BOCW board, and other groups the state government notifies
There is no limit on family size or age. Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
You cannot sign up on your own: the family's name must already be in the list. Check with Am I Eligible on the Ayushman portal or call 1800-1800-4444
Everyone aged 70 and above, whatever the income, gets the separate Ayushman Vay Vandana card
documents: Aadhaar card of the member whose card is being made
Ration card (Antyodaya) or UP Family ID, to find the family in the list
Mobile number for OTP
A live photo, taken on the phone during e-KYC
Labour card, if the family is covered as a registered construction worker
schemes.portalName: Ayushman beneficiary portal (NHA, linked from SACHIS)

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you are making the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you keep. The login OTP and the approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Choose the state Uttar Pradesh. State scheme families are searched from the same Ayushman list. If MMJAA appears in the scheme list for UP, choose that.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Antyodaya families can search by ration card number. Others can search by Aadhaar, Family ID or name.

demoFields.label: Ration card / family number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with the Aadhaar number of the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: The Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar. Otherwise choose face authentication on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets rejected.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: How this member is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in, log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP, choose Uttar Pradesh, and search for your family by ration card, Aadhaar or Family ID.
If your family's names appear, you are covered, whether under PM-JAY or the state's MMJAA. The card and the hospital benefit are the same.
Tap the Aadhaar icon next to a member marked eKYC pending, verify with an Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo and fill in the relation, district and PIN code.
Submit. SACHIS usually approves it within a day or two. Then open Download Card, verify with OTP and save the card on your phone.
If your family is not found, ask at the Ayushman Mitra desk of the nearest government hospital or at a CSC, or call 1800-1800-4444. A family that is not in the list cannot be added online.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk. Never pay cash for a treatment covered by the scheme.
schemes.helpline: 1800-1800-4444 (SACHIS, Uttar Pradesh toll-free) / 14555 (national Ayushman helpline)

schemes.title: UP Family ID — Ek Parivar Ek Pehchan
schemes.department: Department of Planning, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: A single twelve-digit number for the whole family, meant to become the one record Uttar Pradesh checks before giving any benefit. A family that already has a ration card is given the ration card number as its Family ID; families without one register fresh. It is free and is done online or at a Jan Seva Kendra.
schemes.benefit: One family identity number linked to state welfare schemes and employment records
eligibility: Family living in Uttar Pradesh, with every member's Aadhaar linked to a mobile number
A family holding a ration card already has a Family ID — its ration card number — and need not register again
Only families with no ration card register fresh
One ID per family; a member can appear in only one family
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Mobile number linked to the head of the family's Aadhaar
Ration card, if the family holds one
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or voter ID
Bank passbook of the head of the family

demoFields.label: Do you hold a ration card?
demoFields.hint: If yes, your ration card number is already your Family ID — just search and print it, do not register again.

demoFields.label: Head of the Family (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: The whole registration is made in this person's name, and the OTP goes to the mobile linked to their Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Every member is then added against this.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Must be the number linked to the head's Aadhaar, since each member is verified by OTP.

demoFields.label: Members of the family (name, relation, Aadhaar)
demoFields.value: 1. Ram Naresh Yadav, self, 9999 6231 8074; 2. Sushila Devi, wife, 9999 4408 1123; 3. Anjali Yadav, daughter, 9999 7735 0296
demoFields.hint: Everyone who lives in the household. Each member's Aadhaar is verified by an OTP to their own linked mobile, so keep the family together when you fill this.

demoFields.label: Full Address with district, tehsil and village or ward
demoFields.value: Gram Rampur Kalan, Post Dariyabad, Tehsil Ramsanehighat, District Barabanki, 225414
demoFields.hint: Where the family actually lives. The Lekhpal or the ward staff verify at this address.

demoFields.label: Category (SC / ST / OBC / General)
demoFields.hint: Recorded for scheme eligibility. It changes nothing about whether the ID is issued.

demoFields.label: Bank Account of the Head and IFSC
demoFields.hint: Used to link state benefits later. It should be Aadhaar-seeded.

demoSteps: First search familyid.up.gov.in with your ration card number. If the family holds a ration card, the Family ID already exists — print it and stop there.
If there is no ration card, register the head of the family with Aadhaar and the linked mobile, and confirm the OTP.
Add every member with their Aadhaar. Each one is verified by an OTP sent to that member's own Aadhaar-linked mobile, so have the family present while you do it.
Fill the address, category and bank details, submit, and note the application number.
The Lekhpal or the ward-level officer verifies the household. Be available at the address; an unverified application does not proceed.
Once approved, download and print the Family ID from the same site. Keep it with your papers — state schemes and recruitment forms increasingly ask for it.
schemes.helpline: 1076 — UP Chief Minister's helpline

schemes.title: UP e-District certificates, caste, income and domicile
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Caste (jati), income (aay) and domicile (nivas) certificates, along with khatauni copies, disability certificates and birth and death records. Hindi and English. A citizen login exists, but in practice most applications go through a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC), because the operator knows the formats the lekhpal expects and the fee is fixed and small. The lekhpal visits or checks the household record, the tehsildar signs it digitally, and you download the certificate; it needs no further attestation.
schemes.benefit: Digitally signed certificate, normally within 15 working days
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh, applying in the tehsil where you actually live
A mobile number for the OTP, and the household traceable in the lekhpal's records
For a caste certificate, a family record of the caste: the father's certificate, an older relative's certificate, or an affidavit where nothing exists on paper
documents: Aadhaar card
Ration card, or an electricity bill or voter ID as proof of residence
Self-declaration (swaghoshna patra) on the format the portal provides, signed
Recent passport photograph
For a caste certificate: the father's or a close relative's caste certificate, or an affidavit
For an income certificate: salary slip for the employed, or a declaration for farming and daily-wage households

demoFields.label: Applicant's name (Hindi and English)
demoFields.hint: The certificate prints in Hindi, so fill the Hindi box carefully. Type it as it appears on your Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Father's or husband's name
demoFields.hint: Whichever the certificate is to be issued against. For a married woman the husband's name is usual for a domicile certificate.

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Caste, income and domicile are three separate applications with three separate fees. Apply for each one you need.

demoFields.label: Tehsil and district
demoFields.hint: This decides which lekhpal and tehsildar handle your file. Choosing a tehsil you do not live in guarantees a rejection.

demoFields.label: Full address
demoFields.hint: The address as the lekhpal knows it. Add the village and post office, not just the town.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the last year, from all sources including farming. State it honestly; the lekhpal checks.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Scholarship for my son's college admission
demoFields.hint: Say what you need it for. Scholarship applications later ask for this certificate's application number.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Used to confirm your identity and pull in your name.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the download link come here by SMS, so use a number you will keep.

demoSteps: Decide which certificate you need and gather the papers for it. A caste certificate needs some family record of the caste, so ask an elder for the oldest certificate in the house.
Fill in the self-declaration form. Download the format from the portal, write it out, sign it, and photograph it clearly.

Either register on the e-District portal with your mobile number and apply yourself, or take the papers to the nearest Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) and ask the operator to file it. The CSC route costs the notified fee, usually a small fixed amount, and is what most families use.
Fill the application as this sample shows, being careful with the Hindi spelling of names and the tehsil.
Upload the documents, pay the fee and submit. Keep the application number safe; everything afterwards depends on it.
The lekhpal verifies the household and sends a report up to the kanungo and then the tehsildar.
When it is issued, download the digitally signed certificate from the portal with the application number. It is valid as it is and needs no stamp or attestation.
If the deadline passes with no answer, take the application number to the tehsil day (tehsil diwas) or complain on the Jansunwai portal.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2304706 (e-District helpdesk)

schemes.title: UP Samajik Pension — Old Age, Widow and Divyangjan
schemes.department: Social Welfare, Women Welfare and Divyangjan Empowerment Departments, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Uttar Pradesh runs its three social pensions — old age, destitute women, and Divyangjan or leprosy — through one portal, SSPY. The money reaches the pensioner's own bank account every quarter, and the same site shows whether it has been sanctioned and paid.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month, paid quarterly into the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Uttar Pradesh, applying in the district where the applicant lives
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; no age bar for the widow or Divyangjan pension
Family income up to Rs.46,080 a year in rural areas and Rs.56,460 in urban areas
Disability of 40 per cent or more, certified by the Chief Medical Officer, for the Divyangjan pension
Not drawing any other government pension
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or school certificate
Income certificate from e-District
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Disability certificate showing 40 per cent or more, for a Divyangjan pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Recent passport photograph
Caste certificate, where the applicant claims a reserved category

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age, widow or destitute woman, or Divyangjan and leprosy. Each opens a different form on the portal.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Husband's / Father's Name
demoFields.hint: Write 'Late' before the name where he has died; for the widow pension it must match the death certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: There is no minimum age for the widow pension. For the old-age pension you must be 60 or above on the date of application.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly verification both run on this.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The District Social Welfare Officer of this district sanctions the pension.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Must be within Rs.46,080 in rural areas or Rs.56,460 in urban areas. Attach the income certificate you got from e-District.

demoFields.label: Supporting certificate number
demoFields.hint: The death certificate for a widow pension, or the disability certificate number and percentage for a Divyangjan pension.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: In the applicant's own name, not a son's or daughter's, and Aadhaar-seeded. Upload the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The registration number and every credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the income certificate from e-District first, and the death or disability certificate if the pension needs one. The application cannot be completed without them.
Open sspy-up.gov.in, choose your pension type and fill the online application, uploading the photograph, the certificates and the passbook page.
Submit and note the registration number. Log in again with it to make any correction before the district office takes the file up.
The application is verified at the block or tehsil level — for the widow pension by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate's office, for Divyangjan by the district disability officer.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited quarterly to the account. The same portal shows the sanction and each payment against your registration number.
Complete the yearly verification when asked, or the payment stops. If the application is refused, the reason is shown on the portal; fix it and apply again, or take it up on the 1076 helpline.
schemes.helpline: 1076 — UP Chief Minister's helpline

schemes.title: Uttar Pradesh Ration Card
schemes.department: Food and Civil Supplies Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The NFSA ration card that brings subsidised wheat and rice from the fair price shop in Uttar Pradesh, in two kinds — Antyodaya for the poorest households and Household for the rest. The FCS portal is where you check the eligibility list, add or remove a member, download the e-ration card and complain if the shop refuses grain.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month; 35 kg per family for an Antyodaya card
eligibility: Family resident in Uttar Pradesh and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household inside the state's NFSA list, and not excluded by land, income, vehicle or government service
A woman of the household aged 18 or above is recorded as the head of the family
Every member's Aadhaar must be seeded, or that member's grain is not issued
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, house tax receipt or voter ID
Deletion certificate from the previous card, where a member or the family has moved
Income certificate or a self-declaration of income
Passport photograph of the head of the family
Bank passbook copy and the gas connection number
schemes.portalName: UP Food and Civil Supplies portal

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, or correct a detail. A new card is filed at the tehsil supply office or a Jan Seva Kendra; the rest can be started online.

demoFields.label: Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: From the front of the card. Leave it blank only for a brand new card.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: A woman of the household aged 18 or above. The card is issued in her name.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The family's whole entitlement is tracked against this.

demoFields.label: Member to be added, relation and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: Name as on that person's Aadhaar, and how they are related to the head. A newborn's Aadhaar must be made first.

demoFields.label: Reason and supporting certificate
demoFields.hint: A newborn needs the birth certificate. A bride needs the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from her parents' card.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this address.

demoFields.label: Fair Price Shop Name or Code
demoFields.hint: Printed on the card and on the shop's board. It tells the office which register to update.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Search fcs.up.gov.in first to see whether the family is already on the NFSA eligibility list, and download the e-ration card if it is.
For a new card or a correction, fill the application and hand it in at the tehsil supply office or a Jan Seva Kendra, with Aadhaar for every member and the address proof.

For an addition, attach the birth certificate for a newborn, or the marriage certificate and the deletion certificate from the old card for a bride. Without the deletion certificate the system blocks the addition as a duplicate.
Keep the acknowledgement with its application number; every follow-up runs on it.
The supply inspector verifies the family at the address, usually within two to four weeks.
Once the card is issued or updated, download the e-ration card from the portal and check every name and Aadhaar on it.

Get the new member's Aadhaar seeded at the fair price shop's ePoS machine. Until that is done the family's quantity does not increase. If the shop refuses grain that is due, complain on the same portal and on 1967.
schemes.helpline: 1967 and 1800 1800 150 — UP Food and Civil Supplies

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Kanya Sumangala)
schemes.department: Directorate of Women Welfare, Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Rs.25,000 for a daughter, paid in six parts from her birth until she joins college, straight into the mother's bank account (the father's or guardian's if the mother is not alive). The family applies online at each stage: birth, full vaccination, and admission to Class 1, Class 6, Class 9 and a degree or diploma. The total was raised from Rs.15,000 to Rs.25,000 from 1 April 2024.
eligibility: The family lives permanently in Uttar Pradesh and has proof of residence
Family income is up to Rs.3 lakh a year
Up to two daughters of one family can get it. If the second delivery gives twin girls, all three girls are covered. Legally adopted daughters count within the two
Stage 1 (Rs.5,000) is for a girl born on or after 1 April 2019. Stage 2 (Rs.2,000) is for full vaccination, for a girl born on or after 1 April 2018

Stages 3 to 5 (Rs.3,000, Rs.3,000, Rs.5,000) are for admission to Class 1, Class 6 and Class 9 in the current school year. Stage 6 (Rs.7,000) is for admission to a degree or a diploma of at least 2 years after passing Class 10 or 12
Aadhaar of the applicant, father and mother is compulsory. The girl's own Aadhaar is needed from Stage 3 onward
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant, father and mother (and the girl from Stage 3 onward)
Proof of permanent residence in Uttar Pradesh
Bank passbook of the mother (the father's or guardian's if she is not alive; the girl's own for Stage 6)
Recent photo of the girl
Stage 1: birth certificate number. Stage 2: vaccination card
Stages 3 to 5: admission certificate from the school, or only the Student Unique ID if it is a government school
Stage 6: Class 10 or 12 marksheet, the institute ID and the admission fee receipt
Death certificate if the mother or father has died

demoFields.label: Applicant type
demoFields.hint: Who is applying: mother, father or guardian. A grown-up girl can apply for herself, but only for Stage 6.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name
demoFields.hint: Write it exactly as on the applicant's Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you keep. The OTP, your login ID and password, and every status message come here. One number can be used for only one family.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now. Choose your town or nagar panchayat instead of a block if you live in a town.

demoFields.label: Mother's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The mother's 12-digit Aadhaar. The father's Aadhaar is asked for in the next box.

demoFields.label: Father's Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Needed even when the mother is the applicant. If the father has died, upload his death certificate instead.

demoFields.label: Girl's name and date of birth
demoFields.hint: Write it as on the birth certificate. Always use the same spelling at every later stage.

demoFields.label: Category (stage)
demoFields.hint: Choose the stage the girl has reached now. Apply in the same school year as the admission.

demoFields.label: Birth certificate number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the online birth certificate. The portal checks this number by itself.

demoFields.label: Bank account number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The mother's own account, linked to her Aadhaar. Copy both numbers from the first page of the passbook.

demoSteps: Open mksy.up.gov.in and tap Citizen Services Portal (Apply Here). Tick I agree, tap Continue and register with your mobile number and OTP. Your login ID and password come by SMS.
Log in and fill in the form: applicant, Aadhaar of the father and mother, address, income declaration, bank account, the girl's details and the stage you are applying for.
Upload the girl's photo and the documents for that stage, then submit. Write down the application number.
The block office (villages) or the tehsil (towns) checks the form, and the District Probation Officer's office approves it. You can see the status after you log in.
After approval the money is paid through PFMS into the mother's account. Check the bank passbook or SMS.

When the girl reaches the next stage, log in again with the same ID and apply for that stage in the same school year. Do not make a new registration for the same girl, or every application for her gets rejected.
schemes.helpline: 181 (Mahila Helpline, UP Women Welfare) / 1076 (CM Helpline); District Probation Officer's office in your district

schemes.title: Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
schemes.department: Social Welfare Department (Samaj Kalyan Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: The UP government spends Rs.1 lakh on each couple married at a mass wedding it organises. Rs.64,000 goes into the bride's bank account, Rs.21,000 is given as household gifts and Rs.15,000 pays for the ceremony. The total was earlier Rs.51,000. It is for brides from poor families of every religion with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year, and also for widowed, abandoned or legally divorced women who are remarrying. The bride applies online with her Aadhaar, and the wedding is held at a block, town or district mass wedding run by the District Social Welfare Officer.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,00,000 per couple: Rs.64,000 to the bride's account, Rs.21,000 in gifts, Rs.15,000 for the ceremony
eligibility: The bride's parents or guardians are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh. The bride herself must be an adult and applies herself
The family is poor or needy, with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year
On the wedding date the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21
The bride is unmarried, or is a widow, an abandoned woman or a legally divorced woman who is remarrying
SC, ST and OBC applicants must give a caste certificate. Orphan girls, daughters of widows or disabled parents, and girls with a disability get priority
She must not take marriage money from any other central or state scheme for this wedding
documents: Aadhaar card of the bride and the groom
Age proof of both: school record, birth certificate, voter ID, MGNREGA job card or Aadhaar
Income certificate (family income up to Rs.3 lakh a year)
Residence proof of Uttar Pradesh
Caste certificate (for SC, ST and OBC)
Bride's bank passbook, for an account in her own name linked to Aadhaar
Recent photos of the bride and the groom
For remarriage: the former husband's death certificate or the court's divorce decree

demoFields.label: Document Type
demoFields.hint: Choose Aadhaar. Use the 16-digit VID or a driving licence only if you cannot use the Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: 12-digit Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The bride's own Aadhaar, not her father's. The form is filled in the bride's name.

demoFields.label: Contact mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number the family keeps. The OTP and every SMS about the form, the wedding date and the payment come here.

demoFields.label: Declaration
demoFields.hint: You confirm that no other government scheme is giving marriage money for this wedding. If this is found false, the money is recovered.

demoFields.label: Bride's name / Father's name
demoFields.hint: Write both exactly as on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Bride's date of birth
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or older on the wedding date. Upload the age proof that shows this date.

demoFields.label: District / Block or urban body
demoFields.hint: Choose your block if you live in a village, or your nagar panchayat, nagar palika or nagar nigam if you live in a town.

demoFields.label: Annual family income
demoFields.hint: Write the figure from the income certificate. It must be Rs.3 lakh or less.

demoFields.label: Groom's name / Aadhaar / date of birth
demoFields.hint: The groom must be 21 or older on the wedding date. His Aadhaar is checked again at the venue.

demoFields.label: Bride's bank account and IFSC
demoFields.hint: An account in the bride's own name, linked to her Aadhaar. The Rs.64,000 is paid only into this account.

demoSteps: Open cmsvy.upsdc.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें), then the link to fill the application. Choose Aadhaar, enter the bride's Aadhaar number and mobile, tick the declaration and tap Verify.
Fill in the bride's, family's, groom's and bank details, upload the photos and certificates, and submit. Write down the form number.

The block verifier (villages) or the urban body verifier (towns) checks the details, and the District Social Welfare Officer approves the form. The status comes by SMS. You can correct a form only after an SMS asks you to.
An SMS gives the date and venue of the mass wedding. The bride and groom go there with their Aadhaar cards, are checked at the venue and are married by their own rites.
The gifts are handed over at the venue. Rs.64,000 is transferred to the bride's bank account after the wedding.
Print the marriage certificate from the portal (Print Marriage Certificate) and keep it for the marriage registration and other records.
schemes.helpline: 0522-2209259 (Samuhik Vivah helpline) / 0522-3538700 (Social Welfare Directorate, Lucknow) / 1076 (CM Helpline)

schemes.title: Bhulekh Uttarakhand — Khatauni and Land Records
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Government of Uttarakhand
schemes.brief: Bhulekh Uttarakhand is where a landholder in the state sees and prints the khatauni, the record of rights, and the khasra for a plot. It is free and needs no login. Most rural schemes, crop loans and mutation applications ask for the khatauni.
schemes.benefit: Free khatauni and khasra copies, searchable by plot, khata number or owner name
eligibility: Land situated in Uttarakhand and entered in the revenue record
Anyone may view and print a record; no login and no fee
A certified copy for a bank or a court is issued by the tehsil, not printed from the site
Only the recorded holder or an heir can apply to change a record
documents: District, tehsil and village name
Khasra number, or the khata number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, if you go on to file a mutation at the tehsil
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and succession papers, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all three from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Search by
demoFields.hint: Khasra number, khata number, or owner's name. Khata covers every plot you hold in that village.

demoFields.label: Khasra Number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from an older khatauni or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Khata Number
demoFields.hint: The account number. It is the quicker search if you own several plots in the village.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.value: Mahendra Singh Negi, son of Bachan Singh
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first.

demoFields.label: Record wanted
demoFields.hint: Khatauni for the record of rights and the share; khasra for the plot and its details.

demoFields.label: Captcha
demoFields.hint: Asked on every search. It is the only step between you and the record.

demoSteps: Open bhulekh.uk.gov.in and pick district, tehsil and village, then search by khasra number, khata number or owner's name.
Check the area, the owner's name and the share against what you know, and print the copy. There is no fee.
For a bank or a court, ask the tehsil for a certified copy — the print from the site is for your own reference.
If a sale or a death has not been entered, file the mutation at the tehsil with the registered deed or the succession papers. It cannot be done from this site.
After a mutation order, pull a fresh khatauni and check that the name and share are right.
Keep a current khatauni with your papers. PM-Kisan, crop loans and state rural schemes all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your tehsil office, or the patwari of your village circle

schemes.title: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana (Ayushman Golden Card)
schemes.department: State Health Authority, Uttarakhand (Medical Health & Family Welfare Department)
schemes.brief: Free, cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year per family for almost every family in Uttarakhand. Families on the central PM-JAY list are covered by PM-JAY, and the state covers all the other resident families under Atal Ayushman on the same terms, hospitals and packages. The Ayushman (golden) card is made from your ration card or family register, on the phone or at a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC).
schemes.benefit: Rs 5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Uttarakhand families found in any of these lists: NFSA ration card data, the old Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana, SECC 2011 or SECC Plus
No income limit and no limit on family size; every member is covered
Not for people covered by CGHS, ECHS, ESIC or the State Government Health Scheme (state employees and pensioners have their own SGHS card)
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
Atal Ayushman uses a referral system, so planned treatment at a private hospital may first need a referral from a government hospital
documents: Aadhaar card of each member
Family ID: ration card (new or old) or a copy of the family register (Parivar Register)
If you have neither: an ID such as voter ID, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, PAN or passport showing your father's, mother's or spouse's name
Mobile number for OTP
A live photo taken during e-KYC

demoFields.label: Login as
demoFields.hint: Choose Beneficiary when you make the card for yourself or your family.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP and approval message come here.

demoFields.label: Scheme and state
demoFields.hint: Pick Uttarakhand. Atal Ayushman families are on the same Ayushman system, so the search works for both.

demoFields.label: Search your family by
demoFields.hint: The ration card number brings up the whole family. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Ration card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from your ration card. If your family is not found, try Aadhaar or go to a Jan Seva Kendra.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number for e-KYC
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making. Each member is done separately.

demoFields.label: e-KYC method
demoFields.hint: Good for elderly people whose fingerprints do not scan. Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Live photo
demoFields.hint: Face straight, good light, no cap or dark glasses.

demoFields.label: Relation with head of family
demoFields.hint: Relation to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: District and PIN code
demoFields.hint: Where you live now, so nearby empanelled hospitals are shown.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose Uttarakhand and search your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Pick the member, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo, fill the details and submit.
The State Health Authority approves it, usually within a day or two. Log in again and download the card.
If your name is not found or e-KYC fails, take Aadhaar and the ration card or family register to a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) or the Arogya Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital.
When you need treatment, get a government hospital referral where required, then show the card at the Arogya Mitra desk. Treatment is cashless.
schemes.helpline: 155368 / 1800-180-5368 (State Health Authority, Uttarakhand) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)

schemes.title: Apuni Sarkar — Uttarakhand e-Services
schemes.department: Information Technology Development Agency, Government of Uttarakhand
schemes.brief: Apuni Sarkar is Uttarakhand's single window. Income, caste, domicile, character and permanent residence certificates and a long list of departmental services are applied for here, with a delivery time fixed for each under the state's Right to Service Act.
schemes.benefit: Income, caste, domicile and residence certificates with a guaranteed delivery time
eligibility: Resident of Uttarakhand, applying in the tehsil where the family lives
A permanent residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the state for the qualifying period
A caste certificate needs the caste to be on the Uttarakhand SC, ST or OBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Family register (parivar register) copy from the panchayat or the nagar nikay
Father's caste certificate or a school record, for a caste certificate
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, caste, permanent residence, character or a departmental service. Each has its own form, fee and delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family in the parivar register; essential for a caste certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Parivar Register entry
demoFields.hint: The family register entry from the panchayat or nagar nikay. Most Uttarakhand certificates are checked against it.

demoFields.label: Years resident in Uttarakhand
demoFields.hint: For the permanent residence certificate. The parivar register and old land or school records are what prove it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number

eligibility: Parents are permanent residents of Uttarakhand

schemes.title: Krishak Bandhu (Natun) - Farmer Assistance and Death Benefit (KB ID)
schemes.department: Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: Yearly cash help for farmers and share-croppers of West Bengal, paid straight into the bank in two equal parts, for the Kharif and Rabi seasons. If a registered farmer dies between 18 and 60, the family gets a one-time Rs.2 lakh. The 2019 Krishak Bandhu scheme was recast as Krishak Bandhu (Natun) in June 2021. From July 2026 the state is re-checking every existing beneficiary in the field, and money goes only to farmers who pass this check.
schemes.benefit: Rs.10,000 a year for 1 acre or more (minimum Rs.4,000); Rs.2 lakh on death
eligibility: A farmer of West Bengal who cultivates land as owner (raiyat), recorded bargadar (share-cropper), or holder of an agricultural or forest patta
The land must be in the land record (khatian or RoR) or the barga record. Heirs of a recorded owner can apply with a self-declaration and a warison certificate
1 acre or more of cultivable land: Rs.10,000 a year. Less than 1 acre: a share of that, but never less than Rs.4,000
Death benefit: the family of a registered farmer who dies between the ages of 18 and 60 gets Rs.2 lakh once
One enrolment per farmer only. The 2026 re-check also asks whether the farmer pays income tax, draws a regular government salary or pension, and gets PM-KISAN
documents: Filled application form with a stamp-size photo (2 cm x 2.5 cm)
Voter ID card (EPIC) - compulsory
Aadhaar card - compulsory
Latest RoR (khatian), agricultural or forest patta, or barga record
If the land is not yet in your name: the self-declaration form with the land deeds, and a warison certificate from the Gram Panchayat Pradhan
First page of the bank passbook or a cancelled cheque. A normal savings account (not Jan Dhan), Aadhaar-seeded, in a commercial, cooperative or Gramin bank
Mobile number linked with the bank account and Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The Krishak Bandhu desk at the office of the Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) of your block, applying in the block or Gram Panchayat where you hold most of your land. A Bangla Sahayata Kendra (BSK) can also enter the enrolment. The form is page 3 of the PDF linked here and the self-declaration for land not in your name is page 1; blank forms are free at the ADA office. Fill it in Bengali (English or Nepali in the hills), take the originals and one photocopy of each document, and keep the counterfoil with the Acknowledgement ID that the staff give you.

demoFields.hint: The number on your voter ID card.

demoFields.hint: From the first page of your passbook. Tick SB for a savings account.

demoSteps: Download the form from the link above or collect it free at the block ADA office, and fill page 3. If the land is still in a dead parent's name, also fill the self-declaration on page 1 and get a warison certificate from the Pradhan.
Attach the photocopies and paste your photo. Sign or give your thumb impression.
Hand it in at the Krishak Bandhu desk of the ADA office. Keep the counterfoil with the Acknowledgement ID.
Agriculture officers check your land against the land records and approve it; you get a KB ID. Check the status on krishakbandhu.wb.gov.in (Farmer Search) or on WhatsApp 9830383383.
The money comes into your bank account in two equal instalments, for Kharif and Rabi, with an SMS on your mobile.

If the farmer dies between 18 and 60, the family applies at the block ADA office with the death certificate, the farmer's voter or Aadhaar card, the eligible claimant certificate and the RoR, for the Rs.2 lakh.

schemes.title: Bina Mulya Samajik Suraksha Yojana (BMSSY - Samajik Mukti Card)
schemes.department: Labour Department (Labour Commissionerate), Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: Free social security for unorganised workers in West Bengal, such as shop and hotel workers, bidi and garment workers, hawkers, domestic workers, rickshaw pullers, and construction and transport workers. Once registered you get a Samajik Mukti Card with an SSIN number; the state puts Rs.55 a month into your provident fund and pays it back with interest at 60, and also gives money for treatment and surgery, children's studies, disability and death. It began in 2017 as Samajik Suraksha Yojana; since April 2020 the worker pays nothing, which is why it is called Bina Mulya (free). Construction and transport workers are also registered through this scheme.
schemes.benefit: Free PF (Rs.55 a month paid by the state), plus health, education and death help up to Rs.2 lakh
eligibility: Resident of West Bengal aged 18 to 60

Works in one of the 46 listed unorganised industries (for example bidi making, tailoring, hotels, rice mills, shops with fewer than 20 workers), or is self-employed in one of 15 listed jobs (hawker, domestic worker, barber, carpenter, fisherman, head-load worker, rickshaw or van puller, waste picker and others), or is a construction or transport worker
Family income not more than Rs.6,500 a month. There is no income limit for construction and transport workers
Not a member of EPF. The medical help is only for workers without ESI or another government health scheme
Help for children's studies needs at least one year of registration, for up to two children who do not get another scholarship such as SVMCM
documents: Filled Form-I (Parts I to IV), with Part IV certified by your employer, Gram Panchayat Pradhan, councillor or another listed public representative
Photocopy of the first page of your bank passbook
Voter ID card (EPIC) or Aadhaar card
Two recent colour passport-size photos (one pasted on the form)
Names, ages and Aadhaar numbers of dependent family members and of your nominee
For claims later: Form-V with hospital bills and discharge papers, death certificate, or the child's admission certificate and last marksheet
schemes.submitAt: The Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre (LWFC) at your Block Development Office or Municipality, or the Regional Labour Office of the Labour Commissionerate. You can also give it to the Self-Employed Labour Organiser (SLO) or Collecting Agent working in your area, or at a registration camp. Form-I is on pages 26 to 28 of the rules notification linked here, and blank forms are also given at the LWFC. Attach the documents, carry the originals, and keep the receipt with the application number. The Labour Inspector registers you and issues the Samajik Mukti Card with your SSIN.

demoFields.hint: Write the father's name, or the husband's name if you are married.

demoFields.hint: Your own mobile. Write Y and the BPL number only if your family has a BPL card.

demoFields.hint: Your work, from the listed industries or self-employed jobs. Give the employer's address if you work for one.

demoSteps: Collect Form-I at the Labour Welfare Facilitation Centre in your block or municipality office, or from the SLO of your area.
Fill Parts I to III (your details, family members and nominee), and get Part IV signed by your employer, Pradhan or councillor. Construction and transport workers also fill Part V.
Hand it in with the documents and photos, and keep the receipt with the application number.
The Labour Inspector checks it and registers you. You get the Samajik Mukti Card with your SSIN, and the state starts putting Rs.55 a month into your PF account.

For treatment or surgery (up to Rs.20,000 and Rs.60,000 a year), disability, death (Rs.2 lakh for accidental death, Rs.50,000 for normal death) or children's studies (Rs.4,000 to Rs.30,000 a year), apply in Form-V to the same office, within 3 months of discharge, accident or death.
The Assistant Labour Commissioner sanctions the claim and the money is sent to the bank account.
At 60, apply in Form-V for the full PF amount with interest.

schemes.title: West Bengal Old Age and Widow Pension
schemes.department: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department, West Bengal
schemes.brief: West Bengal pays a monthly pension to old people and to widows through its social security portal, alongside Lakshmir Bhandar. Applications are taken at Duare Sarkar camps and at the block or municipal office, and the money is credited to the pensioner's own bank account.
schemes.benefit: Monthly old-age or widow pension paid into the pensioner's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of West Bengal for at least ten years
Age 60 or above for the old-age pension; a widow of 18 or above for the widow pension
Family income within the state's limit, and the applicant not an income-tax payer
Not drawing any other government pension
Name on the digital ration card of the household
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Digital ration card
Age proof — Aadhaar, birth certificate or voter card
Death certificate of the husband, for a widow pension
Bank passbook in the applicant's own name, Aadhaar-seeded
Residence proof of West Bengal
Recent passport photograph
schemes.submitAt: At a Duare Sarkar camp in your area, or at the Block Development Office in a village or the municipality office in a town. The staff there fill in the form for you free.

demoFields.label: Type of pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Old age or widow. Each has its own age condition and its own supporting certificate.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. A spelling that differs from the bank record is why a sanctioned pension never arrives.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth / Age
demoFields.hint: For the old-age pension you must be 60 or above. For the widow pension 18 or above is enough.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Payment and the yearly verification both run on this.

demoFields.label: Digital Ration Card Number
demoFields.hint: The household's card. Eligibility is checked against it, so the applicant's name must be on it.

demoFields.label: District / Block or Municipality / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where you live. The BDO or the municipal office here processes the file.

demoFields.hint: From the death certificate of the husband. Leave it blank for the old-age pension.

demoFields.hint: The application number and every credit are announced here by SMS.

demoSteps: Collect the age proof, or the husband's death certificate for a widow pension, and a passbook in your own name before you start.
Apply at the next Duare Sarkar camp in your area, or at the block or municipal office, where the staff fill it in for you free.
Fill in the details from Aadhaar and the digital ration card and give a bank account in your own name that is Aadhaar-seeded.
Keep the application number from the acknowledgement; the portal shows the status against it.
The block or municipal office verifies the applicant and the household's income, and may call you in.
Once sanctioned, the pension is credited to the account each month. Check the first credit and tell the block office at once if it does not arrive.
Do the yearly verification when asked, or the payment stops. If it is refused, the reason is shown on the portal and the gap can be fixed and filed again.

schemes.title: Annapurna Yojana (Annapurna Bhandar, formerly Lakshmir Bhandar)
schemes.department: Women and Child Development and Social Welfare Department, Government of West Bengal
schemes.brief: Annapurna Yojana pays Rs.3,000 every month to women of West Bengal aged 25 to 60, by DBT into her own bank account. It replaced Lakshmir Bhandar in 2026 under the new state government and is often called Annapurna Bhandar; the amount is now the same for every caste category. You hand in the Family Level Data Collection form at the Block Development Office, the Sub-Divisional Office or a Kolkata Municipal Corporation ward office, or submit it online on the state's social registry portal, where you can also check the status and file a grievance.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month for every eligible woman
eligibility: Woman residing in West Bengal, aged 25 to 60
Not in permanent government employment
Not an income-tax payer
Must not be an illegal immigrant; a voter ID card (EPIC) is required
A savings bank account in her own single name, Aadhaar-linked, in her sole holding and not a joint account
documents: Voter ID card (EPIC)
Aadhaar card
Active mobile number, for the OTP and payment messages
Bank passbook first page, in her own single name
schemes.submitAt: The Block Development Office (BDO) in rural areas, the Sub-Divisional Office (SDO), or the ward office in the Kolkata Municipal Corporation area. Take your voter ID card (EPIC), Aadhaar and your mobile phone. The form can also be submitted online at socialregistry.wb.gov.in.

demoFields.hint: Write it in block letters exactly as it appears on the Swasthya Sathi card. A different spelling on the bank passbook is what holds up most payments.

demoFields.label: Swasthya Sathi card number
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the card. If the family has a card but your name is not on it, get your name added first; the application depends on it.

demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The same Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account you give below.
